book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: br'shyt br' 'lhym 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vh'rts hyth thv vbhv vchshkh 'lpny thvm vrvch 'lhym mrchpt 'lpny hmym
verses.translation: Now the earth was unformed and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the spirit of God hovered over the face of the waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְהִ֣י א֑וֹר וַֽיְהִי־אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy 'vr vyhy'vr
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let there be light.’ And there was light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 'th'vr khytvb vybdl 'lhym byn h'vr vbyn hchshkh
verses.translation: And God saw the light, that it was good; and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym  l'vr yvm vlchshkh qr' lylh vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm 'chd {p}
verses.translation: And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy rqy' btvkh hmym vyhy mbdyl byn mym lmym
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־הָרָקִ֒יעַ֒ וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ וּבֵ֣ין הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעַ֣ל לָרָקִ֑יעַ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 'thrqy' vybdl byn hmym 'shr mtcht lrqy' vbyn hmym 'shr m'l lrqy' vyhykhn
verses.translation: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָֽרָקִ֖יעַ שָׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym lrqy' shmym vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm shny {p}
verses.translation: And God called the firmament Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yqvv hmym mtcht hshmym 'lmqvm 'chd vtr'h hybshh vyhykhn
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear.’ And it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ לַיַּבָּשָׁה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵ֥ה הַמַּ֖יִם קָרָ֣א יַמִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lhym  lybshh 'rts vlmqvh hmym qr' ymym vyr' 'lhym khytvb
verses.translation: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters called He Seas; and God saw that it was good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תַּֽדְשֵׁ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ דֶּ֗שֶׁא עֵ֚שֶׂב מַזְרִ֣יעַ זֶ֔רַע עֵ֣ץ פְּרִ֞י עֹ֤שֶׂה פְּרִי֙ לְמִינ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ב֖וֹ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym tdsh' h'rts dsh' 'shb mzry' zr' 'ts pry 'shh pry lmynv 'shr zr'vbv 'lh'rts vyhykhn
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let the earth put forth grass, herb yielding seed, and fruit-tree bearing fruit after its kind, wherein is the seed thereof, upon the earth.’ And it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ דֶּ֠שֶׁא עֵ֣שֶׂב מַזְרִ֤יעַ זֶ֙רַע֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְעֵ֧ץ עֹֽשֶׂה־פְּרִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ב֖וֹ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vtvts' h'rts dsh' 'shb mzry' zr' lmynhv v'ts 'shhpry 'shr zr'vbv lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khytvb
verses.translation: And the earth brought forth grass, herb yielding seed after its kind, and tree bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after its kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm shlyshy {p}
verses.translation: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְהִ֤י מְאֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַיּ֖וֹם וּבֵ֣ין הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָי֤וּ לְאֹתֹת֙ וּלְמ֣וֹעֲדִ֔ים וּלְיָמִ֖ים וְשָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yhy m'rt brqy' hshmym lhbdyl byn hyvm vbyn hlylh vhyv l'tt vlmv'dym vlymym vshnym
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ לִמְאוֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vhyv lm'vrt brqy' hshmym lh'yr 'lh'rts vyhykhn
verses.translation: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth.’ And it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַמְּאֹרֹ֖ת הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים אֶת־הַמָּא֤וֹר הַגָּדֹל֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־הַמָּא֤וֹר הַקָּטֹן֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וְאֵ֖ת הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 'tshny hm'rt hgdlym 'thm'vr hgdl lmmshlt hyvm v'thm'vr hqtn lmmshlt hlylh v't hkhvkhbym
verses.translation: And God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night; and the stars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vytn 'tm 'lhym brqy' hshmym lh'yr 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִמְשֹׁל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלַּ֔יְלָה וּֽלְהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vlmshl byvm vblylh vlhbdyl byn h'vr vbyn hchshkh vyr' 'lhym khytvb
verses.translation: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness; and God saw that it was good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם רְבִיעִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm rby'y {p}
verses.translation: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יִשְׁרְצ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֖רֶץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֑ה וְעוֹף֙ יְעוֹפֵ֣ף עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵ֖י רְקִ֥יעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym yshrtsv hmym shrts npsh chyh v'vf y'vpf 'lh'rts 'lpny rqy' hshmym
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let fowl fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־הַתַּנִּינִ֖ם הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת כׇּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֣ה ׀ הָֽרֹמֶ֡שֶׂת אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁרְצ֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם לְמִֽינֵהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־ע֤וֹף כָּנָף֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vybr' 'lhym 'thtnynm hgdlym v't khlnpsh hchyh  hrmsht 'shr shrtsv hmym lmynhm v't khl'vf khnf lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khytvb
verses.translation: And God created the great sea-monsters, and every living creature that creepeth, wherewith the waters swarmed, after its kind, and every winged fowl after its kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֗וּ וּמִלְא֤וּ אֶת־הַמַּ֙יִם֙ בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וְהָע֖וֹף יִ֥רֶב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vybrkh 'tm 'lhym l'mr prv vrbv vml'v 'thmym bymym vh'vf yrb b'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed them, saying: ‘Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם חֲמִישִֽׁי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm chmyshy {p}
verses.translation: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ בְּהֵמָ֥ה וָרֶ֛מֶשׂ וְחַֽיְתוֹ־אֶ֖רֶץ לְמִינָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym tvts' h'rts npsh chyh lmynh bhmh vrmsh vchytv'rts lmynh vyhykhn
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let the earth bring forth the living creature after its kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after its kind.’ And it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת־חַיַּ֨ת הָאָ֜רֶץ לְמִינָ֗הּ וְאֶת־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְאֵ֛ת כׇּל־רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 'lhym 'tchyt h'rts lmynh v'thbhmh lmynh v't khlrmsh h'dmh lmynhv vyr' 'lhym khytvb
verses.translation: And God made the beast of the earth after its kind, and the cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the ground after its kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֛ם בְּצַלְמֵ֖נוּ כִּדְמוּתֵ֑נוּ וְיִרְדּוּ֩ בִדְגַ֨ת הַיָּ֜ם וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבְכׇל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבְכׇל־הָרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym n'shh 'dm btslmnv khdmvtnv vyrdv bdgt hym vb'vf hshmym vbbhmh vbkhlh'rts vbkhlhrmsh hrmsh 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Let us make man in our image, after our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֶת־הָֽאָדָם֙ בְּצַלְמ֔וֹ בְּצֶ֥לֶם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּרָ֣א אֹת֑וֹ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בָּרָ֥א אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybr' 'lhym  'th'dm btslmv btslm 'lhym br' 'tv zkhr vnqbh br' 'tm
verses.translation: And God created man in His own image, in the image of God created He him; male and female created He them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֛וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁ֑הָ וּרְד֞וּ בִּדְגַ֤ת הַיָּם֙ וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּבְכׇל־חַיָּ֖ה הָֽרֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vybrkh 'tm 'lhym vy'mr lhm 'lhym prv vrbv vml'v 'th'rts vkhbshh vrdv bdgt hym vb'vf hshmym vbkhlchyh hrmsht 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed them; and God said unto them: ‘Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that creepeth upon the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־כׇּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב  זֹרֵ֣עַ זֶ֗רַע אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הָעֵ֛ץ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ פְרִי־עֵ֖ץ זֹרֵ֣עַ זָ֑רַע לָכֶ֥ם יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לְאׇכְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym hnh ntty lkhm 'tkhl'shb  zr' zr' 'shr 'lpny khlh'rts v'tkhlh'ts 'shrbv pry'ts zr' zr' lkhm yhyh l'khlh
verses.translation: And God said: ‘Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed—to you it shall be for food;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְכׇל־חַיַּ֣ת הָ֠אָ֠רֶץ וּלְכׇל־ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּלְכֹ֣ל  רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה אֶת־כׇּל־יֶ֥רֶק עֵ֖שֶׂב לְאׇכְלָ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־כֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vlkhlchyt h'rts vlkhl'vf hshmym vlkhl  rvmsh 'lh'rts 'shrbv npsh chyh 'tkhlyrq 'shb l'khlh vyhykhn
verses.translation: and to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is a living soul, [I have given] every green herb for food.’ And it was so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 'tkhl'shr 'shh vhnhtvb m'd vyhy'rb vyhybqr yvm hshshy {p}
verses.translation: And God saw every thing that He had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכֻלּ֛וּ הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ וְכׇל־צְבָאָֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhlv hshmym vh'rts vkhltsb'm
verses.translation: And the heaven and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַ֤ל אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vykhl 'lhym byvm hshby'y ml'khtv 'shr 'shh vyshbt byvm hshby'y mkhlml'khtv 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had made; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י ב֤וֹ שָׁבַת֙ מִכׇּל־מְלַאכְתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybrkh 'lhym 'tyvm hshby'y vyqdsh 'tv khy bv shbt mkhlml'khtv 'shrbr' 'lhym l'shvt {p}
verses.translation: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it He rested from all His work which God in creating had made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה תוֹלְד֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ בְּהִבָּֽרְאָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם עֲשׂ֛וֹת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'lh tvldvt hshmym vh'rts bhbr'm byvm 'shvt yhvh 'lhym 'rts vshmym
verses.translation: These are the generations of the heaven and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made earth and heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹ֣ל  שִׂ֣יחַ הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה טֶ֚רֶם יִֽהְיֶ֣ה בָאָ֔רֶץ וְכׇל־עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה טֶ֣רֶם יִצְמָ֑ח כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הִמְטִ֜יר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָדָ֣ם אַ֔יִן לַֽעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhl  shych hshdh trm yhyh b'rts vkhl'shb hshdh trm ytsmch khy l' hmtyr yhvh 'lhym 'lh'rts v'dm 'yn l'bd 'th'dmh
verses.translation: No shrub of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ד יַֽעֲלֶ֣ה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'd y'lh mnh'rts vhshqh 'tkhlpny h'dmh
verses.translation: but there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֩יצֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֗ם עָפָר֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וַיִּפַּ֥ח בְּאַפָּ֖יו נִשְׁמַ֣ת חַיִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֥י הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyytsr yhvh 'lhym 'th'dm 'pr mnh'dmh vypch b'pyv nshmt chyym vyhy h'dm lnpsh chyh
verses.translation: Then the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּטַּ֞ע יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים גַּן־בְּעֵ֖דֶן מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם שָׁ֔ם אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyt' yhvh 'lhym gnb'dn mqdm vyshm shm 'th'dm 'shr ytsr
verses.translation: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden; and there He put the man whom He had formed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּצְמַ֞ח יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כׇּל־עֵ֛ץ נֶחְמָ֥ד לְמַרְאֶ֖ה וְט֣וֹב לְמַאֲכָ֑ל וְעֵ֤ץ הַֽחַיִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַגָּ֔ן וְעֵ֕ץ הַדַּ֖עַת ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
verses.translit: vytsmch yhvh 'lhym mnh'dmh khl'ts nchmd lmr'h vtvb lm'khl v'ts hchyym btvkh hgn v'ts hd't tvb vr'
verses.translation: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָהָר֙ יֹצֵ֣א מֵעֵ֔דֶן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת אֶת־הַגָּ֑ן וּמִשָּׁם֙ יִפָּרֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֖ה לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה רָאשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vnhr yts' m'dn lhshqvt 'thgn vmshm yprd vhyh l'rb'h r'shym
verses.translation: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became four heads.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם הָֽאֶחָ֖ד פִּישׁ֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסֹּבֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.translit: shm h'chd pyshvn hv' hsbb 't khl'rts hchvylh 'shrshm hzhb
verses.translation: The name of the first is Pishon; that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽזְהַ֛ב הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא ט֑וֹב שָׁ֥ם הַבְּדֹ֖לַח וְאֶ֥בֶן הַשֹּֽׁהַם׃
verses.translit: vzhb h'rts hhv' tvb shm hbdlch v'bn hshhm
verses.translation: and the gold of that land is good; there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵֽׁם־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַשֵּׁנִ֖י גִּיח֑וֹן ה֣וּא הַסּוֹבֵ֔ב אֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֶ֥רֶץ כּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshmhnhr hshny gychvn hv' hsvbb 't khl'rts khvsh
verses.translation: And the name of the second river is Gihon; the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַנָּהָ֤ר הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ חִדֶּ֔קֶל ה֥וּא הַֽהֹלֵ֖ךְ קִדְמַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהַנָּהָ֥ר הָֽרְבִיעִ֖י ה֥וּא פְרָֽת׃
verses.translit: vshm hnhr hshlyshy chdql hv' hhlkh qdmt 'shvr vhnhr hrby'y hv' prt
verses.translation: And the name of the third river is Tigris; that is it which goeth toward the east of Asshur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֛ח יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּנִּחֵ֣הוּ בְגַן־עֵ֔דֶן לְעׇבְדָ֖הּ וּלְשׇׁמְרָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyqch yhvh 'lhym 'th'dm vynchhv bgn'dn l'bdh vlshmrh
verses.translation: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַו֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל־הָֽאָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר מִכֹּ֥ל עֵֽץ־הַגָּ֖ן אָכֹ֥ל תֹּאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vytsv yhvh 'lhym 'lh'dm l'mr mkhl 'tshgn 'khl t'khl
verses.translation: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying: ‘Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵעֵ֗ץ הַדַּ֙עַת֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם אֲכׇלְךָ֥ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vm'ts hd't tvb vr' l' t'khl mmnv khy byvm 'khlkh mmnv mvt tmvt
verses.translation: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it; for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym l'tvb hyvt h'dm lbdv ''shhlv 'zr khngdv
verses.translation: And the LORD God said: ‘It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֩צֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה כׇּל־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיָּבֵא֙ אֶל־הָ֣אָדָ֔ם לִרְא֖וֹת מַה־יִּקְרָא־ל֑וֹ וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקְרָא־ל֧וֹ הָֽאָדָ֛ם נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה ה֥וּא שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytsr yhvh 'lhym mnh'dmh khlchyt hshdh v't khl'vf hshmym vyb' 'lh'dm lr'vt mhyqr'lv vkhl 'shr yqr'lv h'dm npsh chyh hv' shmv
verses.translation: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto the man to see what he would call them; and whatsoever the man would call every living creature, that was to be the name thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם שֵׁמ֗וֹת לְכׇל־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּלְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּלְאָדָ֕ם לֹֽא־מָצָ֥א עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' h'dm shmvt lkhlhbhmh vl'vf hshmym vlkhl chyt hshdh vl'dm l'mts' 'zr khngdv
verses.translation: And the man gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found a help meet for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּפֵּל֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ תַּרְדֵּמָ֛ה עַל־הָאָדָ֖ם וַיִּישָׁ֑ן וַיִּקַּ֗ח אַחַת֙ מִצַּלְעֹתָ֔יו וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר בָּשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vypl yhvh 'lhym  trdmh 'lh'dm vyyshn vyqch 'cht mtsl'tyv vysgr bshr tchtnh
verses.translation: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs, and closed up the place with flesh instead thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֩בֶן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֧ים ׀ אֶֽת־הַצֵּלָ֛ע אֲשֶׁר־לָקַ֥ח מִן־הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיְבִאֶ֖הָ אֶל־הָֽאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vybn yhvh 'lhym  'thtsl' 'shrlqch mnh'dm l'shh vyb'h 'lh'dm
verses.translation: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from the man, made He a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ הָֽאָדָם֒ זֹ֣את הַפַּ֗עַם עֶ֚צֶם מֵֽעֲצָמַ֔י וּבָשָׂ֖ר מִבְּשָׂרִ֑י לְזֹאת֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י מֵאִ֖ישׁ לֻֽקְחָה־זֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'dm z't hp'm 'tsm m'tsmy vbshr mbshry lz't yqr' 'shh khy m'ysh lqchhz't
verses.translation: And the man said: ‘This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ יַֽעֲזׇב־אִ֔ישׁ אֶת־אָבִ֖יו וְאֶת־אִמּ֑וֹ וְדָבַ֣ק בְּאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהָי֖וּ לְבָשָׂ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn y'zb'ysh 't'byv v't'mv vdbq b'shtv vhyv lbshr 'chd
verses.translation: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and they shall be one flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֤וּ שְׁנֵיהֶם֙ עֲרוּמִּ֔ים הָֽאָדָ֖ם וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֖א יִתְבֹּשָֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhyv shnyhm 'rvmym h'dm v'shtv vl' ytbshshv
verses.translation: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנָּחָשׁ֙ הָיָ֣ה עָר֔וּם מִכֹּל֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אַ֚ף כִּֽי־אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִכֹּ֖ל עֵ֥ץ הַגָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnchsh hyh 'rvm mkhl chyt hshdh 'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhym vy'mr 'lh'shh 'f khy'mr 'lhym l' t'khlv mkhl 'ts hgn
verses.translation: Now the serpent was more subtle than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman: ‘Yea, hath God said: Ye shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֥אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־הַנָּחָ֑שׁ מִפְּרִ֥י עֵֽץ־הַגָּ֖ן נֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 'lhnchsh mpry 'tshgn n'khl
verses.translation: And the woman said unto the serpent: ‘Of the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִפְּרִ֣י הָעֵץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַגָּן֒ אָמַ֣ר אֱלֹהִ֗ים לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְלֹ֥א תִגְּע֖וּ בּ֑וֹ פֶּן־תְּמֻתֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vmpry h'ts 'shr btvkhhgn 'mr 'lhym l' t'khlv mmnv vl' tg'v bv pntmtvn
verses.translation: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said: Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַנָּחָ֖שׁ אֶל־הָֽאִשָּׁ֑ה לֹֽא־מ֖וֹת תְּמֻתֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hnchsh 'lh'shh l'mvt tmtvn
verses.translation: And the serpent said unto the woman: ‘Ye shall not surely die;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י יֹדֵ֣עַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֗י בְּיוֹם֙ אֲכׇלְכֶ֣ם מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְנִפְקְח֖וּ עֵֽינֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִיתֶם֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים יֹדְעֵ֖י ט֥וֹב וָרָֽע׃
verses.translit: khy yd' 'lhym khy byvm 'khlkhm mmnv vnpqchv 'ynykhm vhyytm kh'lhym yd'y tvb vr'
verses.translation: for God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as God, knowing good and evil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא הָֽאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּ֣י טוֹב֩ הָעֵ֨ץ לְמַאֲכָ֜ל וְכִ֧י תַֽאֲוָה־ה֣וּא לָעֵינַ֗יִם וְנֶחְמָ֤ד הָעֵץ֙ לְהַשְׂכִּ֔יל וַתִּקַּ֥ח מִפִּרְי֖וֹ וַתֹּאכַ֑ל וַתִּתֵּ֧ן גַּם־לְאִישָׁ֛הּ עִמָּ֖הּ וַיֹּאכַֽל׃
verses.translit: vtr' h'shh khy tvb h'ts lm'khl vkhy t'vhhv' l'ynym vnchmd h'ts lhshkhyl vtqch mpryv vt'khl vttn gml'yshh 'mh vy'khl
verses.translation: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat; and she gave also unto her husband with her, and he did eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפָּקַ֙חְנָה֙ עֵינֵ֣י שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י עֵֽירֻמִּ֖ם הֵ֑ם וַֽיִּתְפְּרוּ֙ עֲלֵ֣ה תְאֵנָ֔ה וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם חֲגֹרֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vtpqchnh 'yny shnyhm vyd'v khy 'yrmm hm vytprv 'lh t'nh vy'shv lhm chgrt
verses.translation: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig-leaves together, and made themselves girdles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־ק֨וֹל יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּגָּ֖ן לְר֣וּחַ הַיּ֑וֹם וַיִּתְחַבֵּ֨א הָֽאָדָ֜ם וְאִשְׁתּ֗וֹ מִפְּנֵי֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּת֖וֹךְ עֵ֥ץ הַגָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'tqvl yhvh 'lhym mthlkh bgn lrvch hyvm vytchb' h'dm v'shtv mpny yhvh 'lhym btvkh 'ts hgn
verses.translation: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden toward the cool of the day; and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ אַיֶּֽכָּה׃
verses.translit: vyqr' yhvh 'lhym 'lh'dm vy'mr lv 'ykhh
verses.translation: And the LORD God called unto the man, and said unto him: ‘Where art thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת־קֹלְךָ֥ שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בַּגָּ֑ן וָאִירָ֛א כִּֽי־עֵירֹ֥ם אָנֹ֖כִי וָאֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'tqlkh shm'ty bgn v'yr' khy'yrm 'nkhy v'chb'
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I heard Thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֚י הִגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ כִּ֥י עֵירֹ֖ם אָ֑תָּה הֲמִן־הָעֵ֗ץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוִּיתִ֛יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֥י אֲכׇל־מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אָכָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr my hgyd lkh khy 'yrm 'th hmnh'ts 'shr tsvytykh lblty 'khlmmnv 'khlt
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הָֽאָדָ֑ם הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה עִמָּדִ֔י הִ֛וא נָֽתְנָה־לִּ֥י מִן־הָעֵ֖ץ וָאֹכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'dm h'shh 'shr ntth 'mdy hv' ntnhly mnh'ts v'khl
verses.translation: And the man said: ‘The woman whom Thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑ית וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה הַנָּחָ֥שׁ הִשִּׁיאַ֖נִי וָאֹכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym l'shh mhz't 'shyt vt'mr h'shh hnchsh hshy'ny v'khl
verses.translation: And the LORD God said unto the woman: ‘What is this thou hast done?’ And the woman said: ‘The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים ׀ אֶֽל־הַנָּחָשׁ֮ כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּאת֒ אָר֤וּר אַתָּה֙ מִכׇּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה עַל־גְּחֹנְךָ֣ תֵלֵ֔ךְ וְעָפָ֥ר תֹּאכַ֖ל כׇּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhym  'lhnchsh khy 'shyt z't 'rvr 'th mkhlhbhmh vmkhl chyt hshdh 'lgchnkh tlkh v'pr t'khl khlymy chyykh
verses.translation: And the LORD God said unto the serpent: ‘Because thou hast done this, cursed art thou from among all cattle, and from among all beasts of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵיבָ֣ה  אָשִׁ֗ית בֵּֽינְךָ֙ וּבֵ֣ין הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ וּבֵ֣ין זַרְעָ֑הּ ה֚וּא יְשׁוּפְךָ֣ רֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תְּשׁוּפֶ֥נּוּ עָקֵֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'ybh  'shyt bynkh vbyn h'shh vbyn zr'kh vbyn zr'h hv' yshvpkh r'sh v'th tshvpnv 'qb {s}
verses.translation: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; they shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise their heel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽל־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הַרְבָּ֤ה אַרְבֶּה֙ עִצְּבוֹנֵ֣ךְ וְהֵֽרֹנֵ֔ךְ בְּעֶ֖צֶב תֵּֽלְדִ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְאֶל־אִישֵׁךְ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָתֵ֔ךְ וְה֖וּא יִמְשׇׁל־בָּֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh'shh 'mr hrbh 'rbh 'tsbvnkh vhrnkh b'tsb tldy bnym v'l'yshkh tshvqtkh vhv' ymshlbkh {s}
verses.translation: Unto the woman He said: ‘I will greatly multiply thy pain and thy travail; in pain thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאָדָ֣ם אָמַ֗ר כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֘עְתָּ֮ לְק֣וֹל אִשְׁתֶּ֒ךָ֒ וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ מִן־הָעֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּיתִ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֲרוּרָ֤ה הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּֽעֲבוּרֶ֔ךָ בְּעִצָּבוֹן֙ תֹּֽאכְלֶ֔נָּה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vl'dm 'mr khyshm't lqvl 'shtkh vt'khl mnh'ts 'shr tsvytykh l'mr l' t'khl mmnv 'rvrh h'dmh b'bvrkh b'tsbvn t'khlnh khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: And unto Adam He said: ‘Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying: Thou shalt not eat of it; cursed is the ground for thy sake; in toil shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְק֥וֹץ וְדַרְדַּ֖ר תַּצְמִ֣יחַֽ לָ֑ךְ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ אֶת־עֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vqvts vdrdr ttsmych lkh v'khlt 't'shb hshdh
verses.translation: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּזֵעַ֤ת אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ תֹּ֣אכַל לֶ֔חֶם עַ֤ד שֽׁוּבְךָ֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה כִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה לֻקָּ֑חְתָּ כִּֽי־עָפָ֣ר אַ֔תָּה וְאֶל־עָפָ֖ר תָּשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: bz't 'pykh t'khl lchm 'd shvbkh 'lh'dmh khy mmnh lqcht khy'pr 'th v'l'pr tshvb
verses.translation: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken; for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א הָֽאָדָ֛ם שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ חַוָּ֑ה כִּ֛י הִ֥וא הָֽיְתָ֖ה אֵ֥ם כׇּל־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' h'dm shm 'shtv chvh khy hv' hyth 'm khlchy
verses.translation: And the man called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַשׂ֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְאָדָ֧ם וּלְאִשְׁתּ֛וֹ כׇּתְנ֥וֹת ע֖וֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵֽׁם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvh 'lhym l'dm vl'shtv khtnvt 'vr vylbshm {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD God made for Adam and for his wife garments of skins, and clothed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר  יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים הֵ֤ן הָֽאָדָם֙ הָיָה֙ כְּאַחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֔נּוּ לָדַ֖עַת ט֣וֹב וָרָ֑ע וְעַתָּ֣ה  פֶּן־יִשְׁלַ֣ח יָד֗וֹ וְלָקַח֙ גַּ֚ם מֵעֵ֣ץ הַֽחַיִּ֔ים וְאָכַ֖ל וָחַ֥י לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  yhvh 'lhym hn h'dm hyh kh'chd mmnv ld't tvb vr' v'th  pnyshlch ydv vlqch gm m'ts hchyym v'khl vchy l'lm
verses.translation: And the LORD God said: ‘Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil; and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֛הוּ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִגַּן־עֵ֑דֶן לַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֻקַּ֖ח מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyshlchhv yhvh 'lhym mgn'dn l'bd 'th'dmh 'shr lqch mshm
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְגָ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֑ם וַיַּשְׁכֵּן֩ מִקֶּ֨דֶם לְגַן־עֵ֜דֶן אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֗ים וְאֵ֨ת לַ֤הַט הַחֶ֙רֶב֙ הַמִּתְהַפֶּ֔כֶת לִשְׁמֹ֕ר אֶת־דֶּ֖רֶךְ עֵ֥ץ הַֽחַיִּֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vygrsh 'th'dm vyshkhn mqdm lgn'dn 'thkhrbym v't lht hchrb hmthpkht lshmr 'tdrkh 'ts hchyym {s}
verses.translation: So He drove out the man; and He placed at the east of the garden of Eden the cherubim, and the flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way to the tree of life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֣אָדָ֔ם יָדַ֖ע אֶת־חַוָּ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַתַּ֙הַר֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־קַ֔יִן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר קָנִ֥יתִי אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'dm yd' 'tchvh 'shtv vthr vtld 'tqyn vt'mr qnyty 'ysh 'tyhvh
verses.translation: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived and bore Cain, and said: ‘I have agotten a man with the help of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣סֶף לָלֶ֔דֶת אֶת־אָחִ֖יו אֶת־הָ֑בֶל וַֽיְהִי־הֶ֙בֶל֙ רֹ֣עֵה צֹ֔אן וְקַ֕יִן הָיָ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ד אֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsf lldt 't'chyv 'thbl vyhyhbl r'h ts'n vqyn hyh 'bd 'dmh
verses.translation: And again she bore his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֖י מִקֵּ֣ץ יָמִ֑ים וַיָּבֵ֨א קַ֜יִן מִפְּרִ֧י הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה מִנְחָ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqts ymym vyb' qyn mpry h'dmh mnchh lyhvh
verses.translation: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶ֨בֶל הֵבִ֥יא גַם־ה֛וּא מִבְּכֹר֥וֹת צֹאנ֖וֹ וּמֵֽחֶלְבֵהֶ֑ן וַיִּ֣שַׁע יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־הֶ֖בֶל וְאֶל־מִנְחָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhbl hby' gmhv' mbkhrvt ts'nv vmchlbhn vysh' yhvh 'lhbl v'lmnchtv
verses.translation: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־קַ֥יִן וְאֶל־מִנְחָת֖וֹ לֹ֣א שָׁעָ֑ה וַיִּ֤חַר לְקַ֙יִן֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'lqyn v'lmnchtv l' sh'h vychr lqyn m'd vyplv pnyv
verses.translation: but unto Cain and to his offering He had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־קָ֑יִן לָ֚מָּה חָ֣רָה לָ֔ךְ וְלָ֖מָּה נָפְל֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lqyn lmh chrh lkh vlmh nplv pnykh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Cain: ‘Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא אִם־תֵּיטִיב֙ שְׂאֵ֔ת וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תֵיטִ֔יב לַפֶּ֖תַח חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ וְאֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔וֹ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשׇׁל־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hlv' 'mtytyb sh't v'm l' tytyb lptch cht't rbts v'lykh tshvqtv v'th tmshlbv
verses.translation: If thou doest well, shall it not be lifted up? and if thou doest not well, sin coucheth at the door; and unto thee is its desire, but thou mayest rule over it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יו וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּהְיוֹתָ֣ם בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַיָּ֥קׇם קַ֛יִן אֶל־הֶ֥בֶל אָחִ֖יו וַיַּהַרְגֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qyn 'lhbl 'chyv vyhy bhyvtm bshdh vyqm qyn 'lhbl 'chyv vyhrghv
verses.translation: And Cain spoke unto Abel his brother. And it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־קַ֔יִן אֵ֖י הֶ֣בֶל אָחִ֑יךָ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵ֥ר אָחִ֖י אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lqyn 'y hbl 'chykh vy'mr l' yd'ty hshmr 'chy 'nkhy
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Cain: ‘Where is Abel thy brother?’ And he said: ‘I know not; am I my brother’s keeper?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ ק֚וֹל דְּמֵ֣י אָחִ֔יךָ צֹעֲקִ֥ים אֵלַ֖י מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mh 'shyt qvl dmy 'chykh ts'qym 'ly mnh'dmh
verses.translation: And He said: ‘What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto Me from the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אָר֣וּר אָ֑תָּה מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּצְתָ֣ה אֶת־פִּ֔יהָ לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־דְּמֵ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'rvr 'th mnh'dmh 'shr ptsth 'tpyh lqcht 'tdmy 'chykh mydkh
verses.translation: And now cursed art thou from the ground, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹֽא־תֹסֵ֥ף תֵּת־כֹּחָ֖הּ לָ֑ךְ נָ֥ע וָנָ֖ד תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy t'bd 'th'dmh l'tsf ttkhchh lkh n' vnd thyh b'rts
verses.translation: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a wanderer shalt thou be in the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר קַ֖יִן אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל עֲוֺנִ֖י מִנְּשֹֽׂא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qyn 'lyhvh gdvl 'vny mnsh'
verses.translation: And Cain said unto the LORD: ‘My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵן֩ גֵּרַ֨שְׁתָּ אֹתִ֜י הַיּ֗וֹם מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה וּמִפָּנֶ֖יךָ אֶסָּתֵ֑ר וְהָיִ֜יתִי נָ֤ע וָנָד֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה כׇל־מֹצְאִ֖י יַֽהַרְגֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hn grsht 'ty hyvm m'l pny h'dmh vmpnykh 'str vhyyty n' vnd b'rts vhyh khlmts'y yhrgny
verses.translation: Behold, Thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the land; and from Thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer in the earth; and it will come to pass, that whosoever findeth me will slay me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ יְהֹוָ֗ה לָכֵן֙ כׇּל־הֹרֵ֣ג קַ֔יִן שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקָּ֑ם וַיָּ֨שֶׂם יְהֹוָ֤ה לְקַ֙יִן֙ א֔וֹת לְבִלְתִּ֥י הַכּוֹת־אֹת֖וֹ כׇּל־מֹצְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yhvh lkhn khlhrg qyn shb'tym yqm vyshm yhvh lqyn 'vt lblty hkhvt'tv khlmts'v
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him: ‘Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold.’ And the LORD set a sign for Cain, lest any finding him should smite him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥צֵא קַ֖יִן מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־נ֖וֹד קִדְמַת־עֵֽדֶן׃
verses.translit: vyts' qyn mlpny yhvh vyshb b'rtsnvd qdmt'dn
verses.translation: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤דַע קַ֙יִן֙ אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד אֶת־חֲנ֑וֹךְ וַֽיְהִי֙ בֹּ֣נֶה עִ֔יר וַיִּקְרָא֙ שֵׁ֣ם הָעִ֔יר כְּשֵׁ֖ם בְּנ֥וֹ חֲנֽוֹךְ׃
verses.translit: vyd' qyn 't'shtv vthr vtld 'tchnvkh vyhy bnh 'yr vyqr' shm h'yr khshm bnv chnvkh
verses.translation: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bore Enoch; and he builded a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son Enoch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּלֵ֤ד לַֽחֲנוֹךְ֙ אֶת־עִירָ֔ד וְעִירָ֕ד יָלַ֖ד אֶת־מְחֽוּיָאֵ֑ל וּמְחִיָּיאֵ֗ל יָלַד֙ אֶת־מְת֣וּשָׁאֵ֔ל וּמְתוּשָׁאֵ֖ל יָלַ֥ד אֶת־לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyvld lchnvkh 't'yrd v'yrd yld 'tmchvy'l vmchyy'l yld 'tmtvsh'l vmtvsh'l yld 'tlmkh
verses.translation: And unto Enoch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael; and Mehujael begot Methushael; and Methushael begot Lamech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֥וֹ לֶ֖מֶךְ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאַחַת֙ עָדָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית צִלָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqchlv lmkh shty nshym shm h'cht 'dh vshm hshnyt tslh
verses.translation: And Lamech took unto him two wives; the name of one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶד עָדָ֖ה אֶת־יָבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י יֹשֵׁ֥ב אֹ֖הֶל וּמִקְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vtld 'dh 'tybl hv' hyh 'by yshb 'hl vmqnh
verses.translation: And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יוּבָ֑ל ה֣וּא הָיָ֔ה אֲבִ֕י כׇּל־תֹּפֵ֥שׂ כִּנּ֖וֹר וְעוּגָֽב׃
verses.translit: vshm 'chyv yvbl hv' hyh 'by khltpsh khnvr v'vgb
verses.translation: And his brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all such as handle the harp and pipe.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִלָּ֣ה גַם־הִ֗וא יָֽלְדָה֙ אֶת־תּ֣וּבַל קַ֔יִן לֹטֵ֕שׁ כׇּל־חֹרֵ֥שׁ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל וַֽאֲח֥וֹת תּֽוּבַל־קַ֖יִן נַֽעֲמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vtslh gmhv' yldh 'ttvbl qyn ltsh khlchrsh nchsht vbrzl v'chvt tvblqyn n'mh
verses.translation: And Zillah, she also bore Tubal-cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of brass and iron; and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לֶ֜מֶךְ לְנָשָׁ֗יו עָדָ֤ה וְצִלָּה֙ שְׁמַ֣עַן קוֹלִ֔י נְשֵׁ֣י לֶ֔מֶךְ הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ הָרַ֙גְתִּי֙ לְפִצְעִ֔י וְיֶ֖לֶד לְחַבֻּרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lmkh lnshyv 'dh vtslh shm'n qvly nshy lmkh h'znh 'mrty khy 'ysh hrgty lpts'y vyld lchbrty
verses.translation: And Lamech said unto his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech; For I have slain a man for wounding me, And a young man for bruising me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י שִׁבְעָתַ֖יִם יֻקַּם־קָ֑יִן וְלֶ֖מֶךְ שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy shb'tym yqmqyn vlmkh shb'ym vshb'h
verses.translation: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨דַע אָדָ֥ם עוֹד֙ אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁ֑ת כִּ֣י שָֽׁת־לִ֤י אֱלֹהִים֙ זֶ֣רַע אַחֵ֔ר תַּ֣חַת הֶ֔בֶל כִּ֥י הֲרָג֖וֹ קָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: vyd' 'dm 'vd 't'shtv vtld bn vtqr' 'tshmv sht khy shtly 'lhym zr' 'chr tcht hbl khy hrgv qyn
verses.translation: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bore a son, and called his name Seth: ‘for God hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֤ת גַּם־הוּא֙ יֻלַּד־בֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱנ֑וֹשׁ אָ֣ז הוּחַ֔ל לִקְרֹ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vlsht gmhv' yldbn vyqr' 'tshmv 'nvsh 'z hvchl lqr' bshm yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enosh; then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה סֵ֔פֶר תּוֹלְדֹ֖ת אָדָ֑ם בְּי֗וֹם בְּרֹ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אָדָ֔ם בִּדְמ֥וּת אֱלֹהִ֖ים עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zh spr tvldt 'dm byvm br' 'lhym 'dm bdmvt 'lhym 'shh 'tv
verses.translation: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made He him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בְּרָאָ֑ם וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָ֗ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֶת־שְׁמָם֙ אָדָ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָֽם׃
verses.translit: zkhr vnqbh br'm vybrkh 'tm vyqr' 'tshmm 'dm byvm hbr'm
verses.translation: male and female created He them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י אָדָ֗ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּמְאַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בִּדְמוּת֖וֹ כְּצַלְמ֑וֹ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵֽׁת׃
verses.translit: vychy 'dm shlshym vm't shnh vyvld bdmvtv khtslmv vyqr' 'tshmv sht
verses.translation: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־אָדָ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שֵׁ֔ת שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhyv ymy'dm 'chry hvlydv 'tsht shmnh m't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And the days of Adam after he begot Seth were eight hundred years; and he begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֞וּ כׇּל־יְמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁר־חַ֔י תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymy 'dm 'shrchy tsh' m'vt shnh vshlshym shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֕ת חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.translit: vychysht chmsh shnym vm't shnh vyvld 't'nvsh
verses.translation: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֗ת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־אֱנ֔וֹשׁ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychysht 'chry hvlydv 't'nvsh shb' shnym vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Seth lived after he begot Enosh eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵי־שֵׁ֔ת שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymysht shtym 'shrh shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֥י אֱנ֖וֹשׁ תִּשְׁעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־קֵינָֽן׃
verses.translit: vychy 'nvsh tsh'ym shnh vyvld 'tqynn
verses.translation: And Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Kenan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י אֱנ֗וֹשׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־קֵינָ֔ן חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychy 'nvsh 'chry hvlydv 'tqynn chmsh 'shrh shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Enosh lived after he begot Kenan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י אֱנ֔וֹשׁ חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymy 'nvsh chmsh shnym vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֥י קֵינָ֖ן שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־מַֽהֲלַלְאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vychy qynn shb'ym shnh vyvld 'tmhll'l
verses.translation: And Kenan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י קֵינָ֗ן אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychy qynn 'chry hvlydv 'tmhll'l 'rb'ym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Kenan lived after he begot Mahalalel eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י קֵינָ֔ן עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymy qynn 'shr shnym vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־יָֽרֶד׃
verses.translit: vychy mhll'l chmsh shnym vshshym shnh vyvld 'tyrd
verses.translation: And Mahalalel lived sixty and five years, and begot Jared.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י מַֽהֲלַלְאֵ֗ל אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־יֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychy mhll'l 'chry hvlydv 'tyrd shlshym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Mahalalel lived after he begot Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י מַהֲלַלְאֵ֔ל חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymy mhll'l chmsh vtsh'ym shnh vshmnh m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety and five years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־יֶ֕רֶד שְׁתַּ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־חֲנֽוֹךְ׃
verses.translit: vychyyrd shtym vshshym shnh vm't shnh vyvld 'tchnvkh
verses.translation: And Jared lived a hundred sixty and two years, and begot Enoch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־יֶ֗רֶד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־חֲנ֔וֹךְ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychyyrd 'chry hvlydv 'tchnvkh shmnh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Jared lived after he begot Enoch eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵי־יֶ֔רֶד שְׁתַּ֤יִם וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymyyrd shtym vshshym shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years; and he died. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י חֲנ֔וֹךְ חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־מְתוּשָֽׁלַח׃
verses.translit: vychy chnvkh chmsh vshshym shnh vyvld 'tmtvshlch
verses.translation: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begot Methuselah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֨ךְ חֲנ֜וֹךְ אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vythlkh chnvkh 'th'lhym 'chry hvlydv 'tmtvshlch shlsh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Enoch walked with God after he begot Methuselah three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י חֲנ֑וֹךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khlymy chnvkh chmsh vshshym shnh vshlsh m'vt shnh
verses.translation: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ חֲנ֖וֹךְ אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵינֶ֕נּוּ כִּֽי־לָקַ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vythlkh chnvkh 'th'lhym v'ynnv khylqch 'tv 'lhym {s}
verses.translation: And Enoch walked with God, and he was not; for God took him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח שֶׁ֧בַע וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vychy mtvshlch shb' vshmnym shnh vm't shnh vyvld 'tlmkh
verses.translation: And Methuselah lived a hundred eighty and seven years, and begot Lamech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֗לַח אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־לֶ֔מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֤יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychy mtvshlch 'chry hvlydv 'tlmkh shtym vshmvnym shnh vshb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Methuselah lived after he begot Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י מְתוּשֶׁ֔לַח תֵּ֤שַׁע וְשִׁשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּתְשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymy mtvshlch tsh' vshshym shnh vtsh' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־לֶ֕מֶךְ שְׁתַּ֧יִם וּשְׁמֹנִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vychylmkh shtym vshmnym shnh vm't shnh vyvld bn
verses.translation: And Lamech lived a hundred eighty and two years, and begot a son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶת־שְׁמ֛וֹ נֹ֖חַ לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֞֠ה יְנַחֲמֵ֤נוּ מִֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֙נוּ֙ וּמֵעִצְּב֣וֹן יָדֵ֔ינוּ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽרְרָ֖הּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'tshmv nch l'mr zh ynchmnv mm'shnv vm'tsbvn ydynv mnh'dmh 'shr 'rrh yhvh
verses.translation: And he called his name Noah, saying: ‘This same shall comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, which cometh from the ground which the LORD hath cursed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־לֶ֗מֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־נֹ֔חַ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְתִשְׁעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֹ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vychylmkh 'chry hvlydv 'tnch chmsh vtsh'ym shnh vchmsh m't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And Lamech lived after he begot Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כׇּל־יְמֵי־לֶ֔מֶךְ שֶׁ֤בַע וְשִׁבְעִים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhy khlymylmkh shb' vshb'ym shnh vshb' m'vt shnh vymt {s}
verses.translation: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־נֹ֕חַ בֶּן־חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹלֶד נֹ֔חַ אֶת־שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־חָ֥ם וְאֶת־יָֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: vyhynch bnchmsh m'vt shnh vyvld nch 'tshm 'tchm v'typt
verses.translation: And Noah was five hundred years old; and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־הֵחֵ֣ל הָֽאָדָ֔ם לָרֹ֖ב עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy khyhchl h'dm lrb 'lpny h'dmh vbnvt yldv lhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ בְנֵי־הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֥י טֹבֹ֖ת הֵ֑נָּה וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyr'v bnyh'lhym 'tbnvt h'dm khy tbt hnh vyqchv lhm nshym mkhl 'shr bchrv
verses.translation: that the sons of nobles saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives, whomsoever they chose.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֗ה לֹֽא־יָד֨וֹן רוּחִ֤י בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר וְהָי֣וּ יָמָ֔יו מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh l'ydvn rvchy b'dm l'lm bshgm hv' bshr vhyv ymyv m'h v'shrym shnh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘My spirit shall not abide in man for ever, for that he also is flesh; therefore shall his days be a hundred and twenty years.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָ֘רֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֜אוּ בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hnplym hyv b'rts bymym hhm vgm 'chrykhn 'shr yb'v bny h'lhym 'lbnvt h'dm vyldv lhm hmh hgbrym 'shr m'vlm 'nshy hshm {p}
verses.translation: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when the sons of nobles came in unto the daughters of men, and they bore children to them; the same were the mighty men that were of old, the men of renown.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֥י רַבָּ֛ה רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכׇל־יֵ֙צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh khy rbh r't h'dm b'rts vkhlytsr mchshbt lbv rq r' khlhyvm
verses.translation: And the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vynchm yhvh khy'shh 'th'dm b'rts vyt'tsb 'llbv
verses.translation: And it repented the LORD that He had made man on the earth, and it grieved Him at His heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָ֙אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַד־רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְעַד־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'mchh 'th'dm 'shrbr'ty m'l pny h'dmh m'dm 'dbhmh 'drmsh v'd'vf hshmym khy nchmty khy 'shytm
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and creeping thing, and fowl of the air; for it repenteth Me that I have made them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnch mts' chn b'yny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים הָיָ֖ה בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו אֶת־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־נֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: 'lh tvldt nch nch 'ysh tsdyq tmym hyh bdrtyv 'th'lhym hthlkhnch
verses.translation: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was in his generations a man righteous and wholehearted; Noah walked with God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד נֹ֖חַ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת־שֵׁ֖ם אֶת־חָ֥ם וְאֶת־יָֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: vyvld nch shlshh bnym 'tshm 'tchm v'typt
verses.translation: And Noah begot three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: vtshcht h'rts lpny h'lhym vtml' h'rts chms
verses.translation: And the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי־הִשְׁחִ֧ית כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת־דַּרְכּ֖וֹ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 'th'rts vhnh nshchth khyhshchyt khlbshr 'tdrkhv 'lh'rts {s}
verses.translation: And God saw the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way upon the earth. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כׇּל־בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ חָמָ֖ס מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym lnch qts khlbshr b' lpny khyml'h h'rts chms mpnyhm vhnny mshchytm 'th'rts
verses.translation: And God said unto Noah: ‘The end of all flesh is come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת עֲצֵי־גֹ֔פֶר קִנִּ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־הַתֵּבָ֑ה וְכָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛הּ מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ בַּכֹּֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: 'shh lkh tbt 'tsygpr qnym t'shh 'thtbh vkhprt 'th mbyt vmchvts bkhpr
verses.translation: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; with rooms shalt thou make the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑הּ שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רׇחְבָּ֔הּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vzh 'shr t'shh 'th shlsh m'vt 'mh 'rkh htbh chmshym 'mh rchbh vshlshym 'mh qvmth
verses.translation: And this is how thou shalt make it: the length of the ark three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹ֣הַר  תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַתֵּבָ֗ה וְאֶל־אַמָּה֙ תְּכַלֶּ֣נָּה מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וּפֶ֥תַח הַתֵּבָ֖ה בְּצִדָּ֣הּ תָּשִׂ֑ים תַּחְתִּיִּ֛ם שְׁנִיִּ֥ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃
verses.translit: tshr  t'shh ltbh v'l'mh tkhlnh mlm'lh vptch htbh btsdh tshym tchtym shnym vshlshym t'shh
verses.translation: A light shalt thou make to the ark, and to a cubit shalt thou finish it upward; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת־הַמַּבּ֥וּל מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnny mby' 'thmbvl mym 'lh'rts lshcht khlbshr 'shrbv rvch chyym mtcht hshmym khl 'shrb'rts ygv'
verses.translation: And I, behold, I do bring the flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; every thing that is in the earth shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֛יךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֥ וּנְשֵֽׁי־בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'tbryty 'tkh vb't 'lhtbh 'th vbnykh v'shtkh vnshybnykh 'tkh
verses.translation: But I will establish My covenant with thee; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִכׇּל־הָ֠חַ֠י מִֽכׇּל־בָּשָׂ֞ר שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל תָּבִ֥יא אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֖ה לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vmkhlhchy mkhlbshr shnym mkhl tby' 'lhtbh lhchyt 'tkh zkhr vnqbh yhyv
verses.translation: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: mh'vf lmynhv vmnhbhmh lmynh mkhl rmsh h'dmh lmynhv shnym mkhl yb'v 'lykh lhchyvt
verses.translation: Of the fowl after their kind, and of the cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֗ מִכׇּל־מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם לְאׇכְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th qchlkh mkhlm'khl 'shr y'khl v'spt 'lykh vhyh lkh vlhm l'khlh
verses.translation: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh nch khkhl 'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym khn 'shh
verses.translation: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ לְנֹ֔חַ בֹּֽא־אַתָּ֥ה וְכׇל־בֵּיתְךָ֖ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֑ה כִּֽי־אֹתְךָ֥ רָאִ֛יתִי צַדִּ֥יק לְפָנַ֖י בַּדּ֥וֹר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lnch b''th vkhlbytkh 'lhtbh khy'tkh r'yty tsdyq lpny bdvr hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Noah: ‘Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכֹּ֣ל  הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה תִּֽקַּח־לְךָ֛ שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹ֣א טְהֹרָ֥ה הִ֛וא שְׁנַ֖יִם אִ֥ישׁ וְאִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mkhl  hbhmh hthvrh tqchlkh shb'h shb'h 'ysh v'shtv vmnhbhmh 'shr l' thrh hv' shnym 'ysh v'shtv
verses.translation: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee seven and seven, each with his mate; and of the beasts that are not clean two [and two], each with his mate;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵע֧וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם שִׁבְעָ֥ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה לְחַיּ֥וֹת זֶ֖רַע עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: gm m'vf hshmym shb'h shb'h zkhr vnqbh lchyvt zr' 'lpny khlh'rts
verses.translation: of the fowl also of the air, seven and seven, male and female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ לְיָמִ֨ים ע֜וֹד שִׁבְעָ֗ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מַמְטִ֣יר עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וּמָחִ֗יתִי אֶֽת־כׇּל־הַיְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy lymym 'vd shb'h 'nkhy mmtyr 'lh'rts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh vmchyty 'tkhlhyqvm 'shr 'shyty m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I blot out from off the face of the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ נֹ֑חַ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'sh nch khkhl 'shrtsvhv yhvh
verses.translation: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֕חַ בֶּן־שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וְהַמַּבּ֣וּל הָיָ֔ה מַ֖יִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vnch bnshsh m'vt shnh vhmbvl hyh mym 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣בֹא נֹ֗חַ וּ֠בָנָ֠יו וְאִשְׁתּ֧וֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי־בָנָ֛יו אִתּ֖וֹ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֑ה מִפְּנֵ֖י מֵ֥י הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
verses.translit: vyb' nch vbnyv v'shtv vnshybnyv 'tv 'lhtbh mpny my hmbvl
verses.translation: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him, into the ark, before the waters of the flood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ הַטְּהוֹרָ֔ה וּמִ֨ן־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵינֶ֖נָּה טְהֹרָ֑ה וּמִ֨ן־הָע֔וֹף וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־רֹמֵ֖שׂ עַל־הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: mnhbhmh hthvrh vmnhbhmh 'shr 'ynnh thrh vmnh'vf vkhl 'shrrmsh 'lh'dmh
verses.translation: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the ground,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁנַ֨יִם שְׁנַ֜יִם בָּ֧אוּ אֶל־נֹ֛חַ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֖ה זָכָ֣ר וּנְקֵבָ֑ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־נֹֽחַ׃
verses.translit: shnym shnym b'v 'lnch 'lhtbh zkhr vnqbh kh'shr tsvh 'lhym 'tnch
verses.translation: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י לְשִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וּמֵ֣י הַמַּבּ֔וּל הָי֖וּ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhy lshb't hymym vmy hmbvl hyv 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֤וֹת שָׁנָה֙ לְחַיֵּי־נֹ֔חַ בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָֽה־עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה נִבְקְעוּ֙ כׇּֽל־מַעְיְנֹת֙ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וַאֲרֻבֹּ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נִפְתָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: bshnt shshm'vt shnh lchyynch bchdsh hshny bshb'h'shr yvm lchdsh byvm hzh nbq'v khlm'ynt thvm rbh v'rbt hshmym nptchv
verses.translation: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy hgshm 'lh'rts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh
verses.translation: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֶ֨צֶם הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ בָּ֣א נֹ֔חַ וְשֵׁם־וְחָ֥ם וָיֶ֖פֶת בְּנֵי־נֹ֑חַ וְאֵ֣שֶׁת נֹ֗חַ וּשְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת נְשֵֽׁי־בָנָ֛יו אִתָּ֖ם אֶל־הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: b'tsm hyvm hzh b' nch vshmvchm vypt bnynch v'sht nch vshlsht nshybnyv 'tm 'lhtbh
verses.translation: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה וְכׇל־הַֽחַיָּ֣ה לְמִינָ֗הּ וְכׇל־הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְכׇל־הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וְכׇל־הָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֔הוּ כֹּ֖ל צִפּ֥וֹר כׇּל־כָּנָֽף׃
verses.translit: hmh vkhlhchyh lmynh vkhlhbhmh lmynh vkhlhrmsh hrmsh 'lh'rts lmynhv vkhlh'vf lmynhv khl tspvr khlkhnf
verses.translation: they, and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after its kind, and every fowl after its kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־נֹ֖חַ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֑ה שְׁנַ֤יִם שְׁנַ֙יִם֙ מִכׇּל־הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ ר֥וּחַ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lnch 'lhtbh shnym shnym mkhlhbshr 'shrbv rvch chyym
verses.translation: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh wherein is the breath of life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבָּאִ֗ים זָכָ֨ר וּנְקֵבָ֤ה מִכׇּל־בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֔אוּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּסְגֹּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בַּֽעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhb'ym zkhr vnqbh mkhlbshr b'v kh'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym vysgr yhvh b'dv
verses.translation: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; and the LORD shut him in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֧י הַמַּבּ֛וּל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים י֖וֹם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַתָּ֖רׇם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhy hmbvl 'rb'ym yvm 'lh'rts vyrbv hmym vysh'v 'thtbh vtrm m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bore up the ark, and it was lifted up above the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֛יִם וַיִּרְבּ֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ הַתֵּבָ֖ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vygbrv hmym vyrbv m'd 'lh'rts vtlkh htbh 'lpny hmym
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed, and increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּ֗יִם גָּ֥בְר֛וּ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹ֖ד עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיְכֻסּ֗וּ כׇּל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ הַגְּבֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhmym gbrv m'd m'd 'lh'rts vykhsv khlhhrym hgbhym 'shrtcht khlhshmym
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high mountains that were under the whole heaven were covered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה אַמָּה֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה גָּבְר֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיְכֻסּ֖וּ הֶהָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: chmsh 'shrh 'mh mlm'lh gbrv hmym vykhsv hhrym
verses.translation: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְוַ֞ע כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֣ר  הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ בָּע֤וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבַ֣חַיָּ֔ה וּבְכׇל־הַשֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַשֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכֹ֖ל הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vygv' khlbshr  hrmsh 'lh'rts b'vf vbbhmh vbchyh vbkhlhshrts hshrts 'lh'rts vkhl h'dm
verses.translation: And all flesh perished that moved upon the earth, both fowl, and cattle, and beast, and every swarming thing that swarmeth upon the earth, and every man;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁמַת־ר֨וּחַ חַיִּ֜ים בְּאַפָּ֗יו מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֶּחָֽרָבָ֖ה מֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: khl 'shr nshmtrvch chyym b'pyv mkhl 'shr bchrbh mtv
verses.translation: all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, whatsoever was in the dry land, died.
