verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֜מַח אֶֽת־כׇּל־הַיְק֣וּם  אֲשֶׁ֣ר  עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֗ה מֵאָדָ֤ם עַד־בְּהֵמָה֙ עַד־רֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ וְעַד־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמָּח֖וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּשָּׁ֧אֶר אַךְ־נֹ֛חַ וַֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymch 'tkhlhyqvm  'shr  'lpny h'dmh m'dm 'dbhmh 'drmsh v'd'vf hshmym vymchv mnh'rts vysh'r 'khnch v'shr 'tv btbh
verses.translation: And He blotted out every living substance which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and creeping thing, and fowl of the heaven; and they were blotted out from the earth; and Noah only was left, and they that were with him in the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְבְּר֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vygbrv hmym 'lh'rts chmshym vm't yvm
verses.translation: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־נֹ֔חַ וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־הַֽחַיָּה֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָ֑ה וַיַּעֲבֵ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים ר֙וּחַ֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּשֹׁ֖כּוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyzkhr 'lhym 'tnch v't khlhchyh v'tkhlhbhmh 'shr 'tv btbh vy'br 'lhym rvch 'lh'rts vyshkhv hmym
verses.translation: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that were with him in the ark; and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסָּֽכְרוּ֙ מַעְיְנֹ֣ת תְּה֔וֹם וַֽאֲרֻבֹּ֖ת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyskhrv m'ynt thvm v'rbt hshmym vykhl' hgshm mnhshmym
verses.translation: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ הַמַּ֛יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָ֖רֶץ הָל֣וֹךְ וָשׁ֑וֹב וַיַּחְסְר֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם מִקְצֵ֕ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv hmym m'l h'rts hlvkh vshvb vychsrv hmym mqtsh chmshym vm't yvm
verses.translation: And the waters returned from off the earth continually; and after the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֤נַח הַתֵּבָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָה־עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י אֲרָרָֽט׃
verses.translit: vtnch htbh bchdsh hshby'y bshb'h'shr yvm lchdsh 'l hry 'rrt
verses.translation: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמַּ֗יִם הָיוּ֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְחָס֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֑י בָּֽעֲשִׂירִי֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ נִרְא֖וּ רָאשֵׁ֥י הֶֽהָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhmym hyv hlvkh vchsvr 'd hchdsh h'shyry b'shyry b'chd lchdsh nr'v r'shy hhrym
verses.translation: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֑וֹם וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח נֹ֔חַ אֶת־חַלּ֥וֹן הַתֵּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'rb'ym yvm vyptch nch 'tchlvn htbh 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־הָֽעֹרֵ֑ב וַיֵּצֵ֤א יָצוֹא֙ וָשׁ֔וֹב עַד־יְבֹ֥שֶׁת הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'th'rb vyts' ytsv' vshvb 'dybsht hmym m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And he sent forth a raven, and it went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הַיּוֹנָ֖ה מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲקַ֣לּוּ הַמַּ֔יִם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'thyvnh m'tv lr'vt hqlv hmym m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־מָצְאָה֩ הַיּוֹנָ֨ה מָנ֜וֹחַ לְכַף־רַגְלָ֗הּ וַתָּ֤שׇׁב אֵלָיו֙ אֶל־הַתֵּבָ֔ה כִּי־מַ֖יִם עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ֙ וַיִּקָּחֶ֔הָ וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'mts'h hyvnh mnvch lkhfrglh vtshb 'lyv 'lhtbh khymym 'lpny khlh'rts vyshlch ydv vyqchh vyb' 'th 'lyv 'lhtbh
verses.translation: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him to the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth; and he put forth his hand, and took her, and brought her in unto him into the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֛סֶף שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הַיּוֹנָ֖ה מִן־הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vychl 'vd shb't ymym 'chrym vysf shlch 'thyvnh mnhtbh
verses.translation: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֨א אֵלָ֤יו הַיּוֹנָה֙ לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲלֵה־זַ֖יִת טָרָ֣ף בְּפִ֑יהָ וַיֵּ֣דַע נֹ֔חַ כִּי־קַ֥לּוּ הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vtb' 'lyv hyvnh l't 'rb vhnh 'lhzyt trf bpyh vyd' nch khyqlv hmym m'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the dove came in to him at eventide; and lo in her mouth an olive-leaf freshly plucked; so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־הַיּוֹנָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יָסְפָ֥ה שׁוּב־אֵלָ֖יו עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vyychl 'vd shb't ymym 'chrym vyshlch 'thyvnh vl'ysph shvb'lyv 'vd
verses.translation: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; and she returned not again unto him any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִ֠י בְּאַחַ֨ת וְשֵׁשׁ־מֵא֜וֹת שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חָֽרְב֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּ֤סַר נֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־מִכְסֵ֣ה הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַיַּ֕רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה חָֽרְב֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht vshshm'vt shnh br'shvn b'chd lchdsh chrbv hmym m'l h'rts vysr nch 'tmkhsh htbh vyr' vhnh chrbv pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth; and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dried.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ יָבְשָׁ֖ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbchdsh hshny bshb'h v'shrym yvm lchdsh ybshh h'rts {s}
verses.translation: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־נֹ֥חַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhym 'lnch l'mr
verses.translation: And God spoke unto Noah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֵ֖א מִן־הַתֵּבָ֑ה אַתָּ֕ה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֛ וּבָנֶ֥יךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי־בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: ts' mnhtbh 'th v'shtkh vbnykh vnshybnykh 'tkh
verses.translation: ’Go forth from the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons’ wives with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַחַיָּ֨ה אֲשֶֽׁר־אִתְּךָ֜ מִכׇּל־בָּשָׂ֗ר בָּע֧וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּבְכׇל־הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ (הוצא) [הַיְצֵ֣א] אִתָּ֑ךְ וְשָֽׁרְצ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָר֥וּ וְרָב֖וּ עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khlhchyh 'shr'tkh mkhlbshr b'vf vbbhmh vbkhlhrmsh hrmsh 'lh'rts (hvts') [hyts'] 'tkh vshrtsv b'rts vprv vrbv 'lh'rts
verses.translation: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee of all flesh, both fowl, and cattle, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may swarm in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖צֵא־נֹ֑חַ וּבָנָ֛יו וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי־בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyts'nch vbnyv v'shtv vnshybnyv 'tv
verses.translation: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons’wives with him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַֽחַיָּ֗ה כׇּל־הָרֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ וְכׇל־הָע֔וֹף כֹּ֖ל רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יָצְא֖וּ מִן־הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khlhchyh khlhrmsh vkhlh'vf khl rvmsh 'lh'rts lmshpchtyhm yts'v mnhtbh
verses.translation: every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, whatsoever moveth upon the earth, after their families; went forth out of the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן נֹ֛חַ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח מִכֹּ֣ל  הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהֹרָ֗ה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָע֣וֹף הַטָּה֔וֹר וַיַּ֥עַל עֹלֹ֖ת בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vybn nch mzbch lyhvh vyqch mkhl  hbhmh hthrh vmkhl h'vf hthvr vy'l 'lt bmzbch
verses.translation: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt-offerings on the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רַח יְהֹוָה֮ אֶת־רֵ֣יחַ הַנִּיחֹ֒חַ֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־לִבּ֗וֹ לֹֽא־אֹ֠סִ֠ף לְקַלֵּ֨ל ע֤וֹד אֶת־הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּעֲב֣וּר הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֠י יֵ֣צֶר לֵ֧ב הָאָדָ֛ם רַ֖ע מִנְּעֻרָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־אֹסִ֥ף ע֛וֹד לְהַכּ֥וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־חַ֖י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.translit: vyrch yhvh 'trych hnychch vy'mr yhvh 'llbv l''sf lqll 'vd 'th'dmh b'bvr h'dm khy ytsr lb h'dm r' mn'ryv vl''sf 'vd lhkhvt 'tkhlchy kh'shr 'shyty
verses.translation: And the LORD smelled the sweet savour; and the LORD said in His heart: ‘I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֖ד כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ זֶ֡רַע וְ֠קָצִ֠יר וְקֹ֨ר וָחֹ֜ם וְקַ֧יִץ וָחֹ֛רֶף וְי֥וֹם וָלַ֖יְלָה לֹ֥א יִשְׁבֹּֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: 'd khlymy h'rts zr' vqtsyr vqr vchm vqyts vchrf vyvm vlylh l' yshbtv
verses.translation: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־נֹ֖חַ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֧אמֶר לָהֶ֛ם פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֖וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vybrkh 'lhym 'tnch v'tbnyv vy'mr lhm prv vrbv vml'v 'th'rts
verses.translation: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them: ‘Be fruitful and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹרַאֲכֶ֤ם וְחִתְּכֶם֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַ֚ל כׇּל־חַיַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּרְמֹ֧שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה וּֽבְכׇל־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֥ם נִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vmvr'khm vchtkhm yhyh 'l khlchyt h'rts v'l khl'vf hshmym bkhl 'shr trmsh h'dmh vbkhldgy hym bydkhm ntnv
verses.translation: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, and upon all wherewith the ground teemeth, and upon all the fishes of the sea: into your hand are they delivered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־רֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּא־חַ֔י לָכֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה לְאׇכְלָ֑ה כְּיֶ֣רֶק עֵ֔שֶׂב נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־כֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: khlrmsh 'shr hv'chy lkhm yhyh l'khlh khyrq 'shb ntty lkhm 'tkhl
verses.translation: Every moving thing that liveth shall be for food for you; as the green herb have I given you all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בָּשָׂ֕ר בְּנַפְשׁ֥וֹ דָמ֖וֹ לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: 'khbshr bnpshv dmv l' t'khlv
verses.translation: Only flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֨ךְ אֶת־דִּמְכֶ֤ם לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ אֶדְרֹ֔שׁ מִיַּ֥ד כׇּל־חַיָּ֖ה אֶדְרְשֶׁ֑נּוּ וּמִיַּ֣ד הָֽאָדָ֗ם מִיַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אֶדְרֹ֖שׁ אֶת־נֶ֥פֶשׁ הָֽאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'kh 'tdmkhm lnpshtykhm 'drsh myd khlchyh 'drshnv vmyd h'dm myd 'ysh 'chyv 'drsh 'tnpsh h'dm
verses.translation: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it; and at the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, will I require the life of man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׁפֵךְ֙ דַּ֣ם הָֽאָדָ֔ם בָּֽאָדָ֖ם דָּמ֣וֹ יִשָּׁפֵ֑ךְ כִּ֚י בְּצֶ֣לֶם אֱלֹהִ֔ים עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: shpkh dm h'dm b'dm dmv yshpkh khy btslm 'lhym 'shh 'th'dm
verses.translation: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of God made He man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֑וּ שִׁרְצ֥וּ בָאָ֖רֶץ וּרְבוּ־בָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tm prv vrbv shrtsv b'rts vrbvbh {s}
verses.translation: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; swarm in the earth, and multiply therein.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־נֹ֔חַ וְאֶל־בָּנָ֥יו אִתּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'lnch v'lbnyv 'tv l'mr
verses.translation: And God spoke unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י מֵקִ֛ים אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְאֶֽת־זַרְעֲכֶ֖ם אַֽחֲרֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnny mqym 'tbryty 'tkhm v'tzr'khm 'chrykhm
verses.translation: ’As for Me, behold, I establish My covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־נֶ֤פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֔ם בָּע֧וֹף בַּבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּֽבְכׇל־חַיַּ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ אִתְּכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י הַתֵּבָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v't khlnpsh hchyh 'shr 'tkhm b'vf bbhmh vbkhlchyt h'rts 'tkhm mkhl yts'y htbh lkhl chyt h'rts
verses.translation: and with every living creature that is with you, the fowl, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you; of all that go out of the ark, even every beast of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֧ת כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֛ר ע֖וֹד מִמֵּ֣י הַמַּבּ֑וּל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד מַבּ֖וּל לְשַׁחֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'tbryty 'tkhm vl'ykhrt khlbshr 'vd mmy hmbvl vl'yhyh 'vd mbvl lshcht h'rts
verses.translation: And I will establish My covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of the flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים זֹ֤את אֽוֹת־הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֗ן בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֛ין כׇּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֑ם לְדֹרֹ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym z't 'vthbryt 'shr'ny ntn byny vbynykhm vbyn khlnpsh chyh 'shr 'tkhm ldrt 'vlm
verses.translation: And God said: ‘This is the token of the covenant which I make between Me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־קַשְׁתִּ֕י נָתַ֖תִּי בֶּֽעָנָ֑ן וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'tqshty ntty b'nn vhyth l'vt bryt byny vbyn h'rts
verses.translation: I have set My bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֕ה בְּעַֽנְנִ֥י עָנָ֖ן עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנִרְאֲתָ֥ה הַקֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּעָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vhyh b'nny 'nn 'lh'rts vnr'th hqsht b'nn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when I bring clouds over the earth, and the bow is seen in the cloud,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֛ין כׇּל־נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה בְּכׇל־בָּשָׂ֑ר וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֨ה ע֤וֹד הַמַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַבּ֔וּל לְשַׁחֵ֖ת כׇּל־בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vzkhrty 'tbryty 'shr byny vbynykhm vbyn khlnpsh chyh bkhlbshr vl'yhyh 'vd hmym lmbvl lshcht khlbshr
verses.translation: that I will remember My covenant, which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה הַקֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּֽעָנָ֑ן וּרְאִיתִ֗יהָ לִזְכֹּר֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם בֵּ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּבֵין֙ כׇּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה בְּכׇל־בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhyth hqsht b'nn vr'ytyh lzkhr bryt 'vlm byn 'lhym vbyn khlnpsh chyh bkhlbshr 'shr 'lh'rts
verses.translation: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־נֹ֑חַ זֹ֤את אֽוֹת־הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲקִמֹ֔תִי בֵּינִ֕י וּבֵ֥ין כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'lnch z't 'vthbryt 'shr hqmty byny vbyn khlbshr 'shr 'lh'rts {p}
verses.translation: And God said unto Noah: ‘This is the token of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is upon the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־נֹ֗חַ הַיֹּֽצְאִים֙ מִן־הַתֵּבָ֔ה שֵׁ֖ם וְחָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וְחָ֕ם ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnynch hyts'ym mnhtbh shm vchm vypt vchm hv' 'by khn'n
verses.translation: And the sons of Noah, that went forth from the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth; and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־נֹ֑חַ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה נָֽפְצָ֥ה כׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shlshh 'lh bnynch vm'lh nptsh khlh'rts
verses.translation: These three were the sons of Noah, and of these was the whole earth overspread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥חֶל נֹ֖חַ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וַיִּטַּ֖ע כָּֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: vychl nch 'ysh h'dmh vyt' khrm
verses.translation: And Noah, the man of the land, began and planted a vineyard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שְׁתְּ מִן־הַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁכָּ֑ר וַיִּתְגַּ֖ל בְּת֥וֹךְ אׇהֳלֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vysht mnhyyn vyshkhr vytgl btvkh 'hlh
verses.translation: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא חָ֚ם אֲבִ֣י כְנַ֔עַן אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יו וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לִשְׁנֵֽי־אֶחָ֖יו בַּחֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: vyr' chm 'by khn'n 't 'rvt 'byv vygd lshny'chyv bchvts
verses.translation: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ שֵׁ֨ם וָיֶ֜פֶת אֶת־הַשִּׂמְלָ֗ה וַיָּשִׂ֙ימוּ֙ עַל־שְׁכֶ֣ם שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וַיְכַסּ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וּפְנֵיהֶם֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqch shm vypt 'thshmlh vyshymv 'lshkhm shnyhm vylkhv 'chrnyt vykhsv 't 'rvt 'byhm vpnyhm 'chrnyt v'rvt 'byhm l' r'v
verses.translation: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father’s nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥יקֶץ נֹ֖חַ מִיֵּינ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֕דַע אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָ֥שָׂה ל֖וֹ בְּנ֥וֹ הַקָּטָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyyqts nch myynv vyd' 't 'shr'shh lv bnv hqtn
verses.translation: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָר֣וּר כְּנָ֑עַן עֶ֥בֶד עֲבָדִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְאֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvr khn'n 'bd 'bdym yhyh l'chyv
verses.translation: And he said: Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹ֣הֵי שֵׁ֑ם וִיהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy shm vyhy khn'n 'bd lmv
verses.translation: And he said: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem; And let Canaan be their servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֤פְתְּ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְיֶ֔פֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּ֖ן בְּאׇֽהֳלֵי־שֵׁ֑ם וִיהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: ypt 'lhym lypt vyshkhn b'hlyshm vyhy khn'n 'bd lmv
verses.translation: God enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; And let Canaan be their servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־נֹ֖חַ אַחַ֣ר הַמַּבּ֑וּל שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַֽחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vychynch 'chr hmbvl shlsh m'vt shnh vchmshym shnh
verses.translation: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כׇּל־יְמֵי־נֹ֔חַ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhyv khlymynch tsh' m'vt shnh vchmshym shnh vymt {p}
verses.translation: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years; and he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת בְּנֵי־נֹ֔חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וַיִּוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם בָּנִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt bnynch shm chm vypt vyvldv lhm bnym 'chr hmbvl
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃
verses.translit: bny ypt gmr vmgvg vmdy vyvn vtbl vmshkh vtyrs
verses.translation: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכְּנַ֥ז וְרִיפַ֖ת וְתֹגַרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny gmr 'shkhnz vrypt vtgrmh
verses.translation: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּתִּ֖ים וְדֹדָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbny yvn 'lyshh vtrshysh khtym vddnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֠אֵ֠לֶּה נִפְרְד֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ בְּאַרְצֹתָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לִלְשֹׁנ֑וֹ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: m'lh nprdv 'yy hgvym b'rtstm 'ysh llshnv lmshpchtm bgvyhm
verses.translation: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּפ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: vbny chm khvsh vmtsrym vpvt vkhn'n
verses.translation: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַֽחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥ה וְרַעְמָ֖ה וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖ה שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃
verses.translit: vbny khvsh sb' vchvylh vsbth vr'mh vsbtkh' vbny r'mh shb' vddn
verses.translation: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־נִמְרֹ֑ד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִֽהְי֥וֹת גִּבֹּ֖ר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vkhvsh yld 'tnmrd hv' hchl lhyvt gbr b'rts
verses.translation: And Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֽוּא־הָיָ֥ה גִבֹּֽר־צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר כְּנִמְרֹ֛ד גִּבּ֥וֹר צַ֖יִד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hv'hyh gbrtsyd lpny yhvh 'lkhn y'mr khnmrd gbvr tsyd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; wherefore it is said: ‘Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֨י רֵאשִׁ֤ית מַמְלַכְתּוֹ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֶ֖רֶךְ וְאַכַּ֣ד וְכַלְנֵ֑ה בְּאֶ֖רֶץ שִׁנְעָֽר׃
verses.translit: vthy r'shyt mmlkhtv bbl v'rkh v'khd vkhlnh b'rts shn'r
verses.translation: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִן־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַהִ֖וא יָצָ֣א אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־נִ֣ינְוֵ֔ה וְאֶת־רְחֹבֹ֥ת עִ֖יר וְאֶת־כָּֽלַח׃
verses.translit: mnh'rts hhv' yts' 'shvr vybn 'tnynvh v'trchbt 'yr v'tkhlch
verses.translation: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-ir, and Calah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־רֶ֔סֶן בֵּ֥ין נִֽינְוֵ֖ה וּבֵ֣ין כָּ֑לַח הִ֖וא הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'trsn byn nynvh vbyn khlch hv' h'yr hgdlh
verses.translation: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah—the same is the great city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־לוּדִ֧ים וְאֶת־עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmtsrym yld 'tlvdym v't'nmym v'tlhbym v'tnptchym
verses.translation: And Mizraim begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'tptrsym v'tkhslchym 'shr yts'v mshm plshtym v'tkhptrym {s}
verses.translation: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim—whence went forth the Philistines—and Caphtorim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־צִידֹ֥ן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־חֵֽת׃
verses.translit: vkhn'n yld 'ttsydn bkhrv v'tcht
verses.translation: And Canaan begot Zidon his firstborn, and Heth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'thybvsy v'th'mry v't hgrgshy
verses.translation: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַֽחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־הַסִּינִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'thchvy v'th'rqy v'thsyny
verses.translation: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָֽאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְאַחַ֣ר נָפֹ֔צוּ מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת הַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th'rvdy v'thtsmry v'thchmty v'chr nptsv mshpchvt hkhn'ny
verses.translation: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite; and afterward were the families of the Canaanite spread abroad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י גְּב֤וּל הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִצִּידֹ֔ן בֹּאֲכָ֥ה גְרָ֖רָה עַד־עַזָּ֑ה בֹּאֲכָ֞ה סְדֹ֧מָה וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאַדְמָ֥ה וּצְבֹיִ֖ם עַד־לָֽשַׁע׃
verses.translit: vyhy gbvl hkhn'ny mtsydn b'khh grrh 'd'zh b'khh sdmh v'mrh v'dmh vtsbym 'dlsh'
verses.translation: And the border of the Canaanite was from Zidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־חָ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹֽׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh bnychm lmshpchtm llshntm b'rtstm bgvyhm {s}
verses.translation: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשֵׁ֥ם יֻלַּ֖ד גַּם־ה֑וּא אֲבִי֙ כׇּל־בְּנֵי־עֵ֔בֶר אֲחִ֖י יֶ֥פֶת הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vlshm yld gmhv' 'by khlbny'br 'chy ypt hgdvl
verses.translation: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י שֵׁ֖ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֑וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֥וּד וַֽאֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny shm 'ylm v'shvr v'rpkhshd vlvd v'rm
verses.translation: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י אֲרָ֑ם ע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמַֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vbny 'rm 'vts vchvl vgtr vmsh
verses.translation: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd yld 'tshlch vshlch yld 't'br
verses.translation: And Arpachshad begot Shelah; and Shelah begot Eber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָֽאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יׇקְטָֽן׃
verses.translit: vl'br yld shny bnym shm h'chd plg khy bymyv nplgh h'rts vshm 'chyv yqtn
verses.translation: And unto Eber were born two sons; the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיׇקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־יָֽרַח׃
verses.translit: vyqtn yld 't'lmvdd v'tshlf v'tchtsrmvt v'tyrch
verses.translation: And Joktan begot Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־דִּקְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'thdvrm v't'vzl v'tdqlh
verses.translation: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עוֹבָ֥ל וְאֶת־אֲבִֽימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־שְׁבָֽא׃
verses.translit: v't'vbl v't'bym'l v'tshb'
verses.translation: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אוֹפִ֥ר וְאֶת־חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־יוֹבָ֑ב כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יׇקְטָֽן׃
verses.translit: v't'vpr v'tchvylh v'tyvbb khl'lh bny yqtn
verses.translation: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י מוֹשָׁבָ֖ם מִמֵּשָׁ֑א בֹּאֲכָ֥ה סְפָ֖רָה הַ֥ר הַקֶּֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: vyhy mvshbm mmsh' b'khh sprh hr hqdm
verses.translation: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, unto the mountain of the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי־שֵׁ֔ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָ֑ם בְּאַרְצֹתָ֖ם לְגוֹיֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh bnyshm lmshpchtm llshntm b'rtstm lgvyhm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֧ת בְּנֵי־נֹ֛חַ לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֖ם בְּגוֹיֵהֶ֑ם וּמֵאֵ֜לֶּה נִפְרְד֧וּ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bnynch ltvldtm bgvyhm vm'lh nprdv hgvym b'rts 'chr hmbvl {p}
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations; and of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ שָׂפָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּדְבָרִ֖ים אֲחָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy khlh'rts shph 'cht vdbrym 'chdym
verses.translation: And the whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בְּנׇסְעָ֣ם מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַֽיִּמְצְא֥וּ בִקְעָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyhy bns'm mqdm vymts'v bq'h b'rts shn'r vyshbv shm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they journeyed east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ הָ֚בָה נִלְבְּנָ֣ה לְבֵנִ֔ים וְנִשְׂרְפָ֖ה לִשְׂרֵפָ֑ה וַתְּהִ֨י לָהֶ֤ם הַלְּבֵנָה֙ לְאָ֔בֶן וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ר הָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לַחֹֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'lr'hv hbh nlbnh lbnym vnshrph lshrph vthy lhm hlbnh l'bn vhchmr hyh lhm lchmr
verses.translation: And they said one to another: ‘Come, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly.’ And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ הָ֣בָה  נִבְנֶה־לָּ֣נוּ עִ֗יר וּמִגְדָּל֙ וְרֹאשׁ֣וֹ בַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֖נוּ שֵׁ֑ם פֶּן־נָפ֖וּץ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv hbh  nbnhlnv 'yr vmgdl vr'shv bshmym vn'shhlnv shm pnnpvts 'lpny khlh'rts
verses.translation: And they said: ‘Come, let us build us a city, and a tower, with its top in heaven, and let us make us a name; lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣רֶד יְהֹוָ֔ה לִרְאֹ֥ת אֶת־הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־הַמִּגְדָּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh lr't 'th'yr v'thmgdl 'shr bnv bny h'dm
verses.translation: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֗ה הֵ֣ן עַ֤ם אֶחָד֙ וְשָׂפָ֤ה אַחַת֙ לְכֻלָּ֔ם וְזֶ֖ה הַחִלָּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת וְעַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־יִבָּצֵ֣ר מֵהֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָזְמ֖וּ לַֽעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh hn 'm 'chd vshph 'cht lkhlm vzh hchlm l'shvt v'th l'ybtsr mhm khl 'shr yzmv l'shvt
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language; and this is what they begin to do; and now nothing will be withholden from them, which they purpose to do.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֚בָה נֵֽרְדָ֔ה וְנָבְלָ֥ה שָׁ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפַ֥ת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: hbh nrdh vnblh shm shptm 'shr l' yshm'v 'ysh shpt r'hv
verses.translation: Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨פֶץ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם מִשָּׁ֖ם עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחְדְּל֖וּ לִבְנֹ֥ת הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vypts yhvh 'tm mshm 'lpny khlh'rts vychdlv lbnt h'yr
verses.translation: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth; and they left off to build the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֞ן קָרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל כִּי־שָׁ֛ם בָּלַ֥ל יְהֹוָ֖ה שְׂפַ֣ת כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וּמִשָּׁם֙ הֱפִיצָ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־פְּנֵ֖י כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lkhn qr' shmh bbl khyshm bll yhvh shpt khlh'rts vmshm hpytsm yhvh 'lpny khlh'rts {p}
verses.translation: Therefore was the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there aconfound the language of all the earth; and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת שֵׁ֔ם שֵׁ֚ם בֶּן־מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֔ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֑ד שְׁנָתַ֖יִם אַחַ֥ר הַמַּבּֽוּל׃
verses.translit: 'lh tvldt shm shm bnm't shnh vyvld 't'rpkhshd shntym 'chr hmbvl
verses.translation: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old, and begot Arpachshad two years after the flood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־שֵׁ֗ם אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־אַרְפַּכְשָׁ֔ד חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychyshm 'chry hvlydv 't'rpkhshd chmsh m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Shem lived after he begot Arpachshad five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֣ד חַ֔י חָמֵ֥שׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־שָֽׁלַח׃
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd chy chmsh vshlshym shnh vyvld 'tshlch
verses.translation: And Arpachshad lived five and thirty years, and begot Shelah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֗ד אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שֶׁ֔לַח שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychy 'rpkhshd 'chry hvlydv 'tshlch shlsh shnym v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Arpachshad lived after he begot Shelah four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֥לַח חַ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: vshlch chy shlshym shnh vyvld 't'br
verses.translation: And Shelah lived thirty years, and begot Eber.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־שֶׁ֗לַח אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־עֵ֔בֶר שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychyshlch 'chry hvlydv 't'br shlsh shnym v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Shelah lived after he begot Eber four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־עֵ֕בֶר אַרְבַּ֥ע וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־פָּֽלֶג׃
verses.translit: vychy'br 'rb' vshlshym shnh vyvld 'tplg
verses.translation: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begot Peleg.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־עֵ֗בֶר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־פֶּ֔לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychy'br 'chry hvlydv 'tplg shlshym shnh v'rb' m'vt shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Eber lived after he begot Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־פֶ֖לֶג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־רְעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vychyplg shlshym shnh vyvld 'tr'v
verses.translation: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־פֶ֗לֶג אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־רְע֔וּ תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychyplg 'chry hvlydv 'tr'v tsh' shnym vm'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Peleg lived after he begot Reu two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֔וּ שְׁתַּ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־שְׂרֽוּג׃
verses.translit: vychy r'v shtym vshlshym shnh vyvld 'tshrvg
verses.translation: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begot Serug.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י רְע֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־שְׂר֔וּג שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychy r'v 'chry hvlydv 'tshrvg shb' shnym vm'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Reu lived after he begot Serug two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֥י שְׂר֖וּג שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־נָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vychy shrvg shlshym shnh vyvld 'tnchvr
verses.translation: And Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י שְׂר֗וּג אַחֲרֵ֛י הוֹלִיד֥וֹ אֶת־נָח֖וֹר מָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychy shrvg 'chry hvlydv 'tnchvr m'tym shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Serug lived after he begot Nahor two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֔וֹר תֵּ֥שַׁע וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֖וֹלֶד אֶת־תָּֽרַח׃
verses.translit: vychy nchvr tsh' v'shrym shnh vyvld 'ttrch
verses.translation: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begot Terah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחִ֣י נָח֗וֹר אַחֲרֵי֙ הוֹלִיד֣וֹ אֶת־תֶּ֔רַח תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה וּמְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֥וֹלֶד בָּנִ֖ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vychy nchvr 'chry hvlydv 'ttrch tsh''shrh shnh vm't shnh vyvld bnym vbnvt {s}
verses.translation: And Nahor lived after he begot Terah a hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְחִי־תֶ֖רַח שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיּ֙וֹלֶד֙ אֶת־אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־הָרָֽן׃
verses.translit: vychytrch shb'ym shnh vyvld 't'brm 'tnchvr v'thrn
verses.translation: And Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת תֶּ֔רַח תֶּ֚רַח הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־אַבְרָ֔ם אֶת־נָח֖וֹר וְאֶת־הָרָ֑ן וְהָרָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־לֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt trch trch hvlyd 't'brm 'tnchvr v'thrn vhrn hvlyd 'tlvt
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begot Lot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇת הָרָ֔ן עַל־פְּנֵ֖י תֶּ֣רַח אָבִ֑יו בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּ֖וֹ בְּא֥וּר כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vymt hrn 'lpny trch 'byv b'rts mvldtv b'vr khshdym
verses.translation: And Haran died in the presence of his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָ֧ם וְנָח֛וֹר לָהֶ֖ם נָשִׁ֑ים שֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־אַבְרָם֙ שָׂרָ֔י וְשֵׁ֤ם אֵֽשֶׁת־נָחוֹר֙ מִלְכָּ֔ה בַּת־הָרָ֥ן אֲבִֽי־מִלְכָּ֖ה וַֽאֲבִ֥י יִסְכָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'brm vnchvr lhm nshym shm 'sht'brm shry vshm 'shtnchvr mlkhh bthrn 'bymlkhh v'by yskhh
verses.translation: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּהִ֥י שָׂרַ֖י עֲקָרָ֑ה אֵ֥ין לָ֖הּ וָלָֽד׃
verses.translit: vthy shry 'qrh 'yn lh vld
verses.translation: And Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח תֶּ֜רַח אֶת־אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֶת־ל֤וֹט בֶּן־הָרָן֙ בֶּן־בְּנ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ שָׂרַ֣י כַּלָּת֔וֹ אֵ֖שֶׁת אַבְרָ֣ם בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּצְא֨וּ אִתָּ֜ם מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַד־חָרָ֖ן וַיֵּ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyqch trch 't'brm bnv v'tlvt bnhrn bnbnv v't shry khltv 'sht 'brm bnv vyts'v 'tm m'vr khshdym llkht 'rtsh khn'n vyb'v 'dchrn vyshbv shm
verses.translation: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵי־תֶ֔רַח חָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים וּמָאתַ֣יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֥מׇת תֶּ֖רַח בְּחָרָֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhyv ymytrch chmsh shnym vm'tym shnh vymt trch bchrn {p}
verses.translation: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years; and Terah died in Haran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם לֶךְ־לְךָ֛ מֵאַרְצְךָ֥ וּמִמּֽוֹלַדְתְּךָ֖ וּמִבֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַרְאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l'brm lkhlkh m'rtskh vmmvldtkh vmbyt 'bykh 'lh'rts 'shr 'r'kh
verses.translation: Now the LORD said unto Abram: ‘Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto the land that I will show thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶֽעֶשְׂךָ֙ לְג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל וַאֲבָ֣רֶכְךָ֔ וַאֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וֶהְיֵ֖ה בְּרָכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v''shkh lgvy gdvl v'brkhkh v'gdlh shmkh vhyh brkhh
verses.translation: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבָֽרְכָה֙ מְבָ֣רְכֶ֔יךָ וּמְקַלֶּלְךָ֖ אָאֹ֑ר וְנִבְרְכ֣וּ בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'brkhh mbrkhykh vmqllkh ''r vnbrkhv bkh khl mshpcht h'dmh
verses.translation: And I will bless them that bless thee, and him that curseth thee will I curse; and in thee shall all the families of the earth be blessed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אַבְרָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖וֹ ל֑וֹט וְאַבְרָ֗ם בֶּן־חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּצֵאת֖וֹ מֵחָרָֽן׃
verses.translit: vylkh 'brm kh'shr dbr 'lyv yhvh vylkh 'tv lvt v'brm bnchmsh shnym vshb'ym shnh bts'tv mchrn
verses.translation: So Abram went, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him; and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אַבְרָם֩ אֶת־שָׂרַ֨י אִשְׁתּ֜וֹ וְאֶת־ל֣וֹט בֶּן־אָחִ֗יו וְאֶת־כׇּל־רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָכָ֔שׁוּ וְאֶת־הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֣וּ בְחָרָ֑ן וַיֵּצְא֗וּ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'brm 'tshry 'shtv v'tlvt bn'chyv v'tkhlrkhvshm 'shr rkhshv v'thnpsh 'shr'shv bchrn vyts'v llkht 'rtsh khn'n vyb'v 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר אַבְרָם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַ֚ד מְק֣וֹם שְׁכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד אֵל֣וֹן מוֹרֶ֑ה וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י אָ֥ז בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'br 'brm b'rts 'd mqvm shkhm 'd 'lvn mvrh vhkhn'ny 'z b'rts
verses.translation: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem, unto the terebinth of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהֹוָ֖ה הַנִּרְאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh 'l'brm vy'mr lzr'kh 'tn 'th'rts hz't vybn shm mzbch lyhvh hnr'h 'lyv
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said: ‘Unto thy seed will I give this land’; and he builded there an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעְתֵּ֨ק מִשָּׁ֜ם הָהָ֗רָה מִקֶּ֛דֶם לְבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וַיֵּ֣ט אׇהֳלֹ֑ה בֵּֽית־אֵ֤ל מִיָּם֙ וְהָעַ֣י מִקֶּ֔דֶם וַיִּֽבֶן־שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'tq mshm hhrh mqdm lbyt'l vyt 'hlh byt'l mym vh'y mqdm vybnshm mzbch lyhvh vyqr' bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And he removed from thence unto the mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Ai on the east; and he builded there an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֣ע אַבְרָ֔ם הָל֥וֹךְ וְנָס֖וֹעַ הַנֶּֽגְבָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vys' 'brm hlvkh vnsv' hngbh {p}
verses.translation: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיֵּ֨רֶד אַבְרָ֤ם מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ לָג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם כִּֽי־כָבֵ֥ד הָרָעָ֖ב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhy r'b b'rts vyrd 'brm mtsrymh lgvr shm khykhbd hr'b b'rts
verses.translation: And there was a famine in the land; and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was sore in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יב לָב֣וֹא מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ הִנֵּה־נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִשָּׁ֥ה יְפַת־מַרְאֶ֖ה אָֽתְּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr hqryb lbv' mtsrymh vy'mr 'lshry 'shtv hnhn' yd'ty khy 'shh yptmr'h 't
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife: ‘Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־יִרְא֤וּ אֹתָךְ֙ הַמִּצְרִ֔ים וְאָמְר֖וּ אִשְׁתּ֣וֹ זֹ֑את וְהָרְג֥וּ אֹתִ֖י וְאֹתָ֥ךְ יְחַיּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyyr'v 'tkh hmtsrym v'mrv 'shtv z't vhrgv 'ty v'tkh ychyv
verses.translation: And it will come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they will say: This is his wife; and they will kill me, but thee they will keep alive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְרִי־נָ֖א אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִֽיטַב־לִ֣י בַעֲבוּרֵ֔ךְ וְחָיְתָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י בִּגְלָלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: 'mryn' 'chty 't lm'n yytbly b'bvrkh vchyth npshy bgllkh
verses.translation: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister; that it may be well with me for thy sake, and that my soul may live because of thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּב֥וֹא אַבְרָ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּרְא֤וּ הַמִּצְרִים֙ אֶת־הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־יָפָ֥ה הִ֖וא מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyhy khbv' 'brm mtsrymh vyr'v hmtsrym 'th'shh khyyph hv' m'd
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַיְהַֽלְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַתֻּקַּ֥ח הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 'th shry pr'h vyhllv 'th 'lpr'h vtqch h'shh byt pr'h
verses.translation: And the princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאַבְרָ֥ם הֵיטִ֖יב בַּעֲבוּרָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־ל֤וֹ צֹאן־וּבָקָר֙ וַחֲמֹרִ֔ים וַעֲבָדִים֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַאֲתֹנֹ֖ת וּגְמַלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vl'brm hytyb b'bvrh vyhylv ts'nvbqr vchmrym v'bdym vshpcht v'tnt vgmlym
verses.translation: And he dealt well with Abram for her sake; and he had sheep, and oxen, and he-asses, and men-servants, and maid-servants, and she-asses, and camels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְנַגַּ֨ע יְהֹוָ֧ה ׀ אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֛ה נְגָעִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים וְאֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרַ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyng' yhvh  'tpr'h ng'ym gdlym v'tbytv 'ldbr shry 'sht 'brm
verses.translation: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א פַרְעֹה֙ לְאַבְרָ֔ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֑י לָ֚מָּה לֹא־הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔י כִּ֥י אִשְׁתְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h l'brm vy'mr mhz't 'shyt ly lmh l'hgdt ly khy 'shtkh hv'
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said: ‘What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָ֤ה אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֔וא וָאֶקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ לִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֖ קַ֥ח וָלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lmh 'mrt 'chty hv' v'qch 'th ly l'shh v'th hnh 'shtkh qch vlkh
verses.translation: Why saidst thou: She is my sister? so that I took her to be my wife; now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו עָלָ֛יו פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytsv 'lyv pr'h 'nshym vyshlchv 'tv v't'shtv v'tkhl'shrlv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh gave men charge concerning him; and they brought him on the way, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַל֩ אַבְרָ֨ם מִמִּצְרַ֜יִם ה֠וּא וְאִשְׁתּ֧וֹ וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ וְל֥וֹט עִמּ֖וֹ הַנֶּֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: vy'l 'brm mmtsrym hv' v'shtv vkhl'shrlv vlvt 'mv hngbh
verses.translation: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְרָ֖ם כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד בַּמִּקְנֶ֕ה בַּכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'brm khbd m'd bmqnh bkhsf vbzhb
verses.translation: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְמַסָּעָ֔יו מִנֶּ֖גֶב וְעַד־בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל עַד־הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר־הָ֨יָה שָׁ֤ם אׇֽהֳלֹה֙ בַּתְּחִלָּ֔ה בֵּ֥ין בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל וּבֵ֥ין הָעָֽי׃
verses.translit: vylkh lms'yv mngb v'dbyt'l 'dhmqvm 'shrhyh shm 'hlh btchlh byn byt'l vbyn h'y
verses.translation: And he went on his journeys from the South even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Ai;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־מְקוֹם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־עָ֥שָׂה שָׁ֖ם בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֥א שָׁ֛ם אַבְרָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lmqvm hmzbch 'shr'shh shm br'shnh vyqr' shm 'brm bshm yhvh
verses.translation: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first; and Abram called there on the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם־לְל֔וֹט הַהֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶת־אַבְרָ֑ם הָיָ֥ה צֹאן־וּבָקָ֖ר וְאֹהָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vgmllvt hhlkh 't'brm hyh ts'nvbqr v'hlym
verses.translation: And Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־נָשָׂ֥א אֹתָ֛ם הָאָ֖רֶץ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־הָיָ֤ה רְכוּשָׁם֙ רָ֔ב וְלֹ֥א יָֽכְל֖וּ לָשֶׁ֥בֶת יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: vl'nsh' 'tm h'rts lshbt ychdv khyhyh rkhvshm rb vl' ykhlv lshbt ychdv
verses.translation: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together; for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־רִ֗יב בֵּ֚ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵֽה־אַבְרָ֔ם וּבֵ֖ין רֹעֵ֣י מִקְנֵה־ל֑וֹט וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י אָ֖ז יֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhyryb byn r'y mqnh'brm vbyn r'y mqnhlvt vhkhn'ny vhprzy 'z yshb b'rts
verses.translation: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle. And the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelt then in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל־ל֗וֹט אַל־נָ֨א תְהִ֤י מְרִיבָה֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּבֵ֥ין רֹעַ֖י וּבֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אַחִ֖ים אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'llvt 'ln' thy mrybh byny vbynkh vbyn r'y vbyn r'ykh khy'nshym 'chym 'nchnv
verses.translation: And Abram said unto Lot: ‘Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we are brethren.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א כׇל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ הִפָּ֥רֶד נָ֖א מֵעָלָ֑י אִם־הַשְּׂמֹ֣אל וְאֵימִ֔נָה וְאִם־הַיָּמִ֖ין וְאַשְׂמְאִֽילָה׃
verses.translit: hl' khlh'rts lpnykh hprd n' m'ly 'mhshm'l v'ymnh v'mhymyn v'shm'ylh
verses.translation: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me; if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou take the right hand, then I will go to the left.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂא־ל֣וֹט אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־כׇּל־כִּכַּ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן כִּ֥י כֻלָּ֖הּ מַשְׁקֶ֑ה לִפְנֵ֣י  שַׁחֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־סְדֹם֙ וְאֶת־עֲמֹרָ֔ה כְּגַן־יְהֹוָה֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה צֹֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vysh'lvt 't'ynyv vyr' 'tkhlkhkhr hyrdn khy khlh mshqh lpny  shcht yhvh 'tsdm v't'mrh khgnyhvh kh'rts mtsrym b'khh ts'r
verses.translation: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou goest unto Zoar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְחַר־ל֣וֹ ל֗וֹט אֵ֚ת כׇּל־כִּכַּ֣ר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּסַּ֥ע ל֖וֹט מִקֶּ֑דֶם וַיִּפָּ֣רְד֔וּ אִ֖ישׁ מֵעַ֥ל אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vybchrlv lvt 't khlkhkhr hyrdn vys' lvt mqdm vyprdv 'ysh m'l 'chyv
verses.translation: So Lot chose him all the plain of the Jordan; and Lot journeyed east; and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן וְל֗וֹט יָשַׁב֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיֶּאֱהַ֖ל עַד־סְדֹֽם׃
verses.translit: 'brm yshb b'rtskhn'n vlvt yshb b'ry hkhkhr vy'hl 'dsdm
verses.translation: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the Plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י סְדֹ֔ם רָעִ֖ים וְחַטָּאִ֑ים לַיהֹוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: v'nshy sdm r'ym vcht'ym lyhvh m'd
verses.translation: Now the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners against the LORD exceedingly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל־אַבְרָ֗ם אַחֲרֵי֙ הִפָּֽרֶד־ל֣וֹט מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֣ה שָׁ֑ם צָפֹ֥נָה וָנֶ֖גְבָּה וָקֵ֥דְמָה וָיָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyhvh 'mr 'l'brm 'chry hprdlvt m'mv sh' n' 'ynykh vr'h mnhmqvm 'shr'th shm tspnh vngbh vqdmh vymh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him: ‘Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art, northward and southward and eastward and westward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'tkhlh'rts 'shr'th r'h lkh 'tnnh vlzr'kh 'd'vlm
verses.translation: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֖ כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר  אִם־יוּכַ֣ל אִ֗ישׁ לִמְנוֹת֙ אֶת־עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ גַּֽם־זַרְעֲךָ֖ יִמָּנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmty 'tzr'kh kh'pr h'rts 'shr  'myvkhl 'ysh lmnvt 't'pr h'rts gmzr'kh ymnh
verses.translation: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth; so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וּם הִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בָּאָ֔רֶץ לְאׇרְכָּ֖הּ וּלְרׇחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לְךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: qvm hthlkh b'rts l'rkhh vlrchbh khy lkh 'tnnh
verses.translation: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for unto thee will I give it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֣ל אַבְרָ֗ם וַיָּבֹ֛א וַיֵּ֛שֶׁב בְּאֵלֹנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחֶבְר֑וֹן וַיִּֽבֶן־שָׁ֥ם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'hl 'brm vyb' vyshb b'lny mmr' 'shr bchbrvn vybnshm mzbch lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Abram moved his tent, and came and dwelt by the terebinths of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵי֙ אַמְרָפֶ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־שִׁנְעָ֔ר אַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר כְּדׇרְלָעֹ֙מֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֔ם וְתִדְעָ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'mrpl mlkhshn'r 'ryvkh mlkh 'lsr khdrl'mr mlkh 'ylm vtd'l mlkh gvym
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשׂ֣וּ מִלְחָמָ֗ה אֶת־בֶּ֙רַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֔ם וְאֶת־בִּרְשַׁ֖ע מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֑ה שִׁנְאָ֣ב  מֶ֣לֶךְ אַדְמָ֗ה וְשֶׁמְאֵ֙בֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִ֔ם] וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִיא־צֹֽעַר׃
verses.translit: 'shv mlchmh 'tbr' mlkh sdm v'tbrsh' mlkh 'mrh shn'b  mlkh 'dmh vshm'br mlkh (tsbyym) [tsbvym] vmlkh bl' hy'ts'r
verses.translation: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela—the same is Zoar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אֵ֙לֶּה֙ חָֽבְר֔וּ אֶל־עֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּ֑ים ה֖וּא יָ֥ם הַמֶּֽלַח׃
verses.translit: khl'lh chbrv 'l'mq hshdym hv' ym hmlch
verses.translation: All these came as allies unto the vale of Siddim—the same is the Salt Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עָבְד֖וּ אֶת־כְּדׇרְלָעֹ֑מֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה מָרָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: shtym 'shrh shnh 'bdv 'tkhdrl'mr vshlsh'shrh shnh mrdv
verses.translation: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה בָּ֣א כְדׇרְלָעֹ֗מֶר וְהַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ וַיַּכּ֤וּ אֶת־רְפָאִים֙ בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת קַרְנַ֔יִם וְאֶת־הַזּוּזִ֖ים בְּהָ֑ם וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֵימִ֔ים בְּשָׁוֵ֖ה קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vb'rb' 'shrh shnh b' khdrl'mr vhmlkhym 'shr 'tv vykhv 'trp'ym b'shtrt qrnym v'thzvzym bhm v't h'ymym bshvh qrytym
verses.translation: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַחֹרִ֖י בְּהַרְרָ֣ם שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֚ד אֵ֣יל פָּארָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: v'thchry bhrrm sh'yr 'd 'yl p'rn 'shr 'lhmdbr
verses.translation: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יָּשֻׁ֠בוּ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־עֵ֤ין מִשְׁפָּט֙ הִ֣וא קָדֵ֔שׁ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶֽת־כׇּל־שְׂדֵ֖ה הָעֲמָלֵקִ֑י וְגַם֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַֽצְצֹ֥ן תָּמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshbv vyb'v 'l'yn mshpt hv' qdsh vykhv 'tkhlshdh h'mlqy vgm 'th'mry hyshb bchtstsn tmr
verses.translation: And they turned back, and came to En-mishpat—the same is Kadesh—and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ־סְדֹ֜ם וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֗ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ אַדְמָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ (צביים) [צְבוֹיִ֔ם] וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִוא־צֹ֑עַר וַיַּֽעַרְכ֤וּ אִתָּם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts' mlkhsdm vmlkh 'mrh vmlkh 'dmh vmlkh (tsbyym) [tsbvym] vmlkh bl' hv'ts'r vy'rkhv 'tm mlchmh b'mq hshdym
verses.translation: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela—the same is Zoar; and they set the battle in array against them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת כְּדׇרְלָעֹ֜מֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֗ם וְתִדְעָל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְאַמְרָפֶל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁנְעָ֔ר וְאַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֥ה מְלָכִ֖ים אֶת־הַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 't khdrl'mr mlkh 'ylm vtd'l mlkh gvym v'mrpl mlkh shn'r v'ryvkh mlkh 'lsr 'rb'h mlkhym 'thchmshh
verses.translation: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵ֣מֶק הַשִּׂדִּ֗ים בֶּֽאֱרֹ֤ת בֶּאֱרֹת֙ חֵמָ֔ר וַיָּנֻ֛סוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה וַיִּפְּלוּ־שָׁ֑מָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים הֶ֥רָה נָּֽסוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mq hshdym b'rt b'rt chmr vynsv mlkhsdm v'mrh vyplvshmh vhnsh'rym hrh nsv
verses.translation: Now the vale of Siddim was full of slime pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּקְח֠וּ אֶת־כׇּל־רְכֻ֨שׁ סְדֹ֧ם וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־אׇכְלָ֖ם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqchv 'tkhlrkhsh sdm v'mrh v'tkhl'khlm vylkhv
verses.translation: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֨וּ אֶת־ל֧וֹט וְאֶת־רְכֻשׁ֛וֹ בֶּן־אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָ֖ם וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב בִּסְדֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqchv 'tlvt v'trkhshv bn'chy 'brm vylkhv vhv' yshb bsdm
verses.translation: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֙ הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיַּגֵּ֖ד לְאַבְרָ֣ם הָעִבְרִ֑י וְהוּא֩ שֹׁכֵ֨ן בְּאֵֽלֹנֵ֜י מַמְרֵ֣א הָאֱמֹרִ֗י אֲחִ֤י אֶשְׁכֹּל֙ וַאֲחִ֣י עָנֵ֔ר וְהֵ֖ם בַּעֲלֵ֥י בְרִית־אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyb' hplyt vygd l'brm h'bry vhv' shkhn b'lny mmr' h'mry 'chy 'shkhl v'chy 'nr vhm b'ly bryt'brm
verses.translation: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew—now he dwelt by the terebinths of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָ֔ם כִּ֥י נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אָחִ֑יו וַיָּ֨רֶק אֶת־חֲנִיכָ֜יו יְלִידֵ֣י בֵית֗וֹ שְׁמֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וַיִּרְדֹּ֖ף עַד־דָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyshm' 'brm khy nshbh 'chyv vyrq 'tchnykhyv ylydy bytv shmnh 'shr vshlsh m'vt vyrdf 'ddn
verses.translation: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּחָלֵ֨ק עֲלֵיהֶ֧ם ׀ לַ֛יְלָה ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וַיַּכֵּ֑ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵם֙ עַד־חוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְּׂמֹ֖אל לְדַמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.translit: vychlq 'lyhm  lylh hv' v'bdyv vykhm vyrdpm 'dchvbh 'shr mshm'l ldmshq
verses.translation: And he divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׁב אֵ֖ת כׇּל־הָרְכֻ֑שׁ וְגַם֩ אֶת־ל֨וֹט אָחִ֤יו וּרְכֻשׁוֹ֙ הֵשִׁ֔יב וְגַ֥ם אֶת־הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְאֶת־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshb 't khlhrkhsh vgm 'tlvt 'chyv vrkhshv hshyb vgm 'thnshym v'th'm
verses.translation: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ־סְדֹם֮ לִקְרָאתוֹ֒ אַחֲרֵ֣י שׁוּב֗וֹ מֵֽהַכּוֹת֙ אֶת־כְּדׇרְלָעֹ֔מֶר וְאֶת־הַמְּלָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ אֶל־עֵ֣מֶק שָׁוֵ֔ה ה֖וּא עֵ֥מֶק הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyts' mlkhsdm lqr'tv 'chry shvbv mhkhvt 'tkhdrl'mr v'thmlkhym 'shr 'tv 'l'mq shvh hv' 'mq hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him, at the vale of Shaveh—the same is the King’s Vale.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְכִּי־צֶ֙דֶק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שָׁלֵ֔ם הוֹצִ֖יא לֶ֣חֶם וָיָ֑יִן וְה֥וּא כֹהֵ֖ן לְאֵ֥ל עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vmlkhytsdq mlkh shlm hvtsy' lchm vyyn vhv' khhn l'l 'lyvn
verses.translation: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine; and he was priest of God the Most High.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּר֤וּךְ אַבְרָם֙ לְאֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vybrkhhv vy'mr brvkh 'brm l'l 'lyvn qnh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: And he blessed him, and said: ‘Blessed be Abram of God Most High, Maker of heaven and earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָרוּךְ֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־מִגֵּ֥ן צָרֶ֖יךָ בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֥וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: vbrvkh 'l 'lyvn 'shrmgn tsrykh bydkh vytnlv m'shr mkhl
verses.translation: and blessed be God the Most High, who hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand.’ And he gave him a tenth of all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־סְדֹ֖ם אֶל־אַבְרָ֑ם תֶּן־לִ֣י הַנֶּ֔פֶשׁ וְהָרְכֻ֖שׁ קַֽח־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkhsdm 'l'brm tnly hnpsh vhrkhsh qchlkh
verses.translation: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram: ‘Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָ֖ם אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֑ם הֲרִמֹ֨תִי יָדִ֤י אֶל־יְהֹוָה֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'lmlkh sdm hrmty ydy 'lyhvh 'l 'lyvn qnh shmym v'rts
verses.translation: And Abram said to the king of Sodom: ‘I have lifted up my hand unto the LORD, God Most High, Maker of heaven and earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־מִחוּט֙ וְעַ֣ד שְׂרֽוֹךְ־נַ֔עַל וְאִם־אֶקַּ֖ח מִכׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֣א תֹאמַ֔ר אֲנִ֖י הֶעֱשַׁ֥רְתִּי אֶת־אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mmchvt v'd shrvkhn'l v'm'qch mkhl'shrlkh vl' t'mr 'ny h'shrty 't'brm
verses.translation: that I will not take a thread nor a shoe-latchet nor aught that is thine, lest thou shouldest say: I have made Abram rich;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּלְעָדַ֗י רַ֚ק אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽכְל֣וּ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וְחֵ֙לֶק֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלְכ֖וּ אִתִּ֑י עָנֵר֙ אֶשְׁכֹּ֣ל וּמַמְרֵ֔א הֵ֖ם יִקְח֥וּ חֶלְקָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bl'dy rq 'shr 'khlv hn'rym vchlq h'nshym 'shr hlkhv 'ty 'nr 'shkhl vmmr' hm yqchv chlqm {s}
verses.translation: save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre, let them take their portion.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֣ר  הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָיָ֤ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ אֶל־אַבְרָ֔ם בַּֽמַּחֲזֶ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אַל־תִּירָ֣א אַבְרָ֗ם אָנֹכִי֙ מָגֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ שְׂכָרְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'chr  hdbrym h'lh hyh dbryhvh 'l'brm bmchzh l'mr 'ltyr' 'brm 'nkhy mgn lkh shkhrkh hrbh m'd
verses.translation: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying: ‘Fear not, Abram, I am thy shield, thy reward shall be exceeding great.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֗ם אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לִ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עֲרִירִ֑י וּבֶן־מֶ֣שֶׁק בֵּיתִ֔י ה֖וּא דַּמֶּ֥שֶׂק אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'dny yhvh mhttnly v'nkhy hvlkh 'ryry vbnmshq byty hv' dmshq 'ly'zr
verses.translation: And Abram said: ‘O Lord GOD, what wilt Thou give me, seeing I go hence childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָ֔ם הֵ֣ן לִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖תָּה זָ֑רַע וְהִנֵּ֥ה בֶן־בֵּיתִ֖י יוֹרֵ֥שׁ אֹתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm hn ly l' ntth zr' vhnh bnbyty yvrsh 'ty
verses.translation: And Abram said: ‘Behold, to me Thou hast given no seed, and, lo, one born in my house is to be mine heir.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א יִֽירָשְׁךָ֖ זֶ֑ה כִּי־אִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִמֵּעֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יִֽירָשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: vhnh dbryhvh 'lyv l'mr l' yyrshkh zh khy'm 'shr yts' mm'ykh hv' yyrshkh
verses.translation: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying: ‘This man shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א אֹת֜וֹ הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַבֶּט־נָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וּסְפֹר֙ הַכּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים אִם־תּוּכַ֖ל לִסְפֹּ֣ר אֹתָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ כֹּ֥ה יִהְיֶ֖ה זַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyvts' 'tv hchvtsh vy'mr hbtn' hshmymh vspr hkhvkhbym 'mtvkhl lspr 'tm vy'mr lv khh yhyh zr'kh
verses.translation: And He brought him forth abroad, and said: ‘Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if thou be able to count them’; and He said unto him: ‘So shall thy seed be.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶאֱמִ֖ן בַּֽיהֹוָ֑ה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶ֥הָ לּ֖וֹ צְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'mn byhvh vychshbh lv tsdqh
verses.translation: And he believed in the LORD; and He counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵאתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵא֣וּר כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים לָ֧תֶת לְךָ֛ אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'ny yhvh 'shr hvts'tykh m'vr khshdym ltt lkh 'th'rts hz't lrshth
verses.translation: And He said unto him: ‘I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה בַּמָּ֥ה אֵדַ֖ע כִּ֥י אִֽירָשֶֽׁנָּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny yhvh bmh 'd' khy 'yrshnh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘O Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו קְחָ֥ה לִי֙ עֶגְלָ֣ה מְשֻׁלֶּ֔שֶׁת וְעֵ֥ז מְשֻׁלֶּ֖שֶׁת וְאַ֣יִל מְשֻׁלָּ֑שׁ וְתֹ֖ר וְגוֹזָֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv qchh ly 'glh mshlsht v'z mshlsht v'yl mshlsh vtr vgvzl
verses.translation: And He said unto him: ‘Take Me a heifer of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtle-dove, and a young pigeon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ל֣וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֗לֶּה וַיְבַתֵּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ בַּתָּ֔וֶךְ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אִישׁ־בִּתְר֖וֹ לִקְרַ֣את רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְאֶת־הַצִּפֹּ֖ר לֹ֥א בָתָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqchlv 'tkhl'lh vybtr 'tm btvkh vytn 'yshbtrv lqr't r'hv v'thtspr l' btr
verses.translation: And he took him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each half over against the other; but the birds divided he not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יִט עַל־הַפְּגָרִ֑ים וַיַּשֵּׁ֥ב אֹתָ֖ם אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyrd h'yt 'lhpgrym vyshb 'tm 'brm
verses.translation: And the birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
