verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ לָב֔וֹא וְתַרְדֵּמָ֖ה נָפְלָ֣ה עַל־אַבְרָ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵימָ֛ה חֲשֵׁכָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה נֹפֶ֥לֶת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy hshmsh lbv' vtrdmh nplh 'l'brm vhnh 'ymh chshkhh gdlh nplt 'lyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, a dread, even a great darkness, fell upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאַבְרָ֗ם יָדֹ֨עַ תֵּדַ֜ע כִּי־גֵ֣ר  יִהְיֶ֣ה זַרְעֲךָ֗ בְּאֶ֙רֶץ֙ לֹ֣א לָהֶ֔ם וַעֲבָד֖וּם וְעִנּ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr l'brm yd' td' khygr  yhyh zr'kh b'rts l' lhm v'bdvm v'nv 'tm 'rb' m'vt shnh
verses.translation: And He said unto Abram: ‘Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֧ם אֶת־הַגּ֛וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲבֹ֖דוּ דָּ֣ן אָנֹ֑כִי וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֥ן יֵצְא֖וּ בִּרְכֻ֥שׁ גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vgm 'thgvy 'shr y'bdv dn 'nkhy v'chrykhn yts'v brkhsh gdvl
verses.translation: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge; and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֛ה תָּב֥וֹא אֶל־אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם תִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th tbv' 'l'btykh bshlvm tqbr bshybh tvbh
verses.translation: But thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְד֥וֹר רְבִיעִ֖י יָשׁ֣וּבוּ הֵ֑נָּה כִּ֧י לֹא־שָׁלֵ֛ם עֲוֺ֥ן הָאֱמֹרִ֖י עַד־הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vdvr rby'y yshvbv hnh khy l'shlm 'vn h'mry 'dhnh
verses.translation: And in the fourth generation they shall come back hither; for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בָּ֔אָה וַעֲלָטָ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה תַנּ֤וּר עָשָׁן֙ וְלַפִּ֣יד אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֔ר בֵּ֖ין הַגְּזָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyhy hshmsh b'h v'lth hyh vhnh tnvr 'shn vlpyd 'sh 'shr 'br byn hgzrym h'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and there was thick darkness, behold a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch that passed between these pieces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא כָּרַ֧ת יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־אַבְרָ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֗ נָתַ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִנְּהַ֣ר מִצְרַ֔יִם עַד־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' khrt yhvh 't'brm bryt l'mr lzr'kh ntty 'th'rts hz't mnhr mtsrym 'dhnhr hgdl nhrprt
verses.translation: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying: ‘Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַקֵּינִי֙ וְאֶת־הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַקַּדְמֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'thqyny v'thqnzy v't hqdmny
verses.translation: the Kenite, and the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֥י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְאֶת־הָרְפָאִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'thchty v'thprzy v'thrp'ym
verses.translation: and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְאֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְאֶת־הַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֖י וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'th'mry v'thkhn'ny v'thgrgshy v'thybvsy {s}
verses.translation: and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂרַי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת אַבְרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָלְדָ֖ה ל֑וֹ וְלָ֛הּ שִׁפְחָ֥ה מִצְרִ֖ית וּשְׁמָ֥הּ הָגָֽר׃
verses.translit: vshry 'sht 'brm l' yldh lv vlh shpchh mtsryt vshmh hgr
verses.translation: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bore him no children; and she had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֜י אֶל־אַבְרָ֗ם הִנֵּה־נָ֞א עֲצָרַ֤נִי יְהֹוָה֙ מִלֶּ֔דֶת בֹּא־נָא֙ אֶל־שִׁפְחָתִ֔י אוּלַ֥י אִבָּנֶ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נָּה וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָ֖ם לְק֥וֹל שָׂרָֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shry 'l'brm hnhn' 'tsrny yhvh mldt b'n' 'lshpchty 'vly 'bnh mmnh vyshm' 'brm lqvl shry
verses.translation: And Sarai said unto Abram: ‘Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing; go in, I pray thee, unto my handmaid; it may be that I shall be builded up through her.’ And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֞ח שָׂרַ֣י אֵֽשֶׁת־אַבְרָ֗ם אֶת־הָגָ֤ר הַמִּצְרִית֙ שִׁפְחָתָ֔הּ מִקֵּץ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר שָׁנִ֔ים לְשֶׁ֥בֶת אַבְרָ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַתִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛הּ לְאַבְרָ֥ם אִישָׁ֖הּ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vtqch shry 'sht'brm 'thgr hmtsryt shpchth mqts 'shr shnym lshbt 'brm b'rts khn'n vttn 'th l'brm 'yshh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־הָגָ֖ר וַתַּ֑הַר וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וַתֵּקַ֥ל גְּבִרְתָּ֖הּ בְּעֵינֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhgr vthr vtr' khy hrth vtql gbrth b'ynyh
verses.translation: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived; and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר שָׂרַ֣י אֶל־אַבְרָם֮ חֲמָסִ֣י עָלֶ֒יךָ֒ אָנֹכִ֗י נָתַ֤תִּי שִׁפְחָתִי֙ בְּחֵיקֶ֔ךָ וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י הָרָ֔תָה וָאֵקַ֖ל בְּעֵינֶ֑יהָ יִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יְהֹוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽיׄךָ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shry 'l'brm chmsy 'lykh 'nkhy ntty shpchty bchyqkh vtr' khy hrth v'ql b'ynyh yshpt yhvh byny vbynykh
verses.translation: And Sarai said unto Abram: ‘My wrong be upon thee: I gave my handmaid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָ֜ם אֶל־שָׂרַ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה שִׁפְחָתֵךְ֙ בְּיָדֵ֔ךְ עֲשִׂי־לָ֖הּ הַטּ֣וֹב בְּעֵינָ֑יִךְ וַתְּעַנֶּ֣הָ שָׂרַ֔י וַתִּבְרַ֖ח מִפָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brm 'lshry hnh shpchtkh bydkh 'shylh htvb b'ynykh vt'nh shry vtbrch mpnyh
verses.translation: But Abram said unto Sarai: ‘Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her that which is good in thine eyes.’ And Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּמְצָאָ֞הּ מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהֹוָ֛ה עַל־עֵ֥ין הַמַּ֖יִם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר עַל־הָעַ֖יִן בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ שֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: vymts'h ml'kh yhvh 'l'yn hmym bmdbr 'lh'yn bdrkh shvr
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר הָגָ֞ר שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרַ֛י אֵֽי־מִזֶּ֥ה בָ֖את וְאָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֑כִי וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מִפְּנֵי֙ שָׂרַ֣י גְּבִרְתִּ֔י אָנֹכִ֖י בֹּרַֽחַת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hgr shpcht shry 'ymzh b't v'nh tlkhy vt'mr mpny shry gbrty 'nkhy brcht
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Hagar, Sarai’s handmaid, whence camest thou? and whither goest thou?’ And she said: ‘I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה שׁ֖וּבִי אֶל־גְּבִרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִתְעַנִּ֖י תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh shvby 'lgbrtkh vht'ny tcht ydyh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her: ‘Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה הַרְבָּ֥ה אַרְבֶּ֖ה אֶת־זַרְעֵ֑ךְ וְלֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh hrbh 'rbh 'tzr'kh vl' yspr mrb
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her: ‘I will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְקָרָ֤את שְׁמוֹ֙ יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־עׇנְיֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lh ml'kh yhvh hnkh hrh vyldt bn vqr't shmv yshm''l khyshm' yhvh 'l'nykh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto her: ‘Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son; and thou shalt call his name Ishmael, because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ פֶּ֣רֶא אָדָ֔ם יָד֣וֹ בַכֹּ֔ל וְיַ֥ד כֹּ֖ל בּ֑וֹ וְעַל־פְּנֵ֥י כׇל־אֶחָ֖יו יִשְׁכֹּֽן׃
verses.translit: vhv' yhyh pr' 'dm ydv bkhl vyd khl bv v'lpny khl'chyv yshkhn
verses.translation: And he shall be a wild ass of a man: his hand shall be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the face of all his brethren.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־יְהֹוָה֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל רֳאִ֑י כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֗ה הֲגַ֥ם הֲלֹ֛ם רָאִ֖יתִי אַחֲרֵ֥י רֹאִֽי׃
verses.translit: vtqr' shmyhvh hdbr 'lyh 'th 'l r'y khy 'mrh hgm hlm r'yty 'chry r'y
verses.translation: And she called the name of the LORD that spoke unto her, Thou art a God of seeing; for she said: ‘Have I even here seen Him that seeth Me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ קָרָ֣א לַבְּאֵ֔ר בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י הִנֵּ֥ה בֵין־קָדֵ֖שׁ וּבֵ֥ין בָּֽרֶד׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn qr' lb'r b'r lchy r'y hnh bynqdsh vbyn brd
verses.translation: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד הָגָ֛ר לְאַבְרָ֖ם בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָ֧ם שֶׁם־בְּנ֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָ֥ה הָגָ֖ר יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃
verses.translit: vtld hgr l'brm bn vyqr' 'brm shmbnv 'shryldh hgr yshm''l
verses.translation: And Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְרָ֕ם בֶּן־שְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים בְּלֶֽדֶת־הָגָ֥ר אֶת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל לְאַבְרָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'brm bnshmnym shnh vshsh shnym bldthgr 'tyshm''l l'brm {s}
verses.translation: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אַבְרָ֔ם בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְתֵ֣שַׁע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֨א יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־אַבְרָ֗ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֲנִי־אֵ֣ל שַׁדַּ֔י הִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ לְפָנַ֖י וֶהְיֵ֥ה תָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'brm bntsh'ym shnh vtsh' shnym vyr' yhvh 'l'brm vy'mr 'lyv 'ny'l shdy hthlkh lpny vhyh tmym
verses.translation: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him: ‘I am God Almighty; walk before Me, and be thou wholehearted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְאַרְבֶּ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ בִּמְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: v'tnh bryty byny vbynkh v'rbh 'vtkh bm'd m'd
verses.translation: And I will make My covenant between Me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל אַבְרָ֖ם עַל־פָּנָ֑יו וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֛וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vypl 'brm 'lpnyv vydbr 'tv 'lhym l'mr
verses.translation: And Abram fell on his face; and God talked with him, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֕י הִנֵּ֥ה בְרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְהָיִ֕יתָ לְאַ֖ב הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ny hnh bryty 'tkh vhyyt l'b hmvn gvym
verses.translation: ’As for Me, behold, My covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד אֶת־שִׁמְךָ֖ אַבְרָ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה שִׁמְךָ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֛י אַב־הֲמ֥וֹן גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vl'yqr' 'vd 'tshmkh 'brm vhyh shmkh 'brhm khy 'bhmvn gvym nttykh
verses.translation: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִפְרֵתִ֤י אֹֽתְךָ֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְגוֹיִ֑ם וּמְלָכִ֖ים מִמְּךָ֥ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vhprty 'tkh bm'd m'd vnttykh lgvym vmlkhym mmkh yts'v
verses.translation: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֜י בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֗ךָ וּבֵ֨ין זַרְעֲךָ֧ אַחֲרֶ֛יךָ לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם לִבְרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֑ם לִהְי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'tbryty byny vbynkh vbyn zr'kh 'chrykh ldrtm lbryt 'vlm lhyvt lkh l'lhym vlzr'kh 'chrykh
verses.translation: And I will establish My covenant between Me and thee and thy seed after thee throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee and to thy seed after thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְ֠ךָ֠ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֨ אַחֲרֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת  אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֗יךָ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לַאֲחֻזַּ֖ת עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vntty lkh vlzr'kh 'chrykh 't  'rts mgrykh 't khl'rts khn'n l'chzt 'vlm vhyyty lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land of thy sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם וְאַתָּ֖ה אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֑ר אַתָּ֛ה וְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַֽחֲרֶ֖יךָ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l'brhm v'th 'tbryty tshmr 'th vzr'kh 'chrykh ldrtm
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham: ‘And as for thee, thou shalt keep My covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee throughout their generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֗וּ בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֥ין זַרְעֲךָ֖ אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ הִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֖ם כׇּל־זָכָֽר׃
verses.translit: z't bryty 'shr tshmrv byny vbynykhm vbyn zr'kh 'chrykh hmvl lkhm khlzkhr
verses.translation: This is My covenant, which ye shall keep, between Me and you and thy seed after thee: every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֣ר עׇרְלַתְכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vnmltm 't bshr 'rltkhm vhyh l'vt bryt byny vbynykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of a covenant betwixt Me and you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֶן־שְׁמֹנַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִמּ֥וֹל לָכֶ֛ם כׇּל־זָכָ֖ר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מִכֹּ֣ל בֶּן־נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹ֥א מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vbnshmnt ymym ymvl lkhm khlzkhr ldrtykhm ylyd byt vmqntkhsf mkhl bnnkhr 'shr l' mzr'kh hv'
verses.translation: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any foreigner, that is not of thy seed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִמּ֧וֹל ׀ יִמּ֛וֹל יְלִ֥יד בֵּֽיתְךָ֖ וּמִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיְתָ֧ה בְרִיתִ֛י בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֖ם לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: hmvl  ymvl ylyd bytkh vmqnt khspkh vhyth bryty bbshrkhm lbryt 'vlm
verses.translation: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised; and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָרֵ֣ל  זָכָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִמּוֹל֙ אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר עׇרְלָת֔וֹ וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּ֑יהָ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י הֵפַֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'rl  zkhr 'shr l'ymvl 'tbshr 'rltv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh 'tbryty hpr {s}
verses.translation: And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken My covenant.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתְּךָ֔ לֹא־תִקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמָ֖הּ שָׂרָ֑י כִּ֥י שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l'brhm shry 'shtkh l'tqr' 'tshmh shry khy shrh shmh
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham: ‘As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵרַכְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ וְגַ֨ם נָתַ֧תִּי מִמֶּ֛נָּה לְךָ֖ בֵּ֑ן וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יהָ֙ וְהָֽיְתָ֣ה לְגוֹיִ֔ם מַלְכֵ֥י עַמִּ֖ים מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vbrkhty 'th vgm ntty mmnh lkh bn vbrkhtyh vhyth lgvym mlkhy 'mym mmnh yhyv
verses.translation: And I will bless her, and moreover I will give thee a son of her; yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples shall be of her.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל אַבְרָהָ֛ם עַל־פָּנָ֖יו וַיִּצְחָ֑ק וַיֹּ֣אמֶר בְּלִבּ֗וֹ הַלְּבֶ֤ן מֵאָֽה־שָׁנָה֙ יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְאִ֨ם־שָׂרָ֔ה הֲבַת־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תֵּלֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vypl 'brhm 'lpnyv vytschq vy'mr blbv hlbn m'hshnh yvld v'mshrh hbttsh'ym shnh tld
verses.translation: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart: ‘Shall a child be born unto him that is a hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים ל֥וּ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל יִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'lh'lhym lv yshm''l ychyh lpnykh
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto God: ‘Oh that Ishmael might live before Thee! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲבָל֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֗ יֹלֶ֤דֶת לְךָ֙ בֵּ֔ן וְקָרָ֥אתָ אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יִצְחָ֑ק וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֥י אִתּ֛וֹ לִבְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם לְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'bl shrh 'shtkh yldt lkh bn vqr't 'tshmv ytschq vhqmty 'tbryty 'tv lbryt 'vlm lzr'v 'chryv
verses.translation: And God said: ‘‘Nay, but Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son; and thou shalt call his name Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֮ שְׁמַעְתִּ֒יךָ֒ הִנֵּ֣ה  בֵּרַ֣כְתִּי אֹת֗וֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֥י אֹת֖וֹ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֤ר נְשִׂיאִם֙ יוֹלִ֔יד וּנְתַתִּ֖יו לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vlyshm''l shm'tykh hnh  brkhty 'tv vhpryty 'tv vhrbyty 'tv bm'd m'd shnym'shr nshy'm yvlyd vnttyv lgvy gdvl
verses.translation: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee; behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אָקִ֣ים אֶת־יִצְחָ֑ק אֲשֶׁר֩ תֵּלֵ֨ד לְךָ֤ שָׂרָה֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֣ד הַזֶּ֔ה בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הָאַחֶֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'tbryty 'qym 'tytschq 'shr tld lkh shrh lmv'd hzh bshnh h'chrt
verses.translation: But My covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְכַ֖ל לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֣עַל אֱלֹהִ֔ים מֵעַ֖ל אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhl ldbr 'tv vy'l 'lhym m'l 'brhm
verses.translation: And He left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֗וֹ וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־יְלִידֵ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־מִקְנַ֣ת כַּסְפּ֔וֹ כׇּל־זָכָ֕ר בְּאַנְשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיָּ֜מׇל אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר עׇרְלָתָ֗ם בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm 'tyshm''l bnv v't khlylydy bytv v't khlmqnt khspv khlzkhr b'nshy byt 'brhm vyml 'tbshr 'rltm b'tsm hyvm hzh kh'shr dbr 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם בֶּן־תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִמֹּל֖וֹ בְּשַׂ֥ר עׇרְלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'brhm bntsh'ym vtsh' shnh bhmlv bshr 'rltv
verses.translation: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִ֨מֹּל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת בְּשַׂ֥ר עׇרְלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshm''l bnv bnshlsh 'shrh shnh bhmlv 't bshr 'rltv
verses.translation: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה נִמּ֖וֹל אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: b'tsm hyvm hzh nmvl 'brhm vyshm''l bnv
verses.translation: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵיתוֹ֙ יְלִ֣יד בָּ֔יִת וּמִקְנַת־כֶּ֖סֶף מֵאֵ֣ת בֶּן־נֵכָ֑ר נִמֹּ֖לוּ אִתּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhl'nshy bytv ylyd byt vmqntkhsf m't bnnkhr nmlv 'tv {p}
verses.translation: And all the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּאֵלֹנֵ֖י מַמְרֵ֑א וְה֛וּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב פֶּֽתַח־הָאֹ֖הֶל כְּחֹ֥ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh b'lny mmr' vhv' yshb ptchh'hl khchm hyvm
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him by the terebinths of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים נִצָּבִ֖ים עָלָ֑יו וַיַּ֗רְא וַיָּ֤רׇץ לִקְרָאתָם֙ מִפֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh shlshh 'nshym ntsbym 'lyv vyr' vyrts lqr'tm mptch h'hl vyshtchv 'rtsh
verses.translation: and he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood over against him; and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed down to the earth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗י אִם־נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ אַל־נָ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר מֵעַ֥ל עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny 'mn' mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'ln' t'br m'l 'bdkh
verses.translation: and said: ‘My lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֻקַּֽח־נָ֣א מְעַט־מַ֔יִם וְרַחֲצ֖וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ תַּ֥חַת הָעֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: yqchn' m'tmym vrchtsv rglykhm vhsh'nv tcht h'ts
verses.translation: Let now a little water be fetched, and wash your feet, and recline yourselves under the tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶקְחָ֨ה פַת־לֶ֜חֶם וְסַעֲד֤וּ לִבְּכֶם֙ אַחַ֣ר תַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֥ן עֲבַרְתֶּ֖ם עַֽל־עַבְדְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֵּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.translit: v'qchh ptlchm vs'dv lbkhm 'chr t'brv khy'lkhn 'brtm 'l'bdkhm vy'mrv khn t'shh kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and stay ye your heart; after that ye shall pass on; forasmuch as ye are come to your servant.’ And they said: ‘So do, as thou hast said.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֧ר אַבְרָהָ֛ם הָאֹ֖הֱלָה אֶל־שָׂרָ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מַהֲרִ֞י שְׁלֹ֤שׁ סְאִים֙ קֶ֣מַח סֹ֔לֶת ל֖וּשִׁי וַעֲשִׂ֥י עֻגֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vymhr 'brhm h'hlh 'lshrh vy'mr mhry shlsh s'ym qmch slt lvshy v'shy 'gvt
verses.translation: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said: ‘Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הַבָּקָ֖ר רָ֣ץ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֨ח בֶּן־בָּקָ֜ר רַ֤ךְ וָטוֹב֙ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־הַנַּ֔עַר וַיְמַהֵ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'lhbqr rts 'brhm vyqch bnbqr rkh vtvb vytn 'lhn'r vymhr l'shvt 'tv
verses.translation: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto the servant; and he hastened to dress it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חֶמְאָ֜ה וְחָלָ֗ב וּבֶן־הַבָּקָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְהֽוּא־עֹמֵ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם תַּ֥חַת הָעֵ֖ץ וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqch chm'h vchlb vbnhbqr 'shr 'shh vytn lpnyhm vhv''md 'lyhm tcht h'ts vy'khlv
verses.translation: And he took curd, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵׄלָ֔יׄוׄ אַיֵּ֖ה שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּ֥ה בָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'yh shrh 'shtkh vy'mr hnh b'hl
verses.translation: And they said unto him: ‘Where is Sarah thy wife?’ And he said: ‘Behold, in the tent.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר שׁ֣וֹב אָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּעֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־בֵ֖ן לְשָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וְשָׂרָ֥ה שֹׁמַ֛עַת פֶּ֥תַח הָאֹ֖הֶל וְה֥וּא אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shvb 'shvb 'lykh kh't chyh vhnhbn lshrh 'shtkh vshrh shm't ptch h'hl vhv' 'chryv
verses.translation: And He said: ‘I will certainly return unto thee when the season cometh round; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son.’ And Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֤ם וְשָׂרָה֙ זְקֵנִ֔ים בָּאִ֖ים בַּיָּמִ֑ים חָדַל֙ לִהְי֣וֹת לְשָׂרָ֔ה אֹ֖רַח כַּנָּשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: v'brhm vshrh zqnym b'ym bymym chdl lhyvt lshrh 'rch khnshym
verses.translation: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, and well stricken in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּצְחַ֥ק שָׂרָ֖ה בְּקִרְבָּ֣הּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַחֲרֵ֤י בְלֹתִי֙ הָֽיְתָה־לִּ֣י עֶדְנָ֔ה וַֽאדֹנִ֖י זָקֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vttschq shrh bqrbh l'mr 'chry blty hythly 'dnh v'dny zqn
verses.translation: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying: ‘After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם לָ֣מָּה זֶּה֩ צָחֲקָ֨ה שָׂרָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר הַאַ֥ף אֻמְנָ֛ם אֵלֵ֖ד וַאֲנִ֥י זָקַֽנְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l'brhm lmh zh tschqh shrh l'mr h'f 'mnm 'ld v'ny zqnty
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Abraham: ‘Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying: Shall I of a surety bear a child, who am old?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִפָּלֵ֥א מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר לַמּוֹעֵ֞ד אָשׁ֥וּב אֵלֶ֛יךָ כָּעֵ֥ת חַיָּ֖ה וּלְשָׂרָ֥ה בֵֽן׃
verses.translit: hypl' myhvh dbr lmv'd 'shvb 'lykh kh't chyh vlshrh bn
verses.translation: Is any thing too hard for the LORD. At the set time I will return unto thee, when the season cometh round, and Sarah shall have a son.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּכַחֵ֨שׁ שָׂרָ֧ה ׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר לֹ֥א צָחַ֖קְתִּי כִּ֣י ׀ יָרֵ֑אָה וַיֹּ֥אמֶֽר ׀ לֹ֖א כִּ֥י צָחָֽקְתְּ׃
verses.translit: vtkhchsh shrh  l'mr l' tschqty khy  yr'h vy'mr  l' khy tschqt
verses.translation: Then Sarah denied, saying: ‘I laughed not’; for she was afraid. And He said: ‘Nay; but thou didst laugh.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ מִשָּׁם֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקִ֖פוּ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הֹלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּ֖ם לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqmv mshm h'nshym vyshqpv 'lpny sdm v'brhm hlkh 'mm lshlchm
verses.translation: And the men rose up from thence, and looked out toward Sodom; and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אָמָ֑ר הַֽמְכַסֶּ֤ה אֲנִי֙ מֵֽאַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyhvh 'mr hmkhsh 'ny m'brhm 'shr 'ny 'shh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Shall I hide from Abraham that which I am doing;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם הָי֧וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֛ה לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל וְעָצ֑וּם וְנִ֨בְרְכוּ־ב֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'brhm hyv yhyh lgvy gdvl v'tsvm vnbrkhvbv khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְדַעְתִּ֗יו לְמַ֩עַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצַוֶּ֜ה אֶת־בָּנָ֤יו וְאֶת־בֵּיתוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְשָֽׁמְרוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת צְדָקָ֖ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט לְמַ֗עַן הָבִ֤יא יְהֹוָה֙ עַל־אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֖ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khy yd'tyv lm'n 'shr ytsvh 'tbnyv v'tbytv 'chryv vshmrv drkh yhvh l'shvt tsdqh vmshpt lm'n hby' yhvh 'l'brhm 't 'shrdbr 'lyv
verses.translation: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which He hath spoken of him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה זַעֲקַ֛ת סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה כִּי־רָ֑בָּה וְחַ֨טָּאתָ֔ם כִּ֥י כָבְדָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh z'qt sdm v'mrh khyrbh vcht'tm khy khbdh m'd
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Verily, the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and, verily, their sin is exceeding grievous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽרְדָה־נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה הַכְּצַעֲקָתָ֛הּ הַבָּ֥אָה אֵלַ֖י עָשׂ֣וּ ׀ כָּלָ֑ה וְאִם־לֹ֖א אֵדָֽעָה׃
verses.translit: 'rdhn' v'r'h hkhts'qth hb'h 'ly 'shv  khlh v'ml' 'd'h
verses.translation: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto Me; and if not, I will know.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְנ֤וּ מִשָּׁם֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ סְדֹ֑מָה וְאַ֨בְרָהָ֔ם עוֹדֶ֥נּוּ עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vypnv mshm h'nshym vylkhv sdmh v'brhm 'vdnv 'md lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the men turned from thence, and went toward Sodom; but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֥שׁ אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַאַ֣ף תִּסְפֶּ֔ה צַדִּ֖יק עִם־רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: vygsh 'brhm vy'mr h'f tsph tsdyq 'mrsh'
verses.translation: And Abraham drew near, and said: ‘Will You indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוּלַ֥י יֵ֛שׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר הַאַ֤ף תִּסְפֶּה֙ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א לַמָּק֔וֹם לְמַ֛עַן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַצַּדִּיקִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'vly ysh chmshym tsdyqm btvkh h'yr h'f tsph vl'tsh' lmqvm lm'n chmshym htsdyqm 'shr bqrbh
verses.translation: Peradventure there are fifty righteous within the city; wilt Thou indeed sweep away and not forgive the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָלִ֨לָה לְּךָ֜ מֵעֲשֹׂ֣ת  כַּדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה לְהָמִ֤ית צַדִּיק֙ עִם־רָשָׁ֔ע וְהָיָ֥ה כַצַּדִּ֖יק כָּרָשָׁ֑ע חָלִ֣לָה לָּ֔ךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט֙ כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: chllh lkh m'sht  khdbr hzh lhmyt tsdyq 'mrsh' vhyh khtsdyq khrsh' chllh lkh hshpt khlh'rts l' y'shh mshpt
verses.translation: That be far from Thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from Thee; shall not the judge of all the earth do justly?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה אִם־אֶמְצָ֥א בִסְדֹ֛ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים צַדִּיקִ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר וְנָשָׂ֥אתִי לְכׇל־הַמָּק֖וֹם בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'm'mts' bsdm chmshym tsdyqm btvkh h'yr vnsh'ty lkhlhmqvm b'bvrm
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will forgive all the place for their sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הִנֵּה־נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י עָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'brhm vy'mr hnhn' hv'lty ldbr 'l'dny v'nkhy 'pr v'pr
verses.translation: And Abraham answered and said: ‘Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, who am but dust and ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֠וּלַ֠י יַחְסְר֞וּן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים הַצַּדִּיקִם֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה הֲתַשְׁחִ֥ית בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־כׇּל־הָעִ֑יר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית אִם־אֶמְצָ֣א שָׁ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'vly ychsrvn chmshym htsdyqm chmshh htshchyt bchmshh 'tkhlh'yr vy'mr l' 'shchyt 'm'mts' shm 'rb'ym vchmshh
verses.translation: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous; wilt Thou destroy all the city for lack of five?’ And He said: ‘I will not destroy it, if I find there forty and five.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף ע֜וֹד לְדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם אַרְבָּעִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה בַּעֲב֖וּר הָאַרְבָּעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vysf 'vd ldbr 'lyv vy'mr 'vly ymts'vn shm 'rb'ym vy'mr l' ''shh b'bvr h'rb'ym
verses.translation: And he spoke unto Him yet again, and said: ‘Peradventure there shall be forty found there.’ And He said: ‘I will not do it for the forty’s sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּ֠אמֶר אַל־נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ וַאֲדַבֵּ֔רָה אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֔ה אִם־אֶמְצָ֥א שָׁ֖ם שְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ln' ychr l'dny v'dbrh 'vly ymts'vn shm shlshym vy'mr l' ''shh 'm'mts' shm shlshym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Oh, let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak. Peradventure there shall thirty be found there.’ And He said: ‘I will not do it, if I find thirty there.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּֽה־נָ֤א הוֹאַ֙לְתִּי֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֔י אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּעֲב֖וּר הָֽעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hnhn' hv'lty ldbr 'l'dny 'vly ymts'vn shm 'shrym vy'mr l' 'shchyt b'bvr h'shrym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord. Peradventure there shall be twenty found there.’ And He said: ‘I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּ֠אמֶר אַל־נָ֞א יִ֤חַר לַֽאדֹנָי֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אַךְ־הַפַּ֔עַם אוּלַ֛י יִמָּצְא֥וּן שָׁ֖ם עֲשָׂרָ֑ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אַשְׁחִ֔ית בַּעֲב֖וּר הָעֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ln' ychr l'dny v'dbrh 'khhp'm 'vly ymts'vn shm 'shrh vy'mr l' 'shchyt b'bvr h'shrh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Oh, let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once. Peradventure ten shall be found there.’ And He said: ‘I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם שָׁ֥ב לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vylkh yhvh kh'shr khlh ldbr 'l'brhm v'brhm shb lmqmv
verses.translation: And the LORD went His way, as soon as He had left off speaking to Abraham; and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹ֠אוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הַמַּלְאָכִ֤ים סְדֹ֙מָה֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב וְל֖וֹט יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּשַֽׁעַר־סְדֹ֑ם וַיַּרְא־לוֹט֙ וַיָּ֣קׇם לִקְרָאתָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyb'v shny hml'khym sdmh b'rb vlvt yshb bsh'rsdm vyr'lvt vyqm lqr'tm vyshtchv 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And the two angels came to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom; and Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them; and he fell down on his face to the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר הִנֶּ֣ה נָּא־אֲדֹנַ֗י ס֣וּרוּ נָ֠א אֶל־בֵּ֨ית עַבְדְּכֶ֤ם וְלִ֙ינוּ֙ וְרַחֲצ֣וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁכַּמְתֶּ֖ם וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֣ם לְדַרְכְּכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֹּ֔א כִּ֥י בָרְח֖וֹב נָלִֽין׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh n''dny svrv n' 'lbyt 'bdkhm vlynv vrchtsv rglykhm vhshkhmtm vhlkhtm ldrkhkhm vy'mrv l' khy brchvb nlyn
verses.translation: and he said: ‘Behold now, my lords, turn aside, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your way.’ And they said: ‘Nay; but we will abide in the broad place all night.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְצַר־בָּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד וַיָּסֻ֣רוּ אֵלָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל־בֵּית֑וֹ וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וּמַצּ֥וֹת אָפָ֖ה וַיֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vyptsrbm m'd vysrv 'lyv vyb'v 'lbytv vy'sh lhm mshth vmtsvt 'ph vy'khlv
verses.translation: And he urged them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טֶ֘רֶם֮ יִשְׁכָּ֒בוּ֒ וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י הָעִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֤י סְדֹם֙ נָסַ֣בּוּ עַל־הַבַּ֔יִת מִנַּ֖עַר וְעַד־זָקֵ֑ן כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם מִקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: trm yshkhbv v'nshy h'yr 'nshy sdm nsbv 'lhbyt mn'r v'dzqn khlh'm mqtsh
verses.translation: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ אֶל־לוֹט֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ אַיֵּ֧ה הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַלָּ֑יְלָה הוֹצִיאֵ֣ם אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְנֵדְעָ֖ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'llvt vy'mrv lv 'yh h'nshym 'shrb'v 'lykh hlylh hvtsy'm 'lynv vnd'h 'tm
verses.translation: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him: ‘Where are the men that came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵהֶ֛ם ל֖וֹט הַפֶּ֑תְחָה וְהַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגַ֥ר אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyts' 'lhm lvt hptchh vhdlt sgr 'chryv
verses.translation: And Lot went out unto them to the door, and shut the door after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אַל־נָ֥א אַחַ֖י תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ln' 'chy tr'v
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I pray you, my brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֨א לִ֜י שְׁתֵּ֣י בָנ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יָדְעוּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אוֹצִֽיאָה־נָּ֤א אֶתְהֶן֙ אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ן כַּטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם רַ֠ק לָֽאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵל֙ אַל־תַּעֲשׂ֣וּ דָבָ֔ר כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֥ן בָּ֖אוּ בְּצֵ֥ל קֹרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: hnhn' ly shty bnvt 'shr l'yd'v 'ysh 'vtsy'hn' 'thn 'lykhm v'shv lhn khtvb b'ynykhm rq l'nshym h'l 'lt'shv dbr khy'lkhn b'v btsl qrty
verses.translation: Behold now, I have two daughters that have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes; only unto these men do nothing; forasmuch as they are come under the shadow of my roof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ  גֶּשׁ־הָ֗לְאָה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ הָאֶחָ֤ד בָּֽא־לָגוּר֙ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט שָׁפ֔וֹט עַתָּ֕ה נָרַ֥ע לְךָ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם וַיִּפְצְר֨וּ בָאִ֤ישׁ בְּלוֹט֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיִּגְּשׁ֖וּ לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר הַדָּֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv  gshhl'h vy'mrv h'chd b'lgvr vyshpt shpvt 'th nr' lkh mhm vyptsrv b'ysh blvt m'd vygshv lshbr hdlt
verses.translation: And they said: ‘Stand back.’ And they said: ‘This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs play the judge; now will we deal worse with thee, than with them.’ And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and drew near to break the door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֶת־יָדָ֔ם וַיָּבִ֧יאוּ אֶת־ל֛וֹט אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַבָּ֑יְתָה וְאֶת־הַדֶּ֖לֶת סָגָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshlchv h'nshym 'tydm vyby'v 'tlvt 'lyhm hbyth v'thdlt sgrv
verses.translation: But the men put forth their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and the door they shut.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֗יִת הִכּוּ֙ בַּסַּנְוֵרִ֔ים מִקָּטֹ֖ן וְעַד־גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּלְא֖וּ לִמְצֹ֥א הַפָּֽתַח׃
verses.translit: v'th'nshym 'shrptch hbyt hkhv bsnvrym mqtn v'dgdvl vyl'v lmts' hptch
verses.translation: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great; so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֶל־ל֗וֹט עֹ֚ד מִֽי־לְךָ֣ פֹ֔ה חָתָן֙ וּבָנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֖ בָּעִ֑יר הוֹצֵ֖א מִן־הַמָּקֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'nshym 'llvt 'd mylkh ph chtn vbnykh vbntykh vkhl 'shrlkh b'yr hvts' mnhmqvm
verses.translation: And the men said unto Lot: ‘Hast thou here any besides? son-in-law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whomsoever thou hast in the city; bring them out of the place;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מַשְׁחִתִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־גָדְלָ֤ה צַעֲקָתָם֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיְשַׁלְּחֵ֥נוּ יְהֹוָ֖ה לְשַׁחֲתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khymshchtym 'nchnv 'thmqvm hzh khygdlh ts'qtm 'tpny yhvh vyshlchnv yhvh lshchth
verses.translation: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxed great before the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א ל֜וֹט וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר  אֶל־חֲתָנָ֣יו  לֹקְחֵ֣י בְנֹתָ֗יו וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִן־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־מַשְׁחִ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־הָעִ֑יר וַיְהִ֥י כִמְצַחֵ֖ק בְּעֵינֵ֥י חֲתָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyts' lvt vydbr  'lchtnyv  lqchy bntyv vy'mr qvmv ts'v mnhmqvm hzh khymshchyt yhvh 'th'yr vyhy khmtschq b'yny chtnyv
verses.translation: And Lot went out, and spoke unto his sons-in-law, who married his daughters, and said: ‘Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy the city.’ But he seemed unto his sons-in-law as one that jested.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְמוֹ֙ הַשַּׁ֣חַר עָלָ֔ה וַיָּאִ֥יצוּ הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים בְּל֣וֹט לֵאמֹ֑ר קוּם֩ קַ֨ח אֶֽת־אִשְׁתְּךָ֜ וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַנִּמְצָאֹ֔ת פֶּן־תִּסָּפֶ֖ה בַּעֲוֺ֥ן הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vkhmv hshchr 'lh vy'ytsv hml'khym blvt l'mr qvm qch 't'shtkh v'tshty bntykh hnmts't pntsph b'vn h'yr
verses.translation: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying: ‘Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters that are here; lest thou be swept away in the iniquity of the city.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְמַהְמָ֓הּ  וַיַּחֲזִ֨יקוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּיָד֣וֹ וּבְיַד־אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ וּבְיַד֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתָ֔יו בְּחֶמְלַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַיֹּצִאֻ֥הוּ וַיַּנִּחֻ֖הוּ מִח֥וּץ לָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vytmhmh  vychzyqv h'nshym bydv vbyd'shtv vbyd shty bntyv bchmlt yhvh 'lyv vyts'hv vynchhv mchvts l'yr
verses.translation: But he lingered; and the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him. And they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כְהוֹצִיאָ֨ם אֹתָ֜ם הַח֗וּצָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט עַל־נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ אַל־תַּבִּ֣יט אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְאַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּכׇל־הַכִּכָּ֑ר הָהָ֥רָה הִמָּלֵ֖ט פֶּן־תִּסָּפֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khhvtsy'm 'tm hchvtsh vy'mr hmlt 'lnpshkh 'ltbyt 'chrykh v'lt'md bkhlhkhkhr hhrh hmlt pntsph
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said: ‘Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the Plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be swept away.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹט אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אַל־נָ֖א אֲדֹנָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lvt 'lhm 'ln' 'dny
verses.translation: And Lot said unto them: ‘Oh, not so, my lord;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֠א מָצָ֨א עַבְדְּךָ֣ חֵן֮ בְּעֵינֶ֒יךָ֒ וַתַּגְדֵּ֣ל חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עִמָּדִ֔י לְהַחֲי֖וֹת אֶת־נַפְשִׁ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֗י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לְהִמָּלֵ֣ט הָהָ֔רָה פֶּן־תִּדְבָּקַ֥נִי הָרָעָ֖ה וָמַֽתִּי׃
verses.translit: hnhn' mts' 'bdkh chn b'ynykh vtgdl chsdkh 'shr 'shyt 'mdy lhchyvt 'tnpshy v'nkhy l' 'vkhl lhmlt hhrh pntdbqny hr'h vmty
verses.translation: behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shown unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest the evil overtake me, and I die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־נָ֠א הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֧את קְרֹבָ֛ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וְהִ֣וא מִצְעָ֑ר אִמָּלְטָ֨ה נָּ֜א שָׁ֗מָּה הֲלֹ֥א מִצְעָ֛ר הִ֖וא וּתְחִ֥י נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: hnhn' h'yr hz't qrbh lnvs shmh vhv' mts'r 'mlth n' shmh hl' mts'r hv' vtchy npshy
verses.translation: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one; oh, let me escape thither—is it not a little one?—and my soul shall live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּה֙ נָשָׂ֣אתִי פָנֶ֔יךָ גַּ֖ם לַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֛י הׇפְכִּ֥י אֶת־הָעִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv hnh nsh'ty pnykh gm ldbr hzh lblty hpkhy 'th'yr 'shr dbrt
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which thou hast spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַהֵר֙ הִמָּלֵ֣ט שָׁ֔מָּה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת דָּבָ֔ר עַד־בֹּאֲךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה עַל־כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־הָעִ֖יר צֽוֹעַר׃
verses.translit: mhr hmlt shmh khy l' 'vkhl l'shvt dbr 'db'kh shmh 'lkhn qr' shmh'yr tsv'r
verses.translation: Hasten thou, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither.’—Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ יָצָ֣א עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְל֖וֹט בָּ֥א צֹֽעֲרָה׃
verses.translit: hshmsh yts' 'lh'rts vlvt b' ts'rh
verses.translation: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot came unto Zoar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֗ה הִמְטִ֧יר עַל־סְדֹ֛ם וְעַל־עֲמֹרָ֖ה גׇּפְרִ֣ית וָאֵ֑שׁ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhvh hmtyr 'lsdm v'l'mrh gpryt v'sh m't yhvh mnhshmym
verses.translation: Then the LORD caused to rain upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הַכִּכָּ֑ר וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הֶעָרִ֔ים וְצֶ֖מַח הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhpkh 'th'rym h'l v't khlhkhkhr v't khlyshby h'rym vtsmch h'dmh
verses.translation: and He overthrow those cities, and all the Plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּבֵּ֥ט אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מֵאַחֲרָ֑יו וַתְּהִ֖י נְצִ֥יב מֶֽלַח׃
verses.translit: vtbt 'shtv m'chryv vthy ntsyb mlch
verses.translation: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּבֹּ֑קֶר אֶ֨ל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm bbqr 'lhmqvm 'shr'md shm 'tpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף עַל־פְּנֵ֤י סְדֹם֙ וַעֲמֹרָ֔ה וְעַֽל־כׇּל־פְּנֵ֖י אֶ֣רֶץ הַכִּכָּ֑ר וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה עָלָה֙ קִיטֹ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ כְּקִיטֹ֖ר הַכִּבְשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vyshqf 'lpny sdm v'mrh v'lkhlpny 'rts hkhkhr vyr' vhnh 'lh qytr h'rts khqytr hkhbshn
verses.translation: And he looked out toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the Plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּשַׁחֵ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־עָרֵ֣י הַכִּכָּ֔ר וַיִּזְכֹּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח אֶת־לוֹט֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָ֔ה בַּהֲפֹךְ֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יָשַׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן לֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshcht 'lhym 't'ry hkhkhr vyzkhr 'lhym 't'brhm vyshlch 'tlvt mtvkh hhpkhh bhpkh 'th'rym 'shryshb bhn lvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot dwelt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֩עַל֩ ל֨וֹט מִצּ֜וֹעַר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּהָ֗ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤י בְנֹתָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א לָשֶׁ֣בֶת בְּצ֑וֹעַר וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה ה֖וּא וּשְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'l lvt mtsv'r vyshb bhr vshty bntyv 'mv khy yr' lshbt btsv'r vyshb bm'rh hv' vshty bntyv
verses.translation: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar; and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר הַבְּכִירָ֛ה אֶל־הַצְּעִירָ֖ה אָבִ֣ינוּ זָקֵ֑ן וְאִ֨ישׁ אֵ֤ין בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ לָב֣וֹא עָלֵ֔ינוּ כְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr hbkhyrh 'lhts'yrh 'bynv zqn v'ysh 'yn b'rts lbv' 'lynv khdrkh khlh'rts
verses.translation: And the first-born said unto the younger: ‘Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכָ֨ה נַשְׁקֶ֧ה אֶת־אָבִ֛ינוּ יַ֖יִן וְנִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה עִמּ֑וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃
verses.translit: lkhh nshqh 't'bynv yyn vnshkhbh 'mv vnchyh m'bynv zr'
verses.translation: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֧יןָ אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֛ן יַ֖יִן בַּלַּ֣יְלָה ה֑וּא וַתָּבֹ֤א הַבְּכִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב אֶת־אָבִ֔יהָ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקוּׄמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtshqyn 't'byhn yyn blylh hv' vtb' hbkhyrh vtshkhb 't'byh vl'yd' bshkhbh vbqvmh
verses.translation: And they made their father drink wine that night. And the first-born went in, and lay with her father; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הַבְּכִירָה֙ אֶל־הַצְּעִירָ֔ה הֵן־שָׁכַ֥בְתִּי אֶ֖מֶשׁ אֶת־אָבִ֑י נַשְׁקֶ֨נּוּ יַ֜יִן גַּם־הַלַּ֗יְלָה וּבֹ֙אִי֙ שִׁכְבִ֣י עִמּ֔וֹ וּנְחַיֶּ֥ה מֵאָבִ֖ינוּ זָֽרַע׃
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vt'mr hbkhyrh 'lhts'yrh hnshkhbty 'msh 't'by nshqnv yyn gmhlylh vb'y shkhby 'mv vnchyh m'bynv zr'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the first-born said unto the younger: ‘Behold, I lay yesternight with my father. Let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁקֶ֜יןָ גַּ֣ם בַּלַּ֧יְלָה הַה֛וּא אֶת־אֲבִיהֶ֖ן יָ֑יִן וַתָּ֤קׇם הַצְּעִירָה֙ וַתִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֥ע בְּשִׁכְבָ֖הּ וּבְקֻמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtshqyn gm blylh hhv' 't'byhn yyn vtqm hts'yrh vtshkhb 'mv vl'yd' bshkhbh vbqmh
verses.translation: And they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose, and lay with him; and he knew not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתַּהֲרֶ֛יןָ שְׁתֵּ֥י בְנֽוֹת־ל֖וֹט מֵאֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vthryn shty bnvtlvt m'byhn
verses.translation: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶד הַבְּכִירָה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ מוֹאָ֑ב ה֥וּא אֲבִֽי־מוֹאָ֖ב עַד־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vtld hbkhyrh bn vtqr' shmv mv'b hv' 'bymv'b 'dhyvm
verses.translation: And the first-born bore a son, and called his name Moab—the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַצְּעִירָ֤ה גַם־הִוא֙ יָ֣לְדָה בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־עַמִּ֑י ה֛וּא אֲבִ֥י בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֖וֹן עַד־הַיּֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhts'yrh gmhv' yldh bn vtqr' shmv bn'my hv' 'by bny'mvn 'dhyvm {s}
verses.translation: And the younger, she also bore a son, and called his name Ben-ammi—the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֨ע מִשָּׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אַ֣רְצָה הַנֶּ֔גֶב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בֵּין־קָדֵ֖שׁ וּבֵ֣ין שׁ֑וּר וַיָּ֖גׇר בִּגְרָֽר׃
verses.translit: vys' mshm 'brhm 'rtsh hngb vyshb bynqdsh vbyn shvr vygr bgrr
verses.translation: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶל־שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּרָ֔ר וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־שָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'lshrh 'shtv 'chty hv' vyshlch 'bymlkh mlkh grr vyqch 'tshrh
verses.translation: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife: ‘She is my sister.’ And Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ בַּחֲל֣וֹם הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הִנְּךָ֥ מֵת֙ עַל־הָאִשָּׁ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־לָקַ֔חְתָּ וְהִ֖וא בְּעֻ֥לַת בָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhym 'l'bymlkh bchlvm hlylh vy'mr lv hnkh mt 'lh'shh 'shrlqcht vhv' b'lt b'l
verses.translation: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him: ‘Behold, thou shalt die, because of the woman whom thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ לֹ֥א קָרַ֖ב אֵלֶ֑יהָ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֕י הֲג֥וֹי גַּם־צַדִּ֖יק תַּהֲרֹֽג׃
verses.translit: v'bymlkh l' qrb 'lyh vy'mr 'dny hgvy gmtsdyq thrg
verses.translation: Now Abimelech had not come near her; and he said: ‘Lord, wilt Thou slay even a righteous nation?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֨א ה֤וּא אָֽמַר־לִי֙ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֔וא וְהִֽיא־גַם־הִ֥וא אָֽמְרָ֖ה אָחִ֣י ה֑וּא בְּתׇם־לְבָבִ֛י וּבְנִקְיֹ֥ן כַּפַּ֖י עָשִׂ֥יתִי זֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: hl' hv' 'mrly 'chty hv' vhy'gmhv' 'mrh 'chy hv' btmlbby vbnqyn khpy 'shyty z't
verses.translation: Said he not himself unto me: She is my sister? and she, even she herself said: He is my brother. In the simplicity of my heart and the innocency of my hands have I done this.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ אֵלָ֨יו הָֽאֱלֹהִ֜ים בַּחֲלֹ֗ם גַּ֣ם אָנֹכִ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ כִּ֤י בְתׇם־לְבָבְךָ֙ עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וָאֶחְשֹׂ֧ךְ גַּם־אָנֹכִ֛י אֽוֹתְךָ֖ מֵחֲטוֹ־לִ֑י עַל־כֵּ֥ן לֹא־נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לִנְגֹּ֥עַ אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'lhym bchlm gm 'nkhy yd'ty khy btmlbbkh 'shyt z't v'chshkh gm'nkhy 'vtkh mchtvly 'lkhn l'nttykh lng' 'lyh
verses.translation: And God said unto him in the dream: ‘Yea, I know that in the simplicity of thy heart thou hast done this, and I also withheld thee from sinning against Me. Therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הָשֵׁ֤ב אֵֽשֶׁת־הָאִישׁ֙ כִּֽי־נָבִ֣יא ה֔וּא וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל בַּֽעַדְךָ֖ וֶֽחְיֵ֑ה וְאִם־אֵֽינְךָ֣ מֵשִׁ֔יב דַּ֚ע כִּי־מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת אַתָּ֖ה וְכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v'th hshb 'shth'ysh khynby' hv' vytpll b'dkh vchyh v'm'ynkh mshyb d' khymvt tmvt 'th vkhl'shrlkh
verses.translation: Now therefore restore the man’s wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live; and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּקְרָא֙ לְכׇל־עֲבָדָ֔יו וַיְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בְּאׇזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'bymlkh bbqr vyqr' lkhl'bdyv vydbr 'tkhlhdbrym h'lh b'znyhm vyyr'v h'nshym m'd
verses.translation: And Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears; and the men were sore afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְאַבְרָהָ֗ם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ מֶֽה־עָשִׂ֤יתָ לָּ֙נוּ֙ וּמֶֽה־חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־הֵבֵ֧אתָ עָלַ֛י וְעַל־מַמְלַכְתִּ֖י חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה מַעֲשִׂים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יֵֽעָשׂ֔וּ עָשִׂ֖יתָ עִמָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bymlkh l'brhm vy'mr lv mh'shyt lnv vmhcht'ty lkh khyhb't 'ly v'lmmlkhty cht'h gdlh m'shym 'shr l'y'shv 'shyt 'mdy
verses.translation: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him: ‘What hast thou done unto us? and wherein have I sinned against thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה רָאִ֔יתָ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'l'brhm mh r'yt khy 'shyt 'thdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Abraham: ‘What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי רַ֚ק אֵין־יִרְאַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַהֲרָג֖וּנִי עַל־דְּבַ֥ר אִשְׁתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm khy 'mrty rq 'ynyr't 'lhym bmqvm hzh vhrgvny 'ldbr 'shty
verses.translation: And Abraham said: ‘Because I thought: Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אׇמְנָ֗ה אֲחֹתִ֤י בַת־אָבִי֙ הִ֔וא אַ֖ךְ לֹ֣א בַת־אִמִּ֑י וַתְּהִי־לִ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vgm'mnh 'chty bt'by hv' 'kh l' bt'my vthyly l'shh
verses.translation: And moreover she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and so she became my wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְע֣וּ אֹתִ֗י אֱלֹהִים֮ מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֒ וָאֹמַ֣ר לָ֔הּ זֶ֣ה חַסְדֵּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשִׂ֖י עִמָּדִ֑י אֶ֤ל כׇּל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה אִמְרִי־לִ֖י אָחִ֥י הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr ht'v 'ty 'lhym mbyt 'by v'mr lh zh chsdkh 'shr t'shy 'mdy 'l khlhmqvm 'shr nbv' shmh 'mryly 'chy hv'
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her: This is thy kindness which thou shalt show unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me: He is my brother.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֗ר וַעֲבָדִים֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׁב ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת שָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'bymlkh ts'n vbqr v'bdym vshpcht vytn l'brhm vyshb lv 't shrh 'shtv
verses.translation: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה אַרְצִ֖י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בַּטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֖יךָ שֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh hnh 'rtsy lpnykh btvb b'ynykh shb
verses.translation: And Abimelech said: ‘Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשָׂרָ֣ה אָמַ֗ר הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֜תִּי אֶ֤לֶף כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לְאָחִ֔יךְ הִנֵּ֤ה הוּא־לָךְ֙ כְּס֣וּת עֵינַ֔יִם לְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ וְאֵ֥ת כֹּ֖ל וְנֹכָֽחַת׃
verses.translit: vlshrh 'mr hnh ntty 'lf khsf l'chykh hnh hv'lkh khsvt 'ynym lkhl 'shr 'tkh v't khl vnkhcht
verses.translation: And unto Sarah he said: ‘Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver; behold, it is for thee a covering of the eyes to all that are with thee; and before all men thou art righted.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּרְפָּ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֧לֶךְ וְאֶת־אִשְׁתּ֛וֹ וְאַמְהֹתָ֖יו וַיֵּלֵֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: vytpll 'brhm 'lh'lhym vyrp' 'lhym 't'bymlkh v't'shtv v'mhtyv vyldv
verses.translation: And Abraham prayed unto God; and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maid-servants; and they bore children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָצֹ֤ר עָצַר֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד כׇּל־רֶ֖חֶם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל־דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָהָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy'tsr 'tsr yhvh b'd khlrchm lbyt 'bymlkh 'ldbr shrh 'sht 'brhm {s}
verses.translation: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֛ה פָּקַ֥ד אֶת־שָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמָ֑ר וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהֹוָ֛ה לְשָׂרָ֖ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhvh pqd 'tshrh kh'shr 'mr vy'sh yhvh lshrh kh'shr dbr
verses.translation: And the LORD remembered Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as He had spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֩הַר֩ וַתֵּ֨לֶד שָׂרָ֧ה לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם בֵּ֖ן לִזְקֻנָ֑יו לַמּוֹעֵ֕ד אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vthr vtld shrh l'brhm bn lzqnyv lmv'd 'shrdbr 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶֽת־שֶׁם־בְּנ֧וֹ הַנּֽוֹלַד־ל֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָה־לּ֥וֹ שָׂרָ֖ה יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'brhm 'tshmbnv hnvldlv 'shryldhlv shrh ytschq
verses.translation: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤מׇל אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ בֶּן־שְׁמֹנַ֖ת יָמִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyml 'brhm 'tytschq bnv bnshmnt ymym kh'shr tsvh 'tv 'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֖ם בֶּן־מְאַ֣ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּהִוָּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֥ק בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'brhm bnm't shnh bhvld lv 't ytschq bnv
verses.translation: And Abraham was a hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שָׂרָ֔ה צְחֹ֕ק עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֱלֹהִ֑ים כׇּל־הַשֹּׁמֵ֖עַ יִֽצְחַק־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shrh tschq 'shh ly 'lhym khlhshm' ytschqly
verses.translation: And Sarah said: ‘God hath made laughter for me; every one that heareth will laugh on account of me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מִ֤י מִלֵּל֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם הֵינִ֥יקָה בָנִ֖ים שָׂרָ֑ה כִּֽי־יָלַ֥דְתִּי בֵ֖ן לִזְקֻנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vt'mr my mll l'brhm hynyqh bnym shrh khyyldty bn lzqnyv
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should give children suck? for I have borne him a son in his old age.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֥ל הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַיִּגָּמַ֑ל וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אַבְרָהָם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֣ה גָד֔וֹל בְּי֖וֹם הִגָּמֵ֥ל אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: vygdl hyld vygml vy'sh 'brhm mshth gdvl byvm hgml 'tytschq
verses.translation: And the child grew, and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֨רֶא שָׂרָ֜ה אֶֽת־בֶּן־הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר־יָלְדָ֥ה לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם מְצַחֵֽק׃
verses.translit: vtr' shrh 'tbnhgr hmtsryt 'shryldh l'brhm mtschq
verses.translation: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne unto Abraham, making sport.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם גָּרֵ֛שׁ הָאָמָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את וְאֶת־בְּנָ֑הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִירַשׁ֙ בֶּן־הָאָמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את עִם־בְּנִ֖י עִם־יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: vt'mr l'brhm grsh h'mh hz't v'tbnh khy l' yyrsh bnh'mh hz't 'mbny 'mytschq
verses.translation: Wherefore she said unto Abraham: ‘Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧רַע הַדָּבָ֛ר מְאֹ֖ד בְּעֵינֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֥ת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' hdbr m'd b'yny 'brhm 'l 'vdt bnv
verses.translation: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֗ם אַל־יֵרַ֤ע בְּעֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ עַל־הַנַּ֣עַר וְעַל־אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֛יךָ שָׂרָ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלָ֑הּ כִּ֣י בְיִצְחָ֔ק יִקָּרֵ֥א לְךָ֖ זָֽרַע׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l'brhm 'lyr' b'ynykh 'lhn'r v'l'mtkh khl 'shr t'mr 'lykh shrh shm' bqlh khy bytschq yqr' lkh zr'
verses.translation: And God said unto Abraham: ‘Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall seed be called to thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם אֶת־בֶּן־הָאָמָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי אֲשִׂימֶ֑נּוּ כִּ֥י זַרְעֲךָ֖ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vgm 'tbnh'mh lgvy 'shymnv khy zr'kh hv'
verses.translation: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם אַבְרָהָ֣ם ׀ בַּבֹּ֡קֶר וַיִּֽקַּֽח־לֶ֩חֶם֩ וְחֵ֨מַת מַ֜יִם וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־הָ֠גָ֠ר שָׂ֧ם עַל־שִׁכְמָ֛הּ וְאֶת־הַיֶּ֖לֶד וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֶ֑הָ וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ וַתֵּ֔תַע בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm  bbqr vyqchlchm vchmt mym vytn 'lhgr shm 'lshkhmh v'thyld vyshlchh vtlkh vtt' bmdbr b'r shb'
verses.translation: And Abraham arose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away; and she departed, and strayed in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְל֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם מִן־הַחֵ֑מֶת וַתַּשְׁלֵ֣ךְ אֶת־הַיֶּ֔לֶד תַּ֖חַת אַחַ֥ד הַשִּׂיחִֽם׃
verses.translit: vykhlv hmym mnhchmt vtshlkh 'thyld tcht 'chd hshychm
verses.translation: And the water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֩לֶךְ֩ וַתֵּ֨שֶׁב לָ֜הּ מִנֶּ֗גֶד הַרְחֵק֙ כִּמְטַחֲוֵ֣י קֶ֔שֶׁת כִּ֣י אָֽמְרָ֔ה אַל־אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּמ֣וֹת הַיָּ֑לֶד וַתֵּ֣שֶׁב מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַתִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת־קֹלָ֖הּ וַתֵּֽבְךְּ׃
verses.translit: vtlkh vtshb lh mngd hrchq khmtchvy qsht khy 'mrh 'l'r'h bmvt hyld vtshb mngd vtsh' 'tqlh vtbkh
verses.translation: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow-shot; for she said: ‘Let me not look upon the death of the child.’ And she sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־ק֣וֹל הַנַּ֒עַר֒ וַיִּקְרָא֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אֶל־הָגָר֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ מַה־לָּ֣ךְ הָגָ֑ר אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֧ע אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶל־ק֥וֹל הַנַּ֖עַר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּא־שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lhym 'tqvl hn'r vyqr' ml'kh 'lhym  'lhgr mnhshmym vy'mr lh mhlkh hgr 'ltyr'y khyshm' 'lhym 'lqvl hn'r b'shr hv'shm
verses.translation: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her: ‘What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וּמִי שְׂאִ֣י אֶת־הַנַּ֔עַר וְהַחֲזִ֥יקִי אֶת־יָדֵ֖ךְ בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־לְג֥וֹי גָּד֖וֹל אֲשִׂימֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: qvmy sh'y 'thn'r vhchzyqy 'tydkh bv khylgvy gdvl 'shymnv
verses.translation: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him fast by thy hand; for I will make him a great nation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּפְקַ֤ח אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא בְּאֵ֣ר מָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֜לֶךְ וַתְּמַלֵּ֤א אֶת־הַחֵ֙מֶת֙ מַ֔יִם וַתַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־הַנָּֽעַר׃
verses.translit: vypqch 'lhym 't'ynyh vtr' b'r mym vtlkh vtml' 'thchmt mym vtshq 'thn'r
verses.translation: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הַנַּ֖עַר וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיְהִ֖י רֹבֶ֥ה קַשָּֽׁת׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'lhym 'thn'r vygdl vyshb bmdbr vyhy rbh qsht
verses.translation: And God was with the lad, and he grew; and he dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר פָּארָ֑ן וַתִּֽקַּֽח־ל֥וֹ אִמּ֛וֹ אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshb bmdbr p'rn vtqchlv 'mv 'shh m'rts mtsrym {p}
verses.translation: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran; and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־צְבָא֔וֹ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֱלֹהִ֣ים עִמְּךָ֔ בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyhy b't hhv' vy'mr 'bymlkh vpykhl shrtsb'v 'l'brhm l'mr 'lhym 'mkh bkhl 'shr'th 'shh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his host spoke unto Abraham, saying: ‘God is with thee in all that thou doest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֨בְעָה לִּ֤י בֵֽאלֹהִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה אִם־תִּשְׁקֹ֣ר לִ֔י וּלְנִינִ֖י וּלְנֶכְדִּ֑י כַּחֶ֜סֶד אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֤יתִי עִמְּךָ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עִמָּדִ֔י וְעִם־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־גַּ֥רְתָּה בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'th hshb'h ly b'lhym hnh 'mtshqr ly vlnyny vlnkhdy khchsd 'shr'shyty 'mkh t'shh 'mdy v'mh'rts 'shrgrth bh
verses.translation: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son; but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אָנֹכִ֖י אִשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'nkhy 'shb'
verses.translation: And Abraham said: ‘I will swear.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹכִ֥חַ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־אֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ עַל־אֹדוֹת֙ בְּאֵ֣ר הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּזְל֖וּ עַבְדֵ֥י אֲבִימֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vhvkhch 'brhm 't'bymlkh 'l'dvt b'r hmym 'shr gzlv 'bdy 'bymlkh
verses.translation: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of the well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִ֥י עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וְגַם־אַתָּ֞ה לֹא־הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֗י וְגַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בִּלְתִּ֥י הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh l' yd'ty my 'shh 'thdbr hzh vgm'th l'hgdt ly vgm 'nkhy l' shm'ty blty hyvm
verses.translation: And Abimelech said: ‘I know not who hath done this thing; neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to-day.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לַאֲבִימֶ֑לֶךְ וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm ts'n vbqr vytn l'bymlkh vykhrtv shnyhm bryt
verses.translation: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and they two made a covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֣ב אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶת־שֶׁ֛בַע כִּבְשֹׂ֥ת הַצֹּ֖אן לְבַדְּהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vytsb 'brhm 'tshb' khbsht hts'n lbdhn
verses.translation: And Abraham set seven ewe-lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה שֶׁ֤בַע כְּבָשֹׂת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצַּ֖בְתָּ לְבַדָּֽנָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'l'brhm mh hnh shb' khbsht h'lh 'shr htsbt lbdnh
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Abraham: ‘What mean these seven ewe-lambs which thou hast set by themselves?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֚י אֶת־שֶׁ֣בַע כְּבָשֹׂ֔ת תִּקַּ֖ח מִיָּדִ֑י בַּעֲבוּר֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־לִּ֣י לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י חָפַ֖רְתִּי אֶת־הַבְּאֵ֥ר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr khy 'tshb' khbsht tqch mydy b'bvr thyhly l'dh khy chprty 'thb'r hz't
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Verily, these seven ewe-lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א לַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ם נִשְׁבְּע֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn qr' lmqvm hhv' b'r shb' khy shm nshb'v shnyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore that place was called Beer-sheba; because there they swore both of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיָּ֣קׇם אֲבִימֶ֗לֶךְ וּפִיכֹל֙ שַׂר־צְבָא֔וֹ וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vykhrtv bryt bb'r shb' vyqm 'bymlkh vpykhl shrtsb'v vyshbv 'l'rts plshtym
verses.translation: So they made a covenant at Beer-sheba; and Abimelech rose up, and Phicol the captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּטַּ֥ע אֶ֖שֶׁל בִּבְאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיִּ֨קְרָא־שָׁ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵ֥ל עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyt' 'shl bb'r shb' vyqr'shm bshm yhvh 'l 'vlm
