verses.translation: And Abraham planted a tamarisk-tree in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧גׇר אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vygr 'brhm b'rts plshtym ymym rbym {p}
verses.translation: And Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְהָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים נִסָּ֖ה אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh vh'lhym nsh 't'brhm vy'mr 'lyv 'brhm vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that God did prove Abraham, and said unto him: ‘Abraham’; and he said: ‘Here am I.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר קַח־נָ֠א אֶת־בִּנְךָ֨ אֶת־יְחִֽידְךָ֤ אֲשֶׁר־אָהַ֙בְתָּ֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֔ק וְלֶ֨ךְ־לְךָ֔ אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ הַמֹּרִיָּ֑ה וְהַעֲלֵ֤הוּ שָׁם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ה עַ֚ל אַחַ֣ד הֶֽהָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qchn' 'tbnkh 'tychydkh 'shr'hbt 'tytschq vlkhlkh 'l'rts hmryh vh'lhv shm l'lh 'l 'chd hhrym 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Take now thy son, thine only son, whom thou lovest, even Isaac, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt-offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם אַבְרָהָ֜ם בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַֽיַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ אֶת־חֲמֹר֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־שְׁנֵ֤י נְעָרָיו֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיְבַקַּע֙ עֲצֵ֣י עֹלָ֔ה וַיָּ֣קׇם וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָֽמַר־ל֥וֹ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm 'brhm bbqr vychbsh 'tchmrv vyqch 'tshny n'ryv 'tv v't ytschq bnv vybq' 'tsy 'lh vyqm vylkh 'lhmqvm 'shr'mrlv h'lhym
verses.translation: And Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he cleaved the wood for the burnt-offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֧ם אֶת־עֵינָ֛יו וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־הַמָּק֖וֹם מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.translit: byvm hshlyshy vysh' 'brhm 't'ynyv vyr' 'thmqvm mrchq
verses.translation: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶל־נְעָרָ֗יו שְׁבוּ־לָכֶ֥ם פֹּה֙ עִֽם־הַחֲמ֔וֹר וַאֲנִ֣י וְהַנַּ֔עַר נֵלְכָ֖ה עַד־כֹּ֑ה וְנִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'ln'ryv shbvlkhm ph 'mhchmvr v'ny vhn'r nlkhh 'dkhh vnshtchvh vnshvbh 'lykhm
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto his young men: ‘Abide ye here with the ass, and I and the lad will go yonder; and we will worship, and come back to you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־עֲצֵ֣י הָעֹלָ֗ה וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ עַל־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־הָאֵ֖שׁ וְאֶת־הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'brhm 't'tsy h'lh vyshm 'lytschq bnv vyqch bydv 'th'sh v'thm'khlt vylkhv shnyhm ychdv
verses.translation: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt-offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took in his hand the fire and the knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִצְחָ֜ק אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֤ם אָבִיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֔י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֶּ֣נִּֽי בְנִ֑י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה הָאֵשׁ֙ וְהָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאַיֵּ֥ה הַשֶּׂ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ytschq 'l'brhm 'byv vy'mr 'by vy'mr hnny bny vy'mr hnh h'sh vh'tsym v'yh hshh l'lh
verses.translation: And Isaac spoke unto Abraham his father, and said: ‘My father.’ And he said: ‘Here am I, my son.’ And he said: ‘Behold the fire and the wood; but where is the lamb for a burnt-offering?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֱלֹהִ֞ים יִרְאֶה־לּ֥וֹ הַשֶּׂ֛ה לְעֹלָ֖ה בְּנִ֑י וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'lhym yr'hlv hshh l'lh bny vylkhv shnyhm ychdv
verses.translation: And Abraham said: ‘God will aprovide Himself the lamb for a burnt-offering, my son.’ So they went both of them together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ אֶֽל־הַמָּקוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־ל֣וֹ הָאֱלֹהִים֒ וַיִּ֨בֶן שָׁ֤ם אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־הָעֵצִ֑ים וַֽיַּעֲקֹד֙ אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֔וֹ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ מִמַּ֖עַל לָעֵצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lhmqvm 'shr 'mrlv h'lhym vybn shm 'brhm 'thmzbch vy'rkh 'th'tsym vy'qd 'tytschq bnv vyshm 'tv 'lhmzbch mm'l l'tsym
verses.translation: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־הַֽמַּאֲכֶ֑לֶת לִשְׁחֹ֖ט אֶת־בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'brhm 'tydv vyqch 'thm'khlt lshcht 'tbnv
verses.translation: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֜יו מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהֹוָה֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֣ם ׀ אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'lyv ml'kh yhvh mnhshmym vy'mr 'brhm  'brhm vy'mr hnny
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said: ‘Abraham, Abraham.’ And he said: ‘Here am I.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אַל־תִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָֽדְךָ֙ אֶל־הַנַּ֔עַר וְאַל־תַּ֥עַשׂ ל֖וֹ מְא֑וּמָה כִּ֣י  עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־יְרֵ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ אַ֔תָּה וְלֹ֥א חָשַׂ֛כְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֥ אֶת־יְחִידְךָ֖ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ltshlch ydkh 'lhn'r v'lt'sh lv m'vmh khy  'th yd'ty khyyr' 'lhym 'th vl' chshkht 'tbnkh 'tychydkh mmny
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Lay not thy hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him; for now I know that thou art a God-fearing man, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, from Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּה־אַ֔יִל אַחַ֕ר נֶאֱחַ֥ז בַּסְּבַ֖ךְ בְּקַרְנָ֑יו וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אַבְרָהָם֙ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־הָאַ֔יִל וַיַּעֲלֵ֥הוּ לְעֹלָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vysh' 'brhm 't'ynyv vyr' vhnh'yl 'chr n'chz bsbkh bqrnyv vylkh 'brhm vyqch 'th'yl vy'lhv l'lh tcht bnv
verses.translation: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. And Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אַבְרָהָ֛ם שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ יִרְאֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר הַיּ֔וֹם בְּהַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה יֵרָאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'brhm shmhmqvm hhv' yhvh  yr'h 'shr y'mr hyvm bhr yhvh yr'h
verses.translation: And Abraham called the name of that place Adonai-jireh; as it is said to this day: ‘In the mount where the LORD is seen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־אַבְרָהָ֑ם שֵׁנִ֖ית מִן־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyqr' ml'kh yhvh 'l'brhm shnyt mnhshmym
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham a second time out of heaven,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֗י יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א חָשַׂ֖כְתָּ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֥ אֶת־יְחִידֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr by nshb'ty n'myhvh khy y'n 'shr 'shyt 'thdbr hzh vl' chshkht 'tbnkh 'tychydkh
verses.translation: and said: ‘By Myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בָרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֶכְךָ֗ וְהַרְבָּ֨ה אַרְבֶּ֤ה אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְכַח֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־שְׂפַ֣ת הַיָּ֑ם וְיִרַ֣שׁ זַרְעֲךָ֔ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר אֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khybrkh 'brkhkh vhrbh 'rbh 'tzr'kh khkhvkhby hshmym vkhchvl 'shr 'lshpt hym vyrsh zr'kh 't sh'r 'ybyv
verses.translation: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the seashore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְבָּרְכ֣וּ בְזַרְעֲךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּקֹלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhtbrkhv bzr'kh khl gvyy h'rts 'qb 'shr shm't bqly
verses.translation: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast hearkened to My voice.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שׇׁב אַבְרָהָם֙ אֶל־נְעָרָ֔יו וַיָּקֻ֛מוּ וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו אֶל־בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אַבְרָהָ֖ם בִּבְאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshb 'brhm 'ln'ryv vyqmv vylkhv ychdv 'lb'r shb' vyshb 'brhm bb'r shb' {p}
verses.translation: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer- sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הִ֠נֵּ֠ה יָלְדָ֨ה מִלְכָּ֥ה גַם־הִ֛וא בָּנִ֖ים לְנָח֥וֹר אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry hdbrym h'lh vygd l'brhm l'mr hnh yldh mlkhh gmhv' bnym lnchvr 'chykh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying: ‘Behold, Milcah, she also hath borne children unto thy brother Nahor:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־ע֥וּץ בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־בּ֣וּז אָחִ֑יו וְאֶת־קְמוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֥י אֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: 't'vts bkhrv v'tbvz 'chyv v'tqmv'l 'by 'rm
verses.translation: Uz his first-born, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כֶּ֣שֶׂד וְאֶת־חֲז֔וֹ וְאֶת־פִּלְדָּ֖שׁ וְאֶת־יִדְלָ֑ף וְאֵ֖ת בְּתוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'tkhshd v'tchzv v'tpldsh v'tydlf v't btv'l
verses.translation: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְתוּאֵ֖ל יָלַ֣ד אֶת־רִבְקָ֑ה שְׁמֹנָ֥ה אֵ֙לֶּה֙ יָלְדָ֣ה מִלְכָּ֔ה לְנָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbtv'l yld 'trbqh shmnh 'lh yldh mlkhh lnchvr 'chy 'brhm
verses.translation: And Bethuel begot Rebekah; these eight did Milcah bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפִֽילַגְשׁ֖וֹ וּשְׁמָ֣הּ רְאוּמָ֑ה וַתֵּ֤לֶד גַּם־הִוא֙ אֶת־טֶ֣בַח וְאֶת־גַּ֔חַם וְאֶת־תַּ֖חַשׁ וְאֶֽת־מַעֲכָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vpylgshv vshmh r'vmh vtld gmhv' 'ttbch v'tgchm v'ttchsh v'tm'khh {p}
verses.translation: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she also bore Tebah, and Gaham, and Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְיוּ֙ חַיֵּ֣י שָׂרָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֛ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֖י חַיֵּ֥י שָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhyv chyy shrh m'h shnh v'shrym shnh vshb' shnym shny chyy shrh
verses.translation: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֣מׇת שָׂרָ֗ה בְּקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥וא חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיָּבֹא֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִסְפֹּ֥ד לְשָׂרָ֖ה וְלִבְכֹּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtmt shrh bqryt 'rb' hv' chbrvn b'rts khn'n vyb' 'brhm lspd lshrh vlbkhth
verses.translation: And Sarah died in Kiriatharba—the same is Hebron—in the land of Canaan; and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙קׇם֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י מֵת֑וֹ וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־בְּנֵי־חֵ֖ת לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'brhm m'l pny mtv vydbr 'lbnycht l'mr
verses.translation: And Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke unto the children of Heth, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֵּר־וְתוֹשָׁ֥ב אָנֹכִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם תְּנ֨וּ לִ֤י אֲחֻזַּת־קֶ֙בֶר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה מֵתִ֖י מִלְּפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: grvtvshb 'nkhy 'mkhm tnv ly 'chztqbr 'mkhm v'qbrh mty mlpny
verses.translation: ’I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי־חֵ֛ת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'nv bnycht 't'brhm l'mr lv
verses.translation: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמָעֵ֣נוּ  אֲדֹנִ֗י נְשִׂ֨יא אֱלֹהִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔נוּ בְּמִבְחַ֣ר קְבָרֵ֔ינוּ קְבֹ֖ר אֶת־מֵתֶ֑ךָ אִ֣ישׁ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ אֶת־קִבְר֛וֹ לֹֽא־יִכְלֶ֥ה מִמְּךָ֖ מִקְּבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shm'nv  'dny nshy' 'lhym 'th btvkhnv bmbchr qbrynv qbr 'tmtkh 'ysh mmnv 'tqbrv l'ykhlh mmkh mqbr mtkh
verses.translation: ’Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us; in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧קׇם אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לְעַם־הָאָ֖רֶץ לִבְנֵי־חֵֽת׃
verses.translit: vyqm 'brhm vyshtchv l'mh'rts lbnycht
verses.translation: And Abraham rose up, and bowed down to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־יֵ֣שׁ אֶֽת־נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם לִקְבֹּ֤ר אֶת־מֵתִי֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י שְׁמָע֕וּנִי וּפִגְעוּ־לִ֖י בְּעֶפְר֥וֹן בֶּן־צֹֽחַר׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'tm l'mr 'mysh 'tnpshkhm lqbr 'tmty mlpny shm'vny vpg'vly b'prvn bntschr
verses.translation: And he spoke with them, saying: ‘If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִתֶּן־לִ֗י אֶת־מְעָרַ֤ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֣ה שָׂדֵ֑הוּ בְּכֶ֨סֶף מָלֵ֜א יִתְּנֶ֥נָּה לִּ֛י בְּתוֹכְכֶ֖ם לַאֲחֻזַּת־קָֽבֶר׃
verses.translit: vytnly 'tm'rt hmkhplh 'shrlv 'shr bqtsh shdhv bkhsf ml' ytnnh ly btvkhkhm l'chztqbr
verses.translation: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in the midst of you for a possession of a burying-place.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֶפְר֥וֹן יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵי־חֵ֑ת וַיַּ֩עַן֩ עֶפְר֨וֹן הַחִתִּ֤י אֶת־אַבְרָהָם֙ בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי־חֵ֔ת לְכֹ֛ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר־עִיר֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'prvn yshb btvkh bnycht vy'n 'prvn hchty 't'brhm b'zny bnycht lkhl b'y sh'r'yrv l'mr
verses.translation: Now Ephron was sitting in the midst of the children of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אֲדֹנִ֣י שְׁמָעֵ֔נִי הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וְהַמְּעָרָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־בּ֖וֹ לְךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֑יהָ לְעֵינֵ֧י בְנֵי־עַמִּ֛י נְתַתִּ֥יהָ לָּ֖ךְ קְבֹ֥ר מֵתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: l''dny shm'ny hshdh ntty lkh vhm'rh 'shrbv lkh nttyh l'yny bny'my nttyh lkh qbr mtkh
verses.translation: ’Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee; bury thy dead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyshtchv 'brhm lpny 'm h'rts
verses.translation: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל־עֶפְר֜וֹן בְּאׇזְנֵ֤י עַם־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֛ךְ אִם־אַתָּ֥ה ל֖וּ שְׁמָעֵ֑נִי נָתַ֜תִּי כֶּ֤סֶף הַשָּׂדֶה֙ קַ֣ח מִמֶּ֔נִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָ֥ה אֶת־מֵתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'l'prvn b'zny 'mh'rts l'mr 'kh 'm'th lv shm'ny ntty khsf hshdh qch mmny v'qbrh 'tmty shmh
verses.translation: And he spoke unto Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying: ‘But if thou wilt, I pray thee, hear me: I will give the price of the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַן עֶפְר֛וֹן אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'prvn 't'brhm l'mr lv
verses.translation: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲדֹנִ֣י שְׁמָעֵ֔נִי אֶ֩רֶץ֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵאֹ֧ת שֶֽׁקֶל־כֶּ֛סֶף בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵֽינְךָ֖ מַה־הִ֑וא וְאֶת־מֵתְךָ֖ קְבֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'dny shm'ny 'rts 'rb' m't shqlkhsf byny vbynkh mhhv' v'tmtkh qbr
verses.translation: ’My lord, hearken unto me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע אַבְרָהָם֮ אֶל־עֶפְרוֹן֒ וַיִּשְׁקֹ֤ל אַבְרָהָם֙ לְעֶפְרֹ֔ן אֶת־הַכֶּ֕סֶף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י בְנֵי־חֵ֑ת אַרְבַּ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שֶׁ֣קֶל כֶּ֔סֶף עֹבֵ֖ר לַסֹּחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshm' 'brhm 'l'prvn vyshql 'brhm l'prn 'thkhsf 'shr dbr b'zny bnycht 'rb' m'vt shql khsf 'br lschr
verses.translation: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם  שְׂדֵ֣ה עֶפְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁר֙ בַּמַּכְפֵּלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י מַמְרֵ֑א הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְהַמְּעָרָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר־בּ֔וֹ וְכׇל־הָעֵץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּכׇל־גְּבֻל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vyqm  shdh 'prvn 'shr bmkhplh 'shr lpny mmr' hshdh vhm'rh 'shrbv vkhlh'ts 'shr bshdh 'shr bkhlgblv sbyb
verses.translation: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the border thereof round about, were made sure
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְמִקְנָ֖ה לְעֵינֵ֣י בְנֵי־חֵ֑ת בְּכֹ֖ל בָּאֵ֥י שַֽׁעַר־עִירֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'brhm lmqnh l'yny bnycht bkhl b'y sh'r'yrv
verses.translation: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן֩ קָבַ֨ר אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֶת־שָׂרָ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֶל־מְעָרַ֞ת שְׂדֵ֧ה הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֛ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵ֖א הִ֣וא חֶבְר֑וֹן בְּאֶ֖רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn qbr 'brhm 'tshrh 'shtv 'lm'rt shdh hmkhplh 'lpny mmr' hv' chbrvn b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre—the same is Hebron—in the land of Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קׇם הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה וְהַמְּעָרָ֧ה אֲשֶׁר־בּ֛וֹ לְאַבְרָהָ֖ם לַאֲחֻזַּת־קָ֑בֶר מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵי־חֵֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyqm hshdh vhm'rh 'shrbv l'brhm l'chztqbr m't bnycht {s}
verses.translation: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a burying-place by the children of Heth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַֽיהֹוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּכֹּֽל׃
verses.translit: v'brhm zqn b' bymym vyhvh brkh 't'brhm bkhl
verses.translation: And Abraham was old, well stricken in age; and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶל־עַבְדּוֹ֙ זְקַ֣ן בֵּית֔וֹ הַמֹּשֵׁ֖ל בְּכׇל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֑וֹ שִֽׂים־נָ֥א יָדְךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת יְרֵכִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'brhm 'l'bdv zqn bytv hmshl bkhl'shrlv shymn' ydkh tcht yrkhy
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto his servant, the elder of his house, that ruled over all that he had: ‘Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַשְׁבִּ֣יעֲךָ֔ בַּֽיהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shby'kh byhvh 'lhy hshmym v'lhy h'rts 'shr l'tqch 'shh lbny mbnvt hkhn'ny 'shr 'nkhy yvshb bqrbv
verses.translation: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י אֶל־אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִ֥י לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: khy 'l'rtsy v'lmvldty tlkh vlqcht 'shh lbny lytschq
verses.translation: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son, even for Isaac.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הָעֶ֔בֶד אוּלַי֙ לֹא־תֹאבֶ֣ה הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה לָלֶ֥כֶת אַחֲרַ֖י אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את הֶֽהָשֵׁ֤ב אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־בִּנְךָ֔ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יָצָ֥אתָ מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'bd 'vly l't'bh h'shh llkht 'chry 'lh'rts hz't hhshb 'shyb 'tbnkh 'lh'rts 'shryts't mshm
verses.translation: And the servant said unto him: ‘Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land; must I needs bring thy son back unto the land from whence thou camest?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אַבְרָהָ֑ם הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת־בְּנִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'brhm hshmr lkh pntshyb 'tbny shmh
verses.translation: And Abraham said unto him: ‘Beware thou that thou bring not my son back thither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְקָחַ֜נִי מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֮ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מֽוֹלַדְתִּי֒ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּר־לִ֜י וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־לִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את ה֗וּא יִשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכוֹ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֛ה לִבְנִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.translit: yhvh  'lhy hshmym 'shr lqchny mbyt 'by vm'rts mvldty v'shr dbrly v'shr nshb'ly l'mr lzr'kh 'tn 'th'rts hz't hv' yshlch ml'khv lpnykh vlqcht 'shh lbny mshm
verses.translation: The LORD, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my nativity, and who spoke unto me, and who swore unto me, saying: Unto thy seed will I give this land; He will send His angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife for my son from thence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֨א תֹאבֶ֤ה הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְנִקִּ֕יתָ מִשְּׁבֻעָתִ֖י זֹ֑את רַ֣ק אֶת־בְּנִ֔י לֹ֥א תָשֵׁ֖ב שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'ml' t'bh h'shh llkht 'chrykh vnqyt mshb'ty z't rq 'tbny l' tshb shmh
verses.translation: And if the woman be not willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath; only thou shalt not bring my son back thither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם הָעֶ֙בֶד֙ אֶת־יָד֔וֹ תַּ֛חַת יֶ֥רֶךְ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֑יו וַיִּשָּׁ֣בַֽע ל֔וֹ עַל־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm h'bd 'tydv tcht yrkh 'brhm 'dnyv vyshb' lv 'lhdbr hzh
verses.translation: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח הָ֠עֶ֠בֶד עֲשָׂרָ֨ה גְמַלִּ֜ים מִגְּמַלֵּ֤י אֲדֹנָיו֙ וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וְכׇל־ט֥וּב אֲדֹנָ֖יו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֗קׇם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־אֲרַ֥ם נַֽהֲרַ֖יִם אֶל־עִ֥יר נָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyqch h'bd 'shrh gmlym mgmly 'dnyv vylkh vkhltvb 'dnyv bydv vyqm vylkh 'l'rm nhrym 'l'yr nchvr
verses.translation: And the servant took ten camels, of the camels of his master, and departed; having all goodly things of his master’s in his hand; and he arose, and went to Aram-naharaim, unto the city of Nahor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּבְרֵ֧ךְ הַגְּמַלִּ֛ים מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־בְּאֵ֣ר הַמָּ֑יִם לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב לְעֵ֖ת צֵ֥את הַשֹּׁאֲבֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vybrkh hgmlym mchvts l'yr 'lb'r hmym l't 'rb l't ts't hsh'bt
verses.translation: And he made the camels to kneel down without the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר  יְהֹוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם הַקְרֵה־נָ֥א לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr  yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm hqrhn' lpny hyvm v'shhchsd 'm 'dny 'brhm
verses.translation: And he said: ‘O LORD, the God of my master Abraham, send me, I pray Thee, good speed this day, and show kindness unto my master Abraham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וּבְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִשְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy ntsb 'l'yn hmym vbnvt 'nshy h'yr yts't lsh'b mym
verses.translation: Behold, I stand by the fountain of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַטִּי־נָ֤א כַדֵּךְ֙ וְאֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְאָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤הּ הֹכַ֙חְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיִצְחָ֔ק וּבָ֣הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי־עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם־אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyh hn'r 'shr 'mr 'lyh htyn' khdkh v'shth v'mrh shth vgmgmlykh 'shqh 'th hkhcht l'bdkh lytschq vbh 'd' khy'shyt chsd 'm'dny
verses.translation: So let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say: Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say: Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also; let the same be she that Thou hast appointed for Thy servant, even for Isaac; and thereby shall I know that Thou hast shown kindness unto my master.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ה֗וּא טֶ֘רֶם֮ כִּלָּ֣ה לְדַבֵּר֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה רִבְקָ֣ה יֹצֵ֗את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֻלְּדָה֙ לִבְתוּאֵ֣ל בֶּן־מִלְכָּ֔ה אֵ֥שֶׁת נָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְכַדָּ֖הּ עַל־שִׁכְמָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhyhv' trm khlh ldbr vhnh rbqh yts't 'shr yldh lbtv'l bnmlkhh 'sht nchvr 'chy 'brhm vkhdh 'lshkhmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ טֹבַ֤ת מַרְאֶה֙ מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלָ֕ה וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֣רֶד הָעַ֔יְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּ֥א כַדָּ֖הּ וַתָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vhn'r tbt mr'h m'd btvlh v'ysh l' yd'h vtrd h'ynh vtml' khdh vt'l
verses.translation: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her; and she went down to the fountain, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥רׇץ הָעֶ֖בֶד לִקְרָאתָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַגְמִיאִ֥ינִי נָ֛א מְעַט־מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyrts h'bd lqr'th vy'mr hgmy'yny n' m'tmym mkhdkh
verses.translation: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: ‘Give me to drink, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁתֵ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתֹּ֧רֶד כַּדָּ֛הּ עַל־יָדָ֖הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vt'mr shth 'dny vtmhr vtrd khdh 'lydh vtshqhv
verses.translation: And she said: ‘Drink, my lord’; and she hastened, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּכַ֖ל לְהַשְׁקֹת֑וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֤ם לִגְמַלֶּ֙יךָ֙ אֶשְׁאָ֔ב עַ֥ד אִם־כִּלּ֖וּ לִשְׁתֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: vtkhl lhshqtv vt'mr gm lgmlykh 'sh'b 'd 'mkhlv lshtt
verses.translation: And when she had done giving him drink, she said: ‘I will draw for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתְּעַ֤ר כַּדָּהּ֙ אֶל־הַשֹּׁ֔קֶת וַתָּ֥רׇץ ע֛וֹד אֶֽל־הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִשְׁאֹ֑ב וַתִּשְׁאַ֖ב לְכׇל־גְּמַלָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vtmhr vt'r khdh 'lhshqt vtrts 'vd 'lhb'r lsh'b vtsh'b lkhlgmlyv
verses.translation: And she hastened, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵ֖ה לָ֑הּ מַחֲרִ֕ישׁ לָדַ֗עַת הַֽהִצְלִ֧יחַ יְהֹוָ֛ה דַּרְכּ֖וֹ אִם־לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vh'ysh msht'h lh mchrysh ld't hhtslych yhvh drkhv 'ml'
verses.translation: And the man looked stedfastly on her; holding his peace, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלּ֤וּ הַגְּמַלִּים֙ לִשְׁתּ֔וֹת וַיִּקַּ֤ח הָאִישׁ֙ נֶ֣זֶם זָהָ֔ב בֶּ֖קַע מִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֤י צְמִידִים֙ עַל־יָדֶ֔יהָ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מִשְׁקָלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr khlv hgmlym lshtvt vyqch h'ysh nzm zhb bq' mshqlv vshny tsmydym 'lydyh 'shrh zhb mshqlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בַּת־מִ֣י אַ֔תְּ הַגִּ֥ידִי נָ֖א לִ֑י הֲיֵ֧שׁ בֵּית־אָבִ֛יךְ מָק֥וֹם לָ֖נוּ לָלִֽין׃
verses.translit: vy'mr btmy 't hgydy n' ly hysh byt'bykh mqvm lnv llyn
verses.translation: and said: ‘Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee. Is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו בַּת־בְּתוּאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי בֶּן־מִלְכָּ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְנָחֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv btbtv'l 'nkhy bnmlkhh 'shr yldh lnchvr
verses.translation: And she said unto him: ‘I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore unto Nahor.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו גַּם־תֶּ֥בֶן גַּם־מִסְפּ֖וֹא רַ֣ב עִמָּ֑נוּ גַּם־מָק֖וֹם לָלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv gmtbn gmmspv' rb 'mnv gmmqvm llvn
verses.translation: She said moreover unto him: ‘We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקֹּ֣ד הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqd h'ysh vyshtchv lyhvh
verses.translation: And the man bowed his head, and prostrated himself before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹֽא־עָזַ֥ב חַסְדּ֛וֹ וַאֲמִתּ֖וֹ מֵעִ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֑י אָנֹכִ֗י בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ נָחַ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אֲחֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'shr l''zb chsdv v'mtv m'm 'dny 'nkhy bdrkh nchny yhvh byt 'chy 'dny
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who hath not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master; as for me, the LORD hath led me in the way to the house of my master’s brethren.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֙רׇץ֙ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַתַּגֵּ֖ד לְבֵ֣ית אִמָּ֑הּ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vtrts hn'r vtgd lbyt 'mh khdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And the damsel ran, and told her mother’s house according to these words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְרִבְקָ֥ה אָ֖ח וּשְׁמ֣וֹ לָבָ֑ן וַיָּ֨רׇץ לָבָ֧ן אֶל־הָאִ֛ישׁ הַח֖וּצָה אֶל־הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: vlrbqh 'ch vshmv lbn vyrts lbn 'lh'ysh hchvtsh 'lh'yn
verses.translation: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban; and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the fountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כִּרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־הַנֶּ֗זֶם וְֽאֶת־הַצְּמִדִים֮ עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֲחֹתוֹ֒ וּכְשׇׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֞י רִבְקָ֤ה אֲחֹתוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּֽה־דִבֶּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־הָאִ֔ישׁ וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים עַל־הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khr't 'thnzm v'thtsmdym 'lydy 'chtv vkhshm'v 'tdbry rbqh 'chtv l'mr khhdbr 'ly h'ysh vyb' 'lh'ysh vhnh 'md 'lhgmlym 'lh'yn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he saw the ring, and the bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying: ‘Thus spoke the man unto me, ‘that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the fountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בּ֖וֹא בְּר֣וּךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה לָ֤מָּה תַעֲמֹד֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְאָנֹכִי֙ פִּנִּ֣יתִי הַבַּ֔יִת וּמָק֖וֹם לַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr bv' brvkh yhvh lmh t'md bchvts v'nkhy pnyty hbyt vmqvm lgmlym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have cleared the house, and made room for the camels.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָאִישׁ֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיְפַתַּ֖ח הַגְּמַלִּ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֨ן תֶּ֤בֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא֙ לַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וּמַ֙יִם֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ רַגְלָ֔יו וְרַגְלֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' h'ysh hbyth vyptch hgmlym vytn tbn vmspv' lgmlym vmym lrchts rglyv vrgly h'nshym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And the man came into the house, and he ungirded the camels; and he gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men that were with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ויישם) [וַיּוּשַׂ֤ם] לְפָנָיו֙ לֶאֱכֹ֔ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם־דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: (vyyshm) [vyvshm] lpnyv l'khl vy'mr l' 'khl 'd 'mdbrty dbry vy'mr dbr
verses.translation: And there was set food before him to eat; but he said: ‘I will not eat, until I have told mine errand.’ And he said: ‘Speak on.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bd 'brhm 'nkhy
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֞ה בֵּרַ֧ךְ אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֛י מְאֹ֖ד וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ל֞וֹ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וַעֲבָדִם֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וּגְמַלִּ֖ים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhvh brkh 't'dny m'd vygdl vytnlv ts'n vbqr vkhsf vzhb v'bdm vshpcht vgmlym vchmrym
verses.translation: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great; and He hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֡לֶד שָׂרָה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת אֲדֹנִ֥י בֵן֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י זִקְנָתָ֑הּ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֖וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtld shrh 'sht 'dny bn l'dny 'chry zqnth vytnlv 'tkhl'shrlv
verses.translation: And Sarah my master’s wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵ֥נִי אֲדֹנִ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshb'ny 'dny l'mr l'tqch 'shh lbny mbnvt hkhn'ny 'shr 'nkhy yshb b'rtsv
verses.translation: And my master made me swear, saying: Thou shalt not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֧א אֶל־בֵּית־אָבִ֛י תֵּלֵ֖ךְ וְאֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ml' 'lbyt'by tlkh v'lmshpchty vlqcht 'shh lbny
verses.translation: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife for my son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֑י אֻלַ֛י לֹא־תֵלֵ֥ךְ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'l'dny 'ly l'tlkh h'shh 'chry
verses.translation: And I said unto my master: Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י יְהֹוָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנָ֗יו יִשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכ֤וֹ אִתָּךְ֙ וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּ֖י וּמִבֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh 'shrhthlkhty lpnyv yshlch ml'khv 'tkh vhtslych drkhkh vlqcht 'shh lbny mmshpchty vmbyt 'by
verses.translation: And he said unto me: The LORD, before whom I walk, will send His angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּנָּקֶה֙ מֵאָ֣לָתִ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְאִם־לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְהָיִ֥יתָ נָקִ֖י מֵאָלָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'z tnqh m'lty khy tbv' 'lmshpchty v'ml' ytnv lkh vhyyt nqy m'lty
verses.translation: then shalt thou be clear from my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give her not to thee, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָבֹ֥א הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־הָעָ֑יִן וָאֹמַ֗ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אִם־יֶשְׁךָ־נָּא֙ מַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י הֹלֵ֥ךְ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'b' hyvm 'lh'yn v'mr yhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'myshkhn' mtslych drkhy 'shr 'nkhy hlkh 'lyh
verses.translation: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said: O LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now Thou do prosper my way which I go:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וְהָיָ֤ה הָֽעַלְמָה֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣את לִשְׁאֹ֔ב וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י אֵלֶ֔יהָ הַשְׁקִֽינִי־נָ֥א מְעַט־מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy ntsb 'l'yn hmym vhyh h'lmh hyts't lsh'b v'mrty 'lyh hshqynyn' m'tmym mkhdkh
verses.translation: behold, I stand by the fountain of water; and let it come to pass, that the maiden that cometh forth to draw, to whom I shall say: Give me, I pray thee, a little water from thy pitcher to drink;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמְרָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ גַּם־אַתָּ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַ֥ם לִגְמַלֶּ֖יךָ אֶשְׁאָ֑ב הִ֣וא הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הֹכִ֥יחַ יְהֹוָ֖ה לְבֶן־אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mrh 'ly gm'th shth vgm lgmlykh 'sh'b hv' h'shh 'shrhkhych yhvh lbn'dny
verses.translation: and she shall say to me: Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels; let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed for my master’s son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֩ טֶ֨רֶם אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־לִבִּ֗י וְהִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙ וְכַדָּ֣הּ עַל־שִׁכְמָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָ֑ב וָאֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ הַשְׁקִ֥ינִי נָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ny trm 'khlh ldbr 'llby vhnh rbqh yts't vkhdh 'lshkhmh vtrd h'ynh vtsh'b v'mr 'lyh hshqyny n'
verses.translation: And before I had done speaking to my heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the fountain, and drew. And I said unto her: Let me drink, I pray thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתּ֤וֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה וָאֵ֕שְׁתְּ וְגַ֥ם הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים הִשְׁקָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vtmhr vtvrd khdh m'lyh vt'mr shth vgmgmlykh 'shqh v'sht vgm hgmlym hshqth
verses.translation: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said: Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. So I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁאַ֣ל אֹתָ֗הּ וָאֹמַר֮ בַּת־מִ֣י אַתְּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־נָח֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽלְדָה־לּ֖וֹ מִלְכָּ֑ה וָאָשִׂ֤ם הַנֶּ֙זֶם֙ עַל־אַפָּ֔הּ וְהַצְּמִידִ֖ים עַל־יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'sh'l 'th v'mr btmy 't vt'mr btbtv'l bnnchvr 'shr yldhlv mlkhh v'shm hnzm 'l'ph vhtsmydym 'lydyh
verses.translation: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter art thou? And she said: The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore unto him. And I put the ring upon her nose, and the bracelets upon her hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקֹּ֥ד וָֽאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַיהֹוָ֑ה וָאֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנְחַ֙נִי֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֱמֶ֔ת לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־בַּת־אֲחִ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖י לִבְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'qd v'shtchvh lyhvh v'brkh 'tyhvh 'lhy 'dny 'brhm 'shr hnchny bdrkh 'mt lqcht 'tbt'chy 'dny lbnv
verses.translation: And I bowed my head, and prostrated myself before the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּ֠ה אִם־יֶשְׁכֶ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים חֶ֧סֶד וֶֽאֱמֶ֛ת אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֖י הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֑י וְאִם־לֹ֕א הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔י וְאֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל־יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל־שְׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.translit: v'th 'myshkhm 'shym chsd v'mt 't'dny hgydv ly v'ml' hgydv ly v'pnh 'lymyn 'v 'lshm'l
verses.translation: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me; and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן לָבָ֤ן וּבְתוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵיְהֹוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א הַדָּבָ֑ר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רַ֥ע אוֹ־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vy'n lbn vbtv'l vy'mrv myhvh yts' hdbr l' nvkhl dbr 'lykh r' 'vtvb
verses.translation: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said: ‘The thing proceedeth from the LORD; we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־רִבְקָ֥ה לְפָנֶ֖יךָ קַ֣ח וָלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֤י אִשָּׁה֙ לְבֶן־אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnhrbqh lpnykh qch vlkh vthy 'shh lbn'dnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֛ע עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־דִּבְרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַ֖רְצָה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr shm' 'bd 'brhm 'tdbryhm vyshtchv 'rtsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א הָעֶ֜בֶד כְּלֵי־כֶ֨סֶף וּכְלֵ֤י זָהָב֙ וּבְגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְרִבְקָ֑ה וּמִ֨גְדָּנֹ֔ת נָתַ֥ן לְאָחִ֖יהָ וּלְאִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyvts' h'bd khlykhsf vkhly zhb vbgdym vytn lrbqh vmgdnt ntn l'chyh vl'mh
verses.translation: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah; he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֗וּ ה֛וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֖וֹ וַיָּלִ֑ינוּ וַיָּק֣וּמוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שַׁלְּחֻ֥נִי לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'khlv vyshtv hv' vh'nshym 'shr'mv vylynv vyqvmv bbqr vy'mr shlchny l'dny
verses.translation: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said: ‘Send me away unto my master.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אָחִ֙יהָ֙ וְאִמָּ֔הּ תֵּשֵׁ֨ב הַנַּעֲרָ֥ אִתָּ֛נוּ יָמִ֖ים א֣וֹ עָשׂ֑וֹר אַחַ֖ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chyh v'mh tshb hn'r 'tnv ymym 'v 'shvr 'chr tlkh
verses.translation: And her brother and her mother said: ‘Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַל־תְּאַחֲר֣וּ אֹתִ֔י וַֽיהֹוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑י שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'lt'chrv 'ty vyhvh htslych drkhy shlchvny v'lkhh l'dny
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘Delay me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נִקְרָ֣א לַֽנַּעֲרָ֑ וְנִשְׁאֲלָ֖ה אֶת־פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv nqr' ln'r vnsh'lh 'tpyh
verses.translation: And they said: ‘We will call the damsel, and inquire at her mouth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְרִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ הֲתֵלְכִ֖י עִם־הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyqr'v lrbqh vy'mrv 'lyh htlkhy 'mh'ysh hzh vt'mr 'lkh
verses.translation: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her: ‘Wilt thou go with this man?’ And she said: ‘I will go.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־רִבְקָ֥ה אֲחֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־מֵנִקְתָּ֑הּ וְאֶת־עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְאֶת־אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'trbqh 'chtm v'tmnqth v't'bd 'brhm v't'nshyv
verses.translation: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבָרְכ֤וּ אֶת־רִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לָ֔הּ אֲחֹתֵ֕נוּ אַ֥תְּ הֲיִ֖י לְאַלְפֵ֣י רְבָבָ֑ה וְיִירַ֣שׁ זַרְעֵ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר שֹׂנְאָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vybrkhv 'trbqh vy'mrv lh 'chtnv 't hyy l'lpy rbbh vyyrsh zr'kh 't sh'r shn'yv
verses.translation: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her: ‘Our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let thy seed possess the gate of those that hate them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֨קׇם רִבְקָ֜ה וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ וַתִּרְכַּ֙בְנָה֙ עַל־הַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וַתֵּלַ֖כְנָה אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּקַּ֥ח הָעֶ֛בֶד אֶת־רִבְקָ֖ה וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vtqm rbqh vn'rtyh vtrkhbnh 'lhgmlym vtlkhnh 'chry h'ysh vyqch h'bd 'trbqh vylkh
verses.translation: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man. And the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִצְחָק֙ בָּ֣א מִבּ֔וֹא בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.translit: vytschq b' mbv' b'r lchy r'y vhv' yvshb b'rts hngb
verses.translation: And Isaac came from the way of Beer-lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the land of the South.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק לָשׂ֥וּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת עָ֑רֶב וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה גְמַלִּ֖ים בָּאִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts' ytschq lshvch bshdh lpnvt 'rb vysh' 'ynyv vyr' vhnh gmlym b'ym
verses.translation: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide; and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, there were camels coming.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂ֤א רִבְקָה֙ אֶת־עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא אֶת־יִצְחָ֑ק וַתִּפֹּ֖ל מֵעַ֥ל הַגָּמָֽל׃
verses.translit: vtsh' rbqh 't'ynyh vtr' 'tytschq vtpl m'l hgml
verses.translation: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she alighted from the camel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־הָעֶ֗בֶד מִֽי־הָאִ֤ישׁ הַלָּזֶה֙ הַהֹלֵ֤ךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ לִקְרָאתֵ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעֶ֖בֶד ה֣וּא אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתִּקַּ֥ח הַצָּעִ֖יף וַתִּתְכָּֽס׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lh'bd myh'ysh hlzh hhlkh bshdh lqr'tnv vy'mr h'bd hv' 'dny vtqch hts'yf vttkhs
verses.translation: And she said unto the servant: ‘What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us?’ And the servant said: ‘It is my master.’ And she took her veil, and covered herself.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֥ר הָעֶ֖בֶד לְיִצְחָ֑ק אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyspr h'bd lytschq 't khlhdbrym 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִאֶ֣הָ יִצְחָ֗ק הָאֹ֙הֱלָה֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִמּ֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֧ח אֶת־רִבְקָ֛ה וַתְּהִי־ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֑הָ וַיִּנָּחֵ֥ם יִצְחָ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyb'h ytschq h'hlh shrh 'mv vyqch 'trbqh vthylv l'shh vy'hbh vynchm ytschq 'chry 'mv {p}
verses.translation: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her. And Isaac was comforted for his mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף אַבְרָהָ֛ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה וּשְׁמָ֥הּ קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vysf 'brhm vyqch 'shh vshmh qtvrh
verses.translation: And Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־זִמְרָן֙ וְאֶת־יׇקְשָׁ֔ן וְאֶת־מְדָ֖ן וְאֶת־מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֶת־יִשְׁבָּ֖ק וְאֶת־שֽׁוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vtld lv 'tzmrn v'tyqshn v'tmdn v'tmdyn v'tyshbq v'tshvch
verses.translation: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיׇקְשָׁ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־שְׁבָ֖א וְאֶת־דְּדָ֑ן וּבְנֵ֣י דְדָ֔ן הָי֛וּ אַשּׁוּרִ֥ם וּלְטוּשִׁ֖ם וּלְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqshn yld 'tshb' v'tddn vbny ddn hyv 'shvrm vltvshm vl'mym
verses.translation: And Jokshan begot Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנֹ֔ךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbny mdyn 'yph v'pr vchnkh v'byd' v'ld'h khl'lh bny qtvrh
verses.translation: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֧ן אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: vytn 'brhm 'tkhl'shrlv lytschq
verses.translation: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י הַפִּֽילַגְשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַבְרָהָ֔ם נָתַ֥ן אַבְרָהָ֖ם מַתָּנֹ֑ת וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵ֞ם מֵעַ֨ל יִצְחָ֤ק בְּנוֹ֙ בְּעוֹדֶ֣נּוּ חַ֔י קֵ֖דְמָה אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: vlbny hpylgshym 'shr l'brhm ntn 'brhm mtnt vyshlchm m'l ytschq bnv b'vdnv chy qdmh 'l'rts qdm
verses.translation: But unto the sons of the concubines, that Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts; and he sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה יְמֵ֛י שְׁנֵֽי־חַיֵּ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־חָ֑י מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lh ymy shnychyy 'brhm 'shrchy m't shnh vshb'ym shnh vchmsh shnym
verses.translation: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, a hundred threescore and fifteen years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע וַיָּ֧מׇת אַבְרָהָ֛ם בְּשֵׂיבָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה זָקֵ֣ן וְשָׂבֵ֑עַ וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: vygv' vymt 'brhm bshybh tvbh zqn vshb' vy'sf 'l'myv
verses.translation: And Abraham expired, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ בָּנָ֔יו אֶל־מְעָרַ֖ת הַמַּכְפֵּלָ֑ה אֶל־שְׂדֵ֞ה עֶפְרֹ֤ן בֶּן־צֹ֙חַר֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י מַמְרֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vyqbrv 'tv ytschq vyshm''l bnyv 'lm'rt hmkhplh 'lshdh 'prn bntschr hchty 'shr 'lpny mmr'
verses.translation: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשָּׂדֶ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־קָנָ֥ה אַבְרָהָ֖ם מֵאֵ֣ת בְּנֵי־חֵ֑ת שָׁ֛מָּה קֻבַּ֥ר אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְשָׂרָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hshdh 'shrqnh 'brhm m't bnycht shmh qbr 'brhm vshrh 'shtv
verses.translation: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth; there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־יִצְחָ֣ק בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִצְחָ֔ק עִם־בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry mvt 'brhm vybrkh 'lhym 'tytschq bnv vyshb ytschq 'mb'r lchy r'y {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed Isaac his son; and Isaac dwelt by Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְדֹ֥ת יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֜ה הָגָ֧ר הַמִּצְרִ֛ית שִׁפְחַ֥ת שָׂרָ֖ה לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh tldt yshm''l bn'brhm 'shr yldh hgr hmtsryt shpcht shrh l'brhm
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bore unto Abraham.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל בִּשְׁמֹתָ֖ם לְתוֹלְדֹתָ֑ם בְּכֹ֤ר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָיֹ֔ת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny yshm''l bshmtm ltvldtm bkhr yshm''l nbyt vqdr v'db'l vmbshm
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the first-born of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִשְׁמָ֥ע וְדוּמָ֖ה וּמַשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: vmshm' vdvmh vmsh'
verses.translation: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲדַ֣ד וְתֵימָ֔א יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵֽדְמָה׃
verses.translit: chdd vtym' ytvr npysh vqdmh
verses.translation: Hadad, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedem;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹתָ֔ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְטִֽירֹתָ֑ם שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂ֥ר נְשִׂיאִ֖ם לְאֻמֹּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh hm bny yshm''l v'lh shmtm bchtsryhm vbtyrtm shnym'shr nshy'm l'mtm
verses.translation: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments; twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁנֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י יִשְׁמָעֵ֔אל מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֛ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וְשֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֑ים וַיִּגְוַ֣ע וַיָּ֔מׇת וַיֵּאָ֖סֶף אֶל־עַמָּֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'lh shny chyy yshm''l m't shnh vshlshym shnh vshb' shnym vygv' vymt vy'sf 'l'myv
verses.translation: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred and thirty and seven years; and he expired and died; and was gathered unto his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּנ֨וּ מֵֽחֲוִילָ֜ה עַד־שׁ֗וּר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם בֹּאֲכָ֖ה אַשּׁ֑וּרָה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י כׇל־אֶחָ֖יו נָפָֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhnv mchvylh 'dshvr 'shr 'lpny mtsrym b'khh 'shvrh 'lpny khl'chyv npl {p}
verses.translation: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Asshur: over against all his brethren he did settle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת יִצְחָ֖ק בֶּן־אַבְרָהָ֑ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt ytschq bn'brhm 'brhm hvlyd 'tytschq
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begot Isaac.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יִצְחָק֙ בֶּן־אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּקַחְתּ֣וֹ אֶת־רִבְקָ֗ה בַּת־בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י מִפַּדַּ֖ן אֲרָ֑ם אֲח֛וֹת לָבָ֥ן הָאֲרַמִּ֖י ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyhy ytschq bn'rb'ym shnh bqchtv 'trbqh btbtv'l h'rmy mpdn 'rm 'chvt lbn h'rmy lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean, of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֨ר יִצְחָ֤ק לַֽיהֹוָה֙ לְנֹ֣כַח אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וַיֵּעָ֤תֶר לוֹ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַתַּ֖הַר רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'tr ytschq lyhvh lnkhch 'shtv khy 'qrh hv' vy'tr lv yhvh vthr rbqh 'shtv
verses.translation: And Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren; and the LORD let Himself be entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְרֹֽצְצ֤וּ הַבָּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־כֵּ֔ן לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה אָנֹ֑כִי וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytrtstsv hbnym bqrbh vt'mr 'mkhn lmh zh 'nkhy vtlkh ldrsh 'tyhvh
verses.translation: And the children struggled together within her; and she said: ‘If it be so, wherefore do I live?’ And she went to inquire of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה לָ֗הּ שְׁנֵ֤י (גיים) [גוֹיִם֙] בְּבִטְנֵ֔ךְ וּשְׁנֵ֣י לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִמֵּעַ֖יִךְ יִפָּרֵ֑דוּ וּלְאֹם֙ מִלְאֹ֣ם יֶֽאֱמָ֔ץ וְרַ֖ב יַעֲבֹ֥ד צָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lh shny (gyym) [gvym] bbtnkh vshny l'mym mm'ykh yprdv vl'm ml'm y'mts vrb y'bd ts'yr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto her: Two nations are in thy womb, And two peoples shall be separated from thy bowels; And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְלְא֥וּ יָמֶ֖יהָ לָלֶ֑דֶת וְהִנֵּ֥ה תוֹמִ֖ם בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyml'v ymyh lldt vhnh tvmm bbtnh
verses.translation: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ אַדְמוֹנִ֔י כֻּלּ֖וֹ כְּאַדֶּ֣רֶת שֵׂעָ֑ר וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: vyts' hr'shvn 'dmvny khlv kh'drt sh'r vyqr'v shmv 'shv
verses.translation: And the first came forth ruddy, all over like a hairy mantle; and they called his name Esau.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן יָצָ֣א אָחִ֗יו וְיָד֤וֹ אֹחֶ֙זֶת֙ בַּעֲקֵ֣ב עֵשָׂ֔ו וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְיִצְחָ֛ק בֶּן־שִׁשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּלֶ֥דֶת אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'chrykhn yts' 'chyv vydv 'chzt b'qb 'shv vyqr' shmv y'qb vytschq bnshshym shnh bldt 'tm
verses.translation: And after that came forth his brother, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob. And Isaac was threescore years old when she bore them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּגְדְּלוּ֙ הַנְּעָרִ֔ים וַיְהִ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ צַ֖יִד אִ֣ישׁ שָׂדֶ֑ה וְיַעֲקֹב֙ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֔ם יֹשֵׁ֖ב אֹהָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vygdlv hn'rym vyhy 'shv 'ysh yd' tsyd 'ysh shdh vy'qb 'ysh tm yshb 'hlym
verses.translation: And the boys grew; and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב יִצְחָ֛ק אֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו כִּי־צַ֣יִד בְּפִ֑יו וְרִבְקָ֖ה אֹהֶ֥בֶת אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'hb ytschq 't'shv khytsyd bpyv vrbqh 'hbt 'ty'qb
verses.translation: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison; and Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥זֶד יַעֲקֹ֖ב נָזִ֑יד וַיָּבֹ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו מִן־הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְה֥וּא עָיֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vyzd y'qb nzyd vyb' 'shv mnhshdh vhv' 'yf
verses.translation: And Jacob sod pottage; and Esau came in from the field, and he was faint.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַלְעִיטֵ֤נִי נָא֙ מִן־הָאָדֹ֤ם הָאָדֹם֙ הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י עָיֵ֖ף אָנֹ֑כִי עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמ֖וֹ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv 'ly'qb hl'ytny n' mnh'dm h'dm hzh khy 'yf 'nkhy 'lkhn qr'shmv 'dvm
verses.translation: And Esau said to Jacob: ‘Let me swallow, I pray thee, some of this red, red pottage; for I am faint.’ Therefore was his name called Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִכְרָ֥ה כַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־בְּכֹרָתְךָ֖ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb mkhrh khyvm 'tbkhrtkh ly
verses.translation: And Jacob said: ‘Sell me first thy birth right.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לָמ֑וּת וְלָמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לִ֖י בְּכֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv hnh 'nkhy hvlkh lmvt vlmhzh ly bkhrh
verses.translation: And Esau said: ‘Behold, I am at the point to die; and what profit shall the birthright do to me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ כַּיּ֔וֹם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע ל֑וֹ וַיִּמְכֹּ֥ר אֶת־בְּכֹרָת֖וֹ לְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb hshb'h ly khyvm vyshb' lv vymkhr 'tbkhrtv ly'qb
verses.translation: And Jacob said: ‘Swear to me first’; and he swore unto him; and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֞ב נָתַ֣ן לְעֵשָׂ֗ו לֶ֚חֶם וּנְזִ֣יד עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַיָּ֖קׇם וַיֵּלַ֑ךְ וַיִּ֥בֶז עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'qb ntn l'shv lchm vnzyd 'dshym vy'khl vysht vyqm vylkh vybz 'shv 'thbkhrh {p}
verses.translation: And Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentils; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִלְּבַד֙ הָרָעָ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בִּימֵ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ יִצְחָ֛ק אֶל־אֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים גְּרָֽרָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy r'b b'rts mlbd hr'b hr'shvn 'shr hyh bymy 'brhm vylkh ytschq 'l'bymlkh mlkhplshtym grrh
verses.translation: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א אֵלָיו֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־תֵּרֵ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה שְׁכֹ֣ן בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh vy'mr 'ltrd mtsrymh shkhn b'rts 'shr 'mr 'lykh
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said: ‘Go not down unto Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּ֚וּר בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וְאֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמְּךָ֖ וַאֲבָרְכֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־לְךָ֣ וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֗ אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָֽאֲרָצֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל וַהֲקִֽמֹתִי֙ אֶת־הַשְּׁבֻעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם אָבִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: gvr b'rts hz't v'hyh 'mkh v'brkhkh khylkh vlzr'kh 'tn 'tkhlh'rtst h'l vhqmty 'thshb'h 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm 'bykh
verses.translation: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore unto Abraham thy father;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָתַתִּ֣י לְזַרְעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הָאֲרָצֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑ל וְהִתְבָּרְכ֣וּ בְזַרְעֲךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'tzr'kh khkhvkhby hshmym vntty lzr'kh 't khlh'rtst h'l vhtbrkhv bzr'kh khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: and I will multiply thy seed as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these lands; and by thy seed shall all the nations of the earth bless themselves;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֕קֶב אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמַ֥ע אַבְרָהָ֖ם בְּקֹלִ֑י וַיִּשְׁמֹר֙ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֔י מִצְוֺתַ֖י חֻקּוֹתַ֥י וְתוֹרֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'qb 'shrshm' 'brhm bqly vyshmr mshmrty mtsvty chqvty vtvrty
verses.translation: because that Abraham hearkened to My voice, and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִצְחָ֖ק בִּגְרָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshb ytschq bgrr
verses.translation: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁאֲל֞וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ לְאִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא כִּ֤י יָרֵא֙ לֵאמֹ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֔י פֶּן־יַֽהַרְגֻ֜נִי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ עַל־רִבְקָ֔ה כִּֽי־טוֹבַ֥ת מַרְאֶ֖ה הִֽוא׃
verses.translit: vysh'lv 'nshy hmqvm l'shtv vy'mr 'chty hv' khy yr' l'mr 'shty pnyhrgny 'nshy hmqvm 'lrbqh khytvbt mr'h hv'
verses.translation: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said: ‘She is my sister’; for he feared to say: ‘My wife’; ‘lest the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah, because she is fair to look upon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֣י אָֽרְכוּ־ל֥וֹ שָׁם֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַיַּשְׁקֵ֗ף אֲבִימֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים בְּעַ֖ד הַֽחַלּ֑וֹן וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה יִצְחָק֙ מְצַחֵ֔ק אֵ֖ת רִבְקָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhy khy 'rkhvlv shm hymym vyshqf 'bymlkh mlkh plshtym b'd hchlvn vyr' vhnh ytschq mtschq 't rbqh 'shtv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֲבִימֶ֜לֶךְ לְיִצְחָ֗ק וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַ֣ךְ הִנֵּ֤ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֙ הִ֔וא וְאֵ֥יךְ אָמַ֖רְתָּ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֑וא וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ יִצְחָ֔ק כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן־אָמ֖וּת עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bymlkh lytschq vy'mr 'kh hnh 'shtkh hv' v'ykh 'mrt 'chty hv' vy'mr 'lyv ytschq khy 'mrty pn'mvt 'lyh
verses.translation: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said: ‘Behold, of a surety she is thy wife; and how saidst thou: She is my sister?’ And Isaac said unto him: ‘Because I said: Lest I die because of her.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ מַה־זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֑נוּ כִּ֠מְעַ֠ט שָׁכַ֞ב אַחַ֤ד הָעָם֙ אֶת־אִשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ עָלֵ֖ינוּ אָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh mhz't 'shyt lnv khm't shkhb 'chd h'm 't'shtkh vhb't 'lynv 'shm
verses.translation: And Abimelech said: ‘What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might easily have lain with thy wife, and thou wouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו אֲבִימֶ֔לֶךְ אֶת־כׇּל־הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הַנֹּגֵ֜עַ בָּאִ֥ישׁ הַזֶּ֛ה וּבְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: vytsv 'bymlkh 'tkhlh'm l'mr hng' b'ysh hzh vb'shtv mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And Abimelech charged all the people, saying: ‘He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְרַ֤ע יִצְחָק֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיִּמְצָ֛א בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַהִ֖וא מֵאָ֣ה שְׁעָרִ֑ים וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyzr' ytschq b'rts hhv' vymts' bshnh hhv' m'h sh'rym vybrkhhv yhvh
verses.translation: And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundred-fold; and the LORD blessed him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ הָלוֹךְ֙ וְגָדֵ֔ל עַ֥ד כִּֽי־גָדַ֖ל מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vygdl h'ysh vylkh hlvkh vgdl 'd khygdl m'd
verses.translation: And the man waxed great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ל֤וֹ מִקְנֵה־צֹאן֙ וּמִקְנֵ֣ה בָקָ֔ר וַעֲבֻדָּ֖ה רַבָּ֑ה וַיְקַנְא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyhylv mqnhts'n vmqnh bqr v'bdh rbh vyqn'v 'tv plshtym
verses.translation: And he had possessions of flocks, and possessions of herds, and a great household; and the Philistines envied him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הַבְּאֵרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ עַבְדֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו בִּימֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑יו סִתְּמ֣וּם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיְמַלְא֖וּם עָפָֽר׃
verses.translit: vkhlhb'rt 'shr chprv 'bdy 'byv bymy 'brhm 'byv stmvm plshtym vyml'vm 'pr
verses.translation: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲבִימֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל־יִצְחָ֑ק לֵ֚ךְ מֵֽעִמָּ֔נוּ כִּֽי־עָצַ֥מְתָּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bymlkh 'lytschq lkh m'mnv khy'tsmt mmnv m'd
verses.translation: And Abimelech said unto Isaac: ‘Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם יִצְחָ֑ק וַיִּ֥חַן בְּנַֽחַל־גְּרָ֖ר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vylkh mshm ytschq vychn bnchlgrr vyshb shm
verses.translation: And Isaac departed thence, and encamped in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שׇׁב יִצְחָ֜ק וַיַּחְפֹּ֣ר  אֶת־בְּאֵרֹ֣ת הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָֽפְרוּ֙ בִּימֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔יו וַיְסַתְּמ֣וּם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֣וֹת אַבְרָהָ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֤א לָהֶן֙ שֵׁמ֔וֹת כַּשֵּׁמֹ֕ת אֲשֶׁר־קָרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ן אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshb ytschq vychpr  'tb'rt hmym 'shr chprv bymy 'brhm 'byv vystmvm plshtym 'chry mvt 'brhm vyqr' lhn shmvt khshmt 'shrqr' lhn 'byv
verses.translation: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham; and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחְפְּר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי־יִצְחָ֖ק בַּנָּ֑חַל וַיִּ֨מְצְאוּ־שָׁ֔ם בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vychprv 'bdyytschq bnchl vymts'vshm b'r mym chyym
verses.translation: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of living water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּרִ֜יבוּ רֹעֵ֣י גְרָ֗ר עִם־רֹעֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק לֵאמֹ֖ר לָ֣נוּ הַמָּ֑יִם וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵֽׁם־הַבְּאֵר֙ עֵ֔שֶׂק כִּ֥י הִֽתְעַשְּׂק֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyrybv r'y grr 'mr'y ytschq l'mr lnv hmym vyqr' shmhb'r 'shq khy ht'shqv 'mv
verses.translation: And the herdmen of Gerar strove with Isaac’s herdmen, saying: ‘The water is ours.’ And he called the name of the well Esek; because they contended with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּחְפְּרוּ֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וַיָּרִ֖יבוּ גַּם־עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ שִׂטְנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vychprv b'r 'chrt vyrybv gm'lyh vyqr' shmh shtnh
verses.translation: And they digged another well, and they strove for that also. And he called the name of it Sitnah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעְתֵּ֣ק מִשָּׁ֗ם וַיַּחְפֹּר֙ בְּאֵ֣ר אַחֶ֔רֶת וְלֹ֥א רָב֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמָהּ֙ רְחֹב֔וֹת וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־עַתָּ֞ה הִרְחִ֧יב יְהֹוָ֛ה לָ֖נוּ וּפָרִ֥ינוּ בָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'tq mshm vychpr b'r 'chrt vl' rbv 'lyh vyqr' shmh rchbvt vy'mr khy'th hrchyb yhvh lnv vprynv b'rts
verses.translation: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not. And he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said: ‘For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshm b'r shb'
verses.translation: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהֹוָה֙ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֔וּא וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֕י אֱלֹהֵ֖י אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֑יךָ אַל־תִּירָא֙ כִּֽי־אִתְּךָ֣ אָנֹ֔כִי וּבֵֽרַכְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֔ בַּעֲב֖וּר אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyv yhvh blylh hhv' vy'mr 'nkhy 'lhy 'brhm 'bykh 'ltyr' khy'tkh 'nkhy vbrkhtykh vhrbyty 'tzr'kh b'bvr 'brhm 'bdy
verses.translation: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said: ‘I am the God of Abraham thy father. Fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for My servant Abraham’s sake.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיֶּט־שָׁ֖ם אׇהֳל֑וֹ וַיִּכְרוּ־שָׁ֥ם עַבְדֵי־יִצְחָ֖ק בְּאֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vybn shm mzbch vyqr' bshm yhvh vytshm 'hlv vykhrvshm 'bdyytschq b'r
verses.translation: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there; and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲבִימֶ֕לֶךְ הָלַ֥ךְ אֵלָ֖יו מִגְּרָ֑ר וַאֲחֻזַּת֙ מֵֽרֵעֵ֔הוּ וּפִיכֹ֖ל שַׂר־צְבָאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'bymlkh hlkh 'lyv mgrr v'chzt mr'hv vpykhl shrtsb'v
verses.translation: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his host.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ יִצְחָ֔ק מַדּ֖וּעַ בָּאתֶ֣ם אֵלָ֑י וְאַתֶּם֙ שְׂנֵאתֶ֣ם אֹתִ֔י וַתְּשַׁלְּח֖וּנִי מֵאִתְּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm ytschq mdv' b'tm 'ly v'tm shn'tm 'ty vtshlchvny m'tkhm
verses.translation: And Isaac said unto them: ‘Wherefore are ye come unto me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ רָא֣וֹ רָאִ֘ינוּ֮ כִּֽי־הָיָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה ׀ עִמָּךְ֒ וַנֹּ֗אמֶר תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א אָלָ֛ה בֵּינוֹתֵ֖ינוּ בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְנִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv r'v r'ynv khyhyh yhvh  'mkh vn'mr thy n' 'lh bynvtynv bynynv vbynkh vnkhrth bryt 'mkh
verses.translation: And they said: ‘We saw plainly that the LORD was with thee; and we said: Let there now be an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תַּעֲשֵׂ֨ה עִמָּ֜נוּ רָעָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א נְגַֽעֲנ֔וּךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשִׂ֤ינוּ עִמְּךָ֙ רַק־ט֔וֹב וַנְּשַׁלֵּֽחֲךָ֖ בְּשָׁל֑וֹם אַתָּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה בְּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mt'shh 'mnv r'h kh'shr l' ng'nvkh vkh'shr 'shynv 'mkh rqtvb vnshlchkh bshlvm 'th 'th brvkh yhvh
verses.translation: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace; thou art now the blessed of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'sh lhm mshth vy'khlv vyshtv
verses.translation: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
