verses.translit: vl' ntshtny lnshq lbny vlbnty 'th hskhlt 'shv
verses.translation: and didst not suffer me to kiss my sons and my daughters? now hast thou done foolishly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶשׁ־לְאֵ֣ל יָדִ֔י לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּכֶ֖ם רָ֑ע וֵֽאלֹהֵ֨י אֲבִיכֶ֜ם אֶ֣מֶשׁ  אָמַ֧ר אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֗ר הִשָּׁ֧מֶר לְךָ֛ מִדַּבֵּ֥ר עִֽם־יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִטּ֥וֹב עַד־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: yshl'l ydy l'shvt 'mkhm r' v'lhy 'bykhm 'msh  'mr 'ly l'mr hshmr lkh mdbr 'my'qb mtvb 'dr'
verses.translation: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt; but the God of your father spoke unto me yesternight, saying: Take heed to thyself that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הָלֹ֣ךְ הָלַ֔כְתָּ כִּֽי־נִכְסֹ֥ף נִכְסַ֖פְתָּה לְבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ לָ֥מָּה גָנַ֖בְתָּ אֶת־אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th hlkh hlkht khynkhsf nkhspth lbyt 'bykh lmh gnbt 't'lhy
verses.translation: And now that thou art surely gone, because thou sore longest after thy father’s house, wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְלָבָ֑ן כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔אתִי כִּ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי פֶּן־תִּגְזֹ֥ל אֶת־בְּנוֹתֶ֖יךָ מֵעִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'n y'qb vy'mr llbn khy yr'ty khy 'mrty pntgzl 'tbnvtykh m'my
verses.translation: And Jacob answered and said to Laban: ‘Because I was afraid; for I said: Lest thou shouldest take thy daughters from me by force.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִ֠ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֣א אֶת־אֱלֹהֶ֘יךָ֮ לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶה֒ נֶ֣גֶד אַחֵ֧ינוּ הַֽכֶּר־לְךָ֛ מָ֥ה עִמָּדִ֖י וְקַֽח־לָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־יָדַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י רָחֵ֖ל גְּנָבָֽתַם׃
verses.translit: 'm 'shr tmts' 't'lhykh l' ychyh ngd 'chynv hkhrlkh mh 'mdy vqchlkh vl'yd' y'qb khy rchl gnbtm
verses.translation: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, he shall not live; before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee.’—For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א לָבָ֜ן בְּאֹ֥הֶל יַעֲקֹ֣ב  וּבְאֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֗ה וּבְאֹ֛הֶל שְׁתֵּ֥י הָאֲמָהֹ֖ת וְלֹ֣א מָצָ֑א וַיֵּצֵא֙ מֵאֹ֣הֶל לֵאָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א בְּאֹ֥הֶל רָחֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyb' lbn b'hl y'qb  vb'hl l'h vb'hl shty h'mht vl' mts' vyts' m'hl l'h vyb' b'hl rchl
verses.translation: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two maid-servants; but he found them not. And he went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחֵ֞ל לָקְחָ֣ה אֶת־הַתְּרָפִ֗ים וַתְּשִׂמֵ֛ם בְּכַ֥ר הַגָּמָ֖ל וַתֵּ֣שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיְמַשֵּׁ֥שׁ לָבָ֛ן אֶת־כׇּל־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְלֹ֥א מָצָֽא׃
verses.translit: vrchl lqchh 'thtrpym vtshmm bkhr hgml vtshb 'lyhm vymshsh lbn 'tkhlh'hl vl' mts'
verses.translation: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, and put them in the saddle of the camel, and sat upon them. And Laban felt about all the tent, but found them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־אָבִ֗יהָ אַל־יִ֙חַר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔י כִּ֣י ל֤וֹא אוּכַל֙ לָק֣וּם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ כִּי־דֶ֥רֶךְ נָשִׁ֖ים לִ֑י וַיְחַפֵּ֕שׂ וְלֹ֥א מָצָ֖א אֶת־הַתְּרָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l'byh 'lychr b'yny 'dny khy lv' 'vkhl lqvm mpnykh khydrkh nshym ly vychpsh vl' mts' 'thtrpym
verses.translation: And she said to her father: ‘Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me.’ And he searched, but found not the teraphim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֥חַר לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיָּ֣רֶב בְּלָבָ֑ן וַיַּ֤עַן יַעֲקֹב֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְלָבָ֔ן מַה־פִּשְׁעִי֙ מַ֣ה חַטָּאתִ֔י כִּ֥י דָלַ֖קְתָּ אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.translit: vychr ly'qb vyrb blbn vy'n y'qb vy'mr llbn mhpsh'y mh cht'ty khy dlqt 'chry
verses.translation: And Jacob was wroth, and strove with Laban. And Jacob answered and said to Laban: ‘What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast hotly pursued after me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־מִשַּׁ֣שְׁתָּ אֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלַ֗י מַה־מָּצָ֙אתָ֙ מִכֹּ֣ל כְּלֵי־בֵיתֶ֔ךָ שִׂ֣ים כֹּ֔ה נֶ֥גֶד אַחַ֖י וְאַחֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹכִ֖יחוּ בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: khymshsht 'tkhlkhly mhmts't mkhl khlybytkh shym khh ngd 'chy v'chykh vyvkhychv byn shnynv
verses.translation: Whereas thou hast felt about all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? Set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us two.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶה֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ רְחֵלֶ֥יךָ וְעִזֶּ֖יךָ לֹ֣א שִׁכֵּ֑לוּ וְאֵילֵ֥י צֹאנְךָ֖ לֹ֥א אָכָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.translit: zh 'shrym shnh 'nkhy 'mkh rchlykh v'zykh l' shkhlv v'yly ts'nkh l' 'khlty
verses.translation: These twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she-goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flocks have I not eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טְרֵפָה֙ לֹא־הֵבֵ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ אָנֹכִ֣י אֲחַטֶּ֔נָּה מִיָּדִ֖י תְּבַקְשֶׁ֑נָּה גְּנֻֽבְתִ֣י י֔וֹם וּגְנֻֽבְתִ֖י לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: trph l'hb'ty 'lykh 'nkhy 'chtnh mydy tbqshnh gnbty yvm vgnbty lylh
verses.translation: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bore the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיִ֧יתִי בַיּ֛וֹם אֲכָלַ֥נִי חֹ֖רֶב וְקֶ֣רַח בַּלָּ֑יְלָה וַתִּדַּ֥ד שְׁנָתִ֖י מֵֽעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: hyyty byvm 'khlny chrb vqrch blylh vtdd shnty m'yny
verses.translation: Thus I was: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶה־לִּ֞י עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָה֮ בְּבֵיתֶ֒ךָ֒ עֲבַדְתִּ֜יךָ אַרְבַּֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י בְנֹתֶ֔יךָ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים בְּצֹאנֶ֑ךָ וַתַּחֲלֵ֥ף אֶת־מַשְׂכֻּרְתִּ֖י עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת מֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: zhly 'shrym shnh bbytkh 'bdtykh 'rb''shrh shnh bshty bntykh vshsh shnym bts'nkh vtchlf 'tmshkhrty 'shrt mnym
verses.translation: These twenty years have I been in thy house: I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy flock; and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּלֵ֡י אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִי֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וּפַ֤חַד יִצְחָק֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רֵיקָ֣ם שִׁלַּחְתָּ֑נִי אֶת־עׇנְיִ֞י וְאֶת־יְגִ֧יעַ כַּפַּ֛י רָאָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיּ֥וֹכַח אָֽמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: lvly 'lhy 'by 'lhy 'brhm vpchd ytschq hyh ly khy 'th ryqm shlchtny 't'nyy v'tygy' khpy r'h 'lhym vyvkhch 'msh
verses.translation: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the Fear of Isaac, had been on my side, surely now hadst thou sent me away empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and gave judgment yesternight.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן לָבָ֜ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַבָּנ֨וֹת בְּנֹתַ֜י וְהַבָּנִ֤ים בָּנַי֙ וְהַצֹּ֣אן צֹאנִ֔י וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לִי־ה֑וּא וְלִבְנֹתַ֞י מָֽה־אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה לָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם א֥וֹ לִבְנֵיהֶ֖ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'n lbn vy'mr 'ly'qb hbnvt bnty vhbnym bny vhts'n ts'ny vkhl 'shr'th r'h lyhv' vlbnty mh''shh l'lh hyvm 'v lbnyhn 'shr yldv
verses.translation: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob: ‘The daughters are my daughters, and the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks, and all that thou seest is mine; and what can I do this day for these my daughters, or for their children whom they have borne?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֛ה נִכְרְתָ֥ה בְרִ֖ית אֲנִ֣י וָאָ֑תָּה וְהָיָ֥ה לְעֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'th lkhh nkhrth bryt 'ny v'th vhyh l'd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: And now come, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אָ֑בֶן וַיְרִימֶ֖הָ מַצֵּבָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqch y'qb 'bn vyrymh mtsbh
verses.translation: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֤ב לְאֶחָיו֙ לִקְט֣וּ אֲבָנִ֔ים וַיִּקְח֥וּ אֲבָנִ֖ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ־גָ֑ל וַיֹּ֥אכְלוּ שָׁ֖ם עַל־הַגָּֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb l'chyv lqtv 'bnym vyqchv 'bnym vy'shvgl vy'khlv shm 'lhgl
verses.translation: And Jacob said unto his brethren: ‘Gather stones’; and they took stones, and made a heap. And they did eat there by the heap.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָא־ל֣וֹ לָבָ֔ן יְגַ֖ר שָׂהֲדוּתָ֑א וְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב קָ֥רָא ל֖וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vyqr'lv lbn ygr shhdvt' vy'qb qr' lv gl'd
verses.translation: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha; but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָבָ֔ן הַגַּ֨ל הַזֶּ֥ה עֵ֛ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינְךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמ֖וֹ גַּלְעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn hgl hzh 'd byny vbynkh hyvm 'lkhn qr'shmv gl'd
verses.translation: And Laban said: ‘This heap is witness between me and thee this day.’ Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַמִּצְפָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר יִ֥צֶף יְהֹוָ֖ה בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ כִּ֥י נִסָּתֵ֖ר אִ֥ישׁ מֵרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vhmtsph 'shr 'mr ytsf yhvh byny vbynkh khy nstr 'ysh mr'hv
verses.translation: and Mizpah, for he said: ‘The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תְּעַנֶּ֣ה אֶת־בְּנֹתַ֗י וְאִם־תִּקַּ֤ח נָשִׁים֙ עַל־בְּנֹתַ֔י אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ עִמָּ֑נוּ רְאֵ֕ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים עֵ֖ד בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mt'nh 'tbnty v'mtqch nshym 'lbnty 'yn 'ysh 'mnv r'h 'lhym 'd byny vbynkh
verses.translation: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, and if thou shalt take wives beside my daughters, no man being with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לָבָ֖ן לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב הִנֵּ֣ה  הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֗ה וְהִנֵּה֙ הַמַּצֵּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרִ֖יתִי בֵּינִ֥י וּבֵינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lbn ly'qb hnh  hgl hzh vhnh hmtsbh 'shr yryty byny vbynkh
verses.translation: And Laban said to Jacob: ‘Behold this heap, and behold the pillar, which I have set up betwixt me and thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵ֚ד הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְעֵדָ֖ה הַמַּצֵּבָ֑ה אִם־אָ֗נִי לֹֽא־אֶעֱבֹ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־הַגַּ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְאִם־אַ֠תָּ֠ה לֹא־תַעֲבֹ֨ר אֵלַ֜י אֶת־הַגַּ֥ל הַזֶּ֛ה וְאֶת־הַמַּצֵּבָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'd hgl hzh v'dh hmtsbh 'm'ny l'''br 'lykh 'thgl hzh v'm'th l't'br 'ly 'thgl hzh v'thmtsbh hz't lr'h
verses.translation: This heap be witness, and the pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֤י נָחוֹר֙ יִשְׁפְּט֣וּ בֵינֵ֔ינוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּפַ֖חַד אָבִ֥יו יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: 'lhy 'brhm v'lhy nchvr yshptv bynynv 'lhy 'byhm vyshb' y'qb bpchd 'byv ytschq
verses.translation: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us.’ And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּזְבַּ֨ח יַעֲקֹ֥ב זֶ֙בַח֙ בָּהָ֔ר וַיִּקְרָ֥א לְאֶחָ֖יו לֶאֱכׇל־לָ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֣אכְלוּ לֶ֔חֶם וַיָּלִ֖ינוּ בָּהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyzbch y'qb zbch bhr vyqr' l'chyv l'khllchm vy'khlv lchm vylynv bhr
verses.translation: And Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread; and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם לָבָ֜ן בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְנַשֵּׁ֧ק לְבָנָ֛יו וְלִבְנוֹתָ֖יו וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶתְהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ וַיָּ֥שׇׁב לָבָ֖ן לִמְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshkhm lbn bbqr vynshq lbnyv vlbnvtyv vybrkh 'thm vylkh vyshb lbn lmqmv
verses.translation: And Laban arose early in the morning, kissed his sons and daughters, and blessed them; and then Laban went and returned to his place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב הָלַ֣ךְ לְדַרְכּ֑וֹ וַיִּפְגְּעוּ־ב֖וֹ מַלְאֲכֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'qb hlkh ldrkhv vypg'vbv ml'khy 'lhym
verses.translation: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאָ֔ם מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים זֶ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מַֽחֲנָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb kh'shr r'm mchnh 'lhym zh vyqr' shmhmqvm hhv' mchnym {p}
verses.translation: And Jacob said when he saw them: ‘This is God’s camp.’ And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יַעֲקֹ֤ב מַלְאָכִים֙ לְפָנָ֔יו אֶל־עֵשָׂ֖ו אָחִ֑יו אַ֥רְצָה שֵׂעִ֖יר שְׂדֵ֥ה אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshlch y'qb ml'khym lpnyv 'l'shv 'chyv 'rtsh sh'yr shdh 'dvm
verses.translation: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו אֹתָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֔וּן לַֽאדֹנִ֖י לְעֵשָׂ֑ו כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ עַבְדְּךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב עִם־לָבָ֣ן גַּ֔רְתִּי וָאֵחַ֖ר עַד־עָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vytsv 'tm l'mr khh t'mrvn l'dny l'shv khh 'mr 'bdkh y'qb 'mlbn grty v'chr 'd'th
verses.translation: And he commanded them, saying: ‘Thus shall ye say unto my lord Esau: Thus saith thy servant Jacob: I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed until now.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־לִי֙ שׁ֣וֹר וַחֲמ֔וֹר צֹ֖אן וְעֶ֣בֶד וְשִׁפְחָ֑ה וָֽאֶשְׁלְחָה֙ לְהַגִּ֣יד לַֽאדֹנִ֔י לִמְצֹא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vyhyly shvr vchmvr ts'n v'bd vshpchh v'shlchh lhgyd l'dny lmts'chn b'ynykh
verses.translation: And I have oxen, and asses and flocks, and men-servants and maid-servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favour in thy sight.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּ֤אנוּ אֶל־אָחִ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־עֵשָׂ֔ו וְגַם֙ הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִקְרָֽאתְךָ֔ וְאַרְבַּע־מֵא֥וֹת אִ֖ישׁ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshbv hml'khym 'ly'qb l'mr b'nv 'l'chykh 'l'shv vgm hlkh lqr'tkh v'rb'm'vt 'ysh 'mv
verses.translation: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying: ‘We came to thy brother Esau, and moreover he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּירָ֧א יַעֲקֹ֛ב מְאֹ֖ד וַיֵּ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ וַיַּ֜חַץ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־הַצֹּ֧אן וְאֶת־הַבָּקָ֛ר וְהַגְּמַלִּ֖ים לִשְׁנֵ֥י מַחֲנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyyr' y'qb m'd vytsr lv vychts 'th'm 'shr'tv v'thts'n v'thbqr vhgmlym lshny mchnvt
verses.translation: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. And he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two camps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אִם־יָב֥וֹא עֵשָׂ֛ו אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הָאַחַ֖ת וְהִכָּ֑הוּ וְהָיָ֛ה הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַנִּשְׁאָ֖ר לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mybv' 'shv 'lhmchnh h'cht vhkhhv vhyh hmchnh hnsh'r lplyth
verses.translation: And he said: ‘If Esau come to the one camp, and smite it, then the camp which is left shall escape.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ יַעֲקֹב֒ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אָבִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם וֵאלֹהֵ֖י אָבִ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק יְהֹוָ֞ה הָאֹמֵ֣ר אֵלַ֗י שׁ֧וּב לְאַרְצְךָ֛ וּלְמוֹלַדְתְּךָ֖ וְאֵיטִ֥יבָה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'lhy 'by 'brhm v'lhy 'by ytschq yhvh h'mr 'ly shvb l'rtskh vlmvldtkh v'ytybh 'mkh
verses.translation: And Jacob said: ‘O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, O LORD, who saidst unto me: Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will do thee good;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָטֹ֜נְתִּי מִכֹּ֤ל הַחֲסָדִים֙ וּמִכׇּל־הָ֣אֱמֶ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֣י בְמַקְלִ֗י עָבַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן הַזֶּ֔ה וְעַתָּ֥ה הָיִ֖יתִי לִשְׁנֵ֥י מַחֲנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: qtnty mkhl hchsdym vmkhlh'mt 'shr 'shyt 't'bdkh khy bmqly 'brty 'thyrdn hzh v'th hyyty lshny mchnvt
verses.translation: I am not worthy of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shown unto Thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two camps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּילֵ֥נִי נָ֛א מִיַּ֥ד אָחִ֖י מִיַּ֣ד עֵשָׂ֑ו כִּֽי־יָרֵ֤א אָנֹכִי֙ אֹת֔וֹ פֶּן־יָב֣וֹא וְהִכַּ֔נִי אֵ֖ם עַל־בָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: htsylny n' myd 'chy myd 'shv khyyr' 'nkhy 'tv pnybv' vhkhny 'm 'lbnym
verses.translation: Deliver me, I pray Thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and smite me, the mother with the children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ הֵיטֵ֥ב אֵיטִ֖יב עִמָּ֑ךְ וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶֽת־זַרְעֲךָ֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵרֹֽב׃
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt hytb 'ytyb 'mkh vshmty 'tzr'kh khchvl hym 'shr l'yspr mrb
verses.translation: And Thou saidst: I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥לֶן שָׁ֖ם בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַה֑וּא וַיִּקַּ֞ח מִן־הַבָּ֧א בְיָד֛וֹ מִנְחָ֖ה לְעֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyln shm blylh hhv' vyqch mnhb' bydv mnchh l'shv 'chyv
verses.translation: And he lodged there that night; and took of that which he had with him a present for Esau his brother:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִזִּ֣ים מָאתַ֔יִם וּתְיָשִׁ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֑ים רְחֵלִ֥ים מָאתַ֖יִם וְאֵילִ֥ים עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'zym m'tym vtyshym 'shrym rchlym m'tym v'ylym 'shrym
verses.translation: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גְּמַלִּ֧ים מֵינִיק֛וֹת וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים פָּר֤וֹת אַרְבָּעִים֙ וּפָרִ֣ים עֲשָׂרָ֔ה אֲתֹנֹ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וַעְיָרִ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: gmlym mynyqvt vbnyhm shlshym prvt 'rb'ym vprym 'shrh 'tnt 'shrym v'yrm 'shrh
verses.translation: thirty milch camels and their colts, forty kine and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten foals.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֙ בְּיַד־עֲבָדָ֔יו עֵ֥דֶר עֵ֖דֶר לְבַדּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו֙ עִבְר֣וּ לְפָנַ֔י וְרֶ֣וַח תָּשִׂ֔ימוּ בֵּ֥ין עֵ֖דֶר וּבֵ֥ין עֵֽדֶר׃
verses.translit: vytn byd'bdyv 'dr 'dr lbdv vy'mr 'l'bdyv 'brv lpny vrvch tshymv byn 'dr vbyn 'dr
verses.translation: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by itself; and said unto his servants: ‘Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֥ו אֶת־הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּ֣י יִֽפְגׇשְׁךָ֞ עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֗י וּשְׁאֵֽלְךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְמִי־אַ֙תָּה֙ וְאָ֣נָה תֵלֵ֔ךְ וּלְמִ֖י אֵ֥לֶּה לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vytsv 'thr'shvn l'mr khy ypgshkh 'shv 'chy vsh'lkh l'mr lmy'th v'nh tlkh vlmy 'lh lpnykh
verses.translation: And he commanded the foremost, saying: ‘When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying: Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב מִנְחָ֥ה הִוא֙ שְׁלוּחָ֔ה לַֽאדֹנִ֖י לְעֵשָׂ֑ו וְהִנֵּ֥ה גַם־ה֖וּא אַחֲרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrt l'bdkh ly'qb mnchh hv' shlvchh l'dny l'shv vhnh gmhv' 'chrynv
verses.translation: then thou shalt say: They are thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord, even unto Esau; and, behold, he also is behind us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְצַ֞ו גַּ֣ם אֶת־הַשֵּׁנִ֗י גַּ֚ם אֶת־הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י גַּ֚ם אֶת־כׇּל־הַהֹ֣לְכִ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י הָעֲדָרִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ תְּדַבְּר֣וּן אֶל־עֵשָׂ֔ו בְּמֹצַאֲכֶ֖ם אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vytsv gm 'thshny gm 'thshlyshy gm 'tkhlhhlkhym 'chry h'drym l'mr khdbr hzh tdbrvn 'l'shv bmts'khm 'tv
verses.translation: And he commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying: ‘In this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם גַּ֗ם הִנֵּ֛ה עַבְדְּךָ֥ יַעֲקֹ֖ב אַחֲרֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־אָמַ֞ר אֲכַפְּרָ֣ה פָנָ֗יו בַּמִּנְחָה֙ הַהֹלֶ֣כֶת לְפָנָ֔י וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן֙ אֶרְאֶ֣ה פָנָ֔יו אוּלַ֖י יִשָּׂ֥א פָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm gm hnh 'bdkh y'qb 'chrynv khy'mr 'khprh pnyv bmnchh hhlkht lpny v'chrykhn 'r'h pnyv 'vly ysh' pny
verses.translation: and ye shall say: Moreover, behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us.’ For he said: ‘I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּעֲבֹ֥ר הַמִּנְחָ֖ה עַל־פָּנָ֑יו וְה֛וּא לָ֥ן בַּלַּֽיְלָה־הַה֖וּא בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'br hmnchh 'lpnyv vhv' ln blylhhhv' bmchnh
verses.translation: So the present passed over before him; and he himself lodged that night in the camp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם  בַּלַּ֣יְלָה ה֗וּא וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֤י נָשָׁיו֙ וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י שִׁפְחֹתָ֔יו וְאֶת־אַחַ֥ד עָשָׂ֖ר יְלָדָ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔ר אֵ֖ת מַעֲבַ֥ר יַבֹּֽק׃
verses.translit: vyqm  blylh hv' vyqch 'tshty nshyv v'tshty shpchtyv v't'chd 'shr yldyv vy'br 't m'br ybq
verses.translation: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two handmaids, and his eleven children, and passed over the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֨קָּחֵ֔ם וַיַּֽעֲבִרֵ֖ם אֶת־הַנָּ֑חַל וַֽיַּעֲבֵ֖ר אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqchm vy'brm 'thnchl vy'br 't'shrlv
verses.translation: And he took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּוָּתֵ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב לְבַדּ֑וֹ וַיֵּאָבֵ֥ק אִישׁ֙ עִמּ֔וֹ עַ֖ד עֲל֥וֹת הַשָּֽׁחַר׃
verses.translit: vyvtr y'qb lbdv vy'bq 'ysh 'mv 'd 'lvt hshchr
verses.translation: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָכֹל֙ ל֔וֹ וַיִּגַּ֖ע בְּכַף־יְרֵכ֑וֹ וַתֵּ֙קַע֙ כַּף־יֶ֣רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּהֵאָֽבְק֖וֹ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' khy l' ykhl lv vyg' bkhfyrkhv vtq' khfyrkh y'qb bh'bqv 'mv
verses.translation: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained, as he wrestled with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שַׁלְּחֵ֔נִי כִּ֥י עָלָ֖ה הַשָּׁ֑חַר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֲשַֽׁלֵּחֲךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם־בֵּרַכְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shlchny khy 'lh hshchr vy'mr l' 'shlchkh khy 'mbrkhtny
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Let me go, for the day breaketh.’ And he said: ‘I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו מַה־שְּׁמֶ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv mhshmkh vy'mr y'qb
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘What is thy name?’ And he said: ‘Jacob.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שִׁמְךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־שָׂרִ֧יתָ עִם־אֱלֹהִ֛ים וְעִם־אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַתּוּכָֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr l' y'qb y'mr 'vd shmkh khy 'myshr'l khyshryt 'm'lhym v'm'nshym vtvkhl
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel; for thou hast striven with God and with men, and hast prevailed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַגִּֽידָה־נָּ֣א שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִשְׁמִ֑י וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֹת֖וֹ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vysh'l y'qb vy'mr hgydhn' shmkh vy'mr lmh zh tsh'l lshmy vybrkh 'tv shm
verses.translation: And Jacob asked him, and said: ‘Tell me, I pray thee, thy name.’ And he said: ‘Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name?’ And he blessed him there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יַעֲקֹ֛ב שֵׁ֥ם הַמָּק֖וֹם פְּנִיאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־רָאִ֤יתִי אֱלֹהִים֙ פָּנִ֣ים אֶל־פָּנִ֔ים וַתִּנָּצֵ֖ל נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb shm hmqvm pny'l khyr'yty 'lhym pnym 'lpnym vtntsl npshy
verses.translation: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: ‘for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽזְרַֽח־ל֣וֹ הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖ר אֶת־פְּנוּאֵ֑ל וְה֥וּא צֹלֵ֖עַ עַל־יְרֵכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyzrchlv hshmsh kh'shr 'br 'tpnv'l vhv' tsl' 'lyrkhv
verses.translation: And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped upon his thigh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֡ן לֹֽא־יֹאכְל֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־גִּ֣יד הַנָּשֶׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־כַּ֣ף הַיָּרֵ֔ךְ עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֤י נָגַע֙ בְּכַף־יֶ֣רֶךְ יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּגִ֖יד הַנָּשֶֽׁה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn l'y'khlv bnyyshr'l 'tgyd hnshh 'shr 'lkhf hyrkh 'd hyvm hzh khy ng' bkhfyrkh y'qb bgyd hnshh
verses.translation: Therefore the children of Israel eat not the sinew of the thigh-vein which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day; because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh, even in the sinew of the thigh-vein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְעִמּ֕וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּ֣חַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִ֗ים עַל־לֵאָה֙ וְעַל־רָחֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַשְּׁפָחֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vysh' y'qb 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'shv b' v'mv 'rb' m'vt 'ysh vychts 'thyldym 'll'h v'lrchl v'l shty hshpchvt
verses.translation: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת וְאֶת־יַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְאֶת־לֵאָ֤ה וִֽילָדֶ֙יהָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְאֶת־רָחֵ֥ל וְאֶת־יוֹסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshm 'thshpchvt v'tyldyhn r'shnh v'tl'h vyldyh 'chrnym v'trchl v'tyvsf 'chrnym
verses.translation: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד־גִּשְׁתּ֖וֹ עַד־אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhv' 'br lpnyhm vyshtchv 'rtsh shb' p'mym 'dgshtv 'd'chyv
verses.translation: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨רׇץ עֵשָׂ֤ו לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵ֔הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־צַוָּארָ֖ו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵ֑ׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyrts 'shv lqr'tv vychbqhv vypl 'ltsv'rv vyshqhv vybkhv
verses.translation: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him; and they wept.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת־עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְאֶת־הַיְלָדִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הַיְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר־חָנַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vysh' 't'ynyv vyr' 'thnshym v'thyldym vy'mr my'lh lkh vy'mr hyldym 'shrchnn 'lhym 't'bdkh
verses.translation: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said: ‘Who are these with thee?’ And he said: ‘The children whom God hath graciously given thy servant.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּגַּ֧שְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת הֵ֥נָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶֽיןָ׃
verses.translit: vtgshn hshpchvt hnh vyldyhn vtshtchvyn
verses.translation: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּגַּ֧שׁ גַּם־לֵאָ֛ה וִילָדֶ֖יהָ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְאַחַ֗ר נִגַּ֥שׁ יוֹסֵ֛ף וְרָחֵ֖ל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vtgsh gml'h vyldyh vyshtchvv v'chr ngsh yvsf vrchl vyshtchvv
verses.translation: And Leah also and her children came near, and bowed down; and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לְךָ֛ כׇּל־הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לִמְצֹא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr my lkh khlhmchnh hzh 'shr pgshty vy'mr lmts'chn b'yny 'dny
verses.translation: And he said: ‘What meanest thou by all this camp which I met?’ And he said: ‘To find favour in the sight of my lord.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר עֵשָׂ֖ו יֶשׁ־לִ֣י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕י יְהִ֥י לְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv yshly rb 'chy yhy lkh 'shrlkh
verses.translation: And Esau said: ‘I have enough; my brother, let that which thou hast be thine.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב אַל־נָא֙ אִם־נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖י מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֣י עַל־כֵּ֞ן רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗יךָ כִּרְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַתִּרְצֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'ln' 'mn' mts'ty chn b'ynykh vlqcht mnchty mydy khy 'lkhn r'yty pnykh khr't pny 'lhym vtrtsny
verses.translation: And Jacob said: ‘Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found favour in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand; forasmuch as I have seen thy face, as one seeth the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַח־נָ֤א אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־חַנַּ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכִ֣י יֶשׁ־לִי־כֹ֑ל וַיִּפְצַר־בּ֖וֹ וַיִּקָּֽח׃
verses.translit: qchn' 'tbrkhty 'shr hb't lkh khychnny 'lhym vkhy yshlykhl vyptsrbv vyqch
verses.translation: Take, I pray thee, my gift that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.’ And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר נִסְעָ֣ה וְנֵלֵ֑כָה וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לְנֶגְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr ns'h vnlkhh v'lkhh lngdkh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֲדֹנִ֤י יֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּֽי־הַיְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים וְהַצֹּ֥אן וְהַבָּקָ֖ר עָל֣וֹת עָלָ֑י וּדְפָקוּם֙ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וָמֵ֖תוּ כׇּל־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'dny yd' khyhyldym rkhym vhts'n vhbqr 'lvt 'ly vdpqvm yvm 'chd vmtv khlhts'n
verses.translation: And he said unto him: ‘My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds giving suck are a care to me; and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲבׇר־נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖י לִפְנֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְאִטִּ֗י לְרֶ֨גֶל הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנַי֙ וּלְרֶ֣גֶל הַיְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־אָבֹ֥א אֶל־אֲדֹנִ֖י שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.translit: y'brn' 'dny lpny 'bdv v'ny 'tnhlh l'ty lrgl hml'khh 'shrlpny vlrgl hyldym 'd 'shr'b' 'l'dny sh'yrh
verses.translation: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant; and I will journey on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַצִּֽיגָה־נָּ֣א עִמְּךָ֔ מִן־הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'shv 'tsyghn' 'mkh mnh'm 'shr 'ty vy'mr lmh zh 'mts'chn b'yny 'dny
verses.translation: And Esau said: ‘Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me.’ And he said: ‘What needeth it? let me find favour in the sight of my lord.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֩שׇׁב֩ בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֛ו לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ שֵׂעִֽירָה׃
verses.translit: vyshb byvm hhv' 'shv ldrkhv sh'yrh
verses.translation: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָה וַיִּ֥בֶן ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת וּלְמִקְנֵ֙הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה סֻכֹּ֔ת עַל־כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־הַמָּק֖וֹם סֻכּֽוֹת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'qb ns' skhth vybn lv byt vlmqnhv 'shh skht 'lkhn qr' shmhmqvm skhvt {s}
verses.translation: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him a house, and made booths for his cattle. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ יַעֲקֹ֨ב שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb shlm 'yr shkhm 'shr b'rts khn'n bb'v mpdn 'rm vychn 'tpny h'yr
verses.translation: And Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram; and encamped before the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־חֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־שָׁם֙ אׇהֳל֔וֹ מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־חֲמ֖וֹר אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּמֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqn 'tchlqt hshdh 'shr nthshm 'hlv myd bnychmvr 'by shkhm bm'h qshyth
verses.translation: And he bought the parcel of ground, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of money.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּצֶּב־שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vytsbshm mzbch vyqr'lv 'l 'lhy yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֤א דִינָה֙ בַּת־לֵאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב לִרְא֖וֹת בִּבְנ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vtts' dynh btl'h 'shr yldh ly'qb lr'vt bbnvt h'rts
verses.translation: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אֹתָ֜הּ שְׁכֶ֧ם בֶּן־חֲמ֛וֹר הַֽחִוִּ֖י נְשִׂ֣יא הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אֹתָ֖הּ וַיְעַנֶּֽהָ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'th shkhm bnchmvr hchvy nshy' h'rts vyqch 'th vyshkhb 'th vy'nh
verses.translation: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and humbled her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּדְבַּ֣ק נַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּדִינָ֖ה בַּֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיֶּֽאֱהַב֙ אֶת־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר עַל־לֵ֥ב הַֽנַּעֲרָֽ׃
verses.translit: vtdbq npshv bdynh bty'qb vy'hb 'thn'r vydbr 'llb hn'r
verses.translation: And his soul did cleave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spoke comfortingly unto the damsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁכֶ֔ם אֶל־חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר קַֽח־לִ֛י אֶת־הַיַּלְדָּ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shkhm 'lchmvr 'byv l'mr qchly 'thyldh hz't l'shh
verses.translation: And Shechem spoke unto his father Hamor, saying: ‘Get me this damsel to wife.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַעֲקֹ֣ב שָׁמַ֗ע כִּ֤י טִמֵּא֙ אֶת־דִּינָ֣ה בִתּ֔וֹ וּבָנָ֛יו הָי֥וּ אֶת־מִקְנֵ֖הוּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְהֶחֱרִ֥שׁ יַעֲקֹ֖ב עַד־בֹּאָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'qb shm' khy tm' 'tdynh btv vbnyv hyv 'tmqnhv bshdh vhchrsh y'qb 'db'm
verses.translation: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field; and Jacob held his peace until they came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֛א חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־שְׁכֶ֖ם אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְדַבֵּ֖ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyts' chmvr 'byshkhm 'ly'qb ldbr 'tv
verses.translation: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to speak with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י יַעֲקֹ֜ב בָּ֤אוּ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה֙ כְּשׇׁמְעָ֔ם וַיִּֽתְעַצְּבוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַיִּ֥חַר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹ֑ד כִּֽי־נְבָלָ֞ה עָשָׂ֣ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־בַּֽת־יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְכֵ֖ן לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vbny y'qb b'v mnhshdh khshm'm vyt'tsbv h'nshym vychr lhm m'd khynblh 'shh byshr'l lshkhb 'tbty'qb vkhn l' y'shh
verses.translation: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it; and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought a vile deed in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר חֲמ֖וֹר אִתָּ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנִ֗י חָֽשְׁקָ֤ה נַפְשׁוֹ֙ בְּבִתְּכֶ֔ם תְּנ֨וּ נָ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vydbr chmvr 'tm l'mr shkhm bny chshqh npshv bbtkhm tnv n' 'th lv l'shh
verses.translation: And Hamor spoke with them, saying ‘The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter. I pray you give her unto him to wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִֽתְחַתְּנ֖וּ אֹתָ֑נוּ בְּנֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנוּ־לָ֔נוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ תִּקְח֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtchtnv 'tnv bntykhm ttnvlnv v'tbntynv tqchv lkhm
verses.translation: And make ye marriages with us; give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִתָּ֖נוּ תֵּשֵׁ֑בוּ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁבוּ֙ וּסְחָר֔וּהָ וְהֵֽאָחֲז֖וּ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'tnv tshbv vh'rts thyh lpnykhm shbv vschrvh vh'chzv bh
verses.translation: And ye shall dwell with us; and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁכֶם֙ אֶל־אָבִ֣יהָ וְאֶל־אַחֶ֔יהָ אֶמְצָא־חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֛וּ אֵלַ֖י אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr shkhm 'l'byh v'l'chyh 'mts'chn b'ynykhm v'shr t'mrv 'ly 'tn
verses.translation: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren: ‘Let me find favour in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַרְבּ֨וּ עָלַ֤י מְאֹד֙ מֹ֣הַר וּמַתָּ֔ן וְאֶ֨תְּנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תֹּאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י וּתְנוּ־לִ֥י אֶת־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: hrbv 'ly m'd mhr vmtn v'tnh kh'shr t'mrv 'ly vtnvly 'thn'r l'shh
verses.translation: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me; but give me the damsel to wife.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־שְׁכֶ֨ם וְאֶת־חֲמ֥וֹר אָבִ֛יו בְּמִרְמָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֑רוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר טִמֵּ֔א אֵ֖ת דִּינָ֥ה אֲחֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'nv bnyy'qb 'tshkhm v'tchmvr 'byv bmrmh vydbrv 'shr tm' 't dynh 'chtm
verses.translation: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with guile, and spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לֹ֤א נוּכַל֙ לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֔ה לָתֵת֙ אֶת־אֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ לְאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ עׇרְלָ֑ה כִּֽי־חֶרְפָּ֥ה הִ֖וא לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyhm l' nvkhl l'shvt hdbr hzh ltt 't'chtnv l'ysh 'shrlv 'rlh khychrph hv' lnv
verses.translation: and said unto them: ‘We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּזֹ֖את נֵא֣וֹת לָכֶ֑ם אִ֚ם תִּהְי֣וּ כָמֹ֔נוּ לְהִמֹּ֥ל לָכֶ֖ם כׇּל־זָכָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'khbz't n'vt lkhm 'm thyv khmnv lhml lkhm khlzkhr
verses.translation: Only on this condition will we consent unto you: if ye will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֤נּוּ אֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נִֽקַּֽח־לָ֑נוּ וְיָשַׁ֣בְנוּ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֖ינוּ לְעַ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vntnv 'tbntynv lkhm v'tbntykhm nqchlnv vyshbnv 'tkhm vhyynv l'm 'chd
verses.translation: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־לֹ֧א תִשְׁמְע֛וּ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ לְהִמּ֑וֹל וְלָקַ֥חְנוּ אֶת־בִּתֵּ֖נוּ וְהָלָֽכְנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ml' tshm'v 'lynv lhmvl vlqchnv 'tbtnv vhlkhnv
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽיטְב֥וּ דִבְרֵיהֶ֖ם בְּעֵינֵ֣י חֲמ֑וֹר וּבְעֵינֵ֖י שְׁכֶ֥ם בֶּן־חֲמֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyytbv dbryhm b'yny chmvr vb'yny shkhm bnchmvr
verses.translation: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־אֵחַ֤ר הַנַּ֙עַר֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַדָּבָ֔ר כִּ֥י חָפֵ֖ץ בְּבַֽת־יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְה֣וּא נִכְבָּ֔ד מִכֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vl''chr hn'r l'shvt hdbr khy chpts bbty'qb vhv' nkhbd mkhl byt 'byv
verses.translation: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter. And he was honoured above all the house of his father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א חֲמ֛וֹר וּשְׁכֶ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר עִירָ֑ם וַֽיְדַבְּר֛וּ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֥י עִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyb' chmvr vshkhm bnv 'lsh'r 'yrm vydbrv 'l'nshy 'yrm l'mr
verses.translation: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים הָאֵ֜לֶּה שְֽׁלֵמִ֧ים הֵ֣ם אִתָּ֗נוּ וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וְיִסְחֲר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ וְהָאָ֛רֶץ הִנֵּ֥ה רַֽחֲבַת־יָדַ֖יִם לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם אֶת־בְּנֹתָם֙ נִקַּֽח־לָ֣נוּ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ נִתֵּ֥ן לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: h'nshym h'lh shlmym hm 'tnv vyshbv b'rts vyschrv 'th vh'rts hnh rchbtydym lpnyhm 'tbntm nqchlnv lnshym v'tbntynv ntn lhm
verses.translation: ’These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for, behold, the land is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַךְ־בְּ֠זֹ֠את יֵאֹ֨תוּ לָ֤נוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אִתָּ֔נוּ לִהְי֖וֹת לְעַ֣ם אֶחָ֑ד בְּהִמּ֥וֹל לָ֙נוּ֙ כׇּל־זָכָ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֵ֥ם נִמֹּלִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'khbz't y'tv lnv h'nshym lshbt 'tnv lhyvt l'm 'chd bhmvl lnv khlzkhr kh'shr hm nmlym
verses.translation: Only on this condition will the men consent unto us to dwell with us, to become one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקְנֵהֶ֤ם וְקִנְיָנָם֙ וְכׇל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֔ם הֲל֥וֹא לָ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם אַ֚ךְ נֵא֣וֹתָה לָהֶ֔ם וְיֵשְׁב֖וּ אִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: mqnhm vqnynm vkhlbhmtm hlv' lnv hm 'kh n'vth lhm vyshbv 'tnv
verses.translation: Shall not their cattle and their substance and all their beasts be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ אֶל־חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶל־שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ כׇּל־יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֣עַר עִיר֑וֹ וַיִּמֹּ֙לוּ֙ כׇּל־זָכָ֔ר כׇּל־יֹצְאֵ֖י שַׁ֥עַר עִירֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'lchmvr v'lshkhm bnv khlyts'y sh'r 'yrv vymlv khlzkhr khlyts'y sh'r 'yrv
verses.translation: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיוֹתָ֣ם כֹּֽאֲבִ֗ים וַיִּקְח֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי־בְנֵי־יַ֠עֲקֹ֠ב שִׁמְע֨וֹן וְלֵוִ֜י אֲחֵ֤י דִינָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ חַרְבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ עַל־הָעִ֖יר בֶּ֑טַח וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כׇּל־זָכָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy bhyvtm kh'bym vyqchv shnybnyy'qb shm'vn vlvy 'chy dynh 'ysh chrbv vyb'v 'lh'yr btch vyhrgv khlzkhr
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city unawares, and slew all the males.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־חֲמוֹר֙ וְאֶת־שְׁכֶ֣ם בְּנ֔וֹ הָרְג֖וּ לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב וַיִּקְח֧וּ אֶת־דִּינָ֛ה מִבֵּ֥ית שְׁכֶ֖ם וַיֵּצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tchmvr v'tshkhm bnv hrgv lpychrb vyqchv 'tdynh mbyt shkhm vyts'v
verses.translation: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went forth. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּ֚אוּ עַל־הַ֣חֲלָלִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ הָעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר טִמְּא֖וּ אֲחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: bny y'qb b'v 'lhchllym vybzv h'yr 'shr tm'v 'chvtm
verses.translation: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־צֹאנָ֥ם וְאֶת־בְּקָרָ֖ם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִ֛יר וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לָקָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: 'tts'nm v'tbqrm v'tchmryhm v't 'shrb'yr v't'shr bshdh lqchv
verses.translation: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses, and that which was in the city and that which was in the field;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֵילָ֤ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־טַפָּם֙ וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם שָׁב֖וּ וַיָּבֹ֑זּוּ וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: v'tkhlchylm v'tkhltpm v'tnshyhm shbv vybzv v't khl'shr bbyt
verses.translation: and all their wealth, and all their little ones and their wives, took they captive and spoiled, even all that was in the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־שִׁמְע֣וֹן וְאֶל־לֵוִי֮ עֲכַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִי֒ לְהַבְאִישֵׁ֙נִי֙ בְּיֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּבַפְּרִזִּ֑י וַאֲנִי֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר וְנֶאֶסְפ֤וּ עָלַי֙ וְהִכּ֔וּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י אֲנִ֥י וּבֵיתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'lshm'vn v'llvy 'khrtm 'ty lhb'yshny byshb h'rts bkhn'ny vbprzy v'ny mty mspr vn'spv 'ly vhkhvny vnshmdty 'ny vbyty
verses.translation: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi: ‘Ye have troubled me, to make me odious unto the inhabitants of the land, even unto the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and, I being few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and smite me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֑וּ הַכְזוֹנָ֕ה יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־אֲחוֹתֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mrv hkhzvnh y'shh 't'chvtnv {p}
verses.translation: And they said: ‘Should one deal with our sister as with a harlot?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֔ב ק֛וּם עֲלֵ֥ה בֵֽית־אֵ֖ל וְשֶׁב־שָׁ֑ם וַעֲשֵׂה־שָׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לָאֵל֙ הַנִּרְאֶ֣ה אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּבׇ֨רְחֲךָ֔ מִפְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'ly'qb qvm 'lh byt'l vshbshm v'shhshm mzbch l'l hnr'h 'lykh bbrchkh mpny 'shv 'chykh
verses.translation: And God said unto Jacob: ‘Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there; and make there an altar unto God, who appeared unto thee when thou didst flee from the face of Esau thy brother.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־בֵּית֔וֹ וְאֶ֖ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמּ֑וֹ הָסִ֜רוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּתֹכְכֶ֔ם וְהִֽטַּהֲר֔וּ וְהַחֲלִ֖יפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr y'qb 'lbytv v'l khl'shr 'mv hsrv 't'lhy hnkhr 'shr btkhkhm vhthrv vhchlypv shmltykhm
verses.translation: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him: ‘Put away the strange gods that are among you, and purify yourselves, and change your garments;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָק֥וּמָה וְנַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה־שָּׁ֣ם מִזְבֵּ֗חַ לָאֵ֞ל הָעֹנֶ֤ה אֹתִי֙ בְּי֣וֹם צָֽרָתִ֔י וַֽיְהִי֙ עִמָּדִ֔י בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vnqvmh vn'lh byt'l v''shhshm mzbch l'l h'nh 'ty byvm tsrty vyhy 'mdy bdrkh 'shr hlkhty
verses.translation: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֗ב אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַנֵּכָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדָ֔ם וְאֶת־הַנְּזָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאׇזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּטְמֹ֤ן אֹתָם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב תַּ֥חַת הָאֵלָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם־שְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vytnv 'ly'qb 't khl'lhy hnkhr 'shr bydm v'thnzmym 'shr b'znyhm vytmn 'tm y'qb tcht h'lh 'shr 'mshkhm
verses.translation: And they gave unto Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hand, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth which was by Shechem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסָּ֑עוּ וַיְהִ֣י  חִתַּ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל־הֶֽעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א רָֽדְפ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: vys'v vyhy  chtt 'lhym 'lh'rym 'shr sbybvtyhm vl' rdpv 'chry bny y'qb
verses.translation: And they journeyed; and a terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב ל֗וּזָה אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן הִ֖וא בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל ה֖וּא וְכׇל־הָעָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb lvzh 'shr b'rts khn'n hv' byt'l hv' vkhlh'm 'shr'mv
verses.translation: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—the same is Beth-el—he and all the people that were with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ וַיִּקְרָא֙ לַמָּק֔וֹם אֵ֖ל בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם נִגְל֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בְּבׇרְח֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֥י אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vybn shm mzbch vyqr' lmqvm 'l byt'l khy shm nglv 'lyv h'lhym bbrchv mpny 'chyv
verses.translation: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el, because there God was revealed unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֤מׇת דְּבֹרָה֙ מֵינֶ֣קֶת רִבְקָ֔ה וַתִּקָּבֵ֛ר מִתַּ֥חַת לְבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הָֽאַלּ֑וֹן וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וֹן בָּכֽוּת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtmt dbrh mynqt rbqh vtqbr mtcht lbyt'l tcht h'lvn vyqr' shmv 'lvn bkhvt {p}
verses.translation: And Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak; and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹב֙ ע֔וֹד בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיְבָ֖רֶךְ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lhym 'ly'qb 'vd bb'v mpdn 'rm vybrkh 'tv
verses.translation: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים שִׁמְךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֑ב לֹֽא־יִקָּרֵא֩ שִׁמְךָ֨ ע֜וֹד יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּ֤י אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mrlv 'lhym shmkh y'qb l'yqr' shmkh 'vd y'qb khy 'myshr'l yhyh shmkh vyqr' 'tshmv yshr'l
verses.translation: And God said unto him: ‘Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name’; and He called his name Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֲנִ֨י אֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ פְּרֵ֣ה וּרְבֵ֔ה גּ֛וֹי וּקְהַ֥ל גּוֹיִ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וּמְלָכִ֖ים מֵחֲלָצֶ֥יךָ יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lhym 'ny 'l shdy prh vrbh gvy vqhl gvym yhyh mmkh vmlkhym mchltsykh yts'v
verses.translation: And God said unto him: ‘I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛תִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם וּלְיִצְחָ֖ק לְךָ֣ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה וּֽלְזַרְעֲךָ֥ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'th'rts 'shr ntty l'brhm vlytschq lkh 'tnnh vlzr'kh 'chrykh 'tn 'th'rts
verses.translation: and the land which I gave unto Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֵעָלָ֖יו אֱלֹהִ֑ים בַּמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'l m'lyv 'lhym bmqvm 'shrdbr 'tv
verses.translation: And God went up from him in the place where He spoke with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֨ב יַעֲקֹ֜ב מַצֵּבָ֗ה בַּמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ מַצֶּ֣בֶת אָ֑בֶן וַיַּסֵּ֤ךְ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ נֶ֔סֶךְ וַיִּצֹ֥ק עָלֶ֖יהָ שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: vytsb y'qb mtsbh bmqvm 'shrdbr 'tv mtsbt 'bn vyskh 'lyh nskh vytsq 'lyh shmn
verses.translation: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He spoke with him, a pillar of stone, and he poured out a drink-offering thereon, and poured oil thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר אִתּ֥וֹ שָׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb 'tshm hmqvm 'shr dbr 'tv shm 'lhym byt'l
verses.translation: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Beth-el.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית אֵ֔ל וַֽיְהִי־ע֥וֹד כִּבְרַת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָב֣וֹא אֶפְרָ֑תָה וַתֵּ֥לֶד רָחֵ֖ל וַתְּקַ֥שׁ בְּלִדְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vys'v mbyt 'l vyhy'vd khbrth'rts lbv' 'prth vtld rchl vtqsh bldth
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was still some way to come to Ephrath; and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בְהַקְשֹׁתָ֖הּ בְּלִדְתָּ֑הּ וַתֹּ֨אמֶר לָ֤הּ הַמְיַלֶּ֙דֶת֙ אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י כִּֽי־גַם־זֶ֥ה לָ֖ךְ בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhy bhqshth bldth vt'mr lh hmyldt 'ltyr'y khygmzh lkh bn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the mid-wife said unto her: ‘Fear not; for this also is a son for thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בְּצֵ֤את נַפְשָׁהּ֙ כִּ֣י מֵ֔תָה וַתִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֶּן־אוֹנִ֑י וְאָבִ֖יו קָֽרָא־ל֥וֹ בִנְיָמִֽין׃
verses.translit: vyhy bts't npshh khy mth vtqr' shmv bn'vny v'byv qr'lv bnymyn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing—for she died—that she called his name Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֖מׇת רָחֵ֑ל וַתִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֶפְרָ֔תָה הִ֖וא בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vtmt rchl vtqbr bdrkh 'prth hv' byt lchm
verses.translation: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath—the same is Beth-lehem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּצֵּ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב מַצֵּבָ֖ה עַל־קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ הִ֛וא מַצֶּ֥בֶת קְבֻֽרַת־רָחֵ֖ל עַד־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vytsb y'qb mtsbh 'lqbrth hv' mtsbt qbrtrchl 'dhyvm
verses.translation: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave; the same is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֣ט אׇֽהֳלֹ֔ה מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְמִגְדַּל־עֵֽדֶר׃
verses.translit: vys' yshr'l vyt 'hlh mhl'h lmgdl'dr
verses.translation: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond Migdal-eder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ רְאוּבֵ֗֔ן וַיִּשְׁכַּ֕ב֙ אֶת־בִּלְהָ֖ה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אָבִ֑֔יו וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑͏ֽל׃ {פ} וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshkhn yshr'l b'rts hhv' vylkh r'vbn vyshkhb 'tblhh pylgsh 'byv vyshm' yshr'͏l {p} vyhyv bnyy'qb shnym 'shr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine; and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לֵאָ֔ה בְּכ֥וֹר יַעֲקֹ֖ב רְאוּבֵ֑ן וְשִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבֻלֽוּן׃
verses.translit: bny l'h bkhvr y'qb r'vbn vshm'vn vlvy vyhvdh vyshshkhr vzblvn
verses.translation: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob’s first-born, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י רָחֵ֔ל יוֹסֵ֖ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.translit: bny rchl yvsf vbnymn
verses.translation: the sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י בִלְהָה֙ שִׁפְחַ֣ת רָחֵ֔ל דָּ֖ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vbny blhh shpcht rchl dn vnptly
verses.translation: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid: Dan and Naphtali;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֛ה שִׁפְחַ֥ת לֵאָ֖ה גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּד־ל֖וֹ בְּפַדַּ֥ן אֲרָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny zlph shpcht l'h gd v'shr 'lh bny y'qb 'shr yldlv bpdn 'rm
verses.translation: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, that were born to him in Paddan-aram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יַעֲקֹב֙ אֶל־יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֔יו מַמְרֵ֖א קִרְיַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבַּ֑ע הִ֣וא חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־גָּֽר־שָׁ֥ם אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.translit: vyb' y'qb 'lytschq 'byv mmr' qryt h'rb' hv' chbrvn 'shrgrshm 'brhm vytschq
verses.translation: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father to Mamre, to Kiriatharba—the same is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְי֖וּ יְמֵ֣י יִצְחָ֑ק מְאַ֥ת שָׁנָ֖ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhyv ymy ytschq m't shnh vshmnym shnh
verses.translation: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגְוַ֨ע יִצְחָ֤ק וַיָּ֙מׇת֙ וַיֵּאָ֣סֶף אֶל־עַמָּ֔יו זָקֵ֖ן וּשְׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ עֵשָׂ֥ו וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב בָּנָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vygv' ytschq vymt vy'sf 'l'myv zqn vshb' ymym vyqbrv 'tv 'shv vy'qb bnyv {p}
verses.translation: And Isaac expired, and died, and was gathered unto his people, old and full of days; and Esau and Jacob his sons buried him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: v'lh tldvt 'shv hv' 'dvm
verses.translation: Now these are the generations of Esau—the same is Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת־נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת־עָדָ֗ה בַּת־אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־אׇהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת־עֲנָ֔ה בַּת־צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽחִוִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shv lqch 'tnshyv mbnvt khn'n 't'dh bt'ylvn hchty v't'hlybmh bt'nh bttsb'vn hchvy
verses.translation: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'tbshmt btyshm''l 'chvt nbyvt
verses.translation: and Basemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־רְעוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vtld 'dh l'shv 't'lypz vbshmt yldh 'tr'v'l
verses.translation: And Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz; and Basemath bore Reuel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאׇהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־[יְע֥וּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: v'hlybmh yldh 't[y'vsh] (y'ysh) v'ty'lm v'tqrch 'lh bny 'shv 'shr yldvlv b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, that were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־נָ֠שָׁ֠יו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־כׇּל־נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת־מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־כׇּל־בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'shv 'tnshyv v'tbnyv v'tbntyv v'tkhlnpshvt bytv v'tmqnhv v'tkhlbhmtv v't khlqnynv 'shr rkhsh b'rts khn'n vylkh 'l'rts mpny y'qb 'chyv
verses.translation: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the souls of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan; and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khyhyh rkhvshm rb mshbt ychdv vl' ykhlh 'rts mgvryhm lsh't 'tm mpny mqnyhm
verses.translation: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together; and the land of their sojournings could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'shv bhr sh'yr 'shv hv' 'dvm
verses.translation: And Esau dwelt in the mountain-land of Seir—Esau is Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: v'lh tldvt 'shv 'by 'dvm bhr sh'yr
verses.translation: And these are the generations of Esau the father of a the Edomites in the mountain-land of Seir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן־עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן־בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt bny'shv 'lypz bn'dh 'sht 'shv r'v'l bnbshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bny 'lypz tymn 'vmr tspv vg'tm vqnz
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתִמְנַ֣ע  הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: vtmn'  hyth pylgsh l'lypz bn'shv vtld l'lypz 't'mlq 'lh bny 'dh 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny r'v'l ncht vzrch shmh vmzh 'lh hyv bny bshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath Esau’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אׇהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת־עֲנָ֛ה בַּת־צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת־[יְע֥וּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹֽרַח׃
verses.translit: v'lh hyv bny 'hlybmh bt'nh bttsb'vn 'sht 'shv vtld l'shv 't[y'vsh] (y'ysh) v'ty'lm v'tqrch
verses.translation: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife; and she bore to Esau Jeush, and Jalam, and Korah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'lvpy bny'shv bny 'lypz bkhvr 'shv 'lvf tymn 'lvf 'vmr 'lvf tspv 'lvf qnz
verses.translation: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the first-born of Esau: the chief of Teman, the chief of Omar, the chief of Zepho, the chief of Kenaz,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּֽוּף־קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lvfqrch 'lvf g'tm 'lvf 'mlq 'lh 'lvpy 'lypz b'rts 'dvm 'lh bny 'dh
verses.translation: the chief of Korah, the chief of Gatam, the chief of Amalek. These are the chiefs that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֙חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny r'v'l bn'shv 'lvf ncht 'lvf zrch 'lvf shmh 'lvf mzh 'lh 'lvpy r'v'l b'rts 'dvm 'lh bny bshmt 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son: the chief of Nahath, the chief of Zerah, the chief of Shammah, the chief of Mizzah. These are the chiefs that came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath Esau’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אׇהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אׇהֳלִֽיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'hlybmh 'sht 'shv 'lvf y'vsh 'lvf y'lm 'lvf qrch 'lh 'lvpy 'hlybmh bt'nh 'sht 'shv
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Oholibamah Esau’s wife: the chief of Jeush, the chief of Jalam, the chief of Korah. These are the chiefs that came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lh bny'shv v'lh 'lvpyhm hv' 'dvm {s}
verses.translation: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs; the same is Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי־שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֥וֹן וַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh bnysh'yr hchry yshby h'rts lvtn vshvbl vtsb'vn v'nh
verses.translation: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִשׁ֥וֹן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vdshvn v'tsr vdyshn 'lh 'lvpy hchry bny sh'yr b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs that came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃
verses.translit: vyhyv bnylvtn chry vhymm v'chvt lvtn tmn'
verses.translation: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְאוֹנָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny shvbl 'lvn vmncht v'ybl shpv v'vnm
verses.translation: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־צִבְע֖וֹן וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת־הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹת֥וֹ אֶת־הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'lh bnytsb'vn v'yh v'nh hv' 'nh 'shr mts' 'thymm bmdbr br'tv 'thchmrym ltsb'vn 'byv
verses.translation: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah—this is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאׇהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת־עֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny'nh dshn v'hlybmh bt'nh
verses.translation: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'lh bny dyshn chmdn v'shbn vytrn vkhrn
verses.translation: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lh bny'tsr blhn vz'vn v'qn
verses.translation: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lh bnydyshn 'vts v'rn
verses.translation: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'lvpy hchry 'lvf lvtn 'lvf shvbl 'lvf tsb'vn 'lvf 'nh
verses.translation: These are the chiefs that came of the Horites: the chief of Lotan, the chief of Shobal, the chief of Zibeon, the chief of Anah,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lvf dshn 'lvf 'tsr 'lvf dyshn 'lh 'lvpy hchry l'lpyhm b'rts sh'yr {p}
verses.translation: the chief of Dishon, the chief of Ezer, the chief of Dishan. These are the chiefs that came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלׇךְ־מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'lh hmlkhym 'shr mlkhv b'rts 'dvm lpny mlkhmlkh lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן־בְּע֑וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃
verses.translit: vymlkh b'dvm bl' bnb'vr vshm 'yrv dnhbh
verses.translation: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־זֶ֖רַח מִבׇּצְרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt bl' vymlkh tchtyv yvbb bnzrch mbtsrh
verses.translation: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vymt yvbb vymlkh tchtyv chshm m'rts htymny
verses.translation: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית׃
verses.translit: vymt chshm vymlkh tchtyv hdd bnbdd hmkhh 'tmdyn bshdh mv'b vshm 'yrv 'vyt
verses.translation: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymt hdd vymlkh tchtyv shmlh mmshrqh
verses.translation: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vymt shmlh vymlkh tchtyv sh'vl mrchbvt hnhr
verses.translation: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מׇת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vymlkh tchtyv b'l chnn bn'khbvr
verses.translation: And Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֘מׇת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן־עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: vymt b'l chnn bn'khbvr vymlkh tchtyv hdr vshm 'yrv p'v vshm 'shtv mhytb'l btmtrd bt my zhb
verses.translation: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead; and the name of the city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אֵ֠לֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt 'lvpy 'shv lmshpchtm lmqmtm bshmtm 'lvf tmn' 'lvf 'lvh 'lvf ytt
verses.translation: And these are the names of the chiefs that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names: the chief of Timna, the chief of Alvah, the chief of Jetheth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אׇהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃
verses.translit: 'lvf 'hlybmh 'lvf 'lh 'lvf pynn
verses.translation: the chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lvf qnz 'lvf tymn 'lvf mbtsr
verses.translation: the chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar;
