verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה  אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lvf mgdy'l 'lvf 'yrm 'lh  'lvpy 'dvm lmshbtm b'rts 'chztm hv' 'shv 'by 'dvm {p}
verses.translation: the chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מְגוּרֵ֣י אָבִ֑יו בְּאֶ֖רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.translit: vyshb y'qb b'rts mgvry 'byv b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings, in the land of Canaan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה  תֹּלְד֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֗ב יוֹסֵ֞ף בֶּן־שְׁבַֽע־עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֨ה רֹעֶ֤ה אֶת־אֶחָיו֙ בַּצֹּ֔אן וְה֣וּא נַ֗עַר אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָ֛ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵ֥י זִלְפָּ֖ה נְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֑יו וַיָּבֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־דִּבָּתָ֥ם רָעָ֖ה אֶל־אֲבִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh  tldvt y'qb yvsf bnshb''shrh shnh hyh r'h 't'chyv bts'n vhv' n'r 'tbny blhh v'tbny zlph nshy 'byv vyb' yvsf 'tdbtm r'h 'l'byhm
verses.translation: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren, being still a lad even with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives; and Joseph brought evil report of them unto their father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָהַ֤ב אֶת־יוֹסֵף֙ מִכׇּל־בָּנָ֔יו כִּֽי־בֶן־זְקֻנִ֥ים ה֖וּא ל֑וֹ וְעָ֥שָׂה ל֖וֹ כְּתֹ֥נֶת פַּסִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshr'l 'hb 'tyvsf mkhlbnyv khybnzqnym hv' lv v'shh lv khtnt psym
verses.translation: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age; and he made him a coat of many colours.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֣וּ אֶחָ֗יו כִּֽי־אֹת֞וֹ אָהַ֤ב אֲבִיהֶם֙ מִכׇּל־אֶחָ֔יו וַֽיִּשְׂנְא֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ דַּבְּר֥וֹ לְשָׁלֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 'chyv khy'tv 'hb 'byhm mkhl'chyv vyshn'v 'tv vl' ykhlv dbrv lshlm
verses.translation: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחֲלֹ֤ם יוֹסֵף֙ חֲל֔וֹם וַיַּגֵּ֖ד לְאֶחָ֑יו וַיּוֹסִ֥פוּ ע֖וֹד שְׂנֹ֥א אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vychlm yvsf chlvm vygd l'chyv vyvspv 'vd shn' 'tv
verses.translation: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brethren; and they hated him yet the more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֕א הַחֲל֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm shm'vn' hchlvm hzh 'shr chlmty
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הִנֵּ֠ה אֲנַ֜חְנוּ מְאַלְּמִ֤ים אֲלֻמִּים֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה קָ֥מָה אֲלֻמָּתִ֖י וְגַם־נִצָּ֑בָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה תְסֻבֶּ֙ינָה֙ אֲלֻמֹּ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וַתִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖יןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhnh 'nchnv m'lmym 'lmym btvkh hshdh vhnh qmh 'lmty vgmntsbh vhnh tsbynh 'lmtykhm vtshtchvyn l'lmty
verses.translation: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves came round about, and bowed down to my sheaf.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמְרוּ לוֹ֙ אֶחָ֔יו הֲמָלֹ֤ךְ תִּמְלֹךְ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אִם־מָשׁ֥וֹל תִּמְשֹׁ֖ל בָּ֑נוּ וַיּוֹסִ֤פוּ עוֹד֙ שְׂנֹ֣א אֹת֔וֹ עַל־חֲלֹמֹתָ֖יו וְעַל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'chyv hmlkh tmlkh 'lynv 'mmshvl tmshl bnv vyvspv 'vd shn' 'tv 'lchlmtyv v'ldbryv
verses.translation: And his brethren said to him: ‘Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us?’ And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחֲלֹ֥ם עוֹד֙ חֲל֣וֹם אַחֵ֔ר וַיְסַפֵּ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ לְאֶחָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֨ה חָלַ֤מְתִּֽי חֲלוֹם֙ ע֔וֹד וְהִנֵּ֧ה הַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ וְהַיָּרֵ֗חַ וְאַחַ֤ד עָשָׂר֙ כּֽוֹכָבִ֔ים מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוִ֖ים לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vychlm 'vd chlvm 'chr vyspr 'tv l'chyv vy'mr hnh chlmty chlvm 'vd vhnh hshmsh vhyrch v'chd 'shr khvkhbym mshtchvym ly
verses.translation: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brethren, and said: ‘Behold, I have dreamed yet a dream: and, behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֣ר אֶל־אָבִיו֮ וְאֶל־אֶחָיו֒ וַיִּגְעַר־בּ֣וֹ אָבִ֔יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מָ֛ה הַחֲל֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָלָ֑מְתָּ הֲב֣וֹא נָב֗וֹא אֲנִי֙ וְאִמְּךָ֣ וְאַחֶ֔יךָ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְךָ֖ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: vyspr 'l'byv v'l'chyv vyg'rbv 'byv vy'mr lv mh hchlvm hzh 'shr chlmt hbv' nbv' 'ny v'mkh v'chykh lhshtchvt lkh 'rtsh
verses.translation: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren; and his father rebuked him, and said unto him: ‘What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down to thee to the earth?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְקַנְאוּ־ב֖וֹ אֶחָ֑יו וְאָבִ֖יו שָׁמַ֥ר אֶת־הַדָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqn'vbv 'chyv v'byv shmr 'thdbr
verses.translation: And his brethren envied him; but his father kept the saying in mind. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶחָ֑יו לִרְע֛וֹת אֶׄתׄ־צֹ֥אן אֲבִיהֶ֖ם בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vylkhv 'chyv lr'vt 'tts'n 'byhm bshkhm
verses.translation: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־יוֹסֵ֗ף הֲל֤וֹא אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ רֹעִ֣ים בִּשְׁכֶ֔ם לְכָ֖ה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yshr'l 'lyvsf hlv' 'chykh r'ym bshkhm lkhh v'shlchkh 'lyhm vy'mr lv hnny
verses.translation: And Israel said unto Joseph: ‘Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them.’ And he said to him: ‘Here am I.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ לֶךְ־נָ֨א רְאֵ֜ה אֶת־שְׁל֤וֹם אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־שְׁל֣וֹם הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֵ֖נִי דָּבָ֑ר וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֙הוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣מֶק חֶבְר֔וֹן וַיָּבֹ֖א שְׁכֶֽמָה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv lkhn' r'h 'tshlvm 'chykh v'tshlvm hts'n vhshbny dbr vyshlchhv m'mq chbrvn vyb' shkhmh
verses.translation: And he said to him: ‘Go now, see whether it is well with thy brethren, and well with the flock; and bring me back word.’ So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָאֵ֣הוּ אִ֔ישׁ וְהִנֵּ֥ה תֹעֶ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֧הוּ הָאִ֛ישׁ לֵאמֹ֖ר מַה־תְּבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vymts'hv 'ysh vhnh t'h bshdh vysh'lhv h'ysh l'mr mhtbqsh
verses.translation: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying: ‘What seekest thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֶת־אַחַ֖י אָנֹכִ֣י מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ הַגִּֽידָה־נָּ֣א לִ֔י אֵיפֹ֖ה הֵ֥ם רֹעִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 't'chy 'nkhy mbqsh hgydhn' ly 'yph hm r'ym
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I seek my brethren. Tell me, I pray thee, where they are feeding the flock.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הָאִישׁ֙ נָסְע֣וּ מִזֶּ֔ה כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה דֹּתָ֑יְנָה וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ יוֹסֵף֙ אַחַ֣ר אֶחָ֔יו וַיִּמְצָאֵ֖ם בְּדֹתָֽן׃
verses.translit: vy'mr h'ysh ns'v mzh khy shm'ty 'mrym nlkhh dtynh vylkh yvsf 'chr 'chyv vymts'm bdtn
verses.translation: And the man said: ‘They are departed hence; for I heard them say: Let us go to Dothan.’ And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ מֵרָחֹ֑ק וּבְטֶ֙רֶם֙ יִקְרַ֣ב אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽתְנַכְּל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ לַהֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 'tv mrchq vbtrm yqrb 'lyhm vytnkhlv 'tv lhmytv
verses.translation: And they saw him afar off, and before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו הִנֵּ֗ה בַּ֛עַל הַחֲלֹמ֥וֹת הַלָּזֶ֖ה בָּֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l'chyv hnh b'l hchlmvt hlzh b'
verses.translation: And they said one to another: ‘Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  לְכ֣וּ וְנַֽהַרְגֵ֗הוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד הַבֹּר֔וֹת וְאָמַ֕רְנוּ חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֖ה אֲכָלָ֑תְהוּ וְנִרְאֶ֕ה מַה־יִּהְי֖וּ חֲלֹמֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'th  lkhv vnhrghv vnshlkhhv b'chd hbrvt v'mrnv chyh r'h 'khlthv vnr'h mhyhyv chlmtyv
verses.translation: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say: An evil beast hath devoured him; and we shall see what will become of his dreams.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע רְאוּבֵ֔ן וַיַּצִּלֵ֖הוּ מִיָּדָ֑ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹ֥א נַכֶּ֖נּוּ נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyshm' r'vbn vytslhv mydm vy'mr l' nkhnv npsh
verses.translation: And Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand; and said: ‘Let us not take his life.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֣ם ׀ רְאוּבֵן֮ אַל־תִּשְׁפְּכוּ־דָם֒ הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ אֹת֗וֹ אֶל־הַבּ֤וֹר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְיָ֖ד אַל־תִּשְׁלְחוּ־ב֑וֹ לְמַ֗עַן הַצִּ֤יל אֹתוֹ֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם לַהֲשִׁיב֖וֹ אֶל־אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm  r'vbn 'ltshpkhvdm hshlykhv 'tv 'lhbvr hzh 'shr bmdbr vyd 'ltshlchvbv lm'n htsyl 'tv mydm lhshybv 'l'byv
verses.translation: And Reuben said unto them: ‘Shed no blood; cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand upon him’—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶל־אֶחָ֑יו וַיַּפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף֙ אֶת־כֻּתׇּנְתּ֔וֹ אֶת־כְּתֹ֥נֶת הַפַּסִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrb' yvsf 'l'chyv vypshytv 'tyvsf 'tkhtntv 'tkhtnt hpsym 'shr 'lyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colours that was on him;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּ֨קָּחֻ֔הוּ וַיַּשְׁלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַבֹּ֑רָה וְהַבּ֣וֹר רֵ֔ק אֵ֥ין בּ֖וֹ מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyqchhv vyshlkhv 'tv hbrh vhbvr rq 'yn bv mym
verses.translation: and they took him, and cast him into the pit—and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ֮ לֶֽאֱכׇל־לֶ֒חֶם֒ וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ עֵֽינֵיהֶם֙ וַיִּרְא֔וּ וְהִנֵּה֙ אֹרְחַ֣ת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים בָּאָ֖ה מִגִּלְעָ֑ד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶ֣ם נֹֽשְׂאִ֗ים נְכֹאת֙ וּצְרִ֣י וָלֹ֔ט הוֹלְכִ֖ים לְהוֹרִ֥יד מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vyshbv l'khllchm vysh'v 'ynyhm vyr'v vhnh 'rcht yshm''lym b'h mgl'd vgmlyhm nsh'ym nkh't vtsry vlt hvlkhym lhvryd mtsrymh
verses.translation: And they sat down to eat bread; and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites came from Gilead, with their camels bearing spicery and balm and ladanum, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל־אֶחָ֑יו מַה־בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י נַהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־אָחִ֔ינוּ וְכִסִּ֖ינוּ אֶת־דָּמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh 'l'chyv mhbts' khy nhrg 't'chynv vkhsynv 'tdmv
verses.translation: And Judah said unto his brethren: ‘What profit is it if we slay our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכ֞וּ וְנִמְכְּרֶ֣נּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֗ים וְיָדֵ֙נוּ֙ אַל־תְּהִי־ב֔וֹ כִּֽי־אָחִ֥ינוּ בְשָׂרֵ֖נוּ ה֑וּא וַֽיִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶחָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lkhv vnmkhrnv lyshm''lym vydnv 'lthybv khy'chynv bshrnv hv' vyshm'v 'chyv
verses.translation: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother, our flesh.’ And his brethren hearkened unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַבְרוּ֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים מִדְיָנִ֜ים סֹֽחֲרִ֗ים וַֽיִּמְשְׁכוּ֙ וַיַּֽעֲל֤וּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף֙ מִן־הַבּ֔וֹר וַיִּמְכְּר֧וּ אֶת־יוֹסֵ֛ף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֖ים בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים כָּ֑סֶף וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵ֖ף מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.translit: vy'brv 'nshym mdynym schrym vymshkhv vy'lv 'tyvsf mnhbvr vymkhrv 'tyvsf lyshm''lym b'shrym khsf vyby'v 'tyvsf mtsrymh
verses.translation: And there passed by Midianites, merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שׇׁב רְאוּבֵן֙ אֶל־הַבּ֔וֹר וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵין־יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּבּ֑וֹר וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshb r'vbn 'lhbvr vhnh 'ynyvsf bbvr vyqr' 'tbgdyv
verses.translation: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שׇׁב אֶל־אֶחָ֖יו וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַיֶּ֣לֶד אֵינֶ֔נּוּ וַאֲנִ֖י אָ֥נָה אֲנִי־בָֽא׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'l'chyv vy'mr hyld 'ynnv v'ny 'nh 'nyb'
verses.translation: And he returned unto his brethren, and said: ‘The child is not; and as for me, whither shall I go?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־כְּתֹ֣נֶת יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽיִּשְׁחֲטוּ֙ שְׂעִ֣יר עִזִּ֔ים וַיִּטְבְּל֥וּ אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֖נֶת בַּדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyqchv 'tkhtnt yvsf vyshchtv sh'yr 'zym vytblv 'thkhtnt bdm
verses.translation: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a he-goat, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֞וּ אֶת־כְּתֹ֣נֶת הַפַּסִּ֗ים וַיָּבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶל־אֲבִיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ זֹ֣את מָצָ֑אנוּ הַכֶּר־נָ֗א הַכְּתֹ֧נֶת בִּנְךָ֛ הִ֖וא אִם־לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'tkhtnt hpsym vyby'v 'l'byhm vy'mrv z't mts'nv hkhrn' hkhtnt bnkh hv' 'ml'
verses.translation: and they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said: ‘This have we found. Know now whether it is thy son’s coat or not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכִּירָ֤הּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כְּתֹ֣נֶת בְּנִ֔י חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֖ה אֲכָלָ֑תְהוּ טָרֹ֥ף טֹרַ֖ף יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vykhyrh vy'mr khtnt bny chyh r'h 'khlthv trf trf yvsf
verses.translation: And he knew it, and said: ‘It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרַ֤ע יַעֲקֹב֙ שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּ֥שֶׂם שַׂ֖ק בְּמׇתְנָ֑יו וַיִּתְאַבֵּ֥ל עַל־בְּנ֖וֹ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqr' y'qb shmltyv vyshm shq bmtnyv vyt'bl 'lbnv ymym rbym
verses.translation: And Jacob rent his garments, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּקֻ֩מוּ֩ כׇל־בָּנָ֨יו וְכׇל־בְּנֹתָ֜יו לְנַחֲמ֗וֹ וַיְמָאֵן֙ לְהִתְנַחֵ֔ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּֽי־אֵרֵ֧ד אֶל־בְּנִ֛י אָבֵ֖ל שְׁאֹ֑לָה וַיֵּ֥בְךְּ אֹת֖וֹ אָבִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyqmv khlbnyv vkhlbntyv lnchmv vym'n lhtnchm vy'mr khy'rd 'lbny 'bl sh'lh vybkh 'tv 'byv
verses.translation: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said: ‘Nay, but I will go down to the grave to my son mourning.’ And his father wept for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַ֨מְּדָנִ֔ים מָכְר֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפֽוֹטִיפַר֙ סְרִ֣יס פַּרְעֹ֔ה שַׂ֖ר הַטַּבָּחִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhmdnym mkhrv 'tv 'lmtsrym lpvtypr srys pr'h shr htbchym {p}
verses.translation: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא וַיֵּ֥רֶד יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵאֵ֣ת אֶחָ֑יו וַיֵּ֛ט עַד־אִ֥ישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ חִירָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy b't hhv' vyrd yhvdh m't 'chyv vyt 'd'ysh 'dlmy vshmv chyrh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְא־שָׁ֧ם יְהוּדָ֛ה בַּת־אִ֥ישׁ כְּנַעֲנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ שׁ֑וּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶ֖הָ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyr'shm yhvdh bt'ysh khn'ny vshmv shv' vyqchh vyb' 'lyh
verses.translation: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ עֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vthr vtld bn vyqr' 'tshmv 'r
verses.translation: And she conceived, and bore a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֥הַר ע֖וֹד וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ אוֹנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bn vtqr' 'tshmv 'vnn
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤סֶף עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ שֵׁלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה בִכְזִ֖יב בְּלִדְתָּ֥הּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtsf 'vd vtld bn vtqr' 'tshmv shlh vhyh bkhzyb bldth 'tv
verses.translation: And she yet again bore a son, and called his name Shelah; and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֧ח יְהוּדָ֛ה אִשָּׁ֖ה לְעֵ֣ר בְּכוֹר֑וֹ וּשְׁמָ֖הּ תָּמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyqch yhvdh 'shh l'r bkhvrv vshmh tmr
verses.translation: And Judah took a wife for Er his first-born, and her name was Tamar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י עֵ֚ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֔ה רַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיְמִתֵ֖הוּ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'r bkhvr yhvdh r' b'yny yhvh vymthv yhvh
verses.translation: And Er, Judah’s first-born, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ לְאוֹנָ֔ן בֹּ֛א אֶל־אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖יךָ וְיַבֵּ֣ם אֹתָ֑הּ וְהָקֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh l'vnn b' 'l'sht 'chykh vybm 'th vhqm zr' l'chykh
verses.translation: And Judah said unto Onan: ‘Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother unto her, and raise up seed to thy brother.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣דַע אוֹנָ֔ן כִּ֛י לֹּ֥א ל֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַזָּ֑רַע וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־בָּ֨א אֶל־אֵ֤שֶׁת אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת אַ֔רְצָה לְבִלְתִּ֥י נְתׇן־זֶ֖רַע לְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyd' 'vnn khy l' lv yhyh hzr' vhyh 'mb' 'l'sht 'chyv vshcht 'rtsh lblty ntnzr' l'chyv
verses.translation: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his; and it came to pass when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give seed to his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֛רַע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיָּ֖מֶת גַּם־אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' b'yny yhvh 'shr 'shh vymt gm'tv
verses.translation: And the thing which he did was evil in the sight of the LORD; and He slew him also.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְתָמָ֨ר כַּלָּת֜וֹ שְׁבִ֧י אַלְמָנָ֣ה בֵית־אָבִ֗יךְ עַד־יִגְדַּל֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֔י כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־יָמ֥וּת גַּם־ה֖וּא כְּאֶחָ֑יו וַתֵּ֣לֶךְ תָּמָ֔ר וַתֵּ֖שֶׁב בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh ltmr khltv shby 'lmnh byt'bykh 'dygdl shlh bny khy 'mr pnymvt gmhv' kh'chyv vtlkh tmr vtshb byt 'byh
verses.translation: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter-in-law: ‘Remain a widow in thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown up’; for he said: ‘Lest he also die, like his brethren.’ And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְבּוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וַתָּ֖מׇת בַּת־שׁ֣וּעַ אֵֽשֶׁת־יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּ֜עַל עַל־גֹּֽזְזֵ֤י צֹאנוֹ֙ ה֗וּא וְחִירָ֛ה רֵעֵ֥הוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִ֖י תִּמְנָֽתָה׃
verses.translit: vyrbv hymym vtmt btshv' 'shtyhvdh vynchm yhvdh vy'l 'lgzzy ts'nv hv' vchyrh r'hv h'dlmy tmnth
verses.translation: And in process of time Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheep-shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֻּגַּ֥ד לְתָמָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֥ה חָמִ֛יךְ עֹלֶ֥ה תִמְנָ֖תָה לָגֹ֥ז צֹאנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vygd ltmr l'mr hnh chmykh 'lh tmnth lgz ts'nv
verses.translation: And it was told Tamar, saying: ‘Behold, thy father-in-law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֩סַר֩ בִּגְדֵ֨י אַלְמְנוּתָ֜הּ מֵֽעָלֶ֗יהָ וַתְּכַ֤ס בַּצָּעִיף֙ וַתִּתְעַלָּ֔ף וַתֵּ֙שֶׁב֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח עֵינַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־דֶּ֣רֶךְ תִּמְנָ֑תָה כִּ֤י רָאֲתָה֙ כִּֽי־גָדַ֣ל שֵׁלָ֔ה וְהִ֕וא לֹֽא־נִתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vtsr bgdy 'lmnvth m'lyh vtkhs bts'yf vtt'lf vtshb bptch 'ynym 'shr 'ldrkh tmnth khy r'th khygdl shlh vhv' l'ntnh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And she put off from her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the entrance of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣הָ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיַּחְשְׁבֶ֖הָ לְזוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֥י כִסְּתָ֖ה פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vyr'h yhvdh vychshbh lzvnh khy khsth pnyh
verses.translation: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be a harlot; for she had covered her face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨ט אֵלֶ֜יהָ אֶל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הָֽבָה־נָּא֙ אָב֣וֹא אֵלַ֔יִךְ כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כַלָּת֖וֹ הִ֑וא וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מַה־תִּתֶּן־לִ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyt 'lyh 'lhdrkh vy'mr hbhn' 'bv' 'lykh khy l' yd' khy khltv hv' vt'mr mhttnly khy tbv' 'ly
verses.translation: And he turned unto her by the way, and said: ‘Come, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee’; for he knew not that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said: ‘What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָנֹכִ֛י אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח גְּדִֽי־עִזִּ֖ים מִן־הַצֹּ֑אן וַתֹּ֕אמֶר אִם־תִּתֵּ֥ן עֵרָב֖וֹן עַ֥ד שׇׁלְחֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nkhy 'shlch gdy'zym mnhts'n vt'mr 'mttn 'rbvn 'd shlchkh
verses.translation: And he said: ‘I will send thee a kid of the goats from the flock.’ And she said: ‘Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֣ה הָעֵֽרָבוֹן֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶתֶּן־לָךְ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חֹתָֽמְךָ֙ וּפְתִילֶ֔ךָ וּמַטְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־לָ֛הּ וַיָּבֹ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וַתַּ֥הַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mh h'rbvn 'shr 'tnlkh vt'mr chtmkh vptylkh vmtkh 'shr bydkh vytnlh vyb' 'lyh vthr lv
verses.translation: And he said: ‘What pledge shall I give thee?’ And she said: ‘Thy signet and thy cord, and thy staff that is in thy hand.’ And he gave them to her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּ֣קׇם וַתֵּ֔לֶךְ וַתָּ֥סַר צְעִיפָ֖הּ מֵעָלֶ֑יהָ וַתִּלְבַּ֖שׁ בִּגְדֵ֥י אַלְמְנוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vtqm vtlkh vtsr ts'yph m'lyh vtlbsh bgdy 'lmnvth
verses.translation: And she arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְהוּדָ֜ה אֶת־גְּדִ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֗ים בְּיַד֙ רֵעֵ֣הוּ הָֽעֲדֻלָּמִ֔י לָקַ֥חַת הָעֵרָב֖וֹן מִיַּ֣ד הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וְלֹ֖א מְצָאָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvdh 'tgdy h'zym byd r'hv h'dlmy lqcht h'rbvn myd h'shh vl' mts'h
verses.translation: And Judah sent the kid of the goats by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand; but he found her not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת־אַנְשֵׁ֤י מְקֹמָהּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַיֵּ֧ה הַקְּדֵשָׁ֛ה הִ֥וא בָעֵינַ֖יִם עַל־הַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ לֹא־הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vysh'l 't'nshy mqmh l'mr 'yh hqdshh hv' b'ynym 'lhdrkh vy'mrv l'hyth bzh qdshh
verses.translation: Then he asked the men of her place, saying: ‘Where is the harlot, that was at Enaim by the wayside?’ And they said: ‘There hath been no harlot here.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שׇׁב֙ אֶל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֑יהָ וְגַ֨ם אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמָּקוֹם֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹא־הָיְתָ֥ה בָזֶ֖ה קְדֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'lyhvdh vy'mr l' mts'tyh vgm 'nshy hmqvm 'mrv l'hyth bzh qdshh
verses.translation: And he returned to Judah, and said: ‘I have not found her; and also the men of the place said: There hath been no harlot here.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוּדָה֙ תִּֽקַּֽח־לָ֔הּ פֶּ֖ן נִהְיֶ֣ה לָב֑וּז הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁלַ֙חְתִּי֙ הַגְּדִ֣י הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א מְצָאתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvdh tqchlh pn nhyh lbvz hnh shlchty hgdy hzh v'th l' mts'th
verses.translation: And Judah said: ‘Let her take it, lest we be put to shame; behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כְּמִשְׁלֹ֣שׁ חֳדָשִׁ֗ים וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִֽיהוּדָ֤ה לֵאמֹר֙ זָֽנְתָה֙ תָּמָ֣ר כַּלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְגַ֛ם הִנֵּ֥ה הָרָ֖ה לִזְנוּנִ֑ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָ֔ה הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khmshlsh chdshym vygd lyhvdh l'mr znth tmr khltkh vgm hnh hrh lznvnym vy'mr yhvdh hvtsy'vh vtshrf
verses.translation: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying: ‘Tamar thy daughter-in-law hath played the harlot; and moreover, behold, she is with child by harlotry.’ And Judah said: ‘Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֣וא מוּצֵ֗את וְהִ֨יא שָׁלְחָ֤ה אֶל־חָמִ֙יהָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר־אֵ֣לֶּה לּ֔וֹ אָנֹכִ֖י הָרָ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַכֶּר־נָ֔א לְמִ֞י הַחֹתֶ֧מֶת וְהַפְּתִילִ֛ים וְהַמַּטֶּ֖ה הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: hv' mvts't vhy' shlchh 'lchmyh l'mr l'ysh 'shr'lh lv 'nkhy hrh vt'mr hkhrn' lmy hchtmt vhptylym vhmth h'lh
verses.translation: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father-in-law, saying: ‘By the man, whose these are, am I with child’; and she said: ‘Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and the cords, and the staff.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ צָֽדְקָ֣ה מִמֶּ֔נִּי כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֥ן לֹא־נְתַתִּ֖יהָ לְשֵׁלָ֣ה בְנִ֑י וְלֹֽא־יָסַ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְדַעְתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vykhr yhvdh vy'mr tsdqh mmny khy'lkhn l'nttyh lshlh bny vl'ysf 'vd ld'th
verses.translation: And Judah acknowledged them, and said: ‘She is more righteous than I; forasmuch as I gave her not to Shelah my son.’ And he knew her again no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֖י בְּעֵ֣ת לִדְתָּ֑הּ וְהִנֵּ֥ה תְאוֹמִ֖ים בְּבִטְנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy b't ldth vhnh t'vmym bbtnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י בְלִדְתָּ֖הּ וַיִּתֶּן־יָ֑ד וַתִּקַּ֣ח הַמְיַלֶּ֗דֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עַל־יָד֤וֹ שָׁנִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֖ה יָצָ֥א רִאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy bldth vytnyd vtqch hmyldt vtqshr 'lydv shny l'mr zh yts' r'shnh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that one put out a hand; and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying: ‘This came out first.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כְּמֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ וְהִנֵּה֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו וַתֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־פָּרַ֖צְתָּ עָלֶ֣יךָ פָּ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ פָּֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khmshyb ydv vhnh yts' 'chyv vt'mr mhprtst 'lykh prts vyqr' shmv prts
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold his brother came out; and she said: ‘Wherefore hast thou made a breach for thyself?’ Therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחַר֙ יָצָ֣א אָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־יָד֖וֹ הַשָּׁנִ֑י וַיִּקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ זָֽרַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'chr yts' 'chyv 'shr 'lydv hshny vyqr' shmv zrch {s}
verses.translation: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand; and his name was called Zerah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הוּרַ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּקְנֵ֡הוּ פּוֹטִיפַר֩ סְרִ֨יס פַּרְעֹ֜ה שַׂ֤ר הַטַּבָּחִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מִיַּד֙ הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyvsf hvrd mtsrymh vyqnhv pvtypr srys pr'h shr htbchym 'ysh mtsry myd hyshm''lym 'shr hvrdhv shmh
verses.translation: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hand of the Ishmaelites, that had brought him down thither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְהִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ מַצְלִ֑יחַ וַיְהִ֕י בְּבֵ֖ית אֲדֹנָ֥יו הַמִּצְרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 'tyvsf vyhy 'ysh mtslych vyhy bbyt 'dnyv hmtsry
verses.translation: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲדֹנָ֔יו כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֔ה יְהֹוָ֖ה מַצְלִ֥יחַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'dnyv khy yhvh 'tv vkhl 'shrhv' 'shh yhvh mtslych bydv
verses.translation: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָ֨א יוֹסֵ֥ף חֵ֛ן בְּעֵינָ֖יו וַיְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־בֵּית֔וֹ וְכׇל־יֶשׁ־ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vymts' yvsf chn b'ynyv vyshrt 'tv vypqdhv 'lbytv vkhlyshlv ntn bydv
verses.translation: And Joseph found favour in his sight, and he ministered unto him. And he appointed him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י מֵאָז֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֹת֜וֹ בְּבֵית֗וֹ וְעַל֙ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ל֔וֹ וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית הַמִּצְרִ֖י בִּגְלַ֣ל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֞י בִּרְכַּ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ בְּכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ל֔וֹ בַּבַּ֖יִת וּבַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy m'z hpqyd 'tv bbytv v'l khl'shr yshlv vybrkh yhvh 'tbyt hmtsry bgll yvsf vyhy brkht yhvh bkhl'shr yshlv bbyt vbshdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass from the time that he appointed him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had, in the house and in the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ֮ בְּיַד־יוֹסֵף֒ וְלֹא־יָדַ֤ע אִתּוֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם־הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא אוֹכֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף יְפֵה־תֹ֖אַר וִיפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'zb khl'shrlv bydyvsf vl'yd' 'tv m'vmh khy 'mhlchm 'shrhv' 'vkhl vyhy yvsf ypht'r vyph mr'h
verses.translation: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and, having him, he knew not aught save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was of beautiful form, and fair to look upon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַתִּשָּׂ֧א אֵֽשֶׁת־אֲדֹנָ֛יו אֶת־עֵינֶ֖יהָ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁכְבָ֥ה עִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh vtsh' 'sht'dnyv 't'ynyh 'lyvsf vt'mr shkhbh 'my
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said: ‘Lie with me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֓ן  וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־אֵ֣שֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֔יו הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא־יָדַ֥ע אִתִּ֖י מַה־בַּבָּ֑יִת וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יֶשׁ־ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vym'n  vy'mr 'l'sht 'dnyv hn 'dny l'yd' 'ty mhbbyt vkhl 'shryshlv ntn bydy
verses.translation: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife: ‘Behold, my master, having me, knoweth not what is in the house, and he hath put all that he hath into my hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵינֶ֨נּוּ גָד֜וֹל בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּה֮ מִמֶּ֒נִּי֒ וְלֹֽא־חָשַׂ֤ךְ מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם־אוֹתָ֖ךְ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתְּ־אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨יךְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֜ה הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְחָטָ֖אתִי לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'ynnv gdvl bbyt hzh mmny vl'chshkh mmny m'vmh khy 'm'vtkh b'shr 't'shtv v'ykh ''shh hr'h hgdlh hz't vcht'ty l'lhym
verses.translation: he is not greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּדַבְּרָ֥הּ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֖ף י֣וֹם ׀ י֑וֹם וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֥ע אֵלֶ֛יהָ לִשְׁכַּ֥ב אֶצְלָ֖הּ לִהְי֥וֹת עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy khdbrh 'lyvsf yvm  yvm vl'shm' 'lyh lshkhb 'tslh lhyvt 'mh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א הַבַּ֖יְתָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת מְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨ין אִ֜ישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת שָׁ֖ם בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vyhy khhyvm hzh vyb' hbyth l'shvt ml'khtv v'yn 'ysh m'nshy hbyt shm bbyt
verses.translation: And it came to pass on a certain day, when he went into the house to do his work, and there was none of the men of the house there within,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂ֧הוּ בְּבִגְד֛וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר שִׁכְבָ֣ה עִמִּ֑י וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ בְּיָדָ֔הּ וַיָּ֖נׇס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.translit: vttpshhv bbgdv l'mr shkhbh 'my vy'zb bgdv bydh vyns vyts' hchvtsh
verses.translation: that she caught him by his garment, saying: ‘Lie with me.’ And he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי־עָזַ֥ב בִּגְד֖וֹ בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֖נׇס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vth khy'zb bgdv bydh vyns hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֞א לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵיתָ֗הּ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר רְא֗וּ הֵ֥בִיא לָ֛נוּ אִ֥ישׁ עִבְרִ֖י לְצַ֣חֶק בָּ֑נוּ בָּ֤א אֵלַי֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמִּ֔י וָאֶקְרָ֖א בְּק֥וֹל גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vtqr' l'nshy byth vt'mr lhm l'mr r'v hby' lnv 'ysh 'bry ltschq bnv b' 'ly lshkhb 'my v'qr' bqvl gdvl
verses.translation: that she called unto the men of her house, and spoke unto them, saying: ‘See, he hath brought in a Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְשׇׁמְע֔וֹ כִּֽי־הֲרִימֹ֥תִי קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ אֶצְלִ֔י וַיָּ֖נׇס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'v khyhrymty qvly v'qr' vy'zb bgdv 'tsly vyns vyts' hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled, and got him out.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּנַּ֥ח בִּגְד֖וֹ אֶצְלָ֑הּ עַד־בּ֥וֹא אֲדֹנָ֖יו אֶל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtnch bgdv 'tslh 'dbv' 'dnyv 'lbytv
verses.translation: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּֽא־אֵלַ֞י הָעֶ֧בֶד הָֽעִבְרִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הֵבֵ֥אתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְצַ֥חֶק בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vtdbr 'lyv khdbrym h'lh l'mr b''ly h'bd h'bry 'shrhb't lnv ltschq by
verses.translation: And she spoke unto him according to these words, saying: ‘The Hebrew servant, whom thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּהֲרִימִ֥י קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֥ב בִּגְד֛וֹ אֶצְלִ֖י וַיָּ֥נׇס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.translit: vyhy khhrymy qvly v'qr' vy'zb bgdv 'tsly vyns hchvtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and fled out.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹנָ֜יו אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּרָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיִּ֖חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'dnyv 'tdbry 'shtv 'shr dbrh 'lyv l'mr khdbrym h'lh 'shh ly 'bdkh vychr 'pv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke unto him, saying: ‘After this manner did thy servant to me’; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֲדֹנֵ֨י יוֹסֵ֜ף אֹת֗וֹ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַסֹּ֔הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר־[אֲסִירֵ֥י] (אסורי) הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲסוּרִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי־שָׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.translit: vyqch 'dny yvsf 'tv vytnhv 'lbyt hshr mqvm 'shr['syry] ('svry) hmlkh 'svrym vyhyshm bbyt hshr
verses.translation: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound; and he was there in the prison.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיֵּ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו חָ֑סֶד וַיִּתֵּ֣ן חִנּ֔וֹ בְּעֵינֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר בֵּית־הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh 'tyvsf vyt 'lyv chsd vytn chnv b'yny shr bythshr
verses.translation: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness unto him, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤ר בֵּית־הַסֹּ֙הַר֙ בְּיַד־יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הָ֣אֲסִירִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית הַסֹּ֑הַר וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ שָׁ֔ם ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vytn shr bythshr bydyvsf 't khlh'syrm 'shr bbyt hshr v't khl'shr 'shym shm hv' hyh 'shh
verses.translation: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ין  שַׂ֣ר בֵּית־הַסֹּ֗הַר רֹאֶ֤ה אֶֽת־כׇּל־מְא֙וּמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וַֽאֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה מַצְלִֽיחַ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'yn  shr bythshr r'h 'tkhlm'vmh bydv b'shr yhvh 'tv v'shrhv' 'shh yhvh mtslych {p}
verses.translation: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה חָ֥טְא֛וּ מַשְׁקֵ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם וְהָאֹפֶ֑ה לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם לְמֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh cht'v mshqh mlkhmtsrym vh'ph l'dnyhm lmlkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֣ף פַּרְעֹ֔ה עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י סָרִיסָ֑יו עַ֚ל שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שַׂ֥ר הָאוֹפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqtsf pr'h 'l shny srysyv 'l shr hmshqym v'l shr h'vpym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh was wroth against his two officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֛ית שַׂ֥ר הַטַּבָּחִ֖ים אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַסֹּ֑הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אָס֥וּר שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vytn 'tm bmshmr byt shr htbchym 'lbyt hshr mqvm 'shr yvsf 'svr shm
verses.translation: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יִּפְקֹ֠ד שַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֧ים אֶת־יוֹסֵ֛ף אִתָּ֖ם וַיְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹתָ֑ם וַיִּהְי֥וּ יָמִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vypqd shr htbchym 'tyvsf 'tm vyshrt 'tm vyhyv ymym bmshmr
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph to be with them, and he ministered unto them; and they continued a season in ward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּֽחַלְמוּ֩ חֲל֨וֹם שְׁנֵיהֶ֜ם אִ֤ישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ֙ בְּלַ֣יְלָה אֶחָ֔ד אִ֖ישׁ כְּפִתְר֣וֹן חֲלֹמ֑וֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶ֣ה וְהָאֹפֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲסוּרִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.translit: vychlmv chlvm shnyhm 'ysh chlmv blylh 'chd 'ysh khptrvn chlmv hmshqh vh'ph 'shr lmlkh mtsrym 'shr 'svrym bbyt hshr
verses.translation: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֧א אֲלֵיהֶ֛ם יוֹסֵ֖ף בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיַּ֣רְא אֹתָ֔ם וְהִנָּ֖ם זֹעֲפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyhm yvsf bbqr vyr' 'tm vhnm z'pym
verses.translation: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and saw them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁאַ֞ל אֶת־סְרִיסֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִתּ֧וֹ בְמִשְׁמַ֛ר בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֛וּעַ פְּנֵיכֶ֥ם רָעִ֖ים הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vysh'l 'tsrysy pr'h 'shr 'tv bmshmr byt 'dnyv l'mr mdv' pnykhm r'ym hyvm
verses.translation: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his master’s house, saying: ‘Wherefore look ye so sad to-day?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְנוּ וּפֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם יוֹסֵ֗ף הֲל֤וֹא לֵֽאלֹהִים֙ פִּתְרֹנִ֔ים סַפְּרוּ־נָ֖א לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv chlvm chlmnv vptr 'yn 'tv vy'mr 'lhm yvsf hlv' l'lhym ptrnym sprvn' ly
verses.translation: And they said unto him: ‘We have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it.’ And Joseph said unto them: ‘Do not interpretations belong to God? tell it me, I pray you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֧ר שַֽׂר־הַמַּשְׁקִ֛ים אֶת־חֲלֹמ֖וֹ לְיוֹסֵ֑ף וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ בַּחֲלוֹמִ֕י וְהִנֵּה־גֶ֖פֶן לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyspr shrhmshqym 'tchlmv lyvsf vy'mr lv bchlvmy vhnhgpn lpny
verses.translation: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him: ‘In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַגֶּ֖פֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה שָׂרִיגִ֑ם וְהִ֤וא כְפֹרַ֙חַת֙ עָלְתָ֣ה נִצָּ֔הּ הִבְשִׁ֥ילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶ֖יהָ עֲנָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbgpn shlshh shrygm vhv' khprcht 'lth ntsh hbshylv 'shkhltyh 'nbym
verses.translation: and in the vine were three branches; and as it was budding, its blossoms shot forth, and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכ֥וֹס פַּרְעֹ֖ה בְּיָדִ֑י וָאֶקַּ֣ח אֶת־הָֽעֲנָבִ֗ים וָֽאֶשְׂחַ֤ט אֹתָם֙ אֶל־כּ֣וֹס פַּרְעֹ֔ה וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־הַכּ֖וֹס עַל־כַּ֥ף פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhvs pr'h bydy v'qch 'th'nbym v'shcht 'tm 'lkhvs pr'h v'tn 'thkhvs 'lkhf pr'h
verses.translation: and Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ יוֹסֵ֔ף זֶ֖ה פִּתְרֹנ֑וֹ שְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַשָּׂ֣רִגִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yvsf zh ptrnv shlsht hshrgym shlsht ymym hm
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto him: ‘This is the interpretation of it: the three branches are three days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּע֣וֹד  שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים יִשָּׂ֤א פַרְעֹה֙ אֶת־רֹאשֶׁ֔ךָ וַהֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֖ עַל־כַּנֶּ֑ךָ וְנָתַתָּ֤ כוֹס־פַּרְעֹה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיִ֖יתָ מַשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: b'vd  shlsht ymym ysh' pr'h 'tr'shkh vhshybkh 'lkhnkh vntt khvspr'h bydv khmshpt hr'shvn 'shr hyyt mshqhv
verses.translation: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head, and restore thee unto thine office; and thou shalt give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י אִם־זְכַרְתַּ֣נִי אִתְּךָ֗ כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וְעָשִֽׂיתָ־נָּ֥א עִמָּדִ֖י חָ֑סֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּ֙נִי֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְהוֹצֵאתַ֖נִי מִן־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy 'mzkhrtny 'tkh kh'shr yytb lkh v'shytn' 'mdy chsd vhzkhrtny 'lpr'h vhvts'tny mnhbyt hzh
verses.translation: But have me in thy remembrance when it shall be well with thee, and show kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־גֻנֹּ֣ב גֻּנַּ֔בְתִּי מֵאֶ֖רֶץ הָעִבְרִ֑ים וְגַם־פֹּה֙ לֹא־עָשִׂ֣יתִֽי מְא֔וּמָה כִּֽי־שָׂמ֥וּ אֹתִ֖י בַּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: khygnb gnbty m'rts h'brym vgmph l''shyty m'vmh khyshmv 'ty bbvr
verses.translation: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews; and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא שַׂר־הָאֹפִ֖ים כִּ֣י ט֣וֹב פָּתָ֑ר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אַף־אֲנִי֙ בַּחֲלוֹמִ֔י וְהִנֵּ֗ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֛ה סַלֵּ֥י חֹרִ֖י עַל־רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vyr' shrh'pym khy tvb ptr vy'mr 'lyvsf 'f'ny bchlvmy vhnh shlshh sly chry 'lr'shy
verses.translation: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph: ‘I also saw in my dream, and, behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַסַּ֣ל הָֽעֶלְי֗וֹן מִכֹּ֛ל מַאֲכַ֥ל פַּרְעֹ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹפֶ֑ה וְהָע֗וֹף אֹכֵ֥ל אֹתָ֛ם מִן־הַסַּ֖ל מֵעַ֥ל רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: vbsl h'lyvn mkhl m'khl pr'h m'shh 'ph vh'vf 'khl 'tm mnhsl m'l r'shy
verses.translation: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of baked food for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן יוֹסֵף֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר זֶ֖ה פִּתְרֹנ֑וֹ שְׁלֹ֙שֶׁת֙ הַסַּלִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'n yvsf vy'mr zh ptrnv shlsht hslym shlsht ymym hm
verses.translation: And Joseph answered and said: ‘This is the interpretation thereof: the three baskets are three days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּע֣וֹד  שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים יִשָּׂ֨א פַרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־רֹֽאשְׁךָ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְתָלָ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ עַל־עֵ֑ץ וְאָכַ֥ל הָע֛וֹף אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ֖ מֵעָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: b'vd  shlsht ymym ysh' pr'h 'tr'shkh m'lykh vtlh 'vtkh 'l'ts v'khl h'vf 'tbshrkh m'lykh
verses.translation: within yet three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י י֚וֹם הֻלֶּ֣דֶת אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה לְכׇל־עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּשָּׂ֞א אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ  שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֗ים וְאֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhy  byvm hshlyshy yvm hldt 'tpr'h vy'sh mshth lkhl'bdyv vysh' 'tr'sh  shr hmshqym v'tr'sh shr h'pym btvkh 'bdyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants; and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת־שַׂ֥ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֖ים עַל־מַשְׁקֵ֑הוּ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן הַכּ֖וֹס עַל־כַּ֥ף פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'tshr hmshqym 'lmshqhv vytn hkhvs 'lkhf pr'h
verses.translation: And he restored the chief butler back unto his butlership; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִ֖ים תָּלָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּתַ֛ר לָהֶ֖ם יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: v't shr h'pym tlh kh'shr ptr lhm yvsf
verses.translation: But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־זָכַ֧ר שַֽׂר־הַמַּשְׁקִ֛ים אֶת־יוֹסֵ֖ף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵֽהוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'zkhr shrhmshqym 'tyvsf vyshkhchhv {p}
verses.translation: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּפַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְהִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy mqts shntym ymym vpr'h chlm vhnh 'md 'lhy'r
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּבְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vhnh mnhy'r 'lt shb' prvt ypvt mr'h vbry't bshr vtr'ynh b'chv
verses.translation: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, well-favoured and fat-fleshed; and they fed in the reed-grass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶׁ֧בַע פָּר֣וֹת אֲחֵר֗וֹת עֹל֤וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן֙ מִן־הַיְאֹ֔ר רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְדַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַפָּר֖וֹת עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vhnh shb' prvt 'chrvt 'lvt 'chryhn mnhy'r r'vt mr'h vdqvt bshr vt'mdnh 'tsl hprvt 'lshpt hy'r
verses.translation: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and lean-fleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּאכַ֣לְנָה הַפָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַמַּרְאֶה֙ וְדַקֹּ֣ת הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַפָּר֔וֹת יְפֹ֥ת הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְהַבְּרִיאֹ֑ת וַיִּיקַ֖ץ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'khlnh hprvt r'vt hmr'h vdqt hbshr 't shb' hprvt ypt hmr'h vhbry't vyyqts pr'h
verses.translation: And the ill-favoured and lean-fleshed kine did eat up the seven well-favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֣ה  שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹל֛וֹת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyyshn vychlm shnyt vhnh  shb' shblym 'lvt bqnh 'chd bry'vt vtbvt
verses.translation: And he slept and dreamed a second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים דַּקּ֖וֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnh shb' shblym dqvt vshdvpt qdym tsmchvt 'chryhn
verses.translation: And, behold, seven ears, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְנָה֙ הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים הַבְּרִיא֖וֹת וְהַמְּלֵא֑וֹת וַיִּיקַ֥ץ פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vtbl'nh hshblym hdqvt 't shb' hshblym hbry'vt vhml'vt vyyqts pr'h vhnh chlvm
verses.translation: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַתִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־כׇּל־חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֲכָמֶ֑יהָ וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לָהֶם֙ אֶת־חֲלֹמ֔וֹ וְאֵין־פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vtp'm rvchv vyshlch vyqr' 'tkhlchrtmy mtsrym v'tkhlchkhmyh vyspr pr'h lhm 'tchlmv v'ynpvtr 'vtm lpr'h
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof; and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֶת־חֲטָאַ֕י אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vydbr shr hmshqym 'tpr'h l'mr 'tcht'y 'ny mzkhyr hyvm
verses.translation: Then spoke the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying: ‘I make mention of my faults this day:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל־עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜י בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים אֹתִ֕י וְאֵ֖ת שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִֽים׃
verses.translit: pr'h qtsf 'l'bdyv vytn 'ty bmshmr byt shr htbchym 'ty v't shr h'pym
verses.translation: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in the ward of the house of the captain of the guard, me and the chief baker.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַנַּֽחַלְמָ֥ה חֲל֛וֹם בְּלַ֥יְלָה אֶחָ֖ד אֲנִ֣י וָה֑וּא אִ֛ישׁ כְּפִתְר֥וֹן חֲלֹמ֖וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃
verses.translit: vnchlmh chlvm blylh 'chd 'ny vhv' 'ysh khptrvn chlmv chlmnv
verses.translation: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜נוּ נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י עֶ֚בֶד לְשַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים וַ֨נְּסַפֶּר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּפְתׇּר־לָ֖נוּ אֶת־חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ כַּחֲלֹמ֖וֹ פָּתָֽר׃
verses.translit: vshm 'tnv n'r 'bry 'bd lshr htbchym vnsprlv vyptrlnv 'tchlmtynv 'ysh khchlmv ptr
verses.translation: And there was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר־לָ֖נוּ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל־כַּנִּ֖י וְאֹת֥וֹ תָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr ptrlnv khn hyh 'ty hshyb 'lkhny v'tv tlh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was: I was restored unto mine office, and he was hanged.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶת־יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְרִיצֻ֖הוּ מִן־הַבּ֑וֹר וַיְגַלַּח֙ וַיְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch pr'h vyqr' 'tyvsf vyrytshv mnhbvr vyglch vychlf shmltyv vyb' 'lpr'h
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. And he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי וּפֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִפְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'lyvsf chlvm chlmty vptr 'yn 'tv v'ny shm'ty 'lykh l'mr tshm' chlvm lptr 'tv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: ‘I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it; and I have heard say of thee, that when thou hearest a dream thou canst interpret it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת־פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֱלֹהִ֕ים יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת־שְׁל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'n yvsf 'tpr'h l'mr bl'dy 'lhym y'nh 'tshlvm pr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying: ‘It is not in me; God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּחֲלֹמִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr pr'h 'lyvsf bchlmy hnny 'md 'lshpt hy'r
verses.translation: And Pharaoh spoke unto Joseph: ‘In my dream, behold, I stood upon the brink of the river.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִיפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: vhnh mnhy'r 'lt shb' prvt bry'vt bshr vypt t'r vtr'ynh b'chv
verses.translation: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fat-fleshed and well-favoured; and they fed in the reedgrass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶֽׁבַע־פָּר֤וֹת אֲחֵרוֹת֙ עֹל֣וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת וְרָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְרַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר לֹֽא־רָאִ֧יתִי כָהֵ֛נָּה בְּכׇל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָרֹֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vhnh shb'prvt 'chrvt 'lvt 'chryhn dlvt vr'vt t'r m'd vrqvt bshr l'r'yty khhnh bkhl'rts mtsrym lr'
verses.translation: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill-favoured and lean-fleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֹּאכַ֙לְנָה֙ הַפָּר֔וֹת הָרַקּ֖וֹת וְהָרָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֧בַע הַפָּר֛וֹת הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vt'khlnh hprvt hrqvt vhr'vt 't shb' hprvt hr'shnvt hbry't
verses.translation: And the lean and ill-favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֗נָה וְלֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי־בָ֣אוּ אֶל־קִרְבֶּ֔נָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּתְּחִלָּ֑ה וָאִיקָֽץ׃
verses.translit: vtb'nh 'lqrbnh vl' nvd' khyb'v 'lqrbnh vmr'yhn r' kh'shr btchlh v'yqts
verses.translation: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill-favoured as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא בַּחֲלֹמִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֣ה  שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'r' bchlmy vhnh  shb' shblym 'lt bqnh 'chd ml't vtbvt
verses.translation: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up upon one stalk, full and good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhnh shb' shblym tsnmvt dqvt shdpvt qdym tsmchvt 'chryhm
verses.translation: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְןָ֙ הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת שֶׁ֥בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֖ים הַטֹּב֑וֹת וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֶל־הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vtbl'n hshblym hdqt 't shb' hshblym htbvt v'mr 'lhchrtmym v'yn mgyd ly
verses.translation: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears. And I told it unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הִגִּ֥יד לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yvsf 'lpr'h chlvm pr'h 'chd hv' 't 'shr h'lhym 'shh hgyd lpr'h
verses.translation: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh: ‘The dream of Pharaoh is one; what God is about to do He hath declared unto Pharaoh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֧בַע פָּרֹ֣ת הַטֹּבֹ֗ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הַטֹּבֹ֔ת שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: shb' prt htbt shb' shnym hnh vshb' hshblym htbt shb' shnym hnh chlvm 'chd hv'
verses.translation: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֣בַע הַ֠פָּר֠וֹת הָֽרַקּ֨וֹת וְהָרָעֹ֜ת הָעֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הָרֵק֔וֹת שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַקָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב׃
verses.translit: vshb' hprvt hrqvt vhr't h'lt 'chryhn shb' shnym hnh vshb' hshblym hrqvt shdpvt hqdym yhyv shb' shny r'b
verses.translation: And the seven lean and ill-favoured kine that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind; they shall be seven years of famine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת־פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.translit: hv' hdbr 'shr dbrty 'lpr'h 'shr h'lhym 'shh hr'h 'tpr'h
verses.translation: That is the thing which I spoke unto Pharaoh: what God is about to do He hath shown unto Pharaoh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים בָּא֑וֹת שָׂבָ֥ע גָּד֖וֹל בְּכׇל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hnh shb' shnym b'vt shb' gdvl bkhl'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠קָ֠מוּ שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח כׇּל־הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְכִלָּ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vqmv shb' shny r'b 'chryhn vnshkhch khlhshb' b'rts mtsrym vkhlh hr'b 'th'rts
verses.translation: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יִוָּדַ֤ע הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֛י הָרָעָ֥ב הַה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֑ן כִּֽי־כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vl'yvd' hshb' b'rts mpny hr'b hhv' 'chrykhn khykhbd hv' m'd
verses.translation: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine which followeth; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַחֲל֛וֹם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי־נָכ֤וֹן הַדָּבָר֙ מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמְמַהֵ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'l hshnvt hchlvm 'lpr'h p'mym khynkhvn hdbr m'm h'lhym vmmhr h'lhym l'shtv
verses.translation: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice, it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'th yr' pr'h 'ysh nbvn vchkhm vyshythv 'l'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע׃
verses.translit: y'shh pr'h vypqd pqdym 'lh'rts vchmsh 't'rts mtsrym bshb' shny hshb'
verses.translation: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven years of plenty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹ֙כֶל֙ הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַטֹּב֔וֹת הַבָּאֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ־בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד־פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vyqbtsv 'tkhl'khl hshnym htbvt hb't h'lh vytsbrvbr tcht ydpr'h 'khl b'rym vshmrv
verses.translation: And let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הָאֹ֤כֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.translit: vhyh h'khl lpqdvn l'rts lshb' shny hr'b 'shr thyyn b'rts mtsrym vl'tkhrt h'rts br'b
verses.translation: And the food shall be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny pr'h vb'yny khl'bdyv
verses.translation: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'l'bdyv hnmts' khzh 'ysh 'shr rvch 'lhym bv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto his servants: ‘Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom the spirit of God is?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת־כׇּל־זֹ֑את אֵין־נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'lyvsf 'chry hvdy' 'lhym 'vtkh 'tkhlz't 'ynnbvn vchkhm khmvkh
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: ‘Forasmuch as God hath shown thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל־בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל־פִּ֖יךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כׇּל־עַמִּ֑י רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'th thyh 'lbyty v'lpykh yshq khl'my rq hkhs' 'gdl mmkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled; only in the throne will I be greater than thou.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כׇּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'lyvsf r'h ntty 'tkh 'l khl'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: ‘See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל־יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי־שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַזָּהָ֖ב עַל־צַוָּארֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vysr pr'h 'ttb'tv m'l ydv vytn 'th 'lyd yvsf vylbsh 'tv bgdyshsh vyshm rbd hzhb 'ltsv'rv
verses.translation: And Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כׇּל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'tv bmrkhbt hmshnh 'shrlv vyqr'v lpnyv 'brkh vntvn 'tv 'l khl'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him: ‘Abrech’; and he set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל־יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא־יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת־יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת־רַגְל֖וֹ בְּכׇל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr pr'h 'lyvsf 'ny pr'h vbl'dykh l'yrym 'ysh 'tydv v'trglv bkhl'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph: ‘I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם־יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵ֒חַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֣וֹ אֶת־אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyqr' pr'h shmyvsf tspnt p'nch vytnlv 't'snt btpvty pr' khhn 'n l'shh vyts' yvsf 'l'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעׇמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר בְּכׇל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyvsf bnshlshym shnh b'mdv lpny pr'h mlkhmtsrym vyts' yvsf mlpny pr'h vy'br bkhl'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt.—And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֣עַשׂ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע לִקְמָצִֽים׃
verses.translit: vt'sh h'rts bshb' shny hshb' lqmtsym
verses.translation: And in the seven years of plenty the earth brought forth in heaps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹ֣כֶל  שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן־אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה־הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ נָתַ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyqbts 'tkhl'khl  shb' shnym 'shr hyv b'rts mtsrym vytn'khl b'rym 'khl shdhh'yr 'shr sbybtyh ntn btvkhh
verses.translation: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities; the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי־חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vytsbr yvsf br khchvl hym hrbh m'd 'd khychdl lspr khy'yn mspr
verses.translation: And Joseph laid up corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until they left off numbering; for it was without number.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vlyvsf yld shny bnym btrm tbv' shnt hr'b 'shr yldhlv 'snt btpvty pr' khhn 'vn
verses.translation: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath the daughter of Poti-phera priest of On bore unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי־נַשַּׁ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־כׇּל־עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.translit: vyqr' yvsf 'tshm hbkhvr mnshh khynshny 'lhym 'tkhl'mly v't khlbyt 'by
verses.translation: And Joseph called the name of the first-born Manasseh: ‘for God hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־הִפְרַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עׇנְיִֽי׃
verses.translit: v't shm hshny qr' 'prym khyhprny 'lhym b'rts 'nyy
verses.translation: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: ‘for God hath made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vtkhlynh shb' shny hshb' 'shr hyh b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the seven years of plenty, that was in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכׇל־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּבְכׇל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם׃
verses.translit: vtchlynh shb' shny hr'b lbv' kh'shr 'mr yvsf vyhy r'b bkhlh'rtsvt vbkhl'rts mtsrym hyh lchm
verses.translation: And the seven years of famine began to come, according as Joseph had said; and there was famine in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כׇּל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֛ם אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְכׇל־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל־יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vtr'b khl'rts mtsrym vyts'q h'm 'lpr'h llchm vy'mr pr'h lkhlmtsrym lkhv 'lyvsf 'shry'mr lkhm t'shv
verses.translation: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians: ‘Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כׇּל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhr'b hyh 'l khlpny h'rts vyptch yvsf 'tkhl'shr bhm vyshbr lmtsrym vychzq hr'b b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the famine was over all the face of the earth; and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine was sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל־יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי־חָזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vkhlh'rts b'v mtsrymh lshbr 'lyvsf khychzq hr'b bkhlh'rts
verses.translation: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph to buy corn; because the famine was sore in all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לְבָנָ֔יו לָ֖מָּה תִּתְרָאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyr' y'qb khy yshshbr bmtsrym vy'mr y'qb lbnyv lmh ttr'v
verses.translation: Now Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, and Jacob said unto his sons: ‘Why do ye look one upon another?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רְדוּ־שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וְשִׁבְרוּ־לָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְנִחְיֶ֖ה וְלֹ֥א נָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr hnh shm'ty khy yshshbr bmtsrym rdvshmh vshbrvlnv mshm vnchyh vl' nmvt
verses.translation: And he said: ‘Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt. Get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ אֲחֵֽי־יוֹסֵ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר בָּ֖ר מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyrdv 'chyyvsf 'shrh lshbr br mmtsrym
verses.translation: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn from Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בִּנְיָמִין֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹא־שָׁלַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־אֶחָ֑יו כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־יִקְרָאֶ֖נּוּ אָסֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: v'tbnymyn 'chy yvsf l'shlch y'qb 't'chyv khy 'mr pnyqr'nv 'svn
verses.translation: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said: ‘Lest peradventure harm befall him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבָּאִ֑ים כִּֽי־הָיָ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
