verses.translit: vkhyykhh 'ysh 't'yn 'bdv 'v't'yn 'mtv vshchth lchpshy yshlchnv tcht 'ynv
verses.translation: And if a man smite the eye of his bondman, or the eye of his bondwoman, and destroy it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־שֵׁ֥ן עַבְדּ֛וֹ אֽוֹ־שֵׁ֥ן אֲמָת֖וֹ יַפִּ֑יל לַֽחׇפְשִׁ֥י יְשַׁלְּחֶ֖נּוּ תַּ֥חַת שִׁנּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mshn 'bdv 'vshn 'mtv ypyl lchpshy yshlchnv tcht shnv {p}
verses.translation: And if he smite out his bondman’s tooth, or his bondwoman’s tooth, he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִגַּ֨ח שׁ֥וֹר אֶת־אִ֛ישׁ א֥וֹ אֶת־אִשָּׁ֖ה וָמֵ֑ת סָק֨וֹל יִסָּקֵ֜ל הַשּׁ֗וֹר וְלֹ֤א יֵאָכֵל֙ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֔וֹ וּבַ֥עַל הַשּׁ֖וֹר נָקִֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhyygch shvr 't'ysh 'v 't'shh vmt sqvl ysql hshvr vl' y'khl 'tbshrv vb'l hshvr nqy
verses.translation: And if an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die, the ox shall be surely stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֡ם שׁוֹר֩ נַגָּ֨ח ה֜וּא מִתְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֗ם וְהוּעַ֤ד בִּבְעָלָיו֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְרֶ֔נּוּ וְהֵמִ֥ית אִ֖ישׁ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֑ה הַשּׁוֹר֙ יִסָּקֵ֔ל וְגַם־בְּעָלָ֖יו יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'm shvr ngch hv' mtml shlshm vhv'd bb'lyv vl' yshmrnv vhmyt 'ysh 'v 'shh hshvr ysql vgmb'lyv yvmt
verses.translation: But if the ox was wont to gore in time past, and warning hath been given to its owner, and he hath not kept it in, but it hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and its owner also shall be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כֹּ֖פֶר יוּשַׁ֣ת עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַן֙ פִּדְיֹ֣ן נַפְשׁ֔וֹ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יוּשַׁ֖ת עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'mkhpr yvsht 'lyv vntn pdyn npshv khkhl 'shryvsht 'lyv
verses.translation: If there be laid on him a ransom, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹ־בֵ֥ן יִגָּ֖ח אוֹ־בַ֣ת יִגָּ֑ח כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט הַזֶּ֖ה יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'vbn ygch 'vbt ygch khmshpt hzh y'shh lv
verses.translation: Whether it have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עֶ֛בֶד יִגַּ֥ח הַשּׁ֖וֹר א֣וֹ אָמָ֑ה כֶּ֣סֶף  שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים יִתֵּן֙ לַֽאדֹנָ֔יו וְהַשּׁ֖וֹר יִסָּקֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'm'bd ygch hshvr 'v 'mh khsf  shlshym shqlym ytn l'dnyv vhshvr ysql {s}
verses.translation: If the ox gore a bondman or a bondwoman, he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִפְתַּ֨ח אִ֜ישׁ בּ֗וֹר א֠וֹ כִּֽי־יִכְרֶ֥ה אִ֛ישׁ בֹּ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יְכַסֶּ֑נּוּ וְנָֽפַל־שָׁ֥מָּה שּׁ֖וֹר א֥וֹ חֲמֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vkhyyptch 'ysh bvr 'v khyykhrh 'ysh br vl' ykhsnv vnplshmh shvr 'v chmvr
verses.translation: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּ֤עַל הַבּוֹר֙ יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם כֶּ֖סֶף יָשִׁ֣יב לִבְעָלָ֑יו וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b'l hbvr yshlm khsf yshyb lb'lyv vhmt yhyhlv {s}
verses.translation: the owner of the pit shall make it good; he shall give money unto the owner of them, and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִגֹּ֧ף שֽׁוֹר־אִ֛ישׁ אֶת־שׁ֥וֹר רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת וּמָ֨כְר֜וּ אֶת־הַשּׁ֤וֹר הַחַי֙ וְחָצ֣וּ אֶת־כַּסְפּ֔וֹ וְגַ֥ם אֶת־הַמֵּ֖ת יֶֽחֱצֽוּן׃
verses.translit: vkhyygf shvr'ysh 'tshvr r'hv vmt vmkhrv 'thshvr hchy vchtsv 'tkhspv vgm 'thmt ychtsvn
verses.translation: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, so that it dieth; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the price of it; and the dead also they shall divide.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֣וֹ נוֹדַ֗ע כִּ֠י שׁ֣וֹר נַגָּ֥ח הוּא֙ מִתְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמְרֶ֖נּוּ בְּעָלָ֑יו שַׁלֵּ֨ם יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שׁוֹר֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְהַמֵּ֖ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'v nvd' khy shvr ngch hv' mtmvl shlshm vl' yshmrnv b'lyv shlm yshlm shvr tcht hshvr vhmt yhyhlv {s}
verses.translation: Or if it be known that the ox was wont to gore in time past, and its owner hath not kept it in; he shall surely pay ox for ox, and the dead beast shall be his own.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִגְנֹֽב־אִישׁ֙ שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֔ה וּטְבָח֖וֹ א֣וֹ מְכָר֑וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בָקָ֗ר יְשַׁלֵּם֙ תַּ֣חַת הַשּׁ֔וֹר וְאַרְבַּע־צֹ֖אן תַּ֥חַת הַשֶּֽׂה׃
verses.translit: khy ygnb'ysh shvr 'vshh vtbchv 'v mkhrv chmshh bqr yshlm tcht hshvr v'rb'ts'n tcht hshh
verses.translation: If a man steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־בַּמַּחְתֶּ֛רֶת יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב וְהֻכָּ֣ה וָמֵ֑ת אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ דָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mbmchtrt ymts' hgnb vhkhh vmt 'yn lv dmym
verses.translation: If a thief be found breaking in, and be smitten so that he dieth, there shall be no bloodguiltiness for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־זָרְחָ֥ה הַשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עָלָ֖יו דָּמִ֣ים ל֑וֹ שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם אִם־אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְנִמְכַּ֖ר בִּגְנֵבָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mzrchh hshmsh 'lyv dmym lv shlm yshlm 'm'yn lv vnmkhr bgnbtv
verses.translation: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be bloodguiltiness for him—he shall make restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִֽם־הִמָּצֵא֩ תִמָּצֵ֨א בְיָד֜וֹ הַגְּנֵבָ֗ה מִשּׁ֧וֹר עַד־חֲמ֛וֹר עַד־שֶׂ֖ה חַיִּ֑ים שְׁנַ֖יִם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mhmts' tmts' bydv hgnbh mshvr 'dchmvr 'dshh chyym shnym yshlm {s}
verses.translation: If the theft be found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep, he shall pay double.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יַבְעֶר־אִישׁ֙ שָׂדֶ֣ה אוֹ־כֶ֔רֶם וְשִׁלַּח֙ אֶת־בְּעִירֹ֔ה וּבִעֵ֖ר בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר מֵיטַ֥ב שָׂדֵ֛הוּ וּמֵיטַ֥ב כַּרְמ֖וֹ יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy yb'r'ysh shdh 'vkhrm vshlch 'tb'yrh vb'r bshdh 'chr mytb shdhv vmytb khrmv yshlm {s}
verses.translation: If a man cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall let his beast loose, and it feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ וּמָצְאָ֤ה קֹצִים֙ וְנֶאֱכַ֣ל גָּדִ֔ישׁ א֥וֹ הַקָּמָ֖ה א֣וֹ הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה שַׁלֵּ֣ם יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם הַמַּבְעִ֖ר אֶת־הַבְּעֵרָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khytts' 'sh vmts'h qtsym vn'khl gdysh 'v hqmh 'v hshdh shlm yshlm hmb'r 'thb'rh {s}
verses.translation: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the shocks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field are consumed; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֜הוּ כֶּ֤סֶף אֽוֹ־כֵלִים֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגֻנַּ֖ב מִבֵּ֣ית הָאִ֑ישׁ אִם־יִמָּצֵ֥א הַגַּנָּ֖ב יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khyytn 'ysh 'lr'hv khsf 'vkhlym lshmr vgnb mbyt h'ysh 'mymts' hgnb yshlm shnym
verses.translation: If a man deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, he shall pay double.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֤א יִמָּצֵא֙ הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְנִקְרַ֥ב בַּֽעַל־הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים אִם־לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'ml' ymts' hgnb vnqrb b'lhbyt 'lh'lhym 'ml' shlch ydv bml'kht r'hv
verses.translation: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall come near unto God, to see whether he have not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽל־כׇּל־דְּבַר־פֶּ֡שַׁע עַל־שׁ֡וֹר עַל־חֲ֠מ֠וֹר עַל־שֶׂ֨ה עַל־שַׂלְמָ֜ה עַל־כׇּל־אֲבֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאמַר֙ כִּי־ה֣וּא זֶ֔ה עַ֚ד הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יָבֹ֖א דְּבַר־שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַרְשִׁיעֻן֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְשַׁלֵּ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'lkhldbrpsh' 'lshvr 'lchmvr 'lshh 'lshlmh 'lkhl'bdh 'shr y'mr khyhv' zh 'd h'lhym yb' dbrshnyhm 'shr yrshy'n 'lhym yshlm shnym lr'hv {s}
verses.translation: For every matter of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, whereof one saith: 'This is it,' the cause of both parties shall come before God; he whom God shall condemn shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יִתֵּן֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֜הוּ חֲמ֨וֹר אוֹ־שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֛ה וְכׇל־בְּהֵמָ֖ה לִשְׁמֹ֑ר וּמֵ֛ת אוֹ־נִשְׁבַּ֥ר אוֹ־נִשְׁבָּ֖ה אֵ֥ין רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khyytn 'ysh 'lr'hv chmvr 'vshvr 'vshh vkhlbhmh lshmr vmt 'vnshbr 'vnshbh 'yn r'h
verses.translation: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep, and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁבֻעַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה תִּהְיֶה֙ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אִם־לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֛ח יָד֖וֹ בִּמְלֶ֣אכֶת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְלָקַ֥ח בְּעָלָ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: shb't yhvh thyh byn shnyhm 'ml' shlch ydv bml'kht r'hv vlqch b'lyv vl' yshlm
verses.translation: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, to see whether he have not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner thereof shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־גָּנֹ֥ב יִגָּנֵ֖ב מֵעִמּ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לִבְעָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'mgnb ygnb m'mv yshlm lb'lyv
verses.translation: But if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־טָרֹ֥ף יִטָּרֵ֖ף יְבִאֵ֣הוּ עֵ֑ד הַטְּרֵפָ֖ה לֹ֥א יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'mtrf ytrf yb'hv 'd htrph l' yshlm {p}
verses.translation: If it be torn in pieces, let him bring it for witness; he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִשְׁאַ֥ל אִ֛ישׁ מֵעִ֥ם רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ר אוֹ־מֵ֑ת בְּעָלָ֥יו אֵין־עִמּ֖וֹ שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhyysh'l 'ysh m'm r'hv vnshbr 'vmt b'lyv 'yn'mv shlm yshlm
verses.translation: And if a man borrow aught of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־בְּעָלָ֥יו עִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם אִם־שָׂכִ֣יר ה֔וּא בָּ֖א בִּשְׂכָרֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mb'lyv 'mv l' yshlm 'mshkhyr hv' b' bshkhrv {s}
verses.translation: If the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good; if it be a hireling, he loseth his hire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יְפַתֶּ֣ה אִ֗ישׁ בְּתוּלָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־אֹרָ֖שָׂה וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ מָהֹ֛ר יִמְהָרֶ֥נָּה לּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vkhyypth 'ysh btvlh 'shr l''rshh vshkhb 'mh mhr ymhrnh lv l'shh
verses.translation: And if a man entice a virgin that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־מָאֵ֧ן יְמָאֵ֛ן אָבִ֖יהָ לְתִתָּ֣הּ ל֑וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף יִשְׁקֹ֔ל כְּמֹ֖הַר הַבְּתוּלֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mm'n ym'n 'byh ltth lv khsf yshql khmhr hbtvlt {s}
verses.translation: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְכַשֵּׁפָ֖ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: mkhshph l' tchyh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not suffer a sorceress to live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־שֹׁכֵ֥ב עִם־בְּהֵמָ֖ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khlshkhb 'mbhmh mvt yvmt {s}
verses.translation: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹבֵ֥חַ לָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יׇֽחֳרָ֑ם בִּלְתִּ֥י לַיהֹוָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: zbch l'lhym ychrm blty lyhvh lbdv
verses.translation: He that sacrificeth unto the gods, save unto the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֵ֥ר לֹא־תוֹנֶ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תִלְחָצֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vgr l'tvnh vl' tlchtsnv khygrym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And a stranger shalt thou not wrong, neither shalt thou oppress him; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אַלְמָנָ֥ה וְיָת֖וֹם לֹ֥א תְעַנּֽוּן׃
verses.translit: khl'lmnh vytvm l' t'nvn
verses.translation: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'm'nh t'nh 'tv khy 'mts'q yts'q 'ly shm' 'shm' ts'qtv
verses.translation: If thou afflict them in any wise—for if they cry at all unto Me, I will surely hear their cry—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְהָרַגְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב וְהָי֤וּ נְשֵׁיכֶם֙ אַלְמָנ֔וֹת וּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם יְתֹמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vchrh 'py vhrgty 'tkhm bchrb vhyv nshykhm 'lmnvt vbnykhm ytmym {p}
verses.translation: My wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־כֶּ֣סֶף  תַּלְוֶ֣ה אֶת־עַמִּ֗י אֶת־הֶֽעָנִי֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה ל֖וֹ כְּנֹשֶׁ֑ה לֹֽא־תְשִׂימ֥וּן עָלָ֖יו נֶֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: 'mkhsf  tlvh 't'my 'th'ny 'mkh l'thyh lv khnshh l'tshymvn 'lyv nshkh
verses.translation: If thou lend money to any of My people, even to the poor with thee, thou shalt not be to him as a creditor; neither shall ye lay upon him interest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־חָבֹ֥ל תַּחְבֹּ֖ל שַׂלְמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֑ךָ עַד־בֹּ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ תְּשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'mchbl tchbl shlmt r'kh 'db' hshmsh tshybnv lv
verses.translation: If thou at all take thy neighbour’s garment to pledge, thou shalt restore it unto him by that the sun goeth down;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִ֤וא כְסוּתֹה֙ לְבַדָּ֔הּ הִ֥וא שִׂמְלָת֖וֹ לְעֹר֑וֹ בַּמֶּ֣ה יִשְׁכָּ֔ב וְהָיָה֙ כִּֽי־יִצְעַ֣ק אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁמַעְתִּ֖י כִּֽי־חַנּ֥וּן אָֽנִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy hv' khsvth lbdh hv' shmltv l'rv bmh yshkhb vhyh khyyts'q 'ly vshm'ty khychnvn 'ny {s}
verses.translation: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin; wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto Me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֹ֣א תְקַלֵּ֑ל וְנָשִׂ֥יא בְעַמְּךָ֖ לֹ֥א תָאֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lhym l' tqll vnshy' b'mkh l' t'r
verses.translation: Thou shalt not revile God, nor curse a ruler of thy people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְלֵאָתְךָ֥ וְדִמְעֲךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנֶ֖יךָ תִּתֶּן־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: ml'tkh vdm'kh l' t'chr bkhvr bnykh ttnly
verses.translation: Thou shalt not delay to offer of the fulness of thy harvest, and of the outflow of thy presses. The first-born of thy sons shalt thou give unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּֽן־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְשֹׁרְךָ֖ לְצֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עִם־אִמּ֔וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י תִּתְּנוֹ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: khnt'shh lshrkh lts'nkh shb't ymym yhyh 'm'mv byvm hshmyny ttnvly
verses.translation: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep; seven days it shall be with its dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְי֣וּן לִ֑י וּבָשָׂ֨ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֤ה טְרֵפָה֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ לַכֶּ֖לֶב תַּשְׁלִכ֥וּן אֹתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'nshyqdsh thyvn ly vbshr bshdh trph l' t'khlv lkhlb tshlkhvn 'tv {s}
verses.translation: And ye shall be holy men unto Me; therefore ye shall not eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֖א שֵׁ֣מַע שָׁ֑וְא אַל־תָּ֤שֶׁת יָֽדְךָ֙ עִם־רָשָׁ֔ע לִהְיֹ֖ת עֵ֥ד חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: l' tsh' shm' shv' 'ltsht ydkh 'mrsh' lhyt 'd chms
verses.translation: Thou shalt not utter a false report; put not thy hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרֵֽי־רַבִּ֖ים לְרָעֹ֑ת וְלֹא־תַעֲנֶ֣ה עַל־רִ֗ב לִנְטֹ֛ת אַחֲרֵ֥י רַבִּ֖ים לְהַטֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: l'thyh 'chryrbym lr't vl't'nh 'lrb lntt 'chry rbym lhtt
verses.translation: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou bear witness in a cause to turn aside after a multitude to pervert justice;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדָ֕ל לֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר בְּרִיבֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vdl l' thdr brybv {s}
verses.translation: neither shalt thou favour a poor man in his cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִפְגַּ֞ע שׁ֧וֹר אֹֽיִבְךָ֛ א֥וֹ חֲמֹר֖וֹ תֹּעֶ֑ה הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֶ֖נּוּ לֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy tpg' shvr 'ybkh 'v chmrv t'h hshb tshybnv lv {s}
verses.translation: If thou meet thine enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תִרְאֶ֞ה חֲמ֣וֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ֗ רֹבֵץ֙ תַּ֣חַת מַשָּׂא֔וֹ וְחָדַלְתָּ֖ מֵעֲזֹ֣ב ל֑וֹ עָזֹ֥ב תַּעֲזֹ֖ב עִמּֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khytr'h chmvr shn'kh rbts tcht msh'v vchdlt m'zb lv 'zb t'zb 'mv {s}
verses.translation: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under its burden, thou shalt forbear to pass by him; thou shalt surely release it with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיֹנְךָ֖ בְּרִיבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l' tth mshpt 'bynkh brybv
verses.translation: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִדְּבַר־שֶׁ֖קֶר תִּרְחָ֑ק וְנָקִ֤י וְצַדִּיק֙ אַֽל־תַּהֲרֹ֔ג כִּ֥י לֹא־אַצְדִּ֖יק רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.translit: mdbrshqr trchq vnqy vtsdyq 'lthrg khy l''tsdyq rsh'
verses.translation: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not; for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֹׁ֖חַד לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח כִּ֤י הַשֹּׁ֙חַד֙ יְעַוֵּ֣ר פִּקְחִ֔ים וִֽיסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.translit: vshchd l' tqch khy hshchd y'vr pqchym vyslf dbry tsdyqym
verses.translation: And thou shalt take no gift; for a gift blindeth them that have sight, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגֵ֖ר לֹ֣א תִלְחָ֑ץ וְאַתֶּ֗ם יְדַעְתֶּם֙ אֶת־נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַגֵּ֔ר כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vgr l' tlchts v'tm yd'tm 'tnpsh hgr khygrym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And a stranger shalt thou not oppress; for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת־אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת־תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vshsh shnym tzr' 't'rtskh v'spt 'ttbv'th
verses.translation: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and gather in the increase thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשְּׁבִיעִ֞ת תִּשְׁמְטֶ֣נָּה וּנְטַשְׁתָּ֗הּ וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ אֶבְיֹנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְיִתְרָ֕ם תֹּאכַ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה כֵּֽן־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְכַרְמְךָ֖ לְזֵיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vhshby't tshmtnh vntshth v'khlv 'byny 'mkh vytrm t'khl chyt hshdh khnt'shh lkhrmkh lzytkh
verses.translation: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of thy people may eat; and what they leave the beast of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת לְמַ֣עַן יָנ֗וּחַ שֽׁוֹרְךָ֙ וַחֲמֹרֶ֔ךָ וְיִנָּפֵ֥שׁ בֶּן־אֲמָתְךָ֖ וְהַגֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'shh m'shykh vbyvm hshby'y tshbt lm'n ynvch shvrkh vchmrkh vynpsh bn'mtkh vhgr
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt do thy work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest; that thine ox and thine ass may have rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁמֵ֑רוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לֹ֣א תַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עַל־פִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vbkhl 'shr'mrty 'lykhm tshmrv vshm 'lhym 'chrym l' tzkhyrv l' yshm' 'lpykh
verses.translation: And in all things that I have said unto you take ye heed; and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֔ים תָּחֹ֥ג לִ֖י בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlsh rglym tchg ly bshnh
verses.translation: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto Me in the year.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִים֩ תֹּאכַ֨ל מַצּ֜וֹת כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֗ךָ לְמוֹעֵד֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב כִּי־ב֖וֹ יָצָ֣אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹא־יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'tchg hmtsvt tshmr shb't ymym t'khl mtsvt kh'shr tsvytkh lmv'd chdsh h'byb khybv yts't mmtsrym vl'yr'v pny ryqm
verses.translation: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep; seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, at the time appointed in the month Abib—for in it thou camest out from Egypt; and none shall appear before Me empty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַ֤ג הַקָּצִיר֙ בִּכּוּרֵ֣י מַעֲשֶׂ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּזְרַ֖ע בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְחַ֤ג הָֽאָסִף֙ בְּצֵ֣את הַשָּׁנָ֔ה בְּאׇסְפְּךָ֥ אֶֽת־מַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vchg hqtsyr bkhvry m'shykh 'shr tzr' bshdh vchg h'sf bts't hshnh b'spkh 'tm'shykh mnhshdh
verses.translation: and the feast of harvest, the first-fruits of thy labours, which thou sowest in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when thou gatherest in thy labours out of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כׇּל־זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶל־פְּנֵ֖י הָאָדֹ֥ן ׀ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlsh p'mym bshnh yr'h khlzkhvrkh 'lpny h'dn  yhvh
verses.translation: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִזְבַּ֥ח עַל־חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם־זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹֽא־יָלִ֥ין חֵֽלֶב־חַגִּ֖י עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: l'tzbch 'lchmts dmzbchy vl'ylyn chlbchgy 'dbqr
verses.translation: Thou shalt not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of My feast remain all night until the morning.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹֽא־תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: r'shyt bkhvry 'dmtkh tby' byt yhvh 'lhykh l'tbshl gdy bchlb 'mv {p}
verses.translation: The choicest first-fruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in its mother’s milk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ מַלְאָךְ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמׇרְךָ֖ בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ וְלַהֲבִ֣יאֲךָ֔ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲכִנֹֽתִי׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy shlch ml'kh lpnykh lshmrkh bdrkh vlhby'kh 'lhmqvm 'shr hkhnty
verses.translation: Behold, I send an angel before thee, to keep thee by the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר מִפָּנָ֛יו וּשְׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹל֖וֹ אַל־תַּמֵּ֣ר בּ֑וֹ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ לְפִשְׁעֲכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שְׁמִ֖י בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hshmr mpnyv vshm' bqlv 'ltmr bv khy l' ysh' lpsh'khm khy shmy bqrbv
verses.translation: Take heed of him, and hearken unto his voice; be not rebellious against him; for he will not pardon your transgression; for My name is in him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקֹל֔וֹ וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאָֽיַבְתִּי֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ וְצַרְתִּ֖י אֶת־צֹרְרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khy 'mshmv' tshm' bqlv v'shyt khl 'shr 'dbr v'ybty 't'ybykh vtsrty 'ttsrrykh
verses.translation: But if thou shalt indeed hearken unto his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יֵלֵ֣ךְ מַלְאָכִי֮ לְפָנֶ֒יךָ֒ וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֗ אֶל־הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהַפְּרִזִּי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וְהִכְחַדְתִּֽיו׃
verses.translit: khyylkh ml'khy lpnykh vhby'kh 'lh'mry vhchty vhprzy vhkhn'ny hchvy vhybvsy vhkhchdtyv
verses.translation: For Mine angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֤ה לֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א תׇֽעׇבְדֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כְּמַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כִּ֤י הָרֵס֙ תְּהָ֣רְסֵ֔ם וְשַׁבֵּ֥ר תְּשַׁבֵּ֖ר מַצֵּבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: l'tshtchvh l'lhyhm vl' t'bdm vl' t'shh khm'shyhm khy hrs thrsm vshbr tshbr mtsbtyhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their doings; but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and break in pieces their pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵרַ֥ךְ אֶֽת־לַחְמְךָ֖ וְאֶת־מֵימֶ֑יךָ וַהֲסִרֹתִ֥י מַחֲלָ֖ה מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'bdtm 't yhvh 'lhykhm vbrkh 'tlchmkh v'tmymykh vhsrty mchlh mqrbkh {s}
verses.translation: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֛ה מְשַׁכֵּלָ֥ה וַעֲקָרָ֖ה בְּאַרְצֶ֑ךָ אֶת־מִסְפַּ֥ר יָמֶ֖יךָ אֲמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: l' thyh mshkhlh v'qrh b'rtskh 'tmspr ymykh 'ml'
verses.translation: None shall miscarry, nor be barren, in thy land; the number of thy days I will fulfil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־אֵֽימָתִי֙ אֲשַׁלַּ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהַמֹּתִי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖א בָּהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־כׇּל־אֹיְבֶ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ עֹֽרֶף׃
verses.translit: 't'ymty 'shlch lpnykh vhmty 'tkhlh'm 'shr tb' bhm vntty 'tkhl'ybykh 'lykh 'rf
verses.translation: I will send My terror before thee, and will discomfit all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֥י אֶת־הַצִּרְעָ֖ה לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְגֵרְשָׁ֗ה אֶת־הַחִוִּ֧י אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י וְאֶת־הַחִתִּ֖י מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vshlchty 'thtsr'h lpnykh vgrshh 'thchvy 'thkhn'ny v'thchty mlpnykh
verses.translation: And I will send the hornet before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֧א אֲגָרְשֶׁ֛נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ בְּשָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת פֶּן־תִּהְיֶ֤ה הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְרַבָּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: l' 'grshnv mpnykh bshnh 'cht pnthyh h'rts shmmh vrbh 'lykh chyt hshdh
verses.translation: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the field multiply against thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְעַ֥ט מְעַ֛ט אֲגָרְשֶׁ֖נּוּ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְרֶ֔ה וְנָחַלְתָּ֖ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: m't m't 'grshnv mpnykh 'd 'shr tprh vnchlt 'th'rts
verses.translation: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁתִּ֣י אֶת־גְּבֻלְךָ֗ מִיַּם־סוּף֙ וְעַד־יָ֣ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּמִמִּדְבָּ֖ר עַד־הַנָּהָ֑ר כִּ֣י  אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּיֶדְכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְגֵרַשְׁתָּ֖מוֹ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vshty 'tgblkh mymsvf v'dym plshtym vmmdbr 'dhnhr khy  'tn bydkhm 't yshby h'rts vgrshtmv mpnykh
verses.translation: And I will set thy border from the Red Sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness unto athe River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם וְלֵאלֹֽהֵיהֶ֖ם בְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: l'tkhrt lhm vl'lhyhm bryt
verses.translation: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יֵשְׁבוּ֙ בְּאַרְצְךָ֔ פֶּן־יַחֲטִ֥יאוּ אֹתְךָ֖ לִ֑י כִּ֤י תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l' yshbv b'rtskh pnychty'v 'tkh ly khy t'bd 't'lhyhm khyyhyh lkh lmvqsh {p}
verses.translation: They shall not dwell in thy land—lest they make thee sin against Me, for thou wilt serve their gods—for they will be a snare unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־מֹשֶׁ֨ה אָמַ֜ר עֲלֵ֣ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֗ה אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹן֙ נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם מֵרָחֹֽק׃
verses.translit: v'lmshh 'mr 'lh 'lyhvh 'th v'hrn ndb v'byhv' vshb'ym mzqny yshr'l vhshtchvytm mrchq
verses.translation: And unto Moses He said: ‘Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִגַּ֨שׁ מֹשֶׁ֤ה לְבַדּוֹ֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֣א יִגָּ֑שׁוּ וְהָעָ֕ם לֹ֥א יַעֲל֖וּ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vngsh mshh lbdv 'lyhvh vhm l' ygshv vh'm l' y'lv 'mv
verses.translation: and Moses alone shall come near unto the LORD; but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר לָעָם֙ אֵ֚ת כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים וַיַּ֨עַן כׇּל־הָעָ֜ם ק֤וֹל אֶחָד֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyb' mshh vyspr l'm 't khldbry yhvh v't khlhmshptym vy'n khlh'm qvl 'chd vy'mrv khlhdbrym 'shrdbr yhvh n'shh
verses.translation: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said: ‘All the words which the Lord hath spoken will we do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֚ת כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֣ם בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ תַּ֣חַת הָהָ֑ר וּשְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 't khldbry yhvh vyshkhm bbqr vybn mzbch tcht hhr vshtym 'shrh mtsbh lshnym 'shr shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the mount, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶֽת־נַעֲרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ עֹלֹ֑ת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֞וּ זְבָחִ֧ים שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַיהֹוָ֖ה פָּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tn'ry bny yshr'l vy'lv 'lt vyzbchv zbchym shlmym lyhvh prym
verses.translation: And he sent the young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt-offerings, and sacrificed peace-offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ חֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם בָּאַגָּנֹ֑ת וַחֲצִ֣י הַדָּ֔ם זָרַ֖ק עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh chtsy hdm vyshm b'gnt vchtsy hdm zrq 'lhmzbch
verses.translation: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he dashed against the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֥ה וְנִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: vyqch spr hbryt vyqr' b'zny h'm vy'mrv khl 'shrdbr yhvh n'shh vnshm'
verses.translation: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the hearing of the people; and they said: ‘All that the LORD hath spoken will we do, and obey.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וַיִּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֤ה דַֽם־הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם עַ֥ל כׇּל־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 'thdm vyzrq 'lh'm vy'mr hnh dmhbryt 'shr khrt yhvh 'mkhm 'l khlhdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said: ‘Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you in agreement with all these words.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים מִזִּקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshh v'hrn ndb v'byhv' vshb'ym mzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֕וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְתַ֣חַת רַגְלָ֗יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂה֙ לִבְנַ֣ת הַסַּפִּ֔יר וּכְעֶ֥צֶם הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָטֹֽהַר׃
verses.translit: vyr'v 't 'lhy yshr'l vtcht rglyv khm'shh lbnt hspyr vkh'tsm hshmym lthr
verses.translation: and they saw the God of Israel; and there was under His feet the like of a paved work of sapphire stone, and the like of the very heaven for clearness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־אֲצִילֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א שָׁלַ֖ח יָד֑וֹ וַיֶּֽחֱזוּ֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיֹּאכְל֖וּ וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'l'tsyly bny yshr'l l' shlch ydv vychzv 'th'lhym vy'khlv vyshtv {s}
verses.translation: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel He laid not His hand; and they beheld God, and did eat and drink.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֛י הָהָ֖רָה וֶהְיֵה־שָׁ֑ם וְאֶתְּנָ֨ה לְךָ֜ אֶת־לֻחֹ֣ת הָאֶ֗בֶן וְהַתּוֹרָה֙ וְהַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתַ֖בְתִּי לְהוֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh 'lh 'ly hhrh vhyhshm v'tnh lkh 'tlcht h'bn vhtvrh vhmtsvh 'shr khtbty lhvrtm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Come up to Me into the mount and be there; and I will give thee the tables of stone, and the law and the commandment, which I have written, that thou mayest teach them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ מְשָׁרְת֑וֹ וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqm mshh vyhvsh' mshrtv vy'l mshh 'lhr h'lhym
verses.translation: And Moses rose up, and Joshua his minister; and Moses went up into the mount of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הַזְּקֵנִ֤ים אָמַר֙ שְׁבוּ־לָ֣נוּ בָזֶ֔ה עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־נָשׁ֖וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְחוּר֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם מִי־בַ֥עַל דְּבָרִ֖ים יִגַּ֥שׁ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lhzqnym 'mr shbvlnv bzh 'd 'shrnshvb 'lykhm vhnh 'hrn vchvr 'mkhm myb'l dbrym ygsh 'lhm
verses.translation: And unto the elders he said: ‘Tarry ye here for us, until we come back unto you; and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you; whosoever hath a cause, let him come near unto them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הָהָ֑ר וַיְכַ֥ס הֶעָנָ֖ן אֶת־הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'l mshh 'lhhr vykhs h'nn 'thhr
verses.translation: And Moses went up into the mount, and the cloud covered the mount.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֤ן כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָה֙ עַל־הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַיְכַסֵּ֥הוּ הֶעָנָ֖ן שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י מִתּ֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyshkhn khbvdyhvh 'lhr syny vykhshv h'nn shsht ymym vyqr' 'lmshh byvm hshby'y mtvkh h'nn
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days; and the seventh day He called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַרְאֵה֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּאֵ֥שׁ אֹכֶ֖לֶת בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vmr'h khbvd yhvh kh'sh 'khlt br'sh hhr l'yny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the appearance of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הֶעָנָ֖ן וַיַּ֣עַל אֶל־הָהָ֑ר וַיְהִ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ בָּהָ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָֽיְלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyb' mshh btvkh h'nn vy'l 'lhhr vyhy mshh bhr 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh {p}
verses.translation: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mount; and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיִקְחוּ־לִ֖י תְּרוּמָ֑ה מֵאֵ֤ת כׇּל־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדְּבֶ֣נּוּ לִבּ֔וֹ תִּקְח֖וּ אֶת־תְּרוּמָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lbny yshr'l vyqchvly trvmh m't khl'ysh 'shr ydbnv lbv tqchv 'ttrvmty
verses.translation: ’Speak unto the children of Israel, that they take for Me an offering; of every man whose heart maketh him willing ye shall take My offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹאת֙ הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּקְח֖וּ מֵאִתָּ֑ם זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vz't htrvmh 'shr tqchv m'tm zhb vkhsf vnchsht
verses.translation: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vtkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh v'zym
verses.translation: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’hair;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאׇדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'rt 'ylm m'dmym v'rt tchshym v'tsy shtym
verses.translation: and rams’skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia-wood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּאֹ֑ר בְּשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shmn lm'r bshmym lshmn hmshchh vlqtrt hsmym
verses.translation: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֕הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפֹ֖ד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: 'bnyshhm v'bny ml'ym l'pd vlchshn
verses.translation: onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָ֥שׂוּ לִ֖י מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shv ly mqdsh vshkhnty btvkhm
verses.translation: And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּכֹ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתְךָ֔ אֵ֚ת תַּבְנִ֣ית הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת תַּבְנִ֣ית כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְכֵ֖ן תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khkhl 'shr 'ny mr'h 'vtkh 't tbnyt hmshkhn v't tbnyt khlkhlyv vkhn t'shv {s}
verses.translation: According to all that I show thee, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the furniture thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֥וּ אֲר֖וֹן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אׇרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shv 'rvn 'tsy shtym 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhv v'mh vchtsy rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And they shall make an ark of acacia-wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ תְּצַפֶּ֑נּוּ וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עָלָ֛יו זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr mbyt vmchvts ttspnv v'shyt 'lyv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצַ֣קְתָּ לּ֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וְנָ֣תַתָּ֔ה עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vytsqt lv 'rb' tb't zhb vntth 'l 'rb' p'mtyv vshty tb't 'ltsl'v h'cht vshty tb't 'ltsl'v hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four feet thereof; and two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בַדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'shyt bdy 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֥את אֶת־הָאָרֹ֖ן בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhb't 'thbdym btb't 'l tsl't h'rn lsh't 'th'rn bhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, wherewith to bear the ark.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטַבְּעֹת֙ הָאָרֹ֔ן יִהְי֖וּ הַבַּדִּ֑ים לֹ֥א יָסֻ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: btb't h'rn yhyv hbdym l' ysrv mmnv
verses.translation: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark; they shall not be taken from it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֖ אֶל־הָאָרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָעֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vntt 'lh'rn 't h'dt 'shr 'tn 'lykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ כַפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אׇרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רׇחְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt khprt zhb thvr 'mtym vchtsy 'rkhh v'mh vchtsy rchbh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an ark-cover of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ שְׁנַ֥יִם כְּרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt shnym khrbym zhb mqshh t'shh 'tm mshny qtsvt hkhprt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make two cherubim of gold; of beaten work shalt thou make them, at the two ends of the ark-cover.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠עֲשֵׂ֠ה כְּר֨וּב אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֶת־הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'shh khrvb 'chd mqtsh mzh vkhrvb'chd mqtsh mzh mnhkhprt t'shv 'thkhrbym 'lshny qtsvtyv
verses.translation: And make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end; of one piece with the ark-cover shall ye make the cherubim of the two ends thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו אֶ֨ל־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת יִהְי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyv hkhrbym prshy khnpym lm'lh skhkhym bkhnpyhm 'lhkhprt vpnyhm 'ysh 'l'chyv 'lhkhprt yhyv pny hkhrbym
verses.translation: And the cherubim shall spread out their wings on high, screening the ark-cover with their wings, with their faces one to another; toward the ark-cover shall the faces of the cherubim be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עַל־הָאָרֹ֖ן מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְאֶל־הָ֣אָרֹ֔ן תִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶתֵּ֖ן אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vntt 'thkhprt 'lh'rn mlm'lh v'lh'rn ttn 'th'dt 'shr 'tn 'lykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the ark-cover above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנוֹעַדְתִּ֣י לְךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְדִבַּרְתִּ֨י אִתְּךָ֜ מֵעַ֣ל הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת מִבֵּין֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֲצַוֶּ֛ה אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnv'dty lkh shm vdbrty 'tkh m'l hkhprt mbyn shny hkhrbym 'shr 'l'rvn h'dt 't khl'shr 'tsvh 'vtkh 'lbny yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And there I will meet with thee, and I will speak with thee from above the ark-cover, from between the two cherubim which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ שֻׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אׇרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רׇחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt shlchn 'tsy shtym 'mtym 'rkhv v'mh rchbv v'mh vchtsy qmtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a table of acacia-wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr v'shyt lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ לּ֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ זֵר־זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: v'shyt lv msgrt tpch sbyb v'shyt zrzhb lmsgrtv sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make unto it a border of a handbreadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'shyt lv 'rb' tb't zhb vntt 'thtb't 'l 'rb' hp't 'shr l'rb' rglyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.translit: l'mt hmsgrt thyyn htb't lbtym lbdym lsh't 'thshlchn
verses.translation: Close by the border shall the rings be, for places for the staves to bear the table.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְנִשָּׂא־בָ֖ם אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'thbdym 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb vnsh'bm 'thshlchn
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ קְּעָרֹתָ֜יו וְכַפֹּתָ֗יו וּקְשׂוֹתָיו֙ וּמְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shyt q'rtyv vkhptyv vqshvtyv vmnqytyv 'shr yskh bhn zhb thvr t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and the pans thereof, and the jars thereof, and the bowls thereof, wherewith to pour out; of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֧ עַֽל־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֛ן לֶ֥חֶם פָּנִ֖ים לְפָנַ֥י תָּמִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntt 'lhshlchn lchm pnym lpny tmyd {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt set upon the table showbread before Me always.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מְנֹרַ֖ת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה תֵּעָשֶׂ֤ה הַמְּנוֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt mnrt zhb thvr mqshh t'shh hmnvrh yrkhh vqnh gby'yh khptryh vprchyh mmnh yhyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made, even its base, and its shaft; its cups, its knops, and its flowers, shall be of one piece with it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה  קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vshshh qnym yts'ym mtsdyh shlshh  qny mnrh mtsdh h'chd vshlshh qny mnrh mtsdh hshny
verses.translation: And there shall be six branches going out of the sides thereof: three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candle-stick out of the other side thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִ֠ים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶ֒רַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בַּקָּנֶ֥ה הָאֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch vshlshh gb'ym mshqdym bqnh h'chd khptr vprch khn lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mnhmnrh
verses.translation: three cups made like almond-blossoms in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three cups made like almond-blossoms in the other branch, a knop and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vbmnrh 'rb'h gb'ym mshqdym khptryh vprchyh
verses.translation: And in the candlestick four cups made like almond-blossoms, the knops thereof, and the flowers thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּ֩חַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּחַת־שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tcht shny hqnym mmnh vkhptr tchtshny hqnym mmnh lshsht hqnym hyts'ym mnhmnrh
verses.translation: And a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, and a knop under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the candlestick.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: khptryhm vqntm mmnh yhyv khlh mqshh 'cht zhb thvr
verses.translation: Their knops and their branches shall be of one piece with it; the whole of it one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וְהֶֽעֱלָה֙ אֶת־נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהֵאִ֖יר עַל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'tnrtyh shb'h vh'lh 'tnrtyh vh'yr 'l'br pnyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the lamps thereof, seven; and they shall light the lamps thereof, to give light over against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vmlqchyh vmchttyh zhb thvr
verses.translation: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ אֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַכֵּלִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: khkhr zhb thvr y'shh 'th 't khlhkhlym h'lh
verses.translation: Of a talent of pure gold shall it be made, with all these vessels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְאֵ֖ה וַעֲשֵׂ֑ה בְּתַ֨בְנִיתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה מׇרְאֶ֖ה בָּהָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vr'h v'shh btbnytm 'shr'th mr'h bhr {s}
verses.translation: And see that thou make them after their pattern, which is being shown thee in the mount.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'thmshkhn t'shh 'shr yry't shsh mshzr vtkhlt v'rgmn vtl't shny khrbym m'shh chshb t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains: of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim the work of the skilful workman shalt thou make them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ  הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכׇל־הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'rkh  hyry'h h'cht shmnh v'shrym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht lkhlhyry't
verses.translation: The length of each curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֙יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֑הּ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: chmsh hyry't thyyn chbrt 'shh 'l'chth vchmsh yry't chbrt 'shh 'l'chth
verses.translation: Five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and the other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וְכֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: v'shyt ll't tkhlt 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht mqtsh bchbrt vkhn t'shh bshpt hyry'h hqytsvnh bmchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the first set; and likewise shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is outmost in the second set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: chmshym ll't t'shh byry'h h'cht vchmshym ll't t'shh bqtsh hyry'h 'shr bmchbrt hshnyt mqbylt hll't 'shh 'l'chth
verses.translation: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the second set; the loops shall be opposite one to another.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְחִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶת־הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָהּ֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'shyt chmshym qrsy zhb vchbrt 'thyry't 'shh 'l'chth bqrsym vhyh hmshkhn 'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains one to another with the clasps, that the tabernacle may be one whole.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shyt yry't 'zym l'hl 'lhmshkhn 'shty'shrh yry't t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’hair for a tent over the tabernacle; eleven curtains shalt thou make them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ  הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.translit: 'rkh  hyry'h h'cht shlshym b'mh vrchb 'rb' b'mh hyry'h h'cht mdh 'cht l'shty 'shrh yry't
verses.translation: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of each curtain four cubits; the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת־חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַיְרִיעֹת֙ לְבָ֔ד וְאֶת־שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְכָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל־מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vchbrt 'tchmsh hyry't lbd v'tshsh hyry't lbd vkhplt 'thyry'h hshshyt 'lmvl pny h'hl
verses.translation: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.translit: v'shyt chmshym ll't 'l shpt hyry'h h'cht hqytsnh bchbrt vchmshym ll't 'l shpt hyry'h hchbrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the first set, and fifty loops upon the edge of the curtain which is outmost in the second set.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־הַקְּרָסִים֙ בַּלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְחִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת־הָאֹ֖הֶל וְהָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'shyt qrsy nchsht chmshym vhb't 'thqrsym bll't vchbrt 'th'hl vhyh 'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסֶ֙רַח֙ הָעֹדֵ֔ף בִּירִיעֹ֖ת הָאֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָעֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: vsrch h'df byry't h'hl chtsy hyry'h h'dpt tsrch 'l 'chry hmshkhn
verses.translation: And as for the overhanging part that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth over shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאַמָּ֨ה מִזֶּ֜ה וְהָאַמָּ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ בָּעֹדֵ֔ף בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל־צִדֵּ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vh'mh mzh vh'mh mzh b'df b'rkh yry't h'hl yhyh srvch 'ltsdy hmshkhn mzh vmzh lkhstv
verses.translation: And the cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remaineth over in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאׇדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shyt mkhsh l'hl 'rt 'ylm m'dmym vmkhsh 'rt tchshym mlm'lh {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’skins dyed red and a covering of sealskins above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'thqrshym lmshkhn 'tsy shtym 'mdym
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia-wood, standing up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'mvt 'rkh hqrsh v'mh vchtsy h'mh rchb hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the breadth of each board.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁ֨לָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־אֲחֹתָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.translit: shty ydvt lqrsh h'chd mshlbt 'shh 'l'chth khn t'shh lkhl qrshy hmshkhn
verses.translation: Two tenons shall there be in each board, joined one to another; thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'thqrshym lmshkhn 'shrym qrsh lp't ngbh tymnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnykhsf t'shh tcht 'shrym hqrsh shny 'dnym tchthqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv vshny 'dnym tchthqrsh h'chd lshty ydtyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vltsl' hmshkhn hshnyt lp't tspvn 'shrym qrsh
verses.translation: and for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'rb'ym 'dnyhm khsf shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: And their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vlyrkhty hmshkhn ymh t'shh shshh qrshym
verses.translation: And for the hinder part of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vshny qrshym t'shh lmqts't hmshkhn byrkhtym
verses.translation: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the hinder part.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַ֒טָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhyv t'mm mlmth vychdv yhyv tmym 'lr'shv 'lhtb't h'cht khn yhyh lshnyhm lshny hmqts't yhyv
verses.translation: And they shall be double beneath, and in like manner they shall be complete unto the top thereof unto the first ring; thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyv shmnh qrshym v'dnyhm khsf shshh 'shr 'dnym shny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd vshny 'dnym tcht hqrsh h'chd
verses.translation: Thus there shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'shyt brychm 'tsy shtym chmshh lqrshy tsl'hmshkhn h'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make bars of acacia-wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl'hmshkhn hshnyt vchmshh brychm lqrshy tsl' hmshkhn lyrkhtym ymh
verses.translation: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the hinder part westward;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן־הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־הַקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhbrych htykhn btvkh hqrshym mbrch mnhqtsh 'lhqtsh
verses.translation: and the middle bar in the midst of the boards, which shall pass through from end to end.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת־הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'thqrshym ttsph zhb v'ttb'tyhm t'shh zhb btym lbrychm vtspyt 'thbrychm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for holders for the bars; and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הׇרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhqmt 'thmshkhn khmshptv 'shr hr'yt bhr {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which hath been shown thee in the mount.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'shyt prkht tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb y'shh 'th khrbym
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; with cherubim the work of the skilful workman shall it be made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל־אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־כָֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: vntth 'th 'l'rb'h 'mvdy shtym mtspym zhb vvyhm zhb 'l'rb'h 'dnykhsf
verses.translation: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold, their hooks being of gold, upon four sockets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת־הַפָּרֹ֘כֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֙כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vntth 'thprkht tcht hqrsym vhb't shmh mbyt lprkht 't 'rvn h'dvt vhbdylh hprkht lkhm byn hqdsh vbyn qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the clasps, and shalt bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony; and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vntt 'thkhprt 'l 'rvn h'dt bqdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the ark-cover upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vshmt 'thshlchn mchvts lprkht v'thmnrh nkhch hshlchn 'l tsl' hmshkhn tymnh vhshlchn ttn 'ltsl' tspvn
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shyt mskh lptch h'hl tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the weaver in colours.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'shyt lmskh chmshh 'mvdy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb vvyhm zhb vytsqt lhm chmshh 'dny nchsht {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold; their hooks shall be of gold; and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'thmzbch 'tsy shtym chmsh 'mvt 'rkh vchmsh 'mvt rchb rbv' yhyh hmzbch vshlsh 'mvt qmtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the altar of acacia-wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be four-square; and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt qrntyv 'l 'rb' pntyv mmnv thyyn qrntyv vtspyt 'tv nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof; the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it; and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכׇל־כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt syrtyv ldshnv vy'yv vmzrqtyv vmzlgtyv vmchttyv lkhlkhlyv t'shh nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make its pots to take away its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pans; all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ לּוֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־הָרֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v'shyt lv mkhbr m'shh rsht nchsht v'shyt 'lhrsht 'rb' tb't nchsht 'l 'rb' qtsvtyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make for it a grating of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brazen rings in the four corners thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִלְּמָ֑טָּה וְהָיְתָ֣ה הָרֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vntth 'th tcht khrkhb hmzbch mlmth vhyth hrsht 'd chtsy hmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it under the ledge round the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt bdym lmzbch bdy 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm nchsht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּבָ֥א אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו בַּטַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְהָי֣וּ הַבַּדִּ֗ים עַל־שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּשְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhvb' 'tbdyv btb't vhyv hbdym 'lshty tsl't hmzbch bsh't 'tv
verses.translation: And the staves thereof shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, in bearing it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְךָ֛ בָּהָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: nbvb lcht t'shh 'tv kh'shr hr'h 'tkh bhr khn y'shv {s}
verses.translation: Hollow with planks shalt thou make it; as it hath been shown thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִפְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב־תֵּ֠ימָ֠נָה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶחָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽאַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַפֵּאָ֖ה הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 't chtsr hmshkhn lp't ngbtymnh ql'ym lchtsr shsh mshzr m'h b'mh 'rkh lp'h h'cht
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen a hundred cubits long for one side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'mdyv 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And the pillars thereof shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֨ן לִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּאֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ וְעַמֻּדָ֣ו עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: vkhn lp't tspvn b'rkh ql'ym m'h 'rkh v'mdv 'shrym v'dnyhm 'shrym nchsht vvy h'mdym vchshqyhm khsf
verses.translation: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings a hundred cubits long, and the pillars thereof twenty, and their sockets twenty, of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
