verses.original: וְרֹ֤חַב הֶֽחָצֵר֙ לִפְאַת־יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrchb hchtsr lp'tym ql'ym chmshym 'mh 'mdyhm 'shrh v'dnyhm 'shrh
verses.translation: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר לִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vrchb hchtsr lp't qdmh mzrchh chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vchmsh 'shrh 'mh ql'ym lkhtf 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: The hangings for the one side [of the gate] shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַכָּתֵף֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vlkhtf hshnyt chmsh 'shrh ql'ym 'mdyhm shlshh v'dnyhm shlshh
verses.translation: And for the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְשַׁ֨עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ  עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlsh'r hchtsr mskh  'shrym 'mh tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh rqm 'mdyhm 'rb'h v'dnyhm 'rb'h
verses.translation: And for the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the weaver in colours: their pillars four, and their sockets four.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: khl'mvdy hchtsr sbyb mchshqym khsf vvyhm khsf v'dnyhm nchsht
verses.translation: All the pillars of the court round about shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽאַמָּ֜ה וְרֹ֣חַב  חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְקֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֑ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: 'rkh hchtsr m'h b'mh vrchb  chmshym bchmshym vqmh chmsh 'mvt shsh mshzr v'dnyhm nchsht
verses.translation: The length of the court shall be a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑וֹ וְכׇל־יְתֵדֹתָ֛יו וְכׇל־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lkhl khly hmshkhn bkhl 'bdtv vkhlytdtyv vkhlytdt hchtsr nchsht {s}
verses.translation: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה  אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: v'th ttsvh  'tbny yshr'l vyqchv 'lykh shmn zyt zkh khtyt lm'vr lh'lt nr tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: b'hl mv'd mchvts lprkht 'shr 'lh'dt y'rkh 'tv 'hrn vbnyv m'rb 'dbqr lpny yhvh chqt 'vlm ldrtm m't bny yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: In the tent of meeting, without the veil which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall set it in order, to burn from evening to morning before the LORD; it shall be a statute for ever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶ֩יךָ֩ אֶת־אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜יךָ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֗וֹ מִתּ֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִ֑י אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַאֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְאִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: v'th hqrb 'lykh 't'hrn 'chykh v'tbnyv 'tv mtvkh bny yshr'l lkhhnvly 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr bny 'hrn
verses.translation: And bring thou near unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that they may minister unto Me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בִגְדֵי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֑יךָ לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt bgdyqdsh l'hrn 'chykh lkhbvd vltp'rt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, for splendour and for beauty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־כׇּל־חַכְמֵי־לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּאתִ֖יו ר֣וּחַ חׇכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן לְקַדְּשׁ֖וֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th tdbr 'lkhlchkhmylb 'shr ml'tyv rvch chkhmh v'shv 'tbgdy 'hrn lqdshv lkhhnvly
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s garments to sanctify him, that he may minister unto Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה הַבְּגָדִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשׂ֗וּ חֹ֤שֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד֙ וּמְעִ֔יל וּכְתֹ֥נֶת תַּשְׁבֵּ֖ץ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת וְאַבְנֵ֑ט וְעָשׂ֨וּ בִגְדֵי־קֹ֜דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֛יךָ וּלְבָנָ֖יו לְכַהֲנוֹ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'lh hbgdym 'shr y'shv chshn v'pvd vm'yl vkhtnt tshbts mtsnpt v'bnt v'shv bgdyqdsh l'hrn 'chykh vlbnyv lkhhnvly
verses.translation: And these are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a tunic of chequer work, a mitre, and a girdle; and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵם֙ יִקְח֣וּ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־הַתְּכֵ֖לֶת וְאֶת־הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֑ן וְאֶת־תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhm yqchv 'thzhb v'thtkhlt v'th'rgmn v'ttvl't hshny v'thshsh {p}
verses.translation: And they shall take the gold, and the blue, and the purple, and the scarlet, and the fine linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֖וּ אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָ֠הָ֠ב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן תּוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: v'shv 'th'pd zhb tkhlt v'rgmn tvl't shny vshsh mshzr m'shh chshb
verses.translation: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the skilful workman.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֧י כְתֵפֹ֣ת חֹֽבְרֹ֗ת יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֛וֹ אֶל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖יו וְחֻבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: shty khtpt chbrt yhyhlv 'lshny qtsvtyv vchbr
verses.translation: It shall have two shoulder-pieces joined to the two ends thereof, that it may be joined together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֵ֤שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יִהְיֶ֑ה זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָֽר׃
verses.translit: vchshb 'pdtv 'shr 'lyv khm'shhv mmnv yhyh zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr
verses.translation: And the skilfully woven band, which is upon it, wherewith to gird it on, shall be like the work thereof and of the same piece: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֖י אַבְנֵי־שֹׁ֑הַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tshty 'bnyshhm vptcht 'lyhm shmvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ מִשְּׁמֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל הָאֶ֣בֶן הָאֶחָ֑ת וְאֶת־שְׁמ֞וֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁ֧ה הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־הָאֶ֥בֶן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: shshh mshmtm 'l h'bn h'cht v'tshmvt hshshh hnvtrym 'lh'bn hshnyt khtvldtm
verses.translation: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the six that remain on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חָרַשׁ֮ אֶ֒בֶן֒ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֗ם תְּפַתַּח֙ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֔ים עַל־שְׁמֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֻסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: m'shh chrsh 'bn ptvchy chtm tptch 'tshty h'bnym 'lshmt bny yshr'l msbt mshbtsvt zhb t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones, according to the names of the children of Israel; thou shalt make them to be inclosed in settings of gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֞ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֗ים עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּרֹ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנָשָׂא֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־שְׁמוֹתָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה עַל־שְׁתֵּ֥י כְתֵפָ֖יו לְזִכָּרֹֽן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshmt 'tshty h'bnym 'l khtpt h'pd 'bny zkhrn lbny yshr'l vnsh' 'hrn 'tshmvtm lpny yhvh 'lshty khtpyv lzkhrn {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֖ת זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'shyt mshbtst zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make settings of gold;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֤י שַׁרְשְׁרֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִגְבָּלֹ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה אֶת־שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת הָעֲבֹתֹ֖ת עַל־הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹֽת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vshty shrshrt zhb thvr mgblt t'shh 'tm m'shh 'bt vntth 'tshrshrt h'btt 'lhmshbtst {s}
verses.translation: and two chains of pure gold; of plaited thread shalt thou make them, of wreathen work; and thou shalt put the wreathen chains on the settings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֹ֤שֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חֹשֵׁ֔ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֵפֹ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֑נּוּ זָ֠הָ֠ב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מׇשְׁזָ֖ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt chshn mshpt m'shh chshb khm'shh 'pd t'shnv zhb tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny vshsh mshzr t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a breastplate of judgment, the work of the skilful workman; like the work of the ephod thou shalt make it: of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָב֥וּעַ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה כָּפ֑וּל זֶ֥רֶת אׇרְכּ֖וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רׇחְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: rbv' yhyh khpvl zrt 'rkhv vzrt rchbv
verses.translation: Four-square it shall be and double: a span shall be the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ בוֹ֙ מִלֻּ֣אַת אֶ֔בֶן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה טוּרִ֣ים אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vml't bv ml't 'bn 'rb'h tvrym 'bn tvr 'dm ptdh vbrqt htvr h'chd
verses.translation: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, four rows of stones: a row of carnelian, topaz, and smaragd shall be the first row;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hshny npkh spyr vyhlm
verses.translation: and the second row a carbuncle, a sapphire, and an emerald;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hshlyshy lshm shbv v'chlmh
verses.translation: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ וְשֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מְשֻׁבָּצִ֥ים זָהָ֛ב יִהְי֖וּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhtvr hrby'y trshysh vshhm vyshph mshbtsym zhb yhyv bmlv'tm
verses.translation: and the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be inclosed in gold in their settings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִ֠ים תִּֽהְיֶ֜יןָ עַל־שְׁמֹ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חוֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֕יןָ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃
verses.translit: vh'bnym thyyn 'lshmt bnyyshr'l shtym 'shrh 'lshmtm ptvchy chvtm 'ysh 'lshmv thyyn lshny 'shr shbt
verses.translation: And the stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'lhchshn shrsht gblt m'shh 'bt zhb thvr
verses.translation: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate plaited chains of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עַל־הַחֹ֔שֶׁן שְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֗ אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּע֔וֹת עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'lhchshn shty tb'vt zhb vntt 'tshty htb'vt 'lshny qtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֗ה אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ עֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת אֶל־קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃
verses.translit: vntth 'tshty 'btt hzhb 'lshty htb't 'lqtsvt hchshn
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold on the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲבֹתֹ֔ת תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֑וֹת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־כִּתְפ֥וֹת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: v't shty qtsvt shty h'btt ttn 'lshty hmshbtsvt vntth 'lkhtpvt h'pd 'lmvl pnyv
verses.translation: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, in the forepart thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֗יתָ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֔ב וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: v'shyt shty tb'vt zhb vshmt 'tm 'lshny qtsvt hchshn 'lshptv 'shr 'l'br h'pd byth
verses.translation: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate, upon the edge thereof, which is toward the side of the ephod inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֘יתָ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָב֒ וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפ֨וֹת הָאֵפ֤וֹד מִלְּמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מַחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: v'shyt shty tb'vt zhb vntth 'tm 'lshty khtpvt h'pvd mlmth mmvl pnyv l'mt mchbrtv mm'l lchshb h'pvd
verses.translation: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and shalt put them on the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod underneath, in the forepart thereof, close by the coupling thereof, above the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַ֠חֹ֠שֶׁן מִֽטַּבְּעֹתָ֞ו אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֤ת הָאֵפוֹד֙ בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לִֽהְי֖וֹת עַל־חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפ֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vyrkhsv 'thchshn mtb'tv 'ltb't h'pvd bptyl tkhlt lhyvt 'lchshb h'pvd vl'yzch hchshn m'l h'pvd
verses.translation: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a thread of blue, that it may be upon the skilfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹ֠ן אֶת־שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּחֹ֧שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל־לִבּ֖וֹ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹ֥ן לִפְנֵֽי־יְהֹוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vnsh' 'hrn 'tshmvt bnyyshr'l bchshn hmshpt 'llbv bb'v 'lhqdsh lzkhrn lpnyyhvh tmyd
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ אֶל־חֹ֣שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט אֶת־הָאוּרִים֙ וְאֶת־הַתֻּמִּ֔ים וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־לֵ֣ב אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּבֹא֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹ֠ן אֶת־מִשְׁפַּ֨ט בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל עַל־לִבּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vntt 'lchshn hmshpt 'th'vrym v'thtmym vhyv 'llb 'hrn bb'v lpny yhvh vnsh' 'hrn 'tmshpt bnyyshr'l 'llbv lpny yhvh tmyd {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goeth in before the LORD; and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ אֶת־מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפ֖וֹד כְּלִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'tm'yl h'pvd khlyl tkhlt
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה פִֽי־רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ שָׂפָ֡ה יִֽהְיֶה֩ לְפִ֨יו סָבִ֜יב מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֗ג כְּפִ֥י תַחְרָ֛א יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vhyh pyr'shv btvkhv shph yhyh lpyv sbyb m'shh 'rg khpy tchr' yhyhlv l' yqr'
verses.translation: And it shall have a hole for the head in the midst thereof; it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of a coat of mail that it be not rent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־שׁוּלָ֗יו רִמֹּנֵי֙ תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י עַל־שׁוּלָ֖יו סָבִ֑יב וּפַעֲמֹנֵ֥י זָהָ֛ב בְּתוֹכָ֖ם סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'lshvlyv rmny tkhlt v'rgmn vtvl't shny 'lshvlyv sbyb vp'mny zhb btvkhm sbyb
verses.translation: And upon the skirts of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the skirts thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן זָהָב֙ וְרִמּ֔וֹן פַּֽעֲמֹ֥ן זָהָ֖ב וְרִמּ֑וֹן עַל־שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: p'mn zhb vrmvn p'mn zhb vrmvn 'lshvly hm'yl sbyb
verses.translation: a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the skirts of the robe round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה עַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְשָׁרֵ֑ת וְנִשְׁמַ֣ע ק֠וֹל֠וֹ בְּבֹא֨וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה וּבְצֵאת֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh 'l'hrn lshrt vnshm' qvlv bb'v 'lhqdsh lpny yhvh vbts'tv vl' ymvt {s}
verses.translation: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister; and the sound thereof shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ צִּ֖יץ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ֤ עָלָיו֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shyt tsyts zhb thvr vptcht 'lyv ptvchy chtm qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and engrave upon it, like the engravings of a signet: HOLY TO THE LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְהָיָ֖ה עַל־הַמִּצְנָ֑פֶת אֶל־מ֥וּל פְּנֵֽי־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmt 'tv 'lptyl tkhlt vhyh 'lhmtsnpt 'lmvl pnyhmtsnpt yhyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it on a thread of blue, and it shall be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ עַל־מֵ֣צַח אַהֲרֹן֒ וְנָשָׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־עֲוֺ֣ן הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְכׇֽל־מַתְּנֹ֖ת קׇדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה עַל־מִצְחוֹ֙ תָּמִ֔יד לְרָצ֥וֹן לָהֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'lmtsch 'hrn vnsh' 'hrn 't'vn hqdshym 'shr yqdyshv bny yshr'l lkhlmtnt qdshyhm vhyh 'lmtschv tmyd lrtsvn lhm lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall be upon Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall bear the iniquity committed in the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow, even in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֙ הַכְּתֹ֣נֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאַבְנֵ֥ט תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vshbtst hkhtnt shsh v'shyt mtsnpt shsh v'bnt t'shh m'shh rqm
verses.translation: And thou shalt weave the tunic in chequer work of fine linen, and thou shalt make a mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make a girdle, the work of the weaver in colours.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֻתֳּנֹ֔ת וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם אַבְנֵטִ֑ים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn t'shh khtnt v'shyt lhm 'bntym vmgb'vt t'shh lhm lkhbvd vltp'rt
verses.translation: And for Aaron’s sons thou shalt make tunics, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and head-tires shalt thou make for them, for splendour and for beauty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת־יָדָ֛ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם וְכִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhlbsht 'tm 't'hrn 'chykh v'tbnyv 'tv vmshcht 'tm vml't 'tydm vqdsht 'tm vkhhnv ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and upon his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשֵׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִכְנְסֵי־בָ֔ד לְכַסּ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֣ר עֶרְוָ֑ה מִמׇּתְנַ֥יִם וְעַד־יְרֵכַ֖יִם יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'shh lhm mkhnsybd lkhsvt bshr 'rvh mmtnym v'dyrkhym yhyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover the flesh of their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם  אֶל־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְלֹא־יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָמֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖וֹ וּלְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyv 'l'hrn v'lbnyv bb'm  'l'hl mv'd 'v bgshtm 'lhmzbch lshrt bqdsh vl'ysh'v 'vn vmtv chqt 'vlm lv vlzr'v 'chryv {s}
verses.translation: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they go in unto the tent of meeting, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die; it shall be a statute for ever unto him and unto his seed after him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י לְ֠קַ֠ח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם׃
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shrt'shh lhm lqdsh 'tm lkhhn ly lqch pr 'chd bnbqr v'ylm shnym tmymm
verses.translation: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto Me in the priest’s office: take one young bullock and two rams without blemish,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vlchm mtsvt vchlt mtst blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn slt chtym t'shh 'tm
verses.translation: and unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened mingled with oil, and wafers unleavened spread with oil; of fine wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ אוֹתָם֙ עַל־סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּסָּ֑ל וְאֶ֨ת־הַפָּ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֵילִֽם׃
verses.translit: vntt 'vtm 'lsl 'chd vhqrbt 'tm bsl v'thpr v't shny h'ylm
verses.translation: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v't'hrn v'tbnyv tqryb 'lptch 'hl mv'd vrchtst 'tm bmym
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tent of meeting, and shalt wash them with water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֗ים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְאֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְאֶת־הָאֵפֹ֖ד וְאֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ֣ ל֔וֹ בְּחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'thbgdym vhlbsht 't'hrn 'thkhtnt v't m'yl h'pd v'th'pd v'thchshn v'pdt lv bchshb h'pd
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the tunic, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the skilfully woven band of the ephod.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְנָתַתָּ֛ אֶת־נֵ֥זֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל־הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת׃
verses.translit: vshmt hmtsnpt 'lr'shv vntt 'tnzr hqdsh 'lhmtsnpt
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְיָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tshmn hmshchh vytsqt 'lr'shv vmshcht 'tv
verses.translation: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃
verses.translit: v'tbnyv tqryb vhlbshtm khtnt
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put tunics upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ יַֽד־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְיַד־בָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vchgrt 'tm 'bnt 'hrn vbnyv vchbsht lhm mgb't vhyth lhm khhnh lchqt 'vlm vml't yd'hrn vydbnyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and bind head-tires on them; and they shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute; and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַפָּ֔ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vhqrbt 'thpr lpny 'hl mv'd vsmkh 'hrn vbnyv 'tydyhm 'lr'sh hpr
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the bullock before the tent of meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vshchtt 'thpr lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־קַרְנֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הַדָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht mdm hpr vntth 'lqrnt hmzbch b'tsb'kh v'tkhlhdm tshpkh 'lysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger; and thou shalt pour out all the remaining blood at the base of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת־כׇּל־הַחֵ֘לֶב֮ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֒רֶב֒ וְאֵ֗ת הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tkhlhchlb hmkhsh 'thqrb v't hytrt 'lhkhbd v't shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lyhn vhqtrt hmzbchh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the lobe above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and make them smoke upon the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בְּשַׂ֤ר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־עֹר֣וֹ וְאֶת־פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'tbshr hpr v't'rv v'tprshv tshrf b'sh mchvts lmchnh cht't hv'
verses.translation: But the flesh of the bullock, and its skin, and its dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp; it is a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הָאַ֥יִל הָאֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: v'th'yl h'chd tqch vsmkhv 'hrn vbnyv 'tydyhm 'lr'sh h'yl
verses.translation: Thou shalt also take the one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת־הָאָ֑יִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vshchtt 'th'yl vlqcht 'tdmv vzrqt 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take its blood, and dash it round about against the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶ֨ת־הָאַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִנְתָחָ֑יו וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבּוֹ֙ וּכְרָעָ֔יו וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־נְתָחָ֖יו וְעַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th'yl tntch lntchyv vrchtst qrbv vkhr'yv vntt 'lntchyv v'lr'shv
verses.translation: And thou shalt cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its inwards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת־כׇּל־הָאַ֙יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vhqtrt 'tkhlh'yl hmzbchh 'lh hv' lyhvh rych nychvch 'shh lyhvh hv'
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the whole ram smoke upon the altar; it is a burnt-offering unto the LORD; it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 't h'yl hshny vsmkh 'hrn vbnyv 'tydyhm 'lr'sh h'yl
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vshchtt 'th'yl vlqcht mdmv vntth 'ltnvkh 'zn 'hrn v'ltnvkh 'zn bnyv hymnyt v'lbhn ydm hymnyt v'lbhn rglm hymnyt vzrqt 'thdm 'lhmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of its blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and dash the blood against the altar round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֘חַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht mnhdm 'shr 'lhmzbch vmshmn hmshchh vhzyt 'l'hrn v'lbgdyv v'lbnyv v'lbgdy bnyv 'tv vqdsh hv' vbgdyv vbnyv vbgdy bnyv 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him; and he and his garments shall be hallowed, and his sons and his sons’garments with him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־הָ֠אַ֠יִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב  הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת  שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vlqcht mnh'yl hchlb vh'lyh v'thchlb  hmkhsh 'thqrb v't ytrt hkhbd v't  shty hkhlyt v'thchlb 'shr 'lyhn v't shvq hymyn khy 'yl ml'ym hv'
verses.translation: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat, and the fat tail, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right thigh; for it is a ram of consecration;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhkhr lchm 'cht vchlt lchm shmn 'cht vrqyq 'chd msl hmtsvt 'shr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmt hkhl 'l khpy 'hrn v'l khpy bnyv vhnpt 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put the whole upon the hands of Aaron, and upon the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave-offering before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיח֙וֹחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tm mydm vhqtrt hmzbchh 'lh'lh lrych nychvch lpny yhvh 'shh hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take them from their hands, and make them smoke on the altar upon the burnt-offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 'thchzh m'yl hml'ym 'shr l'hrn vhnpt 'tv tnvph lpny yhvh vhyh lkh lmnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave-offering before the LORD; and it shall be thy portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת  חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vqdsht 't  chzh htnvph v't shvq htrvmh 'shr hvnf v'shr hvrm m'yl hml'ym m'shr l'hrn vm'shr lbnyv
verses.translation: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave-offering, and the thigh of the heave-offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is Aaron’s, and of that which is his sons’.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחׇק־עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh l'hrn vlbnyv lchq'vlm m't bny yshr'l khy trvmh hv' vtrvmh yhyh m't bnyyshr'l mzbchy shlmyhm trvmtm lyhvh
verses.translation: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons as a due for ever from the children of Israel; for it is a heave-offering; and it shall be a heave-offering from the children of Israel of their sacrifices of peace-offerings, even their heave-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבִגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן יִהְי֥וּ לְבָנָ֖יו אַחֲרָ֑יו לְמׇשְׁחָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם וּלְמַלֵּא־בָ֖ם אֶת־יָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbgdy hqdsh 'shr l'hrn yhyv lbnyv 'chryv lmshchh bhm vlml'bm 'tydm
verses.translation: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יִלְבָּשָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תַּחְתָּ֖יו מִבָּנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֛א אֶל־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֥ת בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: shb't ymym ylbshm hkhhn tchtyv mbnyv 'shr yb' 'l'hl mv'd lshrt bqdsh
verses.translation: Seven days shall the son that is priest in his stead put them on, even he who cometh into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת אֵ֥יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֖ים תִּקָּ֑ח וּבִשַּׁלְתָּ֥ אֶת־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בְּמָקֹ֥ם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: v't 'yl hml'ym tqch vbshlt 'tbshrv bmqm qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the ram of consecration, and seethe its flesh in a holy place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכַ֨ל אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־בְּשַׂ֣ר הָאַ֔יִל וְאֶת־הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: v'khl 'hrn vbnyv 'tbshr h'yl v'thlchm 'shr bsl ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the tent of meeting.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָכְל֤וּ אֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֻּפַּ֣ר בָּהֶ֔ם לְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־יָדָ֖ם לְקַדֵּ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑ם וְזָ֥ר לֹא־יֹאכַ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'khlv 'tm 'shr khpr bhm lml' 'tydm lqdsh 'tm vzr l'y'khl khyqdsh hm
verses.translation: And they shall eat those things wherewith atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאִם־יִוָּתֵ֞ר מִבְּשַׂ֧ר הַמִּלֻּאִ֛ים וּמִן־הַלֶּ֖חֶם עַד־הַבֹּ֑קֶר וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֤ אֶת־הַנּוֹתָר֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵ֖ל כִּי־קֹ֥דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'myvtr mbshr hml'ym vmnhlchm 'dhbqr vshrpt 'thnvtr b'sh l' y'khl khyqdsh hv'
verses.translation: And if aught of the flesh of the consecration, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire; it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לְאַהֲרֹ֤ן וּלְבָנָיו֙ כָּ֔כָה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּ֖יתִי אֹתָ֑כָה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תְּמַלֵּ֥א יָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shyt l'hrn vlbnyv khkhh khkhl 'shrtsvyty 'tkhh shb't ymym tml' ydm
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee; seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפַ֨ר חַטָּ֜את תַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה לַיּוֹם֙ עַל־הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּכַפֶּרְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּמָֽשַׁחְתָּ֥ אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vpr cht't t'shh lyvm 'lhkhprym vcht't 'lhmzbch bkhprkh 'lyv vmshcht 'tv lqdshv
verses.translation: And every day shalt thou offer the bullock of sin-offering, beside the other offerings of atonement; and thou shalt do the purification upon the altar when thou makest atonement for it; and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֖ אֹת֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֔ים כׇּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בַּמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shb't ymym tkhpr 'lhmzbch vqdsht 'tv vhyh hmzbch qdsh qdshym khlhng' bmzbch yqdsh {s}
verses.translation: Seven days thou shalt make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; thus shall the altar be most holy; whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם לַיּ֖וֹם תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vzh 'shr t'shh 'lhmzbch khbshym bnyshnh shnym lyvm tmyd
verses.translation: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar: two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַכֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַבֹּ֑קֶר וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'thkhbsh h'chd t'shh bbqr v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym
verses.translation: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at dusk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעִשָּׂרֹ֨ן סֹ֜לֶת בָּל֨וּל בְּשֶׁ֤מֶן כָּתִית֙ רֶ֣בַע הַהִ֔ין וְנֵ֕סֶךְ רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִ֖ין יָ֑יִן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'shrn slt blvl bshmn khtyt rb' hhyn vnskh rby't hhyn yyn lkhbsh h'chd
verses.translation: And with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mingled with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּמִנְחַ֨ת הַבֹּ֤קֶר וּכְנִסְכָּהּ֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔הּ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym khmncht hbqr vkhnskhh t'shhlh lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at dusk, and shalt do thereto according to the meal-offering of the morning, and according to the drink-offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אִוָּעֵ֤ד לָכֶם֙ שָׁ֔מָּה לְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: 'lt tmyd ldrtykhm ptch 'hlmv'd lpny yhvh 'shr 'v'd lkhm shmh ldbr 'lykh shm
verses.translation: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the door of the tent of meeting before the LORD, where I will meet with you, to speak there unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹעַדְתִּ֥י שָׁ֖מָּה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנִקְדַּ֖שׁ בִּכְבֹדִֽי׃
verses.translit: vn'dty shmh lbny yshr'l vnqdsh bkhbdy
verses.translation: And there I will meet with the children of Israel; and [the Tent] shall be sanctified by My glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֧ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֛יו אֲקַדֵּ֖שׁ לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: vqdshty 't'hl mv'd v'thmzbch v't'hrn v'tbnyv 'qdsh lkhhn ly
verses.translation: And I will sanctify the tent of meeting, and the altar; Aaron also and his sons will I sanctify, to minister to Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vshkhnty btvkh bny yshr'l vhyyty lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֧אתִי אֹתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְשׇׁכְנִ֣י בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tm m'rts mtsrym lshkhny btvkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm {p}
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt mzbch mqtr qtrt 'tsy shtym t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon; of acacia-wood shalt thou make it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַמָּ֨ה אׇרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רׇחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'mh 'rkhv v'mh rchbv rbv' yhyh v'mtym qmtv mmnv qrntyv
verses.translation: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be; and two cubits shall be the height thereof; the horns thereof shall be of one piece with it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vtspyt 'tv zhb thvr 'tggv v'tqyrtyv sbyb v'tqrntyv v'shyt lv zr zhb sbyb
verses.translation: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־לּ֣וֹ  מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vshty tb't zhb t'shhlv  mtcht lzrv 'l shty tsl'tyv t'shh 'lshny tsdyv vhyh lbtym lbdym lsh't 'tv bhmh
verses.translation: And two golden rings shalt thou make for it under the crown thereof, upon the two ribs thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make them; and they shall be for places for staves wherewith to bear it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'thbdym 'tsy shtym vtspyt 'tm zhb
verses.translation: And thou shalt make the staves of acacia-wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: vntth 'tv lpny hprkht 'shr 'l'rn h'dt lpny hkhprt 'shr 'lh'dt 'shr 'v'd lkh shmh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the ark-cover that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vhqtyr 'lyv 'hrn qtrt smym bbqr bbqr bhytybv 'thnrt yqtyrnh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall burn thereon incense of sweet spices; every morning, when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbh'lt 'hrn 'thnrt byn h'rbym yqtyrnh qtrt tmyd lpny yhvh ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at dusk, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: l't'lv 'lyv qtrt zrh v'lh vmnchh vnskh l' tskhv 'lyv
verses.translation: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt-offering, nor meal-offering; and ye shall pour no drink-offering thereon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ־קׇדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhpr 'hrn 'lqrntyv 'cht bshnh mdm cht't hkhprym 'cht bshnh ykhpr 'lyv ldrtykhm qdshqdshym hv' lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Aaron shall make atonement upon the horns of it once in the year; with the blood of the sin-offering of atonement once in the year shall he make atonement for it throughout your generations; it is most holy unto the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת־רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לַיהֹוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy tsh' 'tr'sh bnyyshr'l lpqdyhm vntnv 'ysh khpr npshv lyhvh bpqd 'tm vl'yhyh bhm ngf bpqd 'tm
verses.translation: ’When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel, according to their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֣ה  יִתְּנ֗וּ כׇּל־הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: zh  ytnv khlh'br 'lhpqdym mchtsyt hshql bshql hqdsh 'shrym grh hshql mchtsyt hshql trvmh lyhvh
verses.translation: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary—the shekel is twenty gerahs—half a shekel for an offering to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khl h'br 'lhpqdym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh ytn trvmt yhvh
verses.translation: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא־יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: h'shyr l'yrbh vhdl l' ym'yt mmchtsyt hshql ltt 'ttrvmt yhvh lkhpr 'lnpshtykhm
verses.translation: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת־כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ עַל־עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vlqcht 'tkhsf hkhprym m't bny yshr'l vntt 'tv 'l'bdt 'hl mv'd vhyh lbny yshr'l lzkhrvn lpny yhvh lkhpr 'lnpshtykhm {p}
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the atonement money from the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tent of meeting, that it may be a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD, to make atonement for your souls.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנּ֥וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרׇחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ בֵּֽין־אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'shyt khyvr nchsht vkhnv nchsht lrchtsh vntt 'tv byn'hl mv'd vbyn hmzbch vntt shmh mym
verses.translation: ’Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and the base thereof of brass, whereat to wash; and thou shalt put it between the tent of meeting and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vrchtsv 'hrn vbnyv mmnv 'tydyhm v'trglyhm
verses.translation: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ־מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bb'm 'l'hl mv'd yrchtsvmym vl' ymtv 'v bgshtm 'lhmzbch lshrt lhqtyr 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: when they go into the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to cause an offering made by fire to smoke unto the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חׇק־עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥וֹ וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrchtsv ydyhm vrglyhm vl' ymtv vhyth lhm chq'vlm lv vlzr'v ldrtm {p}
verses.translation: so they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not; and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מׇר־דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְקִנְּמׇן־בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה־בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'th qchlkh bshmym r'sh mrdrvr chmsh m'vt vqnmnbshm mchtsytv chmshym vm'tym vqnhbshm chmshym vm'tym
verses.translation: ’Take thou also unto thee the chief spices, of flowing myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין׃
verses.translit: vqdh chmsh m'vt bshql hqdsh vshmn zyt hyn
verses.translation: and of cassia five hundred, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of olive oil a hin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'tv shmn mshchtqdsh rqch mrqcht m'shh rqch shmn mshchtqdsh yhyh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make it a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖וֹ אֶת־אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃
verses.translit: vmshcht bv 't'hl mv'd v't 'rvn h'dt
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint therewith the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'thshlchn v'tkhlkhlyv v'thmnrh v'tkhlyh v't mzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: and the table and all the vessels thereof, and the candlestick and the vessels thereof, and the altar of incense,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tmzbch h'lh v'tkhlkhlyv v'thkhyr v'tkhnv
verses.translation: and the altar of burnt-offering with all the vessels thereof, and the laver and the base thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֑ים כׇּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vqdsht 'tm vhyv qdsh qdshym khlhng' bhm yqdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy; whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v't'hrn v'tbnyv tmshch vqdsht 'tm lkhhn ly
verses.translation: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto Me in the priest’s office.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת־קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lbny yshr'l tdbr l'mr shmn mshchtqdsh yhyh zh ly ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying: This shall be a holy anointing oil unto Me throughout your generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּ֨בְמַתְכֻּנְתּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lbshr 'dm l' yyskh vbmtkhntv l' t'shv khmhv qdsh hv' qdsh yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: Upon the flesh of man shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any like it, according to the composition thereof; it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל־זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shr yrqch khmhv v'shr ytn mmnv 'lzr vnkhrt m'myv {s}
verses.translation: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, he shall be cut off from his people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח־לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף ׀ וּשְׁחֵ֙לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh qchlkh smym ntf  vshchlt vchlbnh smym vlbnh zkhh bd bbd yhyh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; sweet spices with pure frankincense; of each shall there be a like weight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: v'shyt 'th qtrt rqch m'shh rvqch mmlch thvr qdsh
verses.translation: And thou shalt make of it incense, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּ֘נָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshchqt mmnh hdq vntth mmnh lpny h'dt b'hl mv'd 'shr 'v'd lkh shmh qdsh qdshym thyh lkhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with thee; it shall be unto you most holy. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqtrt 'shr t'shh bmtkhnth l' t'shv lkhm qdsh thyh lkh lyhvh
verses.translation: And the incense which thou shalt make, according to the composition thereof ye shall not make for yourselves; it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shry'shh khmvh lhrych bh vnkhrt m'myv {s}
verses.translation: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereof, he shall be cut off from his people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: r'h qr'ty bshm btsl'l bn'vry bnchvr lmth yhvdh
verses.translation: ’See, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחׇכְמָ֛ה וּבִתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכׇל־מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ml' 'tv rvch 'lhym bchkhmh vbtbvnh vbd't vbkhlml'khh
verses.translation: and I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: lchshb mchshbt l'shvt bzhb vbkhsf vbnchsht
verses.translation: to devise skilful works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכׇל־מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vbchrsht 'bn lml't vbchrsht 'ts l'shvt bkhlml'khh
verses.translation: and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת אׇהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְמַטֵּה־דָ֔ן וּבְלֵ֥ב כׇּל־חֲכַם־לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חׇכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'ny hnh ntty 'tv 't 'hly'b bn'chysmkh lmthdn vblb khlchkhmlb ntty chkhmh v'shv 't khl'shr tsvytkh
verses.translation: And I, behold, I have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all that are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ת  אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֶת־הָֽאָרֹן֙ לָֽעֵדֻ֔ת וְאֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כׇּל־כְּלֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: 't  'hl mv'd v'th'rn l'dt v'thkhprt 'shr 'lyv v't khlkhly h'hl
verses.translation: the tent of meeting, and the ark of the testimony, and the ark-cover that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the Tent;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־הַמְּנֹרָ֥ה הַטְּהֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: v'thshlchn v'tkhlyv v'thmnrh hthrh v'tkhlkhlyh v't mzbch hqtrt
verses.translation: and the table and its vessels, and the pure candlestick with all its vessels, and the altar of incense;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־כׇּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־הַכִּיּ֖וֹר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tmzbch h'lh v'tkhlkhlyv v'thkhyvr v'tkhnv
verses.translation: and the altar of burnt-offering with all its vessels, and the laver and its base;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַשְּׂרָ֑ד וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v't bgdy hshrd v'tbgdy hqdsh l'hrn hkhhn v'tbgdy bnyv lkhhn
verses.translation: and the plaited garments, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְאֶת־קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים לַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִ֖ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't shmn hmshchh v'tqtrt hsmym lqdsh khkhl 'shrtsvytkh y'shv {p}
verses.translation: and the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place; according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th dbr 'lbny yshr'l l'mr 'kh 'tshbtty tshmrv khy 'vt hv' byny vbynykhm ldrtykhm ld't khy 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: ’Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying: Verily ye shall keep My sabbaths, for it is a sign between Me and you throughout your generations, that ye may know that I am the LORD who sanctify you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָכֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֙יהָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כׇּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בָהּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'thshbt khy qdsh hv' lkhm mchllyh mvt yvmt khy khlh'shh bh ml'khh vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mqrb 'myh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore, for it is holy unto you; every one that profaneth it shall surely be put to death; for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָ֑ה כׇּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.translit: shsht ymym y'shh ml'khh vbyvm hshby'y shbt shbtvn qdsh lyhvh khlh'shh ml'khh byvm hshbt mvt yvmt
verses.translation: Six days shall work be done; but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the LORD; whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vshmrv bnyyshr'l 'thshbt l'shvt 'thshbt ldrtm bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byny vbyn bny yshr'l 'vt hv' l'lm khyshsht ymym 'shh yhvh 'thshmym v'th'rts vbyvm hshby'y shbt vynpsh {s}
verses.translation: It is a sign between Me and the children of Israel for ever; for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day He ceased from work and rested.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֤ר אִתּוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָעֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vytn 'lmshh khkhltv ldbr 'tv bhr syny shny lcht h'dt lcht 'bn khtbym b'tsb' 'lhym
verses.translation: And He gave unto Moses, when He had made an end of speaking with him upon mount Sinai, the two tables of the testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־בֹשֵׁ֥שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָרֶ֣דֶת מִן־הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעָ֜ם עַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ ק֣וּם  עֲשֵׂה־לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵֽלְכוּ֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כִּי־זֶ֣ה  מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֙נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' h'm khybshsh mshh lrdt mnhhr vyqhl h'm 'l'hrn vy'mrv 'lyv qvm  'shhlnv 'lhym 'shr ylkhv lpnynv khyzh  mshh h'ysh 'shr h'lnv m'rts mtsrym l' yd'nv mhhyh lv
verses.translation: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him: ‘Up, make us a god who shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן פָּֽרְקוּ֙ נִזְמֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאׇזְנֵ֣י נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָבִ֖יאוּ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'hrn prqv nzmy hzhb 'shr b'zny nshykhm bnykhm vbntykhm vhby'v 'ly
verses.translation: And Aaron said unto them: ‘Break off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ֙ כׇּל־הָעָ֔ם אֶת־נִזְמֵ֥י הַזָּהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאׇזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.translit: vytprqv khlh'm 'tnzmy hzhb 'shr b'znyhm vyby'v 'l'hrn
verses.translation: And all the people broke off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מִיָּדָ֗ם וַיָּ֤צַר אֹתוֹ֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶט וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyqch mydm vytsr 'tv bchrt vy'shhv 'gl mskhh vy'mrv 'lh 'lhykh yshr'l 'shr h'lvkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And he received it at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, and made it a molten calf; and they said: ‘This is thy god, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיִּקְרָ֤א אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר חַ֥ג לַיהֹוָ֖ה מָחָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'hrn vybn mzbch lpnyv vyqr' 'hrn vy'mr chg lyhvh mchr
verses.translation: And when Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said: ‘To-morrow shall be a feast to the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֙ימוּ֙ מִֽמׇּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּעֲל֣וּ עֹלֹ֔ת וַיַּגִּ֖שׁוּ שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב הָעָם֙ לֶֽאֱכֹ֣ל וְשָׁת֔וֹ וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ לְצַחֵֽק׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhymv mmchrt vy'lv 'lt vygshv shlmym vyshb h'm l'khl vshtv vyqmv ltschq {p}
verses.translation: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt-offerings, and brought peace-offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to make merry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה לֶךְ־רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lmshh lkhrd khy shcht 'mkh 'shr h'lyt m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto Moses: ‘Go, get thee down; for thy people, that thou broughtest up out of the land of Egypt, have dealt corruptly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־לוֹ֙ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ל֔וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: srv mhr mnhdrkh 'shr tsvytm 'shv lhm 'gl mskhh vyshtchvvlv vyzbchvlv vy'mrv 'lh 'lhykh yshr'l 'shr h'lvkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: they have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed unto it, and said: This is thy god, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lmshh r'yty 'th'm hzh vhnh 'mqshh'rf hv'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses: ‘I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הַנִּ֣יחָה לִּ֔י וְיִֽחַר־אַפִּ֥י בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכַלֵּ֑ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: v'th hnychh ly vychr'py bhm v'khlm v''shh 'vtkh lgvy gdvl
verses.translation: Now therefore let Me alone, that My wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of thee a great nation.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְחַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָמָ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ יֶחֱרֶ֤ה אַפְּךָ֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֙אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל וּבְיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vychl mshh 'tpny yhvh 'lhyv vy'mr lmh yhvh ychrh 'pkh b'mkh 'shr hvts't m'rts mtsrym bkhch gdvl vbyd chzqh
verses.translation: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said: ‘LORD, why doth Thy wrath wax hot against Thy people, that Thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֩מָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר בְּרָעָ֤ה הֽוֹצִיאָם֙ לַהֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָם֙ בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּ֨לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lmh y'mrv mtsrym l'mr br'h hvtsy'm lhrg 'tm bhrym vlkhltm m'l pny h'dmh shvb mchrvn 'pkh vhnchm 'lhr'h l'mkh
verses.translation: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, saying: For evil did He bring them forth, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from Thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against Thy people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹ֡ר לְאַבְרָהָם֩ לְיִצְחָ֨ק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ לָהֶם֮ בָּךְ֒ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת־זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכׇל־הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶתֵּן֙ לְזַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וְנָחֲל֖וּ לְעֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: zkhr l'brhm lytschq vlyshr'l 'bdykh 'shr nshb't lhm bkh vtdbr 'lhm 'rbh 'tzr'khm khkhvkhby hshmym vkhlh'rts hz't 'shr 'mrty 'tn lzr'khm vnchlv l'lm
verses.translation: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, Thy servants, to whom Thou didst swear by Thine own self, and saidst unto them: I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּנָּ֖חֶם יְהֹוָ֑ה עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְעַמּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vynchm yhvh 'lhr'h 'shr dbr l'shvt l'mv {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD repented of the evil which He said He would do unto His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
